en.description: Activations appear mainly in contexts where reports, records, or sources are used to explain, list, or label information; other cases include the fixed parenthetical “it may be said,” source and reporting assessments, media interviews, quoted legends, medical diagnosis, statements of uncertainty, and political figures’ television appearances. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Statements in reports, records, and information
patterns.context: Uses report, record, or sources as information sources, with verbs such as indicate, establish, list, and label describing their contents, evidence, or uncertainty; common nearby structures include does/not, it, and that.
patterns.domain: Legal records, news reports, and location information

patterns.name: Parenthetical expression “it may be said”
patterns.context: “it may be said” functions as a parenthetical that qualifies or modifies the preceding statement; a report or evidence context is not required.

patterns.name: Source and reporting assessments
patterns.context: Discusses how different sources, interpretations, or reports handle unverified allegations; emphasizes information sources and their credibility or differences.

patterns.name: Media appearances and interviews
patterns.context: Biographical entries list media appearances, interviews, or regular contributions, with nearby terms such as radio, television, and on.

patterns.name: Legends and what they claim
patterns.context: Uses a fixed expression to introduce what a legend or traditional narrative claims.

patterns.name: Medical diagnosis and disease classification
patterns.context: Medical texts list diseases and abbreviations and state the capabilities or limitations of diagnostic tests.

patterns.name: Uncertainty and its source
patterns.context: Explicitly states that a location or fact is uncertain and mentions a source’s location designation.

patterns.name: Political figures’ statements on media programs
patterns.context: News reports describe political figures appearing on television programs and advancing an issue or exerting pressure on the program.

11_225.description: 激活主要出现在报告、记录或来源被用来说明、列举或标注信息的语境；另覆盖固定插入语“it may be said”、来源与报道评价、媒体采访、传说引述、医学诊断、不确定性说明及政治人物电视露面，缺乏单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 报告、记录及信息的陈述
patterns.trigger: “The officer's accident report does not indicate… it does, however, indicate…”（1）；“The record does not establish…”（3）；“The report went on to list…”（5）；“Some sources label…”（9）
patterns.context: 以 report、record 或 sources 为信息来源，用 indicate、establish、list、label 等动词说明其内容、证据或不确定性；邻近常见 does/not、it、that 等陈述结构。
patterns.domain: 法律记录、新闻报道、地点资料

patterns.name: it may be said 的插入表达
patterns.trigger: “to which she had been almost, it may be said, brought up”
patterns.context: “it may be said”作为插入语，限定或修饰前面的说法；不要求报告或证据语境。

patterns.name: 来源与报道评价
patterns.trigger: “Other sources, of course, have different interpretations”；“sources”
patterns.context: 讨论不同来源、解释或报道如何处理未经核实的指控；强调信息来源及其可信度或差异。

patterns.name: 媒体露面与采访
patterns.trigger: “public radio and television appearances”；“interviewed frequently on National Public Radio”
patterns.context: 人物简介中列举媒体露面、采访或定期贡献，附近出现 radio、television、on 等词。

patterns.name: 传说及其所称内容
patterns.context: 以固定表达引出传说或传统叙述所称的内容。

patterns.name: 医学诊断与疾病分类
patterns.trigger: “No single diagnostic test can accurately diagnose…”
patterns.context: 医学文本列举疾病及缩写，并陈述诊断测试的能力或局限。

patterns.name: 不确定性及其来源
patterns.trigger: “Location Uncertainty”；“where the station was located is uncertain”
patterns.context: 明确指出地点或事实不确定，并提及来源对位置的标注。

patterns.name: 政治人物在媒体节目中的表态
patterns.trigger: “Mr. Obama, in an appearance on NBC's ‘Meet the Press,’”
patterns.context: 新闻报道描述政治人物参加电视节目，并在节目中推动议题或施压。

en.description: Activations are scattered across copulas, legal procedure and allegation language, statements of reports and data, news paraphrases, medical definitions and classifications, as well as contrastive connectives; no single stable lexical or semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: be in clauses
patterns.context: Activations often fall on be verbs or nearby, especially copulas, passive structures, or auxiliary constructions in formal narratives, definitions, and judgments; not every instance can be unified this way.
patterns.domain: Written narrative, news, legal, and academic texts

patterns.name: Legal allegations and litigation language
patterns.context: Litigation procedures, allegations, evidence, or sworn statements; activations are scattered across legal formulae and related words.

patterns.name: Statements of reports, evidence, and results
patterns.context: Related nouns and surrounding statement words activate when citing reports, describing data, or summarizing research results.
patterns.domain: News, academic abstracts, or science reporting

patterns.name: Paraphrases and sources in reporting
patterns.context: News texts paraphrase someone’s claims, identify sources, or cite reports.

patterns.name: Academic classification and definition statements
patterns.context: Defines and classifies medical terms and lists subtypes.

patterns.name: Contrast and transition markers
patterns.context: Introduces contrast, qualification, or transition after stating facts or evidence.

patterns.name: Isolated neutral connectives or function words
patterns.context: These high-frequency words activate sporadically across contexts, with no consistent collocation or semantic condition.

11_225.description: 激活分散于正式书面语中的系词、法律程序与指控措辞、报告及数据陈述、新闻转述和医学定义分类，也涉及转折连接；没有单一稳定的词汇或语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 从句中的 be
patterns.trigger: « it»« may»« be»« said»；« is»，« is»；« was»
patterns.context: 激活常落在 be 动词或其附近，尤其是正式叙述、定义、判断中的系词、被动结构或助动结构；并非每个实例都能据此归一。
patterns.domain: 书面叙述、新闻、法律、学术文本

patterns.name: 法律指控与诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: « indictment»、« charge»、« failed»、« to»« sufficiently»；« affidavits»、« aver»
patterns.context: 诉讼程序、指控、证据或宣誓陈述语境；激活散布在法律固定表达及相关词上。

patterns.name: 报告、证据与结果的陈述
patterns.context: 引用报告、说明数据或概述研究结果时，相关名词及其周边陈述词激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、学术摘要或科普报道

patterns.name: 报道中的转述与来源
patterns.context: 新闻文本中转述某人说法、交代消息来源或引用报道。

patterns.name: 分类与定义式学术表述
patterns.context: 对医学术语进行定义、分类并列出亚型。

patterns.name: 对比与转折标记
patterns.context: 在陈述事实或证据后引出对比、修正或转折。

patterns.name: 单独出现的中性连接或功能词
patterns.context: 这些高频词在不同语境中零散激活，未显示一致的特定搭配或语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres and often fall on English syntactic transitions, quotations, or source and media expressions in reporting; legal and medical passages also show strong activations, but no clear lexical pattern unifies all examples.

patterns.name: Quotation expressions and complement structures
patterns.context: Auxiliary verbs, copulas, or prepositions in English sentences connect to following participial or quotation expressions; in some examples, the relation may simply be syntactic adjacency.

patterns.name: News sources and reporting
patterns.context: News or informational texts mention news sources, differences among sources, or uncertainty about location information.

patterns.name: Media organizations, radio, and television
patterns.context: Involves television programs, interview broadcasts, or radio program production and distribution.

patterns.name: Statements and evidence in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal texts describe affidavits, testimony, or parties’ actions; activations fall at common narrative transitions in legal documents.

patterns.name: Medical classification definitions
patterns.context: Medical descriptions open with terms, definitions, and classification entries.

11_225.description: 激活分散于多种文体，常落在英语句法衔接、引述或报道中的来源与媒体表达；法律、医学段落也有较强激活，但未见能统一解释所有例子的明确词汇模式。

patterns.name: 引述表达与补语结构
patterns.trigger: « may»10« be»8« said»3；« was»4« fond»3« of»10« describing；« said»4« in»4« mastery
patterns.context: 英语句子中的助动词、系动词或介词与后续分词/引述表达相连；个别例子里也可能只是句法邻接。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、哲学论述、诗歌

patterns.name: 消息来源与报道
patterns.context: 新闻或资料性文本提及消息来源、来源差异或地点信息的不确定性。

patterns.name: 媒体机构及广播电视
patterns.trigger: « producers»6« of»7« the»5« Fox»7« TV»8« show»9；« on»5« the»7« air»4；« radio»4« program»2
patterns.context: 涉及电视节目、采访播出或广播节目制作与传播。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的陈述与证据
patterns.trigger: « affidavits»5« further»8 averred；« partnership meetings».»2 The
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述宣誓书、证词或当事人行为；激活落在法律文书常见的叙述衔接处。

patterns.name: 医学分类定义
patterns.context: 医学说明以术语、定义和分类条目开篇。

en.concept: Function words in English verb constructions
en.description: Primarily responds to infinitive to and constructions with may/would followed by a verb; other cases involve prediction/evidence vocabulary, statistical citations, report narratives, and an internal fragment of multifactorial. Several activations cannot be explained by one unified local pattern.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Occurs in an infinitive construction followed by a verb; appears across different fields and genres.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, academic and legal texts

patterns.name: Modal verb constructions
patterns.context: may/would followed by a bare verb; found in narrative and historical discussion contexts, respectively.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative and encyclopedic historical texts

patterns.name: Prediction- or estimation-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves statements about survival rates, predictors, or evidence, but trigger words and syntactic positions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Citation of statistical data
patterns.context: Numbers and reports of statistical results occur nearby in citations of government statistics.
patterns.domain: Public health and social policy discussion

patterns.name: Report introducing subsequent content
patterns.context: report is the subject, with went on to introducing the report’s subsequent list of items.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a multisyllabic word
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented word multifactorial; this passage shows no stable syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: it be at a sentence boundary
patterns.context: The sentence contains the parenthetical it may be said, followed by It is at the start of the next sentence; this may reflect a local high-frequency function-word collocation, but there are few instances.

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers without clear classification
patterns.context: Occurrences are in medical terminology, legal argument, and general copular constructions, with no clear shared local condition.

11_225.concept: 英语动词结构中的功能词
11_225.description: 主要响应不定式 to 及 may/would 等后接动词的结构；另见预测/证据词汇、统计引述、报告叙述和 multifactorial 词内片段。多处激活无法由统一局部模式解释。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤其是随后接动词原形的 to（如 «to»9 estimate、«to»9 list、«to»9 believe、«to»9 sufficiently）
patterns.context: 处于不定式结构中，后接动词；不同领域和文体均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 情态动词搭配
patterns.context: may/would 后接动词原形；分别出现于叙事和历史论述语境。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、百科历史文本

patterns.name: 预测或估计相关词汇
patterns.context: 涉及生存率、预测因子或证据的陈述，但触发词与句法位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 统计数据引述
patterns.context: 政府统计数据引述中，数字与统计结果的报告相邻。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、社会政策论述

patterns.name: 报告引出后续内容
patterns.context: 以 report 作主语，使用 went on to 引出报告后续列举内容。

patterns.name: 多音节词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 multifactorial 一词内部；该段未显示稳定的句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 句界处 it be
patterns.context: 句内有 it may be said 的插入语，后续句首又出现 It is；可能反映局部高频功能词搭配，但实例有限。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的零散触发
patterns.context: 分别位于医学术语、法律论证及一般系词结构中，未见共同而明确的局部条件。

en.description: The most prominent patterns are “as the name suggests/implies” and infinitive to; a few other examples activate in the legal quotation “it is stated” and the statistical-evidence lead-in “statistics show.” The corpus spans diverse fields.

patterns.name: “as the name…” expression
patterns.context: name activates most strongly in explanatory parentheticals such as “as the name suggests/implies.”
patterns.domain: Popular science explanations, educational texts, and product feature descriptions

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: to is followed by a bare verb, often to explain purpose, function, or legal interpretation; both to itself and nearby verbs activate.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal texts, news, and general expository prose

patterns.name: “it is” wording
patterns.context: In a legal quotation, it is introduces a statement, with strong activation on is.

patterns.name: Statistical data lead-in
patterns.context: Introduces subsequent facts using statistical data as evidence; show activates strongly.

11_225.concept: 说明性表达与不定式标记
11_225.description: 最突出的模式是“as the name suggests/implies”和不定式 to；此外，少数例子在法律引述的“it is stated”及统计证据引出语“statistics show”中也激活，语料领域多样。

patterns.name: “as the name…”表达
patterns.trigger: “as the« name» suggests”“as the« name» implies”
patterns.context: 在“as the name suggests/implies”一类说明性插入语中，name 激活最强。
patterns.domain: 科普说明、教育文本及产品功能介绍

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: “to« classify»”“to« evaluate»”“is« to» be construed”“to« list»”“to« predict”
patterns.context: to 后接动词原形，常用于说明目的、功能或法律解释；to 本身及邻近动词均有激活。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、新闻及一般说明文

patterns.name: “it is”措辞
patterns.context: 法律引文中以 it is 引出陈述，is 激活强。

patterns.name: 统计数据引出语
patterns.context: 以统计数据作为证据引出后续事实；show 激活强。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或社会议题研究

en.description: Activations often fall in statements defining or explaining meaning and research uses, especially “define/understand” constructions and purpose constructions describing how measures or methods are used for classification, diagnosis, prediction, or assessment; other cases include title explanations and accurate assessment.

patterns.name: Defining or interpreting legal terms in statutes
patterns.context: Legal texts explain how a term is defined in the case or law, or how statutory language should be understood; one example involves criminal charge terminology, another a cited precedent.

patterns.name: Statements of research results, classification, or assessment uses
patterns.context: Research or reviews state that a measure, method, or feature may participate in a process or be used for classification, diagnosis, prediction, or assessment; triggers often fall on functional relation words and purpose constructions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, clinical research, and reviews

patterns.name: Explanation of definitions and further classification
patterns.context: Medical literature first defines a disease or entity, then describes its subtypes.

patterns.name: Explanation of test-type names
patterns.context: Educational expository prose uses the name itself to introduce an explanation of a test type or term.

patterns.name: Expressions of precision or accurate assessment
patterns.context: Discusses improving measures to identify or assess different subtypes more accurately; the passage also involves precision medicine.
patterns.domain: Medical reviews and COPD subtype research

11_225.description: 激活常落在定义、解释含义及研究用途表述中，尤其是“定义/理解”结构，以及指标或方法用于分类、诊断、预测、评估的目的结构；另见题名释义与准确评估。

patterns.name: 法律条文中定义或解释法律术语
patterns.context: 法律文本中说明某术语在本案或法律中的定义，或解释立法文字应如何理解；一个例子是刑事指控用语，另一个是判例引文。

patterns.name: 研究结果、分类或评估的用途表述
patterns.context: 研究或综述中陈述某指标、方法或特征可能参与过程，或可用于分类、诊断、预测、评估；触发常落在功能关系词及目的结构上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、临床研究、综述

patterns.name: 定义与进一步分类的说明
patterns.context: 医学文献先给出疾病或实体的定义，继而说明其细分亚型。

patterns.name: 测验题型名称的释义
patterns.context: 教育说明文用名称本身来引出对题型或术语含义的解释。
patterns.domain: 教育、测量与评估说明文

patterns.name: 精确性或准确评估的表达
patterns.context: 讨论改进指标，以更准确地识别或评估不同亚型；段内同时涉及精准医疗。
patterns.domain: 医学综述、COPD 分型研究

en.description: Activations often fall in explanatory or judgment expressions: stating assessment or classification uses, defining terms, and also citing reports, attributing sources, and introducing legal quotations. The material is mainly medical discussion but spans multiple genres.

patterns.name: Assessing, classifying, or defining an object
patterns.context: Makes statements about an object’s function, determination, assessment, or classification; common forms include modal verb plus verb or definition/classification expressions.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, pathology, and clinical research; also other expository texts

patterns.name: Phrases expressing degree, manner, or term definitions
patterns.context: Describes the extent or accuracy of a practice, or explains a word’s meaning; activations fall on different tokens in the relevant phrases.
patterns.domain: Educational explanations, medical papers, and legal opinions

patterns.name: Narrative verbs introducing reports or cited material
patterns.context: Refers to narrative constructions in which a report continues to list information.

patterns.name: Attribution of uncertain information
patterns.context: Facts such as a location are uncertain, and a source is cited for its designation.

patterns.name: Introducing quoted content after a legal citation
patterns.context: After a case or legal reference, a formulaic expression introduces the following quoted text.

11_225.description: 激活多落在说明性、判定性表达中：提出评估或分类用途、界定术语，也包括引述报告、标注来源及引出法律引文；整体以医学论述为主，但跨越多个文体。

patterns.name: 评估、分类或定义对象
patterns.trigger: “might be involved”“could serve as a marker to classify”“metrics that more accurately assess”“can be helpful in the diagnosis”“to evaluate”“is defined as”“is further classified into”
patterns.context: 围绕对象的功能、判定、评估或分类作陈述；常见句式为情态动词加动词，或定义/分类表达。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、病理学及临床研究；亦见其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 表示程度、方式或术语界定的短语
patterns.trigger: “as the name implies”“broadly employed”“more accurately”“that term is herein defined”
patterns.context: 描述某做法的适用程度或准确性，或解释词语含义；激活落在相关短语中的不同 token 上。
patterns.domain: 教育说明、医学论文、法律判决

patterns.name: 报告或资料引述的叙述动词
patterns.context: 提及报告继续列举信息的叙述结构。
patterns.domain: 新闻或报告类说明文本

patterns.name: 不确定信息的来源标注
patterns.context: 对地点等事实存在不确定性，并用来源来说明其标注。

patterns.name: 法律引文后引出引述内容
patterns.context: 判例或法律资料引文后，以公式化表达引入后续引用文字。

en.concept: Subword and formatting fragments in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across internal fragments of technical terms, compound words, or identifiers; they also appear in question-opening formats, encyclopedia line breaks, and proper names. Apart from local formatting or subword features, the examples lack shared semantics.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in technical terms and proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments inside longer words or identifiers, often within compounds, technical terms, or code identifiers. The fragments differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Code, medicine and biology, physics, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Question mark at line start and line-break formatting
patterns.context: StackExchange questions begin with “Q:”, followed by a line break and then the question body; activations also cover the area near the start of the question.

patterns.name: Wikipedia timeline and entry formatting
patterns.context: Year-event pages repeatedly contain line breaks and column formatting; another example repeats a person’s name in the entry heading and title. The common formatting cue is uncertain.

patterns.name: HSCT abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in medical narratives about bone marrow failure-related diseases, transplantation, and patient susceptibility.

patterns.name: Dustan in a proper name
patterns.context: Triggered by repeated forms of the person’s name, “George Dustan”; there is insufficient evidence of a connection to other triggers.

patterns.name: Line-break and whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Timeline entries contain multiple blank lines and blank-line markers; this may be a formatting trigger rather than semantic content.

11_267.concept: 专业文本中的子词与格式片段
11_267.description: 激活分散在专业词、复合词或标识符的内部片段，也见于问答开头格式、百科换行排版及专名。除局部格式或子词特征外，各例缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 技术与专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词语或标识符内部的片段；常处于复合词、技术术语或代码标识符中。不同例子里的片段并不相同。
patterns.domain: 代码、医学与生物学、物理学、百科条目

patterns.name: 句首问号及换行格式
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题以“Q:”开头，随后换行，再进入问题正文；激活还覆盖问题句首附近。

patterns.name: 维基百科年表与条目排版
patterns.context: 年份事件页中反复出现换行和栏目排版；另一个例子是人物条目标题与姓名重复。共同格式线索不确定。

patterns.name: HSCT 缩写
patterns.context: 出现在骨髓衰竭相关疾病、移植及患者易感性的医学叙述中。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Dustan
patterns.context: 触发于人物名“George Dustan”的重复写法；未见足够证据说明与其他触发相连。

patterns.name: 换行与空白排版
patterns.context: 年表条目中有多处空行及空白行标记；可能是格式触发，而非语义内容。

en.concept: Primarily triggered by word-initial “For,” with sporadic other word-form triggers
en.description: Most strong activations fall on word-initial For across web, religious, medical, patent, and email genres; a few others occur on table/create in code, a word-final fragment of inflamed, and an internal fragment of conjugated, which are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Words beginning with For
patterns.context: For occurs at the beginning of a sentence or passage, followed by different types of phrases; it is triggered across several listed corpus domains.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including web, religious writing, medicine, patents, and email

patterns.name: Additional activation on words following For
patterns.context: Weaker additional activations occur when For is followed by centuries or addressing, and at a line break in an email sign-off; this does not occur in every For passage.

patterns.name: Non-For trigger fragments
patterns.context: These occur respectively on table create in code/database statements, inflamed in medical text (marked portion: «amed»), and conjugated in a chemistry paper (marked portion: «jug»); no shared condition is apparent across contexts.

11_267.concept: 词首“For”触发为主，另有零散词形触发
11_267.description: 多数强激活落在词首 For，跨网页、宗教、医学、专利和邮件等文体；另有少数代码中的 table/create、inflamed 的词尾片段及 conjugated 的词内片段，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: For 起始词
patterns.context: For 出现在句首或片段开头，后接不同类型的短语；在所列多个语料领域中均触发。
patterns.domain: 网页、宗教文字、医学、专利、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: For 后接词的附加激活
patterns.context: 分别在 For 后接 centuries、addressing，以及邮件结尾换行符时出现较弱的附加激活；并非每个 For 片段都有此现象。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文、电子邮件

patterns.name: 非 For 触发片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在代码/数据库语句中的 table create、医学文本中的 inflamed（标记部分为 «amed»）、以及化学论文中的 conjugated（标记部分为 «jug»）；上下文之间看不出共同条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、医学论文、化学论文

en.description: Activations broadly fall on split identifiers and special boundaries such as underscores and hyphens; code macros, dimension names, and build configurations are especially prominent. They also occur in medical vocabulary, academic text, email fields, and tabular formatting, without a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Special underscore markers
patterns.context: Underscore-separated naming fragments in code identifiers; segment 1 also appears near a request number

patterns.name: HPP/INCLUDED macro identifiers
patterns.context: Boost C++ header guards or related macro names, often accompanied by #define and copyright comments

patterns.name: Hyphen-linked phrases
patterns.context: Hyphens are marked separately, connecting internal word fragments or compounds; semantics and domains vary

patterns.name: Tab-separated formatting
patterns.context: Tabs create aligned or columnar formatting between words

patterns.name: Internal segmentation of specific drug names
patterns.context: Compound names or terms in pharmacology abstracts are split into multiple subword fragments

patterns.name: Sentence-initial/word-initial segmentation
patterns.context: A paragraph begins with a truncated word fragment, followed by a Roman numeral and a possessive

patterns.name: Request number and colon format
patterns.context: An email-style request field is followed by a number, abbreviation, and comma-separated values

patterns.name: Tensor shape and variable naming
patterns.context: Code output declares array/tensor dimensions adjacent to variable names

patterns.name: Hyphen in copyright year range
patterns.context: A year range in a copyright comment appears alongside a Boost macro and copyright line

patterns.name: Ordinary academic headings and abstract vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical titles or abstract text; apart from general punctuation/fragment segmentation, there is no clear shared trigger word

patterns.name: Go build rules and configuration strings
patterns.context: Rule files contain Go targets, build tags, and configuration names

patterns.name: Smart-pointer comment
patterns.context: A C++ header comment explains the non-owning semantics of Handle

11_267.concept: 特殊分隔符及片段边界
11_267.description: 激活广泛落在被切分的标识符、下划线与连字符等特殊边界上；代码宏、维度名和构建配置尤为突出，也见于医学词汇、学术文本、邮件字段及制表符排版，未显示单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 特殊下划线标记
patterns.context: 代码标识符中以下划线分隔的命名片段；段1还出现在请求编号附近

patterns.name: HPP/INCLUDED 宏标识符
patterns.context: Boost C++ 头文件保护宏或相关宏名，常伴随 #define、版权注释

patterns.name: 连字符连接的短语
patterns.context: 连字符被单独标出，连接词内片段或复合词；语义和领域各异
patterns.domain: 代码注释、医学/学术文本

patterns.name: 制表符分隔排版
patterns.trigger: «\t»（标记显示为制表符），反复出现在 “XVI's teachings” 段
patterns.context: 制表符在词语间形成对齐或分栏式排版

patterns.name: 特定药名内部切分
patterns.context: 药理学摘要中的化合物名或术语被切成多个子词片段

patterns.name: 句首/词首切分
patterns.context: 段落以被截断的单词片段开头，后接罗马数字和所有格

patterns.name: 请求编号与冒号格式
patterns.context: 邮件式请求字段后接编号、缩写及逗号分隔的数值

patterns.name: 张量形状与变量命名
patterns.context: 代码输出声明数组/张量维度，邻接变量名

patterns.name: 版权年份连字符
patterns.context: 版权注释中的年份范围，和 Boost 宏及版权行同时出现

patterns.name: 普通学术标题与摘要词汇
patterns.trigger: «Role»…«factor»-«ĸ»«B»；“Effects of the consumption of rice … selenium supplementation”
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要正文；除一般标点/片段切分外，没有明显共同触发词

patterns.name: Go 构建规则与配置字符串
patterns.context: 规则文件中出现 Go 目标、构建标签及配置名称

patterns.name: 智能指针注释
patterns.context: C++ 头文件注释说明 Handle 的非拥有语义

en.description: Activations are distributed across code and configuration, academic text, and medical abstracts. Clearer shared cues include tab/newline structure and hyphenated compounds; the rest are mostly passage-specific fields, terms, or sentence forms, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Field/indentation structure after tabs
patterns.context: In code or table-like data, tabs separate fields and often accompany line breaks and indentation; this is a clearly prominent marker across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: Github code, formatting/fields in academic text

patterns.name: Hyphens and compound-word boundaries
patterns.context: Hyphens join compounds or identifiers; in several passages, adjacent hyphen tokens themselves activate strongly, without a stable semantic-category restriction.
patterns.domain: Code, academic papers, and technical terms

patterns.name: Code field names and configuration keys
patterns.context: In code comments or structured configuration, field/key names occur near declarations, assignments, or JSON key-value pairs; indentation and line breaks are also common.
patterns.domain: Github source code, configuration, and JSON

patterns.name: Academic abstract and research-title wording
patterns.context: Formal nominal phrasing in paper abstracts or titles; activations are scattered across ordinary academic wording, with no specific word shared by all examples.

patterns.name: English possessives and quotation markers
patterns.context: In philosophical discussion, possessives and quoted terms appear in sentences distinguishing traditions and ideas; seen only in this passage.

patterns.name: Date/time and name strings in code test data
patterns.context: Sample attributes, names, and timestamps are provided as key-value pairs in a test-code template string.

patterns.name: Specific biochemical terms in a paper title
patterns.context: Compound technical terms describing a method and enzyme genotype in the title; there is insufficient evidence that the topic itself is a stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Combination of natural environment and supplements in medical text
patterns.context: A noun phrase at the start of an abstract, consisting of the study subject and supplementation; appears only in this passage.

patterns.name: Electrophoresis and water-sample descriptions in medical text
patterns.context: Phrasing in an abstract involving children, testing/assessment methods, and water samples; the terms are specific and difficult to group with other passages into a narrower common pattern.

patterns.name: Instability terminology in scientific abstracts
patterns.context: Astrophysics/fluid-physics term phrase following the abstract marker.

patterns.name: HIV mucosal transmission research phrasing
patterns.context: Research-topic phrase in a grant record, followed by the reason the study is limited.

patterns.name: Cloud-service cookie configuration values
patterns.context: Configuration code specifies a cookie policy or signing name as a string value, adjacent to field comments.

patterns.name: JSON banner configuration
patterns.context: Key-value pairs in a JSON object containing a banner type and URL; appears only in this passage.

11_267.concept: 排版边界与复合词标记
11_267.description: 激活分布在代码与配置、学术文本及医学摘要中。较清楚的共同线索是制表符/换行结构和连字符复合词；其余多为各段特有字段、术语或句式，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 制表符后的字段/缩进结构
patterns.context: 代码或类似表格的数据中，制表符用于分隔字段，常伴随换行和缩进；多个段落中这是明确突出的标记。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、学术文本中的排版/字段

patterns.name: 连字符及复合词边界
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合词或标识符；在若干段中相邻连字符 token 本身激活很强，未见稳定的语义类别限制。
patterns.domain: 代码、学术论文与技术术语

patterns.name: 代码字段名与配置键
patterns.context: 代码注释或结构化配置中，字段名/键名位于声明、赋值或 JSON 键值附近；同时常出现缩进与换行。

patterns.name: 学术摘要与研究标题措辞
patterns.trigger: «Effects of the consumption»、«Improved method for the identification»、«The evaluation of the effectiveness»、«Analysis of the saturation»、«Studies of the biology»
patterns.context: 论文摘要或标题中的正式名词化表述；激活散布在普通学术措辞中，缺少一个所有样例共享的特定词项。

patterns.name: 英文所有格与引文标记
patterns.context: 哲学论述中，所有格及引号内术语出现在关于传统与思想区分的句子中；仅见于此段。

patterns.name: 代码测试数据中的日期时间与人名字符串
patterns.context: 测试代码的模板字符串内，以键值形式给出样例属性、姓名和时间戳。

patterns.name: 论文题名中的特定生化术语
patterns.context: 标题中描述方法及酶基因型的复合专业术语；没有足够证据说明该主题本身是稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生化/医学论文标题

patterns.name: 医学文本中的自然环境与补充剂组合
patterns.trigger: «rice from non-KBD areas and selenium supplementation»
patterns.context: 摘要开头以研究对象和补充措施构成的名词短语；仅此段出现。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的电泳与水样描述
patterns.context: 摘要中涉及儿童、检测/评估方法及水样的表述；词项具体，难与其他段落归并为更窄的共同模式。

patterns.name: 科学摘要中的不稳定性术语
patterns.context: 摘要标记之后的天体/流体物理术语短语。

patterns.name: HIV 黏膜传播研究表述
patterns.context: 资助项目记录中的研究主题短语，后接研究受限的原因。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学项目描述

patterns.name: 云服务 Cookie 配置值
patterns.context: 配置代码中以字符串值指定 Cookie 策略或签名名称，并与字段注释相邻。

patterns.name: JSON 横幅配置
patterns.context: JSON 对象中的键值对，包含横幅类型和网址；仅此段出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to punctuation, numbers, keys, and identifiers in code and structured text; also covers R/Go code, tabular data, LaTeX math markers, and a few paper terms and subword fragments.

patterns.name: Structured-data and code punctuation
patterns.context: Activations fall on delimiters, brackets, operators, and neighboring tokens in structured sequences; often accompanied by field names, key-value pairs, or code expressions.
patterns.domain: JSON, program code, data frames, arrays, and other structured text

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers often occur in coordinates, measurements, array fields, tabular data, or code constants; some are contiguous with punctuation.
patterns.domain: Data records, code, tables, and numerical text

patterns.name: CamelCase identifiers and code names
patterns.context: Triggers occur in code identifiers whose names may join multiple words, mix capitalization, or contain underscores; activations are distributed across internal identifier tokens.

patterns.name: Field names, keys, and properties
patterns.context: Words serve as fields/keys in objects, JSON, or data structures, typically enclosed in quotation marks and adjacent to colons or assignment structures.
patterns.domain: JSON, program data structures, data-analysis code

patterns.name: R data wrangling and table operations
patterns.context: Occurs in R-style assignment and data-frame construction code, alongside column names, character vectors, and tabular data.

patterns.name: Go control flow and error handling
patterns.context: Conditionals, return statements, and error construction in Go code; activations also cover statement punctuation and string templates.

patterns.name: Ordinary words or specific word fragments in text
patterns.context: Occurs in natural-language sentences or paper text; activation positions involve internal word segmentation, as well as a few function words.

patterns.name: Networking and optical terms
patterns.context: Appears in papers discussing modulated optical signals, fiber sensing, and communications technology; the most prominent activation is «tele».
patterns.domain: Academic text on optics, fiber sensing, and communications

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical paper markers
patterns.context: Appears near theorem environments and formula notation in mathematical papers, alongside academic prose.

11_267.concept: 结构化代码与数据文本
11_267.description: 主要响应代码与结构化文本中的标点、数字、键名和标识符；另覆盖 R/Go 代码、表格数据、LaTeX 数学标记，以及少量论文术语和词片。

patterns.name: 结构化数据与代码标点
patterns.context: 激活落在结构化序列中的分隔符、括号、运算符及其邻近 token 上；常伴随字段名、键值或代码表达式。
patterns.domain: JSON、程序代码、数据框与数组等结构化文本

patterns.name: 数字与数值串
patterns.context: 数字常处于坐标、测量值、数组字段、表格数据或代码中的常量位置；部分数字与标点连续。
patterns.domain: 数据记录、代码、表格及数值文本

patterns.name: 驼峰式标识符与代码名称
patterns.context: 触发出现在代码标识符中，名称可能由多个词拼接、大小写混合或含下划线；激活分布在标识符内部 token。

patterns.name: 字段名、键名与属性
patterns.context: 词语作为对象、JSON 或数据结构中的字段/键，通常由引号包围并与冒号或赋值结构相邻。
patterns.domain: JSON、程序数据结构、数据分析代码

patterns.name: R 数据整理与表格操作
patterns.context: 出现在 R 风格的赋值和数据框构造代码中，伴随列名、字符向量及表格数据。

patterns.name: Go 控制流与错误处理
patterns.context: Go 代码中的条件判断、返回语句和错误构造；激活也覆盖语句标点与字符串模板。

patterns.name: 文本中的普通词语或特定词片
patterns.context: 出现在自然语言句子或论文文字中；激活位置涉及词内部切分，也包括少量句法词。
patterns.domain: 光纤传感论文、数学逻辑论文

patterns.name: 网络与光学术语
patterns.context: 论文讨论调制光信号、光纤传感及通信技术时出现；其中最突出的激活是 «tele»。
patterns.domain: 光学、光纤传感与通信学术文本

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学论文标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中定理环境和公式记号附近出现，伴随学术叙述。

en.description: Activations span various technical texts: HTML/XML tags and attributes, template configuration, JavaScript/jQuery, image-processing commands, and TikZ parameters. The shared feature is structured source code or technical syntax, but the specific triggering syntax varies.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup and attribute syntax
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, closing tags, and entity characters; often interspersed with indentation and line breaks.
patterns.domain: Web source code and technical documentation

patterns.name: Template and configuration syntax
patterns.context: Go templates use braces for conditions, includes, and configuration values.

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery code
patterns.context: Browser-side scripts containing objects, functions, selectors, and event-handling code.
patterns.domain: Web frontend programming Q&A and code

patterns.name: Command line and image processing
patterns.context: A sequence of shell commands for extracting and combining PDF images.

patterns.name: TikZ drawing parameters
patterns.context: LaTeX/TikZ environments and lists of drawing options.

11_267.concept: 技术标记与代码语法
11_267.description: 激活覆盖多种技术文本：HTML/XML 标签与属性、模板配置、JavaScript/jQuery、图像处理命令和 TikZ 参数。共同特点是结构化源码或技术语法，但具体触发语法并不统一。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记与属性语法
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性、结束标签及实体字符处；常夹杂缩进和换行。

patterns.name: 模板与配置语法
patterns.context: Go 模板中以大括号表达条件、include 和配置值。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的模板/配置代码

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery 代码
patterns.context: 浏览器端脚本中的对象、函数、选择器及事件处理代码。
patterns.domain: 网页前端编程问答与代码

patterns.name: 命令行与图像处理
patterns.context: 连续的 shell 命令，用于提取并拼接 PDF 图像。

patterns.name: TikZ 绘图参数
patterns.context: LaTeX/TikZ 环境及绘图选项列表。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code identifiers, configuration and test text, as well as specialized terms in technical documentation and papers; local triggers differ across passages, with no stable shared lexical or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Identifiers and configuration fields in code
patterns.context: In code or structured configuration, field names, property names, or identifiers are marked as split fragments; there is no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Test instructions and expected text
patterns.context: Instructions and expected diagnostic text appear together in compiler tests or test fixtures.

patterns.name: Numerical ranges and units
patterns.context: Coffee intake is described using numerical ranges and units after grouping study subjects.

patterns.name: Encryption keys and lifecycle
patterns.context: Describes the use and destruction of server-sent keys, signatures, and one-time prekeys.

patterns.name: Absorption lines and sample selection in astronomy

patterns.name: Command-line arguments and debugging configuration
patterns.context: Explains how to set environment variables and JVM arguments to debug Maven.

patterns.name: Account credentials and dependencies

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 激活分散于代码标识符、配置与测试文本，以及技术说明和论文中的专门术语；各段局部触发不同，未见稳定共享的词汇或语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与配置字段
patterns.context: 代码或结构化配置中，字段名、属性名或标识符被拆分标记；没有统一的语义主题。
patterns.domain: Github 代码与 JSON 配置

patterns.name: 测试指令与预期文本
patterns.context: 编译器测试或测试夹具中，指令与预期诊断文本相邻。

patterns.name: 数值范围及单位说明
patterns.trigger: 「0-12 cups caffeinated coffee」「3-4 cups of caffe...」
patterns.context: 研究对象分组后，用数值范围和单位说明咖啡摄入量。

patterns.name: 加密密钥与生命周期
patterns.trigger: 「signed pre key bundle」「fixed keys」「unsigned pre keys」「disposes of the pre key」
patterns.context: 描述服务器发送密钥、签名及一次性预密钥的使用和销毁。

patterns.name: 天文学中的吸收线与样本选择

patterns.name: 命令行参数和调试配置

patterns.domain: Github 脚本注释与 Java 工具文档

patterns.name: 账户凭据与依赖关系

en.description: Activation positions across the ten passages show no clear unified semantics: most are local structures, identifiers, and punctuation fragments in code or legal/technical text, including command arguments, comment tags, method calls, fields, log class names, and statutory citations; the common pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Command arguments and hyphen options
patterns.context: PowerShell commands and their parameters; `-` is followed by a parameter name beginning with an uppercase letter, near a command name and parameter value.

patterns.name: Chart plugin comments
patterns.context: A Flot plugin name in an HTML comment; discusses drawing donut or bar charts.

patterns.name: Plotting call arguments
patterns.context: Dot-separated graphics method calls in code, followed by parentheses and arguments such as coordinates and colors.

patterns.name: Financial rule wording
patterns.context: Formal text about price fluctuation limits and the amendment and scope of related rules.

patterns.name: Designer-generated code documentation
patterns.context: C# auto-generated code regions and XML documentation comments describing designer support methods.

patterns.name: Compiler directives and diagnostic strings
patterns.context: Expected compiler warning text and quoted options appear near an OpenCL pragma.

patterns.name: Version properties and comment tags
patterns.context: XML-style documentation comments and summary tags follow code properties/accessors.

patterns.name: Tokenization of class names in logs
patterns.context: A log line in Java startup error output, containing a package name, class name, and Loading message.

patterns.name: Geometry field names and comments
patterns.context: Consecutive declarations of geometric-shape fields in a struct or class, with comments explaining their meanings.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory section numbers
patterns.context: A legal discussion cites statutory sections and code numbers, and refers to judicial discretion.

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 覆盖十段的激活位置并无明显统一语义：多为代码或法律/技术文本中的局部结构、标识符与标点片段，包括命令参数、注释标签、方法调用、字段、日志类名及法条引文；共同规律不清。

patterns.name: 命令参数与连字符选项
patterns.context: PowerShell 命令及其参数；`-` 后接由大写开头的参数名，附近有命令名和参数值。

patterns.name: 图表插件注释
patterns.context: HTML 注释中的 Flot 插件名称；讨论绘制 donut 或 bar charts。

patterns.name: 绘图调用参数
patterns.context: 代码中点号分隔的图形方法调用，后跟括号及坐标、颜色等参数。

patterns.name: 交易规则法律措辞
patterns.context: 关于价格波动限制规则及其修订、适用范围的正式文字。

patterns.name: 设计器生成代码文档
patterns.context: C# 自动生成代码区域及 XML 文档注释，说明设计器支持方法。

patterns.name: 编译器指令与诊断字符串
patterns.context: OpenCL pragma 附近包含编译器预期警告文本及引号中的选项。

patterns.name: 版本属性及注释标签
patterns.context: 代码属性/访问器之后出现 XML 风格文档注释及 summary 标签。

patterns.name: 日志中的类名分词
patterns.context: Java 启动错误输出中的日志行，包含包名、类名和 Loading 消息。

patterns.name: 几何字段名与注释
patterns.context: 结构体或类中连续声明几何形状字段，并以注释解释其含义。

patterns.name: 法规引文与法条编号
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用法规章节、法典编号及法院裁量权。

en.concept: Explanation and description in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across technical documentation, code comments and configuration, explanations of identifiers, paired feature options, legal reasoning, physics-paper terminology, and stylesheet template syntax; there is no obvious unified lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Explanatory tone in code documentation
patterns.context: Sentences explaining or stating design decisions, often in code comments, documentation, and technical Q&A; activations fall on explanatory words and surrounding technical text.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, code comments, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Paired options, states, or feature descriptions in code
patterns.context: Lists or contrasts two features, options, states, or uses; common in code comments, configuration, and help text.

patterns.name: Programming identifiers and their definitions or explanations
patterns.context: Technical terms, identifiers, or component names occur alongside explanations of their meanings, properties, limitations, or usage.

patterns.name: Legal citations and reasoning
patterns.context: Cites statutory section numbers and explains their relation to a preceding section or legal rationale.

patterns.name: Model parameters and factorization terminology in scientific papers
patterns.context: Theoretical physics paper context discussing factorization methods and parameter values.

patterns.name: Stylesheet and template syntax in code
patterns.context: In CSS/preprocessor code, style declarations appear next to conditional, macro, or export syntax.

11_267.concept: 技术文本中的解释与说明
11_267.description: 激活分布于技术说明、代码注释与配置、标识符释义、成对功能选项，也涵盖法律条款推理、物理论文术语及样式模板语法；没有明显统一的词汇触发点。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的技术说明语气
patterns.trigger: “This means that”, “We decided to”, “In the example above”, “This library only supports”
patterns.context: 以解释、说明或陈述设计决定的句子为背景，常见于代码注释、文档和技术问答；激活落在说明性词语及周围技术文本上。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、代码注释、技术问答

patterns.name: 代码中成对的选项、状态或功能说明
patterns.trigger: “allows the chart to redraw”, “also used to draw donut charts”, “cut buffer and selection”, “disable smooth transitions”, “wait for native BacklightHandler”
patterns.context: 列举或对照两个功能、选项、状态或用途；多见于代码注释、配置和帮助文本。

patterns.name: 编程标识符及其定义或解释
patterns.context: 技术名词、标识符或组件名与其含义、属性、限制或用法同时出现。

patterns.name: 法律条款的引证与推理
patterns.context: 引用法条编号，并在法律论述中解释其与前条或法律理由的关系。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的模型参数与因子化术语
patterns.context: 理论物理论文语境，讨论因子化方法及参数取值。

patterns.name: 代码中的样式与模板语法
patterns.context: CSS／预处理器代码中，样式声明与条件、宏或导出语法相邻。

en.concept: Explanatory and help-seeking language in technical contexts
en.description: A set of passages highlights We/we need to, decisions, and to-do phrasing in code comments; another uses help-seeking forms such as way to…/I can… in Q&A. The rest concern clipboard switching, API parameter documentation, and numeric configuration code, with no shared trigger word.

patterns.name: First-person plural comments
patterns.context: Code comments use We/we to describe design decisions, required steps, or to-do items; activations often fall on We, need, to, and similar words.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments and technical documentation

patterns.name: Expressions of means and ability in questions
patterns.context: Questions ask whether there is a way to do something, often using way to… or I can…; no specific technical topic is required.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and function descriptions
patterns.context: An entry in a clipboard-related enum or command describes switching between two objects; activations concentrate on interchange.

patterns.name: Constructor options in API documentation
patterns.context: A Markdown-formatted module API method description lists parameter types and explains their meanings.

patterns.name: Explicit casts in C/C++ example comments
patterns.context: Discusses compiler differences in handling templates or type conversions; a code example uses a comment to explain an explicit cast.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia technical articles and code examples

patterns.name: Numeric tables and comment fragments
patterns.context: Near numeric arrays, ranges, or configuration tables in code, followed by a default-value comment; activations highlight minus signs and whitespace.

11_267.concept: 技术语境中的说明与求助表达
11_267.description: 一组段落突出代码注释里的 We/we need to、决定及待办表达；另有问答中 way to…/I can… 的求助句式。其余分别涉及剪贴板切换、API 参数文档及数字配置代码，缺少共同触发词。

patterns.name: 第一人称复数评论
patterns.context: 代码注释中以 We/we 叙述设计决定、必要步骤或待办事项；激活常落在 We、need、to 等词上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释及技术文档

patterns.name: 提问中的方式与能力表达
patterns.context: 问句询问是否有办法完成某事，常见 way to… 或 I can… 的表达；不要求特定技术主题。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及功能说明
patterns.context: 剪贴板相关枚举或命令条目中，描述两个对象之间的切换；激活集中于 interchange。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码/命令帮助文本

patterns.name: API 文档中的构造器选项
patterns.context: Markdown 格式的模块 API 方法说明，列出参数类型并解释其含义。

patterns.name: C/C++ 示例注释中的显式转换
patterns.context: 讨论编译器处理模板或类型转换差异，代码示例以注释解释显式转换。
patterns.domain: 百科技术文章及代码示例

patterns.name: 数字表格与注释片段
patterns.context: 代码中的数字数组、范围或配置表附近，后接默认值注释；激活突出负号及空白。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on we, split identifiers, and technical terms in code comments that explain intent or compatibility. They also cover configuration parameters, user permissions, CSS, kernel registers, paper titles, and specific expressions in advertising, regulatory, and energy-related emails.

patterns.name: we / we don't in comments
patterns.context: Occurs in code comments, especially when explaining design intent, compatibility, or compiler behavior; activations concentrate on we and nearby words.
patterns.domain: GitHub source-code comments, programming explanations in Wikipedia

patterns.name: Multiword identifiers and their tokenization
patterns.context: CamelCase, snake_case, or concatenated uppercase identifiers in code, configuration, or technical documentation are split into multiple tokens; not all identifiers trigger equally.
patterns.domain: GitHub, software configuration, and technical materials

patterns.name: Technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Domain terms, compound terms, and explanatory text appear in science or engineering contexts; activations occur on the terms themselves and nearby common words.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, software documentation, programming materials, commercial energy emails

patterns.name: Expressions describing permission, change, or enablement
patterns.context: Describes actions users can perform, behavior permitted by a system, or features now supported.
patterns.domain: Technical comments, commercial software update notes

patterns.name: Specification parameters and configuration values
patterns.context: A parameter, property, or configuration item is followed by a type, number, unit, or default value; especially hyphenated parameter names and values.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, CSS configuration, machine-learning API documentation

patterns.name: Commercial products, prices, and transaction descriptions
patterns.context: Narratives about TV channel packages or financial regulations and transaction policies; no clear, consistent local trigger.
patterns.domain: Commercial advertisements, financial law, or corporate emails

patterns.name: Markdown headings and paper openings
patterns.context: A paper uses line breaks and underscore-style headings as separators before proceeding to the Introduction and introducing the research field.

patterns.name: CSS properties and important declarations
patterns.context: CSS declarations consist of properties and values and include the !default marker; activations cover some properties, punctuation, and values.

patterns.name: Explanation of padding in code
patterns.context: A convolution-layer parameter description lists padding as an optional integer and explains that zero padding is added on both sides.

patterns.name: Hardware registers and permission flags
patterns.context: CPU or architecture documentation discusses control registers, privileged flags, and changes to them.

patterns.name: Advertising language and offers
patterns.context: Promotional wording describes monthly fees, channel counts, and package prices.

patterns.name: Regulations and financial transaction history
patterns.context: Summarizes legal reforms, regulation names, and their authorization of specific financial transactions.

patterns.name: Energy product codes and valuation features
patterns.context: Lists energy-market products or system codes and describes the range of valuations they support.

11_267.concept: 技术文本中的说明性表达
11_267.description: 激活主要落在代码注释中说明意图或兼容性的 we、拆分的标识符和技术术语；也覆盖配置参数、用户权限、CSS、内核寄存器、论文标题及广告、法规和能源邮件中的具体表达。

patterns.name: 注释中的 we / we don't
patterns.trigger: « We»10« intentionally»；« compatibility»5« we»10« don»2«'t»7«；«//»5« we»9« need»4« to»7« explicitly»9« cast
patterns.context: 位于代码注释中，尤其是说明设计意图、兼容性或编译器行为时；激活集中在 we 及其邻近词。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释、Wikipedia 中的编程说明

patterns.name: 多词标识符及其分词
patterns.context: 代码、配置或技术文档中，驼峰式、下划线式或连写的大写标识符被拆成多个 token；并非所有标识符都同样触发。

patterns.name: 技术术语与复合词
patterns.trigger: « Ch»1«iral»5« effective»5« field»3« theory»；« kernel»« size»6« filters»6« convolution»；« compiler»« template»；« mean»« reversion»
patterns.context: 科技或工程语境中出现领域术语、复合术语及其说明文字；触发分布于术语本身和邻近普通词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、软件文档、编程资料、商业能源邮件

patterns.name: 描述允许、变更或启用的表述
patterns.trigger: « allowed»5« since»6« users»5« can»4；« Users»6« are»3« allowed»6« to»6« change»8；« now»9« allows»3« for»3
patterns.context: 描述用户可进行的操作、系统许可的行为或功能现在支持的事项。
patterns.domain: 技术注释、商业软件更新说明

patterns.name: 规范参数与配置值
patterns.context: 参数、属性或配置项后接类型、数值、单位或默认值；特别是带连字符的参数名与值。
patterns.domain: Github 源码、CSS 配置、机器学习接口文档

patterns.name: 商业产品、价格与交易描述
patterns.context: 电视频道套餐或金融法规、交易政策的叙述；没有明显统一的局部触发词。
patterns.domain: 商业广告、金融法律或企业邮件

patterns.name: Markdown 标题及论文开篇
patterns.context: 论文以换行和下划线式标题分隔后进入 Introduction，并在开篇介绍研究领域。

patterns.name: CSS 属性与重要声明
patterns.context: CSS 声明以属性和值构成，并出现 !default 标记；激活覆盖属性、标点和值的一部分。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 CSS/Sass 样式代码

patterns.name: 代码中 padding 的说明
patterns.context: 卷积层参数说明中，padding 被列为可选整数，并解释为两侧添加的零填充。

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器与权限标志
patterns.context: CPU 或体系结构说明中谈到控制寄存器、特权标志及其变更行为。
patterns.domain: Github 内核/硬件相关注释

patterns.name: 广告措辞与报价
patterns.context: 以促销口吻描述月费、频道数量和套餐报价。

patterns.name: 法规与金融交易历史
patterns.trigger: « laws»4« were»4« reform»4«ed»6« to»7« permit»5；« exchanges»5« to»5« trade»5« single»-«stock»5« futures»7
patterns.context: 概述法律改革、法规名称及其对特定金融交易的许可。

patterns.name: 能源产品代号和估值功能
patterns.context: 列举能源市场产品或系统代号，并说明其支持的估值范围。
patterns.domain: Enron 企业邮件、能源交易

en.concept: Local word forms and markers in technical text
en.description: Samples span code, software Q&A, and physics papers, with no reliable unified semantic trigger. Local clues include We/within-word fragments, broken/breaking, software terms, style properties, table columns, and interface layout.

patterns.name: English pronoun We
patterns.context: Capitalized English We or nearby character fragments are highlighted; in some examples We is a sentence subject, while in others it is a within-word fragment in Weinberg, so they cannot all be treated as the complete word.

patterns.name: broken / breaking in technical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in physics descriptions of spontaneous symmetry breaking.

patterns.name: Version and component names
patterns.context: In software Q&A or code comments, references versions, libraries, or plugin names.

patterns.name: Interface styling and graphics properties
patterns.context: Code and explanations for frontend styling or SVG attributes.

patterns.name: Code and technical markers
patterns.context: Markers and proper spellings appear alongside code, class names, configuration, or technical discussion.
patterns.domain: Software development Q&A and source code

patterns.name: Columns and cells
patterns.context: Discusses table columns, aliases, or data-grid cells.

patterns.name: Changes in content layout
patterns.context: Describes website content moving due to interaction or layout.

patterns.name: Highlight markers
patterns.context: Samples contain line breaks or comment markers, but it is uncertain whether these markers cause the activations.

11_267.concept: 技术文本中的局部词形与标记
11_267.description: 样本横跨代码、软件问答与物理论文，未见可靠的统一语义触发；局部出现 We/词内片段、broken/breaking、软件术语、样式属性、表格列和界面布局等线索。

patterns.name: 英语代词 We
patterns.trigger: "We"，如 [1] "// We output strings"、[2] "Weinberg"（词内）、[3] "We use"、[6] "Used"（不完全匹配）、[8] "We assume"
patterns.context: 英语大写 We 或其邻近字符片段被突出；部分例子中 We 是句子主语，另有 Weinberg 词内片段，不能统一视作完整单词

patterns.name: 技术术语中的 broken / breaking
patterns.context: 出现在对称性自发破缺的物理学表述中

patterns.name: 版本与组件名
patterns.context: 软件问答或代码注释中，涉及版本、库或插件名称

patterns.name: 界面样式与图形属性
patterns.context: 前端样式或 SVG 属性的代码与说明

patterns.name: 代码与技术标记
patterns.context: 代码、类名、配置或技术讨论中夹杂标记与专有拼写

patterns.name: 列与单元格
patterns.context: 讨论表格列、别名或数据网格单元格

patterns.name: 内容布局变化
patterns.context: 描述网站页面内容因交互或布局而移动

patterns.name: 高亮标记
patterns.context: 样本中出现换行或注释标记，但触发是否来自这些标记并不确定

en.description: Activation samples span physics, code, law, and political text. The physics passages concern symmetry breaking or restoration; code passages concern disabling, clearing, warnings, and identifiers; the remainder includes insurance-law wording and policy cuts. A single meaning does not readily explain them all.

patterns.name: Symmetry breaking and restoration
patterns.context: Physics papers discuss symmetry breaking, gauge symmetry, or restoration of unitarity; the trigger words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Disabling a generator or feature
patterns.context: Explains disabling an automatically generated getter to avoid conflicts; other highlighted content is mainly nearby code and explanation.

patterns.name: Clearing styles and plotting code
patterns.context: CSS style properties appear alongside a subsequent comment about generating an image.

patterns.name: Compiler extensions and warning suppression
patterns.context: C/C++ code comments explain a nonstandard extension and disable related warnings with a pragma.

patterns.name: Insurance contract liability wording
patterns.context: A disclaimer or confidentiality notice states that information may not be relied on as a basis for a contract.

patterns.name: Insurer's right of subrogation
patterns.context: A court ruling discusses an excess insurer's equitable right of subrogation.

patterns.name: Cuts and weakening in political commentary
patterns.context: Political commentary describes cuts to spending and the weakening of insurance options; highlights fall on several policy nouns and verbs.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and encoding types
patterns.context: Class members or variable declarations highlight underscore-containing identifiers and encoding type names.

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 激活样本横跨物理、代码、法律和政治文本；物理段涉及对称性破缺或恢复，代码段涉及关闭、清除、警告及标识符，其余为保险法律措辞与政策削减，难以由单一词义统一解释。

patterns.name: 对称性破缺与恢复
patterns.trigger: “break the electroweak symmetry”、“spontaneous breaking of the original symmetry”、“restore unitarity”
patterns.context: 物理学论文中讨论对称性破缺、规范对称性或恢复幺正性；触发词并不完全相同

patterns.name: 关闭生成器或功能
patterns.context: 说明为避免冲突而关闭自动生成的 getter；其余高亮内容主要是邻近代码与说明

patterns.name: 清除样式与绘图代码
patterns.trigger: “clearing-caption-font-size”、“clearing-caption-padding”、“We use these to make the image”
patterns.context: CSS 样式属性与随后关于生成图像的注释同时出现

patterns.name: 编译器扩展与警告抑制
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码注释解释非标准扩展，并通过 pragma 禁用相关警告

patterns.name: 保险合同责任措辞
patterns.context: 免责或保密声明中说明信息不得作为合同依据

patterns.name: 保险人追偿权
patterns.trigger: “excess insurer possesses a right of reimbursement”
patterns.context: 法院判决讨论超额保险人的衡平法追偿权

patterns.name: 政治评论中的削减与削弱
patterns.trigger: “cut $468 billion in Medicare spending”、“gutting the private insurance options”
patterns.context: 政治评论描述削减支出、削弱保险选项；高亮落在若干政策名词及动词上

patterns.name: 代码标识符与编码类型
patterns.context: 类成员或变量声明，突出带下划线的标识符及编码类型名称

en.description: Responds to varied encoding/UTF-8 code, CSS style comments, and recurring legal disclaimers in Enron emails; commonality is weak, and activation depends on local wording.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers in Enron emails
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on disclaimer wording stating that an email does not constitute a contract or may not be relied on to assert a contract; the same disclaimer has several similar versions, including variants with line breaks or quotation marks.

patterns.name: Encoding and UTF-8 in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code and technical Q&A about setting string encodings, URL encoding/decoding, or describing encoded data; activations fall on related identifiers and near UTF-8 strings.

patterns.name: CSS table-style comments and colors
patterns.context: A CSS comment explains striped/hover table background colors, with color values and CSS variable definitions nearby.

11_267.concept: none
11_267.description: 响应多种具体的编码/UTF-8代码、CSS样式注释，以及反复出现的Enron邮件法律免责声明；共同点较弱，激活依赖各局部措辞。

patterns.name: Enron邮件法律免责声明
patterns.trigger: “intended recipient”“contract by estoppel”“Enron Corp.”以及“may not be relied on”
patterns.context: 激活集中在关于邮件不构成合同、不得据此主张合同的免责声明措辞；同一免责声明有多种近似版本，含换行或引用符号变体。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: 代码中的编码与 UTF-8
patterns.context: 出现在设置字符串编码、URL 编解码或说明已编码数据的代码与技术问答中；激活落在相关标识符及 UTF-8 字符串附近。

patterns.name: CSS 表格样式注释与颜色
patterns.context: CSS 注释说明表格条纹/悬停背景色，附近有颜色值和 CSS 变量定义。

en.concept: Proper names and terms in technical and legal contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across source-code identifiers, compiler and language-compatibility discussions, legal liability and remedies terminology, and UTF-8/charset encoding; no single stable meaning covers all passages.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type names in code
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around code identifiers, type declarations, and member/method names; these are mostly camelCase, snake_case, or capitalized programming terms.

patterns.name: Compiler and C++ compatibility
patterns.context: Discusses language standards, differences in compiler implementations, compatibility issues, or whether an upgrade is necessary.

patterns.name: Legal liability and remedies terminology
patterns.context: Civil litigation facts and claims involving defenses, damages, torts, or property/contract remedies.

patterns.name: Character encoding and charset
patterns.context: Sets output encoding or discusses a conflict between the character set specified by a server and file-reading options.
patterns.domain: Programming source code and technical Q&A

11_267.concept: 技术与法律语境中的专名、术语
11_267.description: 激活散见于源码标识符、编译器与语言兼容讨论、法律责任及救济术语，也涉及 UTF-8/charset 编码；没有单一稳定语义可覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与类型名
patterns.context: 激活分布在代码标识符、类型声明和成员/方法名称周围；多为驼峰、下划线或大写开头的编程词。

patterns.name: 编译器与 C++ 兼容性
patterns.context: 讨论语言标准、编译器实现差异、兼容问题或升级是否必要。

patterns.name: 法律责任与救济术语
patterns.context: 民事诉讼事实与主张，涉及抗辩、赔偿、侵权或财产/合同救济。

patterns.name: 字符编码与 charset
patterns.context: 设置输出编码，或讨论服务器指定的字符集与文件读取选项之间的冲突。

en.concept: High-information words and code snippets in diverse texts
en.description: Activations cover source-code identifiers and punctuation, discussions of nonstandard C/C++ arrays, technical Q&A and parameter documentation, as well as religious-policy commentary and dispute and rights terminology in legal rulings; there is no clear trigger spanning all texts.

patterns.name: Identifiers and symbols in code
patterns.context: Multiple identifiers, type names, or syntax symbols are marked in source code; trigger words are not fixed and commonly occur in declarations, function signatures, and implementation code.
patterns.domain: C/C++ and C# code on GitHub

patterns.name: Compiler extensions and variable-length arrays
patterns.context: Discusses nonstandard array extensions, whether compilers accept them, and related code or compilation behavior.
patterns.domain: C/C++ technical discussions and source-code comments

patterns.name: Explanatory Q&A text
patterns.context: StackExchange answers explain technical issues, constraints, or alternatives in natural language; activations are distributed across explanatory phrases and sentences.

patterns.name: Descriptive field documentation
patterns.context: Comments use labels such as Description/Input and bullet points to explain parameters or fields.

patterns.name: Religious and contraceptive policy dispute
patterns.context: Describes the Obama administration's insurance rules and their conflict with religious institutions' principles of faith.

patterns.name: Legal litigation and remedies terminology
patterns.context: Describes claims, contract or insurance disputes, and legal remedies; the passage contains legal facts or judicial analysis.

11_267.concept: 多样文本中的高信息词与代码片段
11_267.description: 激活覆盖源码标识符与标点、C/C++非标准数组讨论、技术问答和参数文档，也覆盖宗教政策评论及法律判决中的争议与权利术语；没有贯穿所有文本的明显触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与符号
patterns.context: 在源码中，多个标识符、类型名或语法符号被标记；触发词并不固定，常见于声明、函数签名及实现代码。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++、C# 代码

patterns.name: 编译器扩展及可变长数组
patterns.context: 讨论非标准数组扩展、编译器是否接受，以及相关代码或编译行为。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 技术讨论与源码注释

patterns.name: 解释性问答文字
patterns.context: StackExchange 答案以自然语言说明技术问题、限制或替代方案；激活分布在解释性短语和句子中。

patterns.name: 描述性字段文档
patterns.context: 注释中使用 Description/Input 等标签，并以项目符号说明参数或字段。

patterns.name: 宗教与避孕政策争议
patterns.context: 陈述奥巴马政府的保险规定及其与宗教机构信仰原则的冲突。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼与救济术语
patterns.context: 描述诉讼主张、合同或保险争议及法律救济；段落含法律事实或司法分析。

en.description: Activations occur on code identifiers, types, and API names, as well as compiler and XML terminology and common English words in technical explanations; there is also a theoretical physics passage, with no clear cross-domain commonality.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and type names
patterns.context: Activations fall on multiword identifiers or type names in program code, especially parts formed by underscores, capitalization boundaries, or type/member naming; nearby content often includes declarations, property access, or API calls.

patterns.name: Programming languages and tool names
patterns.context: Language, tool, or runtime names and related terms activate in discussions of language features, compiler compatibility, or platform behavior.

patterns.name: XML parsing terminology
patterns.context: Explains the difference between XML documents and entities, and how parsers or XPath handle them.

patterns.name: Common English words in technical text
patterns.context: Common English function words, conjunctions, and frequent predicates in technical explanations or Q&A also activate across different topics, not just code tokens.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols and physics terms activate in theoretical physics discussions of Lagrangian mass terms, gauge fields, and symmetry breaking.

11_267.concept: 技术文本与标识符
11_267.description: 激活见于代码标识符、类型与 API 名称，也见于编译器、XML 等技术术语和技术说明中的普通英文词；另有一段理论物理文本，跨领域共性不明确。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类型名
patterns.context: 激活落在程序代码中的多词标识符或类型名上，尤其是下划线、大小写边界或类型/成员命名构成的部分；周边常有声明、属性访问或 API 调用。

patterns.name: 编程语言及工具名称
patterns.context: 讨论语言特性、编译器兼容性或平台行为时，语言、工具或运行时名称及相关术语激活。

patterns.name: XML 解析术语
patterns.context: 说明 XML 文档与实体的区别，以及解析器或 XPath 的处理方式。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的通用英文词
patterns.context: 技术说明或问答中的普通英文功能词、连接词及常见谓语也有激活，分布于不同主题，并非只限代码 token。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与数学记号
patterns.context: 拉格朗日质量项、规范场及对称性破缺的理论物理叙述中，数学符号和物理术语激活。

en.description: Mainly responds to programming contexts involving types, generics, compiler support, and operator overloading; also covers big integers and bases, date-time serialization, image-picker comments, and stream-string decoding options.

patterns.name: Programming language types and generics
patterns.context: Discusses language type rules, templates/generics, operator overloading, compiler support, or compatibility.

patterns.name: Numeric representation and base conversion
patterns.context: Discusses big-integer representation, encoding bases, or implementing numeric processing oneself.

patterns.name: Date-time serialization
patterns.context: Asks about serialization support for a specific date-time type and possible alternatives.

patterns.name: Image-capture component name
patterns.context: Appears in a file-header comment describing a platform-native image picker implementation.

patterns.name: Stream decoding options
patterns.context: Code sets stream-processing options and explains why string decoding is unnecessary.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and inline comments

11_267.concept: 编程技术术语与实现讨论
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术语境中的类型、泛型、编译器支持与运算符重载讨论；也覆盖大整数及进制、日期时间序列化、图像选择器注释和流字符串解码选项。

patterns.name: 编程语言类型与泛型
patterns.context: 讨论语言类型规则、模板/泛型、运算符重载、编译器支持或兼容性

patterns.name: 数值表示与进制转换
patterns.context: 讨论大整数表示、编码进制或自行实现数值处理

patterns.name: 日期时间序列化
patterns.trigger: “DateTimeOffset”“not serialized as a Date at all”
patterns.context: 询问特定日期时间类型的序列化支持及替代办法

patterns.name: 图像采集组件名称
patterns.context: 出现在文件头注释中，描述平台原生图像选择器实现

patterns.name: 流解码选项
patterns.context: 代码设置流处理选项，并解释为何不需要解码字符串
patterns.domain: Github 源代码与行内注释

en.description: Mainly responds to compilers, type systems, and differences in their support in programming discussions; also covers concrete code/APIs, browser compatibility, and numeric representation in development contexts, with no narrow theme shared by all passages.

patterns.name: Compiler and type-system differences
patterns.context: Discusses how compilers handle language features, inference, support, or code acceptance, and differences in behavior across compilers.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, compilers, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Generics, overloading, and polymorphism
patterns.context: Explains the purpose and compatibility of generics, overloading, type classes, or polymorphism in type systems.
patterns.domain: Programming language design and API compatibility discussions

patterns.name: Code implementation and specific syntax/API
patterns.context: Code snippets or technical explanations include specific libraries, functions, types, or implementations; they do not all concern the same language feature.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, code examples, and developer discussions

patterns.name: Cross-platform/browser support limitations
patterns.context: Notes that a web feature or API is unsupported by some browsers, raising questions about cross-browser compatibility.

patterns.name: Bit width and numeric representation approaches
patterns.context: Discusses data types for representing values beyond the 64-bit range and lists wider integers or emulation approaches.
patterns.domain: Low-level programming and numeric type implementations

11_267.concept: 编程技术讨论
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术讨论中的编译器、类型系统及其支持差异；也覆盖具体代码/API、浏览器兼容和数值表示等开发语境，未见所有片段都共享的窄主题。

patterns.name: 编译器与类型系统的差异
patterns.trigger: «comp»«ilers»10« handle»、«comp»«ilers»10« are»、«comp»«ilers»10« tolerate»；另有 «implicit»« argument»« deduction»、«compiler»
patterns.context: 讨论编译器如何处理语言特性、推断、支持或容忍代码，以及编译器间行为差异。
patterns.domain: 编程语言、编译器与技术问答

patterns.name: 泛型、重载与多态
patterns.context: 解释类型系统中泛型、重载、类型类或多态机制的用途与兼容性。
patterns.domain: 编程语言设计与 API 兼容性讨论

patterns.name: 代码实现与具体语法/API
patterns.context: 代码片段或技术解释中出现具体库、函数、类型或实现方案；并非都涉及同一语言特性。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、代码示例与开发者讨论

patterns.name: 跨平台/浏览器支持限制
patterns.context: 指出某个网页功能或 API 不被部分浏览器支持，从而质疑跨浏览器兼容性。

patterns.name: 位宽与数值表示方案
patterns.context: 讨论表示超出 64 位范围的数据类型，并列举更宽整数或模拟方案。
patterns.domain: 底层编程与数值类型实现

en.description: Mainly responds to programming technical text: compiler support and compatibility, language and type mechanisms; also covers UI styling issues and frontend code for property access, option configuration, and explanatory comments.

patterns.name: Compiler compatibility and type support
patterns.context: Discusses whether compilers can support, infer, or accept a language feature, type, or coding style.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, C++, tools, and Q&A, [1][2][4][5]

patterns.name: Language features and type mechanisms
patterns.context: Explains or compares language abstractions, type systems, operator/function overloading, or library mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Functional programming, Scala, JavaScript, and other technical discussions, [3][6][8]

patterns.name: Ignored UI style properties
patterns.context: Explains that a style designer's font settings have no effect and that the UI engine ignores the relevant properties.

patterns.name: String decoding options and comment explanations
patterns.context: Code configures an option and uses a comment to explain that string decoding is unnecessary.

patterns.name: Reading SVG stroke width
patterns.context: Code reads an SVG stroke width from an element attribute or style, with a nearby comment stating an assumption.

11_267.concept: 编程技术解释与实现
11_267.description: 主要响应编程技术文本：编译器支持与兼容性、语言和类型机制；也覆盖 UI 样式故障及前端代码中属性读取、选项配置和解释性注释。

patterns.name: 编译器兼容性与类型支持
patterns.context: 讨论编译器能否支持、推断或容忍某种语言特性、类型或代码写法。

patterns.name: 语言特性与类型机制
patterns.context: 解释或比较语言抽象、类型系统、操作符/函数重载或库机制。
patterns.domain: 函数式编程、Scala、JavaScript 等技术讨论，[3][6][8]

patterns.name: 界面样式属性被忽略
patterns.context: 说明样式设计器对字体设置不起作用，并指出界面引擎忽略相关属性。
patterns.domain: 桌面 UI 与样式引擎问答，[7]

patterns.name: 字符串解码选项与注释说明
patterns.context: 代码配置选项后用注释解释无需解码字符串。

patterns.name: SVG 描边宽度读取
patterns.context: 代码从元素属性或样式中读取 SVG 描边宽度，附近注释陈述假设。

en.concept: Local features in numerical and scientific text
en.description: Activates on numbers, operators, and punctuation across math problems, as well as biomedical text containing diversity-related vocabulary or quantitative units; sporadic subword fragments are also highlighted, insufficient to establish a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in math problems
patterns.context: Several tokens near numbers, minus signs, comparison symbols, and punctuation activate in math questions or arithmetic expressions; paragraph 1 is also followed by a newline and “Let y =”.

patterns.name: Diversity-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in organizational contexts discussing diversity, fairness, and inclusion, or in descriptions of diversity among chemical or biological entities; the triggering terms belong to different domains.
patterns.domain: Corporate diversity and inclusion; biomedical/chemical abstracts

patterns.name: Quantitative scientific text with units
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to scientific units of measurement, exponents, or experimental doses; some activations fall on parts of units or on numbers rather than semantic words.

patterns.name: Other locally high-activation words
patterns.context: These highlights are scattered across problems, method descriptions, and results; the fragments themselves do not show a common, clear trigger.

11_390.concept: 数字与科学文本局部特征
11_390.description: 激活跨数学题中的数字、运算符和标点，以及含多样性词汇或定量单位的生物医学文本；另有零散词片段高亮，无法据此确认统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学问句或算术表达式中，数字、负号、比较符号及标点附近的若干 token 激活；第 1 段还接着出现换行和“Let y =”。

patterns.name: 多样性相关词汇
patterns.context: 讨论多样性、公平与包容的组织语境，或描述化学、生物学对象的多样性；触发词所在领域不同。
patterns.domain: 企业多元与包容；生物医学/化学摘要

patterns.name: 含单位的定量科学文本
patterns.context: 数值与科学计量单位、指数或实验剂量相邻；有些激活落在单位组成部分或数字上，而非语义词。

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活词
patterns.context: 这些高亮分散在题目、方法描述及结果文本中，片段本身没有显示出共同而明确的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学题与生物医学摘要

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to minus signs and the following numbers, variables, fractions, or expressions in mathematical material, and also to expressions containing subtraction; one passage of cochlear science prose has no obvious common trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions following a minus sign
patterns.context: A minus sign prefixes a number or algebraic expression; it is often followed by a number, variable, fraction, or parentheses, and appears in operations, answers, or lists.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; math problems, calculations, or numerical lists

patterns.name: Subtraction operators and math-problem contexts
patterns.context: A minus sign occurs in a continuous arithmetic expression and may indicate subtraction or a negative number; sometimes accompanied by a newline, problem instruction, or result.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; arithmetic exercises and calculation problems

patterns.name: Local mathematical sequences of numbers and operators
patterns.context: Formula fragments comprising numbers, variables, plus or minus signs, slashes, parentheses, and similar symbols; the specific operation may not be identifiable from the fragment alone.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; formula or expression fragments

patterns.name: General English explanatory prose
patterns.context: Continuous English prose discussing processes within the cochlea and their functions; no obvious mathematical symbols or minus signs.

11_390.concept: 数学负号及减法
11_390.description: 主要在数学材料中对负号及其后的数值、变量、分数或表达式强烈响应，也见于含减法的算式；另有一段耳蜗科学散文，无明显共同触发线索。

patterns.name: 负号后的数学表达式
patterns.context: 负号作为数值或代数表达式的前缀；常接数字、变量、分数或括号，出现在运算、答案、列表中。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；数学题、计算式或数值列表

patterns.name: 减法运算符及其数学题语境
patterns.context: 减号处于连续算术表达式中，可表示减法或负数；有时伴随换行、题目指令或结果。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；算术练习与计算题

patterns.name: 数字与运算符的局部数学序列
patterns.context: 数字、变量、正负号、斜线、括号等组成的公式片段；不一定能仅凭片段确定具体运算含义。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；公式或表达式残片

patterns.name: 一般英文说明性文字
patterns.context: 连续英文散文，谈及耳蜗内的过程及其功能；没有明显数学符号或减号。

en.description: Responds mainly to minus signs and neighboring numbers or variables; also activates noticeably on long-space alignment in documents, including court headings and code/license fields.

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative-number/subtraction expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign is used as a number sign or as a subtraction operator in a mathematical expression; often accompanied by numbers, decimal points, or variables.

patterns.name: Fixed-spacing and parenthetical formatting in court headings
patterns.context: Appears near title pages, case names, or court headings in court rulings; long spaces align the heading, case name, and parentheses.

patterns.name: Long-space alignment in code
patterns.context: Spaces align fields, values, or addresses in code or license text; this is distinct from legal-heading formatting.

11_390.concept: 负号与长空格排版
11_390.description: 主要响应负号及其邻近数字或变量；另对文档中的长空格排版对齐有明显激活，见于法院标题和代码/许可证字段。

patterns.name: 负号及负数/减法表达式
patterns.context: 负号作为数字的符号或数学表达式中的减法运算符；前后常伴随数字、小数点或变量。

patterns.name: 法院标题中的固定空格与括号排版
patterns.trigger: «                        »（长空格），后接“THE PEOPLE,”、“)”或法院名称等
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决书标题页、案名或法院抬头附近；长空格用于对齐标题、案名和括号。

patterns.name: 代码中的长空格对齐
patterns.trigger: «                        »，如“"push"”后的长空格及GNU许可证地址前的长空格
patterns.context: 代码或许可证文本中，空格用于对齐字段、数值或地址；并非法律标题排版。

en.concept: Specific word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations occur on substrings within several specific words (especially intrac and United), tokenized proper nouns and technical terms, as well as newlines, code punctuation, and formula symbols; contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Specific substring “intrac” within words
patterns.context: Activations fall within words beginning with intrac; [2], [3], and [8] all contain this substring, but the meanings and domains differ

patterns.name: Specific substring “United” within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on United in place-name phrases; no other similar place names are observed

patterns.name: Newlines and numeric formatting
patterns.context: Short sequences of numbers, commas, carriage returns, and newlines, with activations distributed across multiple characters

patterns.name: “6 Force” title fragment
patterns.context: Force follows the number 6 in title-style line-break formatting

patterns.name: Names and punctuation/code fragments
patterns.context: Code symbols, newlines, and punctuation occur around status parameters, variables, or strings; multiple positions activate simultaneously

patterns.name: Tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword fragments in a company name, which is repeated later and followed by a company description

patterns.name: Tokenization in technical terms
patterns.context: Multiple consecutive subword fragments activate to form the title of a research project

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on several fragments of LaTeX formulas and astronomical numerical expressions

11_390.concept: 特定词片段与格式标记
11_390.description: 激活分布在若干特定词内子串（尤其 intrac、United）、分词化专名与专业术语，以及换行、代码标点和公式符号上；各类上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: 词内特定子串“intrac”
patterns.context: 激活落在以 intrac 开头的词内部；[2]、[3]、[8] 都出现这一子串，但词义和领域不同

patterns.name: 词内特定子串“United”
patterns.context: 激活落在地名短语中的 United；未见于其他类似地名

patterns.name: 换行及数字化排版
patterns.context: 数字、逗号、回车与换行组成的短序列，激活分布在多个字符上

patterns.name: “6 Force”标题片段
patterns.context: 数字 6 后接 Force，出现在标题式的换行排版中

patterns.name: 名称及标点/代码片段
patterns.context: 状态参数、变量或字符串周围夹有代码符号、换行和标点；多种位置同时激活

patterns.name: 专有名称中的分词
patterns.context: 激活分布在公司名称的词片段中，后文重复该名称并介绍公司

patterns.name: 专业术语中的分词
patterns.context: 多个词内子片段连续激活，构成研究项目标题

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: 激活落在 LaTeX 公式和天文学数值表达式的若干片段上

en.concept: Boundaries and fragments in structured text
en.description: Sensitive mainly to newlines, indentation, and list formatting; also activates on names, place names, numeric fields, and split long words. Other activations are scattered across code credits, academic biographies, sports results, election directories, and patent text, without a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Table or list line breaks
patterns.context: Content is laid out as a multiline table, itemized list, or delimited record; activations often fall on newlines and surrounding spaces or punctuation
patterns.domain: Structured text, rosters, and data lists

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns are split into multiple subword tokens; these may be place names, personal names, or organization names, with no unified semantic category
patterns.domain: Emails, biographies, sports records, encyclopedia, and academic texts

patterns.name: Numeric, date, and identifier fields
patterns.context: Numbers occur in aligned numeric rows, years, rankings, volume numbers, or date fields
patterns.domain: Data tables in emails, sports results, journal information, and date lines

patterns.name: Code documentation and attribution blocks
patterns.context: Code comments or source-file headers containing routine descriptions, author information, and indentation

patterns.name: Terminology suffixes and web-comment fragments
patterns.context: Fragmentary English word endings appear near optimization-related sentences, links, and quoted comments; the full word or a shared meaning cannot be determined from context

patterns.name: Heading and author-biography formatting
patterns.context: An author-introduction heading followed by a professional and institutional biography

patterns.name: Repeated listing of a name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia biography opens with a repeated name, followed by birth information

patterns.name: Competition stages and ranking records
patterns.context: Event names, stages, riders, and overall results are listed in rows

patterns.name: Journal bibliographic information
patterns.context: Short bibliographic-style lines containing journal names and volume numbers

patterns.name: Date heading and prose opening
patterns.context: A date follows a heading, then the body text begins; there are many newlines

patterns.name: Election results directory
patterns.context: Section headings, directory-style links, and associated bibliography in an encyclopedia entry
