patterns.name: Long-word fragments in patent technical terminology
patterns.context: Long technical words are split into subwords within patent descriptions of mechanical structures and component movement

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与片段
11_390.description: 主要对换行、缩进和条目化排版敏感；同时在姓名、地名、数字字段及被拆分的长词上激活。其余激活分散于代码署名、学术简介、体育成绩、选举目录和专利文本，未显出统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 表格或列表换行
patterns.trigger: 频繁出现的「↵」，尤其与缩进、短行、字段分隔符相邻
patterns.context: 内容被排成多行表格、条目清单或带分隔符的记录；激活常落在换行及周围空格、标点上
patterns.domain: 结构化文本、名单与数据列表

patterns.name: 姓名及专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词 token；有时是地名、人名或机构名，未见统一语义类别
patterns.domain: 邮件、传记、体育记录、百科与学术文本

patterns.name: 数字与日期、编号字段
patterns.context: 数字出现在对齐的数值行、年份、排名、卷号或日期字段中
patterns.domain: 邮件中的数据表、体育结果、期刊信息及日期行

patterns.name: 代码文档与署名块
patterns.context: 代码注释或源文件头部，包含例程说明、作者信息和缩进格式

patterns.name: 术语后缀及网页评论残片
patterns.context: 断裂的英文词尾出现在优化相关句子、链接和评论引用附近；无法由上下文确定完整词或共同语义

patterns.name: 标题与作者简介格式
patterns.context: 作者介绍标题及其下方的职业、机构简介

patterns.name: 姓名重复列示
patterns.context: 百科传记开头重复姓名，随后接出生信息

patterns.name: 竞赛阶段与名次记录
patterns.trigger: 「Stage 3」「Stage 1」「Tour of Flanders」「Giro d'Italia」「3rd place overall classification」
patterns.context: 赛事名称、阶段、车手和总成绩按行列出

patterns.name: 期刊书目信息
patterns.context: 期刊名称与卷号构成的书目式短行

patterns.name: 日期标题与散文开头
patterns.context: 标题后跟日期，再转入正文；换行较多

patterns.name: 选举结果目录
patterns.trigger: 「Voting and results」「Results by Alliance」「List of Elected MPs」「Elections in Tamil Nadu」「Bibliography」
patterns.context: 百科条目的章节标题、目录式链接和附属书目
patterns.domain: 选举相关 Wikipedia 条目

patterns.name: 专利技术词中的长词片段
patterns.context: 长技术词被拆分成子词，处于机械结构与部件运动的专利描述中

en.concept: Proper nouns and fields in structured text
en.description: Activations cluster around proper nouns and their dense enumeration: academic institutions, astronomical addresses, and author bylines are most common, with coverage also including patent trademarks/inventors, project-title terminology, management-course topics, and email contacts.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and place names in institutional addresses
patterns.context: University, department, city, street, region, and country names in institutional, departmental, or author addresses; proper nouns are often split into multiple subwords
patterns.domain: Academic paper author addresses, institutional profiles

patterns.name: Astronomical institutions and academic units
patterns.context: Academic institution names and their affiliations, often listed alongside postal addresses, postal codes, and countries

patterns.name: Author names and byline fields
patterns.context: Author, editor, or contact names in bylines, correspondence information, or database editor fields; names often contain split character fragments
patterns.domain: Paper bylines, journal editor information, grant project records

patterns.name: Product and technology names in patent text
patterns.context: Trademarks, computing platforms, product names, or inventor names in patent background or explanatory text and patent citations

patterns.name: Embryology terminology in project names
patterns.context: Research-method and biological-material terminology appears consecutively in NIH project or literature title-style fields; “Embryos” and words in the title trigger activation

patterns.name: Management education programs and business terminology
patterns.context: A series of business-management topics appears in descriptions of full-time management program courses or areas of focus

patterns.name: Email recipients and business contacts
patterns.context: Email headers list recipients, copied recipients, and email addresses; names may be accompanied by company email addresses

11_390.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与字段
11_390.description: 激活集中于专名及其密集列举：学术机构、天文地址和作者署名最常见，也覆盖专利商标/发明人、项目标题术语、管理课程主题及邮件联系人。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的专名与地名
patterns.context: 机构、院系或作者地址中出现的大学、城市、街道、地区及国家名称；专名内部常被切成多个子词
patterns.domain: 学术论文作者地址、机构简介

patterns.name: 天文学机构与学术单位
patterns.context: 学术机构名称及其隶属关系，常与邮政地址、邮编、国家并列

patterns.name: 作者姓名与署名字段
patterns.context: 作者、编辑或联系人姓名出现在署名、通讯信息或数据库编辑字段中；姓名常包含被拆分的字符片段
patterns.domain: 论文署名、期刊编辑信息、基金项目文献记录

patterns.name: 专利文本中的产品与技术名称
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明文字中出现商标、计算机平台、产品名或专利引用中的发明人姓名

patterns.name: 项目名称中的胚胎学术语
patterns.trigger: “Optical Sectioning Deep Inside Live Embryos by Selective Plane Illumination”
patterns.context: NIH项目或文献标题式字段中，连续出现研究方法和生物材料术语；“Embryos”及标题中的词触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目/文献记录

patterns.name: 管理教育项目与商业术语
patterns.context: 介绍全日制管理项目课程或关注领域时出现的一串商业管理主题

patterns.name: 邮件收件人及商务联系人
patterns.context: 邮件头部列出收件人、抄送人和邮箱地址；姓名可能伴随公司邮箱

en.concept: Special word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across rare proper nouns and word-internal fragments, technical terms, code identifiers, forum word forms, mathematical notation, and newline markers; the commonality seems to be a response to rare or special subword fragments, not a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Rare fragments in entity names
patterns.context: Long or uncommon spelling fragments in personal names, place names, or building names; activations fall on subword fragments within the names.

patterns.name: Rare word forms in academic terminology and literature titles
patterns.context: Mycological terminology, German book titles, or technical word forms in academic literature, containing word-internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: Nested type terms in code identifiers
patterns.context: Hyphenated identifiers in GCC or compiler diagnostic directives; highlights segments such as nested, anonymous, and type.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in application names
patterns.context: Proper or common words in continuous text, with activations concentrated on subword fragments in the middle of their spelling; different instances do not clearly belong to the same semantic class.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and local formula fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on variables, integral-symbol commands, or formatting commands in mathematical formulas and LaTeX notation.

patterns.name: Paragraph and section boundary markers
patterns.context: A newline marker in a conclusion paragraph activates; surrounding text discusses the conclusion of a family-centered project.

11_390.concept: 特殊词形与子词片段
11_390.description: 激活分散于罕见专名和词内片段、专业术语、代码标识符、论坛中的词形、数学记号及换行标记；共同点更像对少见或特殊子词片段的响应，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 实体名称的罕见片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或建筑名称中，尤其是较长或不常见的拼写片段；激活落在名称内部的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 学术术语与文献标题中的罕见词形
patterns.context: 真菌学术语、德语书名或学术文献中的专业词形，包含词内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的嵌套类型词
patterns.context: GCC 或编译器诊断指令中的连字符标识符；突出显示嵌套、匿名、类型等词段。

patterns.name: 应用名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 连续文本中的专名或普通词，激活集中在拼写中间的子词片段；不同实例并不显然属于同一语义类。

patterns.name: 数学记号与公式局部
patterns.context: 数学公式及 LaTeX 记号中，激活落在变量、积分符号命令或排版命令上。

patterns.name: 段落与小节边界标记
patterns.context: 结论段落中的换行标记被激活，周围涉及家庭中心项目的结论文字。

en.description: Activations occur in diverse texts, often on subword fragments within proper nouns (especially place names, institutions, and venues), and also in category directories, headings, and legal citations; there is no stable single trigger word, and some examples are difficult to attribute.

patterns.name: Fujian place names/proper nouns ending in “ian”
patterns.context: The suffix -ian appears in a place or institution name; activation falls on the final fragment of the word rather than the whole sentence
patterns.domain: Geographic encyclopedia entries, medical institution text

patterns.name: Category directories and section headings
patterns.context: Category lists or section/category headings in the title area or at the end of Wikipedia entries; activations often fall on category words or entities within them

patterns.name: Regional or institutional entities in proper nouns
patterns.context: Place names, venues, institutions, or entity names appear in directory entries or narratives, especially multiword proper nouns
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia categories, travel descriptions, sports entries

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within proper nouns split into multiple subwords; examples include fungal genus names, place names, team names, and studio names
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, travel copy, sports and film encyclopedias

patterns.name: Report-series abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Near legal case citations and case names, court reporter series, and volume/page information

patterns.name: Disease and hospital terminology in medical titles/institution names
patterns.context: Pathogens, tumors, and hospitals appear in medical research or institution names

patterns.name: Consecutive words in general proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper-noun phrases in headings or introductory sentences discussing a theatrical genre, language, or region; no local trigger shared with other examples

patterns.name: Court in institution/venue names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a proper noun in arena names or street addresses

patterns.name: Fragmentary or heterogeneous directory/citation snippets
patterns.context: Activations occur in book titles, case names, or mixed directory and citation text, without enough repeated evidence to establish a more specific pattern

11_390.concept: 专名与结构化条目片段
11_390.description: 激活出现在多种文本中，常落于被子词切分的专名片段（尤其地名、机构、场馆），也见于分类目录、标题及法律引证；缺乏稳定单一触发词，部分样本难以归因。

patterns.name: “ian”结尾的福建地名/专名
patterns.context: 地名或机构名中出现词尾 -ian；激活落在该词的末尾片段，而非整句
patterns.domain: 百科地理、医学机构文本

patterns.name: 分类目录与栏目标题
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾或标题区的分类列表、栏目/分类标题；激活常落在分类词或其中实体名上
patterns.domain: 百科条目与分类元数据

patterns.name: 专名中的地域或机构实体
patterns.context: 地名、场馆、机构或实体名称出现在目录条目或叙述中，尤其是多词专名
patterns.domain: 百科分类、旅游介绍、体育条目

patterns.name: 专名中的词素片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在被切分成多个子词的专名内部；现有例子涵盖真菌属名、地名、队名和制片厂名
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、旅游文案、体育与电影百科

patterns.name: 法律引证中的报告集简称
patterns.context: 法律判例引证及案名、法院报告集和卷页信息附近

patterns.name: 医学标题/机构名中的疾病与医院术语
patterns.context: 医学研究或机构名称中出现病原体、肿瘤和医院等术语

patterns.name: 一般专名中的连续词语
patterns.context: 标题或介绍性句子中，谈及戏曲类型、语言或地域的专名短语；缺少与其他样本一致的局部触发条件

patterns.name: 机构/场馆名中的 Court
patterns.context: 作为专名的一部分，出现在球馆名称或道路地址中

patterns.name: 残缺或异质的目录/引证片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在书名、案名或混杂的目录与引证文本中，未见足够重复证据形成更具体规律

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within proper nouns, long words, and multisyllabic words, especially place, street, and institution names; there are also sporadic responses to category labels, medical terminology, sports and program entries, and newline delimiters. The range of genres is broad, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local subword fragments within multiword expressions
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within proper nouns or technical terms; these are usually long, multisyllabic, or uncommon names, and fragments may span adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, legal, medical, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: City streets and place names
patterns.context: Place names occur in street addresses or place descriptions; some activations concentrate on fragments within the names and may extend to Avenue.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, historical encyclopedias, public transit descriptions

patterns.name: Category or entry-style text after proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns such as species names or category labels occur in encyclopedia definitions, classification entries, or category lists.

patterns.name: Ingredients and institution names
patterns.context: Experimental materials, culture media, or supplier names are listed as proper nouns and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Consecutive newline characters
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph or item boundaries in encyclopedia entries or lists; also activates when occurring alone.

patterns.name: Section or program title words
patterns.context: Common English words are tokenized and activate in headings or program names following a newline.

patterns.name: Sports team and venue proper nouns
patterns.context: Team, venue, and campus-related proper nouns appear in university basketball team descriptions.

patterns.name: Long book titles and river names
patterns.context: Geographic proper nouns appear in river and watershed contexts in descriptions of book contents.

patterns.name: Cutaneous fungi and disease names
patterns.context: Study subjects and disease names appear in quantitative testing and patient descriptions.

patterns.name: City and neighborhood names in addresses
patterns.context: Multiple neighborhood and city names are listed in transit service area descriptions.

patterns.name: Incomplete or peripheral activations in geographic names
patterns.context: A large geographic proper-noun fragment activates weakly, possibly co-occurring with a stronger place-name fragment in the same passage.

patterns.name: Institution, competition, or artist-related proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns or event names appear in sports reports and biographical project abstracts; activations are weak and scattered.

11_390.concept: 专名与长词片段
11_390.description: 激活多落在专名、长词及多音节词的内部子词片段，尤见地名、街道和机构名称；也零星响应分类标签、医学术语、体育与节目条目，以及换行分隔符。覆盖文体广，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 多词内部的局部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语的词内片段上；通常是较长、多音节或不常见的名称，片段可跨相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、医学及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 城市街道及地点名称
patterns.context: 地名在街道地址或地点描述中出现；部分激活集中于名称内部片段，也可延伸到 Avenue。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、历史百科、公共交通说明

patterns.name: 专名后的分类或条目式文本
patterns.context: 物种名或类别标签等专名出现在百科定义句、分类条目或类别列表中。

patterns.name: 成分与机构名称
patterns.context: 实验材料、培养基或供应商名称以专名及缩写形式列举。

patterns.name: 连续换行符
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目或名单的段落、条目分隔处；单独出现时也激活。

patterns.name: 章节或节目标题词
patterns.context: 换行后的标题或栏目名称中，普通英文词被分词激活。

patterns.name: 运动队名称与场馆专名
patterns.context: 大学篮球队介绍中，队名、场地及校区相关专名出现。

patterns.name: 长篇书名与河流名称
patterns.context: 书籍内容介绍中，地理专名在河流及流域语境里出现。

patterns.name: 皮肤真菌与疾病名称
patterns.context: 研究对象和疾病名称出现在定量检测及患者描述中。

patterns.name: 地址中的城市及社区名称
patterns.context: 交通服务范围描述中，多个社区及城市名依次列举。

patterns.name: 地理名称中的不完整或边缘激活
patterns.context: 较大的地理专名片段仅有弱激活，可能与同段中更强的地名片段共现。
patterns.domain: 历史地理叙述、法律文本

patterns.name: 机构、竞赛或艺术家相关专名
patterns.context: 专名或活动名称出现在赛事报道、人物生平项目摘要中；激活较弱且分散。

en.description: Activations occur in noun phrases, proper nouns, technical terms, table percentages, Danish word forms, and code fields; common patterns are weak, some cover only a single passage, and they are difficult to reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Function words and collocational elements in noun phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall within ordinary noun phrases, often involving noun modifiers, compound nouns, or plural nouns; the specific semantics vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, patent, travel, sports, and historical texts

patterns.name: Components of institutions and proper nouns
patterns.context: Place names, organization names, or venue names within proper nouns; activations concentrate on several words or morphemes in the name.

patterns.name: Ingredients, materials, and experimental reagent names
patterns.context: Culture media, reagents, or drug names appear in biomedical methods or drug tables; some abbreviations and word-internal fragments activate.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, experimental methods and medical tables

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics in parentheses
patterns.context: Values or percentages in table rows, especially percentages in parentheses; no clear consistent numerical semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Word-internal graphemes and multilingual morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall inside longer words rather than on whole words; examples include brand names or inflected and derived Danish forms, with unclear triggers.

patterns.name: Fields and values in structured configuration
patterns.context: Activations occur near field names, type declarations, and default values in JSON/API documentation, including newline markers.

patterns.name: TV station and entry-category text
patterns.context: Channel information, references, and category labels at the end of encyclopedia entries; activations include conjunctions within category phrases.

11_390.concept: none
11_390.description: 激活分布在名词短语、专名、专业术语、表格百分比、丹麦语词形和代码字段等处；共同规律较弱，部分只覆盖单段，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的功能词和搭配成分
patterns.trigger: 如 “assembly plant”“valet parking system”“campgrounds”“toilets”“Assembly Hall”“dining rooms”
patterns.context: 激活落在普通名词短语中，常涉及名词前修饰语、名词复合词或复数名词；不同例子具体语义不一。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、旅游、体育及历史文本

patterns.name: 机构与专名中的组成部分
patterns.trigger: “Nissan”“Aguascalientes, Mexico”“Beijing Solarbio Science & Technology Co.”“Indiana Hoosiers”“Assembly Hall”
patterns.context: 专名内部的地名、组织名或场馆名；激活集中于名称中的若干词或词素。

patterns.name: 成分、材料与实验试剂名称
patterns.context: 生物医学方法或药物表格中，出现培养基、试剂或药物名称；部分缩写和词内片段被激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，实验方法与医学表格

patterns.name: 数字及括号中的统计数据
patterns.context: 表格行中的数值或百分比，尤其括号内的百分比；未见明确一致的数值语义。

patterns.name: 词内字素与多语种形态片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在较长词内部而非完整词上；可见于品牌词或丹麦语屈折、派生形式，触发条件不清。
patterns.domain: 论文材料、丹麦语议会文本

patterns.name: 结构化配置中的字段和值
patterns.context: JSON/API 文档中，字段名、类型声明和默认值附近出现激活，包含换行标记。

patterns.name: 电视台与条目分类文本
patterns.trigger: “KOTA”“subchannel”“Category: Television channels and stations established in 1958”
patterns.context: 百科条目尾部的频道信息、参考资料及分类标签；激活包括分类短语中的连接词。

en.description: Primarily responds to dense combinations of numbers, percentages, and punctuation in tables or aligned data; also responds to code identifiers, hexadecimal constants, and date strings. Activations in prose fall on subword fragments, possibly due to numeric or tokenization effects; a shared cause with the primary pattern cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Numeric and percentage table cells
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and percent signs are split or adjacent in tables or aligned statistical data; often accompanied by line breaks and blank columns
patterns.domain: Clinical research tables in PubMed Central, including counts, proportions, age, sex, and regional statistics

patterns.name: Consecutive numbers and dates/decimals
patterns.context: Dates, identifiers, or decimals occur in aligned rows and columns, with numbers adjacent to slashes or decimal points

patterns.name: Architecture/instruction fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++-style identifiers, comments, or parameters, with numbers mixed with letters and split into fragments

patterns.name: Hexadecimal constants and symbols in code
patterns.context: Hexadecimal addresses are adjacent to equals signs, the letter x, and numbers in debug macros or constant assignments

patterns.name: Incidental combinations of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Words are split by tokenization in continuous text, with nearby numbers or punctuation, but no clear statistical table structure

11_390.concept: 数字及结构化数据片段
11_390.description: 主要响应表格或对齐数据中密集的数字、百分比及标点组合；也响应代码标识符、十六进制常量和日期数字串。散文段的激活落在拆分词片段上，可能是数字/分词效应，无法确认与主模式同因。

patterns.name: 数字与百分比表格单元格
patterns.context: 表格或对齐的统计数据中，数字、标点和百分号被拆分或紧邻；常伴随换行及空白列
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的临床研究表格，包括人数、比例、年龄、性别及地区统计

patterns.name: 连续数字与日期/小数
patterns.context: 对齐的行列数据中出现日期、编号或小数，数字和斜线、小数点相邻
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格或日志式数据

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的架构/指令片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 风格标识符、注释或参数中，数字与字母混合并被拆分
patterns.domain: Github 的 x86 指令相关代码

patterns.name: 代码中的十六进制常量与符号
patterns.context: 调试宏或常量赋值中，十六进制地址紧邻等号、字母 x 和数字
patterns.domain: Github 的预处理宏/底层代码

patterns.name: 数字与标点的偶然组合
patterns.trigger: « lim»«ous»«ines»及其周围的 «moving»；激活落在拆分后的词片段上
patterns.context: 连续文本中词语被分词切开，附近有数字或标点，但未见明确统计表格结构

en.concept: Numbers and identifiers in structured data
en.description: Primarily activates on numbers, percentages, and aligned cell data in research tables, covering counts, measurements, and labels across topics; also activates on enum constants and x86 instruction identifiers in code.

patterns.name: Numbers and percentages in tables
patterns.context: Trigger locations are mostly near values or statistical columns in scientific tables, often with row breaks, inter-column whitespace, counts, and percentages; specific numbers and table structures vary across excerpts

patterns.name: Identifiers or measurements in tables
patterns.context: Activations fall on row-initial identifiers, abbreviated fields, or numeric cells; aligned multicolumn data surrounds them, but no consistent field meaning is evident

patterns.name: Code constants and enum identifiers
patterns.context: Located in debug-block ID definitions resembling C/C++, followed by an assignment and a hexadecimal constant

patterns.name: x86 instruction mnemonic identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in instruction ID names, near comments indicating X86/X64 instruction categories

11_390.concept: 结构化数据中的数字与标识符
11_390.description: 主要对论文表格中数字、百分比及对齐的单元格数据激活，覆盖不同主题的计数、测量值和标签；另对代码中的枚举常量及 x86 指令标识符激活。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与百分比
patterns.context: 触发位置多在科学表格的数值或统计列附近，常伴随行换行、列间空白、计数和百分比；不同片段中具体数字及表格结构各异

patterns.name: 表格中的编号或测量值
patterns.context: 激活落在表格行首的编号、缩写字段或数值单元格；周围有对齐的多列数据，但未见统一的字段含义
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的表格（具体主题不一）

patterns.name: 代码常量与枚举标识符
patterns.context: 位于类似 C/C++ 的调试块 ID 定义中，后接赋值与十六进制常量

patterns.name: x86 指令助记符标识符
patterns.context: 出现在指令 ID 名称中，邻近注释标明 X86/X64 指令类别
patterns.domain: GitHub 汇编器或指令集相关代码

en.concept: Symbolic fields in structured tables and code
en.description: Activations cluster on numbers, percentages, and measurements in structured tables, as well as identifiers, assignment symbols, and hexadecimal constants in code; also seen on column headers and separator lines in genomic tables.

patterns.name: Numbers and percentages in tables
patterns.context: Numbers, percent signs, and adjacent fragments occur in table rows and columns, statistical results, or measurements; numbers are often split into tokens and surrounded by variable names or text labels

patterns.name: Code identifiers and hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Identifiers, operators, and hexadecimal values are interspersed in code or debug constant definitions; some identifiers are split into subwords

patterns.name: Column headers and separator lines in genomic tables
patterns.context: Table header rows and column separators made of consecutive hyphens
patterns.domain: Genomics research tables in PubMed Central

11_390.concept: 结构化表格与代码中的符号化字段
11_390.description: 激活集中于结构化表格中的数字、百分比和测量值，以及代码中的标识符、赋值符号与十六进制常量；另见基因组表格列标题和分隔线。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与百分比
patterns.context: 数字、百分号及其相邻部分出现在表格行列、统计结果或测量值中；数字常被拆分标记，周围有变量名或文字标签

patterns.name: 代码标识符与十六进制常量
patterns.context: 代码或调试常量定义中，标识符、运算符和十六进制值混排；部分标识符被拆成子词

patterns.name: 基因组表格的列标题与分隔线
patterns.context: 表格标题行和由连续连字符构成的列分隔线
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的基因组学论文表格

en.description: Primarily responds to extracted text from biomedical research tables: values, percentages, headers, and separator lines, as well as row and column content such as group labels, medical terms, drugs, regions, ages, and experimental abbreviations.

patterns.name: Values, percentages, and statistical symbols in tables
patterns.context: Occur as counts, proportions, statistical results, or missing values in table rows and columns; activations fall on numbers, percent signs, and symbols.

patterns.name: Table header rows and column separator lines
patterns.context: Near table column names, headers, or column separators represented by horizontal lines.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research tables and their extracted text

patterns.name: Case, sample, and group codes
patterns.context: Tables list category labels by cohort, subject characteristics, or cell/control group, often alongside numbers.
patterns.domain: Clinical cohort and experimental biomedical tables

patterns.name: Medical classification or diagnostic terms
patterns.context: Disease or diagnosis names occur as table entries or as part of prose introducing a table.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine and medical literature such as ophthalmology

patterns.name: Drug names and medication frequency
patterns.context: Drug names appear as table row labels, followed by user counts and proportions.
patterns.domain: Medical treatment or clinical research tables

patterns.name: Geographic region categories
patterns.context: Region names appear as table row labels for groups or demographic variables, adjacent to counts and percentages.
patterns.domain: Demographic results tables in medical research

patterns.name: Age groups
patterns.context: Age variables and ranges appear as category rows in tables, followed by counts and proportions.

patterns.name: Special abbreviations and experimental condition labels
patterns.context: Technical abbreviations or experimental measures occur in table headers, variable names, or entries; the available excerpts are insufficient to establish a consistent meaning.

11_390.concept: 生物医学表格结构与内容
11_390.description: 主要响应生物医学论文表格的抽取文本：数值、百分比、表头和分隔线，以及分组标签、医学术语、药物、区域、年龄与实验缩写等行列内容。

patterns.name: 表格中的数值、百分比与统计符号
patterns.context: 在表格行列中作为计数、比例、统计结果或缺失值出现；激活落在数字、百分号及符号上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的结果表格

patterns.name: 表格标题行与列分隔线
patterns.context: 表格的列名、表头或用横线模拟的列分隔符附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文表格及其抽取文本

patterns.name: 病例、样本与分组代码
patterns.context: 表格按队列、受试者特征或细胞/对照组列出类别标签，常与数值并列。
patterns.domain: 临床队列及实验生物医学表格

patterns.name: 医学分类或诊断术语
patterns.context: 疾病或诊断名称作为表格条目或正文表格引介的一部分出现。
patterns.domain: 临床医学与眼科等医学文献

patterns.name: 药物名称及用药频数
patterns.context: 药物名作为表格行标签，后接使用人数及比例。
patterns.domain: 医学治疗或临床研究表格

patterns.name: 地理区域类别
patterns.context: 区域名称作为分组或人口统计变量的表格行标签，并与计数和百分比相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学研究的人口统计结果表

patterns.name: 年龄分组
patterns.context: 年龄变量及年龄区间作为表格分类行，后接人数和比例。

patterns.name: 特殊缩写与实验条件标签
patterns.context: 专业缩写或实验指标出现在表格标题、变量名或条目中；现有片段不足以确定其统一含义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验或临床表格

en.description: Primarily responds to aligned numbers, percentages, and statistical symbols in plain-text tables, and often to hyphens and space separators; a few activations fall on code instructions, gene abbreviations, clinical labels, and variable names.

patterns.name: Numbers, percentages, and statistical symbols in tables
patterns.context: Numbers occur in table cells, row or column headers, or statistical results, often adjacent to decimal points, percent signs, range symbols, parentheses, and separators.

patterns.name: Table column separators and whitespace padding
patterns.context: Long hyphens separate column headers or data regions in space-aligned plain-text tables; cells are separated by whitespace.
patterns.domain: Aligned text in paper tables and code comments

patterns.name: mov substring in instruction names
patterns.context: Substring occurs in x86 instruction identifiers, adjacent to cmov instruction names and their comments.

patterns.name: Gene names and biochemical abbreviations
patterns.context: Uppercase letters, numbers, and lowercase suffixes form gene names or experimental sample abbreviations in tables.

patterns.name: Clinical classification labels
patterns.context: Labels occur in column headers or row names of cohort-characteristics or clinical-staging tables.

patterns.name: Education variable labels
patterns.context: Appears as a variable name in a table, followed by a value in years.

11_390.concept: 纯文本表格结构与数据
11_390.description: 主要响应纯文本表格中对齐的数字、百分比和统计符号，也常响应横线及空格分隔；少数激活落在代码指令、基因缩写、临床标签和变量名上。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字、百分比与统计符号
patterns.context: 数字出现在表格单元格、行列标题或统计结果中，常与小数点、百分号、范围符号、括号及分隔线相邻。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的数据表

patterns.name: 表格列分隔线与空白填充
patterns.context: 由空格对齐的纯文本表格中，长横线分隔列标题或数据区；单元格之间以空格留白。
patterns.domain: 论文表格及代码注释中的对齐文本

patterns.name: 指令名称中的 mov 子串
patterns.context: 子串位于 x86 指令标识符中，与 cmov 指令名称及其注释相邻。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的汇编/反汇编代码

patterns.name: 基因名与生化缩写
patterns.context: 大写字母、数字及小写后缀构成表格中的基因名或实验样本缩写。
patterns.domain: 遗传学或生物医学表格

patterns.name: 临床分类标签
patterns.context: 标签出现在队列特征或临床分期表的列标题、行名中。

patterns.name: 教育变量标签
patterns.context: 作为表格中的变量名称，后接以年为单位的数值。
patterns.domain: 医学或人口统计学论文表格

en.description: Primarily responds to numeric tokens in medical research tables; also covers age-group boundaries, a few variable labels or unit fragments, symbols, and hyphen separators. Triggers are scattered and show no stable specific numeric or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric cells in tables
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, percentages, statistics, or numeric fields in medical research tables, interspersed with unmarked table text and other values; no particular value or statistical meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Medical research tables in PubMed Central, including demographics, outcomes, measurements, and experimental results

patterns.name: Boundary numbers and hyphens in age ranges
patterns.context: Numbers occur in age-stratified ranges or adjacent age-group rows in tables; hyphens may also trigger independently.

patterns.name: Short text or unit fragments in headers/labels
patterns.context: A few labels, within-word fragments, units, or symbols activate adjacent to table values; no stable word meaning or specific symbol condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Medical table labels, variable names, and typographic symbols

patterns.name: Hyphen-style table separators
patterns.context: Triggers occur on table separator rows made of consecutive hyphens beneath a title.

11_390.concept: 医学表格格式与数值
11_390.description: 主要响应医学论文表格中的数值 token；也覆盖年龄分组边界、少数变量标签或单位片段、符号及横线分隔符。触发对象分散，未显示稳定的特定数值或语义条件。

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与数值单元格
patterns.context: 激活落在医学论文表格的数字、百分比、统计量或数值字段中，常与未标记的表格文字和其他数值交错；不要求特定数值或统计含义。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文表格，包括人口统计、结局、测量值和实验结果

patterns.name: 年龄范围中的边界数字和连字符
patterns.context: 数字出现在按年龄分层的范围或相邻年龄组表格行中，连字符可能本身也触发。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、流行病学及年龄分层表格

patterns.name: 表头/标签中的短文本或单位片段
patterns.context: 激活少量标签、词内片段、单位或符号，位置邻接表格数值；未见稳定的词义或特定符号条件。
patterns.domain: 医学表格标签、变量名与排版符号

patterns.name: 横线式表格分隔符
patterns.context: 触发出现在标题下方由连续短横线构成的表格分隔行。

en.description: Primarily responds to tabular content in biomedical papers: numbers, percentages, statistics, row labels, and column separators/missing-value markers; also covers local substrings in disease terms, patient characteristics, and table syntax, without fixed trigger locations.

patterns.name: Percentages and statistical values in medical research tables
patterns.context: Columns contain counts, percentages, decimals, ranges, or statistics; activations often fall on numbers, numeric fragments, and percent signs, without requiring a particular disease or table column
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and clinical/experimental results tables

patterns.name: Table structure separators and blank-cell markers
patterns.context: Column padding in headers or table rows, Markdown/text table separators, and missing-value positions
patterns.domain: Plain-text or Markdown representations of paper tables

patterns.name: Local substrings in medical terms and names
patterns.context: Short substrings within medical terms or compound words are marked; sometimes these are disease names, drugs, or clinical terms, with no consistent lexical position evident
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper text and table labels

patterns.name: Table row labels and category names
patterns.context: Variables, categories, locations, or measurement names in tables; activations may fall at the beginning or within a label, or also on adjacent values

patterns.name: Primer sequence headers and formatting markers in tables
patterns.context: Primer names, gene names, and sequences follow figure/table references; markers concentrate mainly on figure/table syntax and separators

patterns.name: Disease names and tumor classification text
patterns.context: In lists of tumor classifications or pathology names, activations cover some disease terms and their modifiers

patterns.name: Patient-characteristic tables such as sex and age
patterns.context: Within hyphen-separated patient/sample rows, sex, age, or identifiers appear alongside subsequent measurement values

patterns.name: Scale definitions and patient-group descriptions before tables
patterns.context: In grouping/definition tables following clinical visit descriptions, markers fall near sample-size symbols, separators, and truncated group labels

11_390.concept: 生物医学表格文本
11_390.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中表格化内容：数字、百分比、统计值、行标签及列分隔/缺失值标记；也覆盖疾病术语、患者特征和表格语法等局部子串，触发位置并不固定。

patterns.name: 医学论文表格中的百分比及统计数值
patterns.context: 表格列中出现计数、百分比、小数、范围或统计量；激活常落在数字、数字片段及百分号上，不要求特定疾病或表格列
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及临床/实验结果表

patterns.name: 表格结构分隔符与空白单元格标记
patterns.context: 表头或表格行的列间填充、Markdown/文本表格分隔线及缺失值位置
patterns.domain: 论文表格的文本化或Markdown表示

patterns.name: 医学术语及名称中的局部子串
patterns.context: 医学名词或复合词内部的短子串被标记；有时是疾病名称、药物或临床术语，未显示统一的词法位置
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文正文、表格标签

patterns.name: 表格行标签与分类名称
patterns.context: 表格中的变量、类别、地点或测量名称；激活可能落在标签的开头或内部，也可能同时出现在相邻数值中

patterns.name: 表格中的基因引物序列标题和格式标记
patterns.context: 图表引用后紧接引物名、基因名和序列等表格内容；标记主要集中于图像/表格语法和分隔符
patterns.domain: 开放获取论文的Markdown化表格

patterns.name: 疾病名称与肿瘤分类文字
patterns.context: 肿瘤分类或病理名称的列表中，激活覆盖部分疾病词及其修饰词
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的肿瘤/病理分类

patterns.name: 性别年龄等患者特征表格
patterns.context: 横线分隔的患者/样本行内，性别、年龄或编号与后续测量数值并列

patterns.name: 表格前的量表定义及患者分组说明
patterns.context: 临床访视描述之后的分组/定义表格，标记落在样本量符号、分隔符及截断的组别标签附近

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical research tables, covering separators, cell boundaries, numbers/percentages, short labels, and medical word fragments; many triggers cover only part of a token, with no consistent semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: Table hyphens/separators
patterns.context: Markdown/plain-text hyphens in medical research tables, between column headers and data or between table rows and columns; the hyphen fragments themselves are marked
patterns.domain: Medical research tables in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Table number and percentage formatting
patterns.context: Numbers, percent signs, or parenthesis boundaries in medical table data, especially percentages, counts, and parenthesized values; markers sometimes cover only part of a number or punctuation

patterns.name: Table cell boundaries and short fields
patterns.context: Short labels, category values, or field names in tables; often located in headers, at row starts, or between adjacent values, with markers possibly covering only part of a word
patterns.domain: Medical research tables and clinical data

patterns.name: Fragments within medical terms
patterns.context: Terms such as diseases, drugs, or covariates in medical tables or prose; activations fall on continuous or sporadic substrings within words, with no consistent semantic category evident

patterns.name: Table row indices/short values
patterns.context: Indices at the start of table data rows or short values in fields, often alongside information such as sex and age
patterns.domain: Clinical case or patient data tables

11_390.concept: 医学表格格式与片段
11_390.description: 激活主要出现在生物医学论文的表格中，覆盖分隔线、单元格边界、数字/百分比、短标签及医学词语片段；不少触发只落在 token 的局部，未显示一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 表格横线/分隔符
patterns.context: 医学论文表格中，列标题与数据之间或表格行列之间的 Markdown/纯文本横线；横线片段本身被标记
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文表格

patterns.name: 表格数字及百分比格式
patterns.context: 医学表格数据中的数字、百分号或括号边界，尤其是百分比、计数和带括号的数值；标记有时只覆盖数字或标点的一部分

patterns.name: 表格单元格边界与短字段
patterns.context: 表格中的短标签、分类值或字段名；常处于表头、行首或相邻数值之间，标记可能只覆盖词的一部分
patterns.domain: 医学论文表格及临床数据

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 医学表格或正文中的疾病、药物、协变量等术语；激活落在词内的连续或分散子串，未见统一的词义类别

patterns.name: 表格行序号/短数值
patterns.context: 表格数据行首的序号或字段中的短数值，常与性别、年龄等信息并列
patterns.domain: 临床病例或患者数据表

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, statistical symbols, hyphens, and formatting boundaries in biomedical research tables; also covers disease/cell-line labels, drugs and tumor categories, covariates, and mortality headers; additionally, a within-word fragment related to Shanghai.

patterns.name: Table numbers and statistics
patterns.context: Occur in numeric columns of medical research tables, often adjacent to ±, parentheses, percent signs, or other numbers; the value itself and its position in the table may matter more than its meaning.

patterns.name: Table separators and formatting characters
patterns.context: Table hyphens, column separators, or padding spaces, especially in plain-text tables and Markdown table structures.
patterns.domain: Plain-text extracts or formatted text of paper tables

patterns.name: Medical classification labels and abbreviations
patterns.context: Disease categories, cell lines, clinical grades, and similar labels in medical or biomedical tables; some triggers fall within words or at abbreviation boundaries, with no consistent meaning evident.

patterns.name: Percent signs and adjacent boundaries
patterns.context: At percentage suffixes or formatting boundaries of table statistics, activations fall on percent signs or closing parentheses.

patterns.name: Drug regimens and numeric results
patterns.context: Drug names and treatment regimens form clinical table rows with frequencies/proportions; activations still fall mainly on statistical value formatting.
patterns.domain: Treatment or medication tables in clinical research

patterns.name: Follow-up and tumor category tables
patterns.context: Column headers describe postoperative onset, follow-up, recurrence, and complications, followed by tumor categories and case information.

patterns.name: Drug screening/cell-line IC50 tables
patterns.context: Cell lines and assay values are listed under an EC~50~ (μM) header, in a pharmacological or cytotoxicity results table format.

patterns.name: Tumor types and case counts
patterns.context: Tumor or disease categories are listed in tables alongside counts and percentages; activations are distributed across different category-word fragments and numbers.

patterns.name: Covariate description tables
patterns.context: In methodological tables such as “Covariate type / Reason for inclusion,” separators and blank cells appear before variable names.

patterns.name: Age groups and mortality headers
patterns.context: Deaths, person-time observed, and mortality rates are grouped by sex, age, and year; numbers form age ranges and table hyphens.

patterns.name: Shanghai place-name fragment
patterns.context: The spelling of the place name is split in a single table excerpt, surrounded mainly by numbers and table data; there is insufficient evidence to connect it semantically to other triggers.
patterns.domain: Location information in medical research tables

11_390.concept: 生物医学表格结构与内容
11_390.description: 主要对生物医学论文表格的数字、统计符号、横线和排版边界起反应，也覆盖疾病/细胞系标签、药物与肿瘤类别、协变量和死亡率表头；另有上海词内片段。

patterns.name: 表格数字与统计值
patterns.context: 出现在医学研究表格的数值列，常紧邻 ±、括号、百分号或其他数字；数值本身及其在表格中的位置可能比语义更重要。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的结果表格

patterns.name: 表格分隔线与排版字符
patterns.context: 表格横线、列分隔或填充空格，尤其出现在文本表格和 Markdown 表格结构处。
patterns.domain: 论文表格的纯文本抽取或格式化文本

patterns.name: 医学分类标签与缩写
patterns.trigger: «FC»、«1»（NYHA FC 后的分级）、«HD»、«s»、«NK»、« oste»、« primary»、« disorders»
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学表格中的疾病类别、细胞系、临床分级等标签；部分触发落在词内或缩写边界，未显示统一词义。

patterns.name: 百分号及其邻接边界
patterns.context: 百分数后缀或表格统计值的格式边界处，激活落在百分号或闭括号上。

patterns.name: 药物方案及其数值结果
patterns.context: 药物名称、治疗方案与频数/比例组成的临床表格行；激活主要仍落在统计值格式上。
patterns.domain: 临床研究中的治疗或用药表格

patterns.name: 随访与肿瘤类别表格
patterns.context: 表格列标题描述术后起始、随访、复发和并发症，随后出现肿瘤类别及病例信息。

patterns.name: 药物筛选/细胞系 IC50 表格
patterns.context: EC~50~（μM）标题下列出细胞系及测定值，格式为药理或细胞毒性实验结果表。

patterns.name: 肿瘤类型及病例计数
patterns.context: 表格中列出肿瘤或疾病类别，旁边伴有数量和百分比；激活分布在类别词的不同片段及数字上。

patterns.name: 协变量说明表
patterns.context: 在“Covariate type / Reason for inclusion”一类方法学表格中，先出现分隔线和空白单元，再进入变量名称。

patterns.name: 年龄分组与死亡率表头
patterns.context: 死亡人数、观察人时和死亡率按性别、年龄、年份分组；数字构成年龄区间及表格横线。

patterns.name: 上海地名片段
patterns.context: 单个表格片段中的地名拼写被拆分，附近主要是数字和表格数据；没有足够证据与其他触发建立语义联系。
patterns.domain: 医学论文表格中的地点信息

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, statistics, and aligned separators in medical research tables, as well as a few field words, abbreviations, place names, and fragments within drug names; activations often fall on table layout or near numbers, and do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Numbers and statistical values in medical tables
patterns.context: Numbers occur in medical research tables or next to field names, units, or statistical symbols; some activations fall within values or near parentheses and percent signs
patterns.domain: Data tables in medical papers in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Table separators and repeated hyphens
patterns.context: Consecutive hyphens beneath headers or between table columns, used for column-width alignment and separation
patterns.domain: Plain-text table formatting in medical papers

patterns.name: Age-range markers in medical tables
patterns.context: Numbers form age-stratified ranges followed by years; located in column headers of mortality tables

patterns.name: Table whitespace indentation and column-alignment spaces
patterns.context: Spaces between column headers or table content, used for indentation, alignment, or padding in plain-text tables; no nearby actual value is required
patterns.domain: Plain-text formatting of medical research tables

patterns.name: Specific numeric and character fragments in disease names
patterns.context: Anti-tuberculosis drug regimens and the percentages that follow; activations include both drug-name character fragments and proportion symbols

patterns.name: Fragments within place names
patterns.context: Occurs within the place name Shanghai, not at the beginning of the full word; surrounded by table values
patterns.domain: Research location data in medical research tables

patterns.name: Fragments within anatomical movement names
patterns.context: Occurs within the names of range-of-motion items Abduction and Internal rotation, adjacent to measurement values

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and variable-ending fragments
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in medical fields or abbreviations such as Serum, Incidence, and NYHA FC; adjacent to table field names

11_390.concept: 医学表格结构与内容
11_390.description: 主要响应医学论文表格中的数字、统计值和对齐分隔线，也响应少量字段词、缩写、地名及药名内部片段；激活常落在表格布局或数字附近，模式并非单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 医学表格中的数字及统计值
patterns.context: 数字处于医学研究表格或紧邻字段名、单位、统计符号的位置；部分激活落在数值内部或括号、百分号附近
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文中的数据表

patterns.name: 表格分隔线与重复横线
patterns.context: 表头下方或表格列之间的连续横线，用作列宽对齐和分隔
patterns.domain: 医学论文的纯文本表格排版

patterns.name: 医学表格中的年龄区间标记
patterns.context: 数字构成按年龄分组的区间，后接 years；位于死亡率表的列标题中

patterns.name: 表格空白缩进及列对齐空格
patterns.context: 列标题或表格内容之间的空格，被用于纯文本表格的缩进、对齐或留白；不要求附近有实际数值
patterns.domain: 医学论文表格的纯文本排版

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的特定数字与字符片段
patterns.context: 抗结核药物方案及其后方的百分比数据；激活既包括药名字符片段，也包括比例符号

patterns.name: 地名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名 Shanghai 的内部，而非完整词首；周围是表格数值
patterns.domain: 医学论文表格中的研究地点数据

patterns.name: 解剖动作名称内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在关节活动度项目名称 Abduction、Internal rotation 中，邻近测量数值

patterns.name: 医学缩写及变量词尾片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 Serum、Incidence、NYHA FC 等医学字段或缩写中；与表格字段名相邻

en.concept: Som subword fragments and local word-form features
en.description: The most stable trigger is a name or word-form fragment beginning with Som, spanning papers, email, legal, encyclopedia, and parliamentary texts. It also responds strongly to immunochromatographic terminology and word fragments in online ads for cheap drugs; these two patterns are difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Somerville / Sommers surname fragments
patterns.context: Word fragments at the beginning of surnames; subsequent spellings vary, e.g., Somerville, Sommers, Sompa, Sommerella, Som（m）ige
patterns.domain: Personal and institution names and ordinary text across domains

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in drug names
patterns.context: Appears within the full technical term “immunochromatographic assay,” which describes a detection method

patterns.name: Wording in cheap-drug advertisements
patterns.context: Online drug-purchase advertising phrased like “cheapest … online pills”; “che” appears again on the same line
patterns.domain: Web pages or spam advertising text

11_399.concept: Som 词片段及局部词形特征
11_399.description: 最稳定触发点是以 Som 开头的人名或词形片段，横跨论文、邮件、法律、百科及议会文本；另对免疫层析术语和网络廉价药广告中的词片段强烈响应，二者与主模式难以统一。

patterns.name: Somerville / Sommers 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 姓氏开头的词片段；后续拼写各异，如 Somerville、Sommers、Sompa、Sommerella、Som（m）ige
patterns.domain: 跨领域人名、机构名及普通文本

patterns.name: 药物名称中的内部词片段
patterns.context: 出现在完整技术术语“immunochromatographic assay”中，术语描述检测方法

patterns.name: 廉价药品广告措辞
patterns.context: “cheapest … online pills”式网络购药广告语；同一行再次出现“che”

en.description: Activation samples span advertisements, tournament titles, medical papers, database fields, notices, questions, LaTeX markup, and line breaks in proper names. Apart from some token fragments and structural markers, there is no stable semantic or domain-level commonality.

patterns.name: Drug-promotion web text
patterns.context: Spelling is split into subwords; includes “cheapest online pills,” followed by a line break and another occurrence of “che”
patterns.domain: Web / drug promotion or spam advertising

patterns.name: Tennis tournament title beginning with a year
patterns.context: A year is followed by the title of a mixed-doubles event at the Australian Championships, ending with a line break

patterns.name: Detection method terminology
patterns.context: A paper title describes a competitive immunochromatographic assay and its target substance

patterns.name: Dental restoration paper title
patterns.context: The title describes custom fabrication of a positioning abutment on tilted implants, followed by a clinical report format

patterns.name: Research project description field
patterns.context: An NIH project text begins with an all-caps field name and states that the description is based on the applicant’s abstract

patterns.name: Surprise notification phrase
patterns.context: Begins with an exclamation expressing surprise, followed by a colloquial sentence about receiving a notification

patterns.name: Gatekeeper question
patterns.context: A question asks who will serve as gatekeeper, followed by a description of the role

patterns.name: Fragmented multilingual / garbled text
patterns.context: A short fragment consists of split letters, diacritics, and non-Latin characters; its meaning is unclear
patterns.domain: Unknown source, possibly multilingual text or encoding corruption

patterns.name: LaTeX proposition labels
patterns.context: Square brackets, section, proposition, and Lemma structural markers alternate in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Repeated proper name and paragraph breaks
patterns.context: The proper name Borodulino is repeated, split within the name, with blank lines before and after

11_399.concept: none
11_399.description: 激活样本跨越广告、赛事标题、医学论文、数据库字段、通知语、问句、LaTeX标记及专名换行；除若干分词片段和结构标记外，没有稳定的语义或领域共性。

patterns.name: 药品促销网页文本
patterns.context: 拼写被拆成子词，出现“cheapest online pills”，后接换行及再次出现“che”
patterns.domain: 网页／药品促销或垃圾广告

patterns.name: 年份开头的网球赛事标题
patterns.context: 年份后接澳大利亚锦标赛的混双项目标题，并以换行结束

patterns.name: 检测方法术语
patterns.context: 论文标题中描述竞争性免疫层析检测，以及目标物质

patterns.name: 牙科修复论文标题
patterns.context: 标题描述倾斜种植体上的定位基台定制制作，后接临床报告格式

patterns.name: 科研项目描述字段
patterns.context: NIH 项目文本中以全大写字段名开头，说明描述基于申请者摘要

patterns.name: 惊喜提示语
patterns.context: 以惊喜感叹词开头，后接收到通知的口语化句子

patterns.name: 看门人问句
patterns.context: 以疑问句询问谁将担任看门人，后接角色说明

patterns.name: 拆分的多语种／乱码片段
patterns.context: 短片段由被拆开的字母、变音符号及非拉丁字符构成，语义不明
patterns.domain: 来源不明，可能为多语种或编码异常文本

patterns.name: LaTeX 命题标签
patterns.context: 数学论文中的方括号、section、proposition 与 Lemma 等结构标记交错出现

patterns.name: 专名重复与段落换行
patterns.context: 专名 Borodulino 被重复，名称内部拆分，前后有空行
patterns.domain: 百科词条或目录式文本

en.description: Responds most strongly to the symbolic structure of algebra problems: variable letters and function notation, numeric constants, multiplication, addition, subtraction, equals signs, and powers. It also covers mathematical contexts such as definitions, questions, expansion, solving, divisibility checks, and rearrangement.

patterns.name: Variable letters in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables occur in polynomials, function notation, equations, or expressions to be found; often adjacent to numbers, multiplication signs, powers, or equals signs.
patterns.domain: Algebra problems and solution steps in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Function notation for variables
patterns.context: A variable or function name is followed by parenthesized arguments as a definition or evaluation target; not present in every passage.
patterns.domain: Mathematical function notation and symbolic definitions

patterns.name: Algebraic operations and equation structure
patterns.context: Operators connect variables and constants to form polynomials, equations, expansions, or transformation tasks; this structure runs throughout the samples.

patterns.name: Explicit mathematical instructions or questions
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions occur in natural-language problem statements, definitions, or operation instructions; activation is concentrated on the symbols, with sporadic activation on instruction words.

patterns.name: Specific numbers and numeric terms
patterns.context: Multi-digit numbers serve as constants in algebraic expressions and are connected to variables or operators; values vary, with no fixed numeric pattern.

patterns.name: Divisibility and judgment statements
patterns.context: Asks whether a number divides a variable expression and gives a Boolean-form answer; a rare, distinctive problem type in the samples.

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion
patterns.context: Explicitly asks to expand a product of polynomials containing variables and constants.

patterns.name: Systems of equations and solving
patterns.context: Gives one or more equations and asks to solve or introduce a relationship between variables.

patterns.name: Rearranging into a specified form
patterns.context: Asks to rewrite an expression in a target form with specified variable powers and coefficients.

11_399.concept: 代数符号与题目结构
11_399.description: 对代数题中的符号结构反应最强：变量字母及其函数记号、数字常数、乘加减、等号和幂；也覆盖定义、提问、展开、求解、整除判断与重排等数学语境。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量字母
patterns.context: 变量出现在多项式、函数记号、方程或待求表达式中；常与数字、乘号、幂、等号相邻。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的代数题目与解题过程

patterns.name: 变量的函数记号
patterns.context: 变量或函数名后接括号参数，作为定义或求值对象；并非每段都出现。
patterns.domain: 数学函数表示与符号定义

patterns.name: 代数运算与方程结构
patterns.context: 运算符连接变量和常数，构成多项式、方程、展开式或变形任务；该结构贯穿样本。

patterns.name: 明确的数学指令或提问
patterns.context: 代数式置于自然语言题干、定义或操作指令中；激活主要集中在符号内容，指令词也有零星激活。
patterns.domain: 数学练习题及解题提示

patterns.name: 特定数字与数值项
patterns.context: 多位数作为代数表达式中的常数，与变量或运算符相连；数值本身多样，未见固定数值规律。

patterns.name: 整除与判断式
patterns.context: 询问某数是否整除变量表达式，并给出布尔式回答；是样本中少见的独特题型。

patterns.name: 多项式展开
patterns.context: 显式要求展开含变量与常数的多项式乘积。

patterns.name: 方程组与求解
patterns.context: 给出一个或多个方程，并要求求解或引入变量关系。

patterns.name: 重新整理为指定形式
patterns.context: 要求把表达式改写成含指定变量幂次与系数的目标形式。

en.concept: Mathematical problem instructions and definition text
en.description: Primarily responds to equation prompts, variable definitions and solving, digit-count questions, and rounding questions in DM Mathematics; also appears once in a biomedical paper’s opening data statement and Introduction.

patterns.name: Equation-solving prompts
patterns.context: After a linear equation, system of equations, or expression with variables, asks to solve for a variable; often accompanied by equation numbers, punctuation, and an answer on a new line.

patterns.name: Digit questions
patterns.context: First gives a variable or expression, then asks for a particular digit of the result, followed by a short numeric answer.

patterns.name: Rounding problems
patterns.context: Gives a value or variable definition and asks for rounding to a specified precision or number of digits.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and substitution
patterns.context: Introduces a variable, function, or relationship using Let, often setting up a subsequent calculation; an explicit question may not appear in the excerpt.

patterns.name: Article structure and supplementary-material statement
patterns.context: The paper begins with a data availability statement before moving to the introduction.

11_399.concept: 数学题指令与定义文本
11_399.description: 主要响应 DM 数学题中的方程提示、变量定义及求解、位数和取整问法；另有一次生物医学论文开篇的数据声明与 Introduction。

patterns.name: 方程求解提示
patterns.context: 线性方程、联立方程或含变量的算式之后，要求求解变量；常伴有方程编号、标点及换行答案。

patterns.name: 数字位数题
patterns.trigger: “What is the tens digit”“What is the hundreds digit”
patterns.context: 先给出变量或算式，再询问结果的某一位数字，后接简短数字答案。

patterns.name: 取整题
patterns.trigger: “rounded to one dp”“Round … to the nearest ten thousand”
patterns.context: 给出数值或变量定义，要求按指定精度或位数取整。

patterns.name: 数学定义与代入
patterns.context: 用 Let 引入变量、函数或其关系，常作为后续计算题的设定；未必在截取处出现明确提问。

patterns.name: 文章结构与补充材料声明
patterns.trigger: “All relevant data are within the manuscript and its Supporting Information files.”、“Introduction”
patterns.context: 论文开头先声明数据可获得性，再进入引言。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Activation spans varied formats and domains: all-caps limitation-of-liability wording in legal clauses, protein names and statistical reporting in medical abstracts, algebraic expansion and equation derivation, Python data-processing code, and whitespace and indented line breaks in legal text. No single meaning explains all of it.

patterns.name: Blank lines and indented line breaks
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on carriage returns, newlines, tabs, and their combinations; paragraphs contain consecutive blank lines or indentation, with almost no semantic words.

patterns.name: Protein kinase names and Greek-letter subtypes
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract about mRNA expression and lymphoid tumors; activation is concentrated on protein names and subtype markers.

patterns.name: Statistical models and regression analysis
patterns.context: Model results concern maternal beliefs/support and daughter measures, reporting regression analyses, P values, and model-fit statistics.

patterns.name: All-caps legal phrase in a limitation-of-liability clause
patterns.context: Appears in a disclaimer-style limitation-of-liability sentence, with capitalized legal terms, enumerated loss types, and emphasis formatting.

patterns.name: Algebraic expression expansion
patterns.context: Asks to expand a polynomial or product containing the variable k; activation also falls on exponents, coefficients, and operators.

patterns.name: Python data-processing code
patterns.context: Appears in code using Python/Pandas to access dataframe columns, construct lists, and process a time column.

patterns.name: Numeric comparisons and regression in medical research
patterns.context: Reports group means and P values, followed by patient characteristics and logistic regression analysis.

patterns.name: Greatest common divisor and integer-equation derivation
patterns.context: A math problem first asks for the greatest common divisor, then gives an integer linear relation and algebraic derivation.

patterns.name: Polynomial definitions and algebraic assumptions
patterns.context: Formal derivations proceed by defining polynomials, specifying variables, or assuming an equality.

11_399.concept: 多领域结构化文本标记
11_399.description: 激活覆盖多种格式和领域：法律条款中的大写责任限制语、医学摘要中的蛋白名及统计报告、数学展开与方程推导、Python 数据处理代码，以及法律文本的空白和缩进换行；没有单一词义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 空白行与缩进换行
patterns.context: 激活集中在回车、换行、制表符及其组合；段落里有连续空行或缩进，几乎没有语义词。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 文本中的排版/格式

patterns.name: 蛋白激酶名称与希腊字母亚型
patterns.context: 出现在 mRNA 表达与淋巴肿瘤相关的摘要中，激活集中于蛋白名及亚型标记。

patterns.name: 统计模型与回归分析
patterns.context: 围绕母亲信念/支持与女儿指标的模型结果，报告回归分析、P 值和模型拟合数值。

patterns.name: 责任限制条款中的大写法律短语
patterns.context: 出现在免责声明式的责任限制句中，包含大写法律术语、列举损失类型及强调格式。

patterns.name: 代数表达式展开
patterns.context: 要求展开包含变量 k 的多项式或乘积；激活也落在指数、系数和运算符上。

patterns.name: Python 数据处理代码
patterns.context: 出现在用 Python/Pandas 访问数据框列、构造列表并处理时间列的代码中。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的数值比较与回归
patterns.context: 报告组间均值及 P 值，随后描述患者特征和 logistic 回归分析。

patterns.name: 最大公约数与整数方程推导
patterns.context: 数学题先询问最大公约数，继而给出整数线性关系与代数推导。

patterns.name: 多项式定义与代数假设
patterns.context: 以定义多项式、指定变量或假设等式的方式展开形式化推导。

en.description: Primarily responds to polynomial products and variable powers, especially “Expand” or “Rearrange” instructions followed by algebraic expressions. It also responds to one sum involving binomial coefficients, as well as sporadic numbers and text beside formulas.

patterns.name: Algebraic expansion instructions
patterns.context: Appears in math problems consisting of polynomial products or algebraic expressions, followed by an expression to expand or rearrange; activation in each passage is concentrated on the instruction word and the subsequent formula.
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Polynomial products and variable powers
patterns.context: In polynomial products made up of variables, coefficients, and powers; formula structures are complex, often with nested parentheses and repeated terms. This pattern also occurs in formulas without an explicit expansion instruction.

patterns.name: Binomial coefficients and binomial sum
patterns.context: A finite sum written using binomial coefficients, including omitted terms and a right-hand delimiter; unlike the other passages’ polynomial expansion problems.
patterns.domain: LaTeX mathematical expression, possibly involving a binomial or combinatorial sum

patterns.name: Local arithmetic and symbolic fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic numbers, variables, or natural-language fragments appearing only beside complex algebraic formulas; their specific relation to the expansion pattern cannot be determined from context.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text or local fragments around formulas

11_399.concept: 符号代数表达式
11_399.description: 主要响应多项式乘积及变量幂，尤其是“Expand”或“Rearrange”指令与后续代数式；另响应一段组合系数求和式，也有零散数字和公式旁文字。

patterns.name: 代数式展开指令
patterns.context: 出现在由多项式乘积或代数表达式构成的数学题目中，后接待展开或重排的表达式；各段激活主要集中于指令词及其后续公式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 中的符号代数题

patterns.name: 多项式乘积与变量幂
patterns.context: 变量与系数、幂次组成的多项式乘积中；公式结构复杂，常有多层括号及重复项。此模式也见于没有明确展开指令的公式。
patterns.domain: 符号多项式及代数运算

patterns.name: 组合系数与二项式求和
patterns.context: 以组合系数形式写出的有限求和，包含省略项和右侧定界符；不同于其余段落的多项式展开题。
patterns.domain: LaTeX 数学表达式，可能涉及二项式或组合求和

patterns.name: 局部算术及符号片段
patterns.context: 仅在复杂代数公式旁出现的零散数字、变量或自然语言片段，无法从上下文确认其与展开模式的具体关系。
patterns.domain: 数学文本或公式周边的局部片段

en.description: Activation is distributed across numbers and variables in scientific formulas, crystallographic numeric parameter tables, capitalized names and case titles in legal documents, administrative route entries, and mean in medical statistical comparisons. In each case, it favors specific symbols or formatting fragments in structured text.

patterns.name: Scientific mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Variables, Greek letters, partial derivatives, equations, and equation markers appear in mathematical or physical formulas; activation often falls on symbols and formula structure.

patterns.name: Crystallographic numeric table format
patterns.context: In SADABS numerical correction records, parameter names are followed by equals signs and values, with arrows listing before-and-after values; formatted table content.

patterns.name: Proper names and legal-document formatting
patterns.context: Names, attorneys’ names, or estate case titles in court records appear in all caps or segmented capitalization, mixed with dates, addresses, and legal roles.

patterns.name: Administrative district route entries
patterns.context: Itemized lists of roads or regional routes in Philippine cities, with locations and road names following district numbers.

patterns.name: mean in statistical comparisons
patterns.context: An abstract narrative compares median and mean and concerns test results and questionnaire conditions.

11_399.concept: 结构化文本标记
11_399.description: 激活分布于科学公式与变量、晶体学数值参数表、法律文书中的大写人名和案名、行政路线条目，以及医学统计比较中的 mean；各处都偏向结构化文本中的特定符号或格式片段。

patterns.name: 科学数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学或物理公式中出现变量、希腊字母、偏导、等式及公式标记；激活常落在符号及公式结构上。

patterns.name: 晶体学数值表格格式
patterns.context: SADABS 数值校正记录中，参数名后跟等号和数值，并以箭头列出前后值；格式化表格内容。

patterns.name: 专名及法律文书排版
patterns.context: 法院案卷中的人名、律师姓名或遗产案件标题，以大写或分段大写呈现，夹杂日期、地址和法律身份。

patterns.name: 行政区路线条目
patterns.context: 菲律宾城市道路或区域路线的分项列表，区域编号后接地点、道路名称。

patterns.name: 统计比较中的 mean
patterns.context: 摘要叙述中比较 median 与 mean，涉及检查结果及问卷条件。

en.description: The most stable signal is have and its common syntactic collocations, present throughout all ten passages; nearby personal pronouns, modal verbs, and be also often activate. Topics span education, forum advice, recruitment, sports, product copy, and workplace complaints, with no unified thematic semantics.

patterns.name: Auxiliary and lexical uses of have
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on have, often in have + noun, have to + verb, or have + object complement structures; the contexts themselves are not unified.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, education and recruitment text, product copy, sports discussion, work complaints

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and modal/copular constructions
patterns.context: Offers advice to people or groups, states ability or obligation, or describes their state; often occurs near have in the sentence, with some activation on these collocations as well.
patterns.domain: Informal discussion, instructions, recruitment requirements, service descriptions

patterns.name: “great” and positive evaluations
patterns.context: Positively evaluates opportunities, products, or expected outcomes; sometimes occurs in the same sentence as have, but is not a theme shared by all passages.
patterns.domain: Forum advice, sports commentary, product promotion

patterns.name: Education, training, and qualification requirements
patterns.context: Involves study, teaching, training experience, or job qualifications; some passages also contain have.
patterns.domain: Education, professional qualifications, community training descriptions

patterns.name: Disagreement and group positions
patterns.context: Discusses whether a group supports, opposes, or should be allowed to do something.

patterns.name: Sports roster and playoff expectations
patterns.context: Hypothesizes that a team has a suitable roster and predicts its season results.

patterns.name: Men’s grooming products
patterns.context: Lists grooming products and provides selection advice and product reviews.

patterns.name: Work management and unrealistic deadlines
patterns.context: Complains that managers do not understand the work and that unreasonable deadlines consume coding time.

11_399.concept: have 及其句法搭配
11_399.description: 最稳定的线索是 have 及其常见句法搭配，贯穿十段；邻近的人称代词、情态词和 be 也常激活。话题横跨教育、论坛建议、招聘、体育、商品文案与职场抱怨，主题语义并不统一。

patterns.name: have 的助动词/实义用法
patterns.trigger: “have”及其变体，如 “have to”“have the”“have a”“Have”“have 3 terms”
patterns.context: 激活集中落在 have 上，常处于 have + 名词、have to + 动词或 have + 宾语补足语结构；语境本身并不统一。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、教育与招聘文本、产品文案、体育讨论、工作抱怨

patterns.name: 人称代词与情态/系词搭配
patterns.trigger: “you”“They”“people”附近的 “will”“should”“can”“would”“be”“don’t”；例如“you have to”“They will be”“you should have”
patterns.context: 对人或群体提出建议、陈述能力/义务，或描述其状态；多见于 have 所在句子的邻近位置，部分激活也落在这些搭配上。
patterns.domain: 非正式议论、指导说明、招聘条件、服务介绍

patterns.name: “great”及正面评价
patterns.context: 正面评价机会、产品或预期结果；有时与 have 同句，但不是所有段落共有的主题。
patterns.domain: 论坛建议、体育评论、商品宣传

patterns.name: 教育、培训与资历条件
patterns.context: 涉及学习、教学、培训经历或入职资格；有些段落同时出现 have。
patterns.domain: 教育、职业资格、社区培训介绍

patterns.name: 意见分歧与群体立场
patterns.trigger: “in favor of it”“stop opposing”“people who care”“Everyone should be allowed”
patterns.context: 讨论某群体是否支持、反对或应获准做某事。

patterns.name: 体育阵容与季后赛预期
patterns.trigger: “good starting RB’s”“make the playoffs”“win it all”
patterns.context: 假设球队拥有合适阵容，并预测其赛季成绩。

patterns.name: 男士理容产品
patterns.trigger: “balm, wax, combs, scissors, safety razors, or beard trimmers”
patterns.context: 列举理容用品，并介绍选择建议与产品评价。

patterns.name: 工作管理与不切实际期限
patterns.trigger: “unrealistic deadlines”“managers who don’t understand the work”“people who have no idea what we do”
patterns.context: 抱怨管理者不了解工作、导致编码时间被不合理期限占满。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on numbers, operators, and LaTeX math commands in scientific formulas. The rest is scattered across English function words, negation and degree expressions, and vocabulary from multiple domains, with no single semantic or syntactic pattern explaining it.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical formatting
patterns.context: Numbers or operators are embedded in formulas, LaTeX math formatting, or mathematical definitions; activation often falls on numbers and adjacent symbols.
patterns.domain: Academic formulas in ArXiv and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Function and parenthesis structures in formulas
patterns.context: Around functions, variables, parentheses, or LaTeX commands in mathematical expressions, usually alongside the number pattern.

patterns.name: Common English function words and phrases
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, activation is scattered across pronouns, prepositions, auxiliaries, and words in phrases; there is no clear, consistent syntactic position.
patterns.domain: HackerNews dialogue and general English text

patterns.name: Negation and degree expressions
patterns.context: There is local activation around negation, degree, or comparison expressions, but these words are not shared by every passage.
patterns.domain: Medical text, forum discussion, legal argument

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric evaluations
patterns.context: Numbers occur in ratings, dimensions, or formulas; this may be an incidental overlap between number form and other patterns.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, scientific descriptions, and formulas

patterns.name: Antibodies and experimental materials terminology
patterns.context: Experimental methods discuss vesicles, membranes, antibodies, and material preparation.

patterns.name: Legal procedures and party-rights vocabulary
patterns.context: Legal discussion of assessment of testimony, jury authority, and defendants exercising constitutional rights.

patterns.name: Golf experience and ratings
patterns.context: A personal review of golf equipment or course experience mentions rounds, courses, and ratings.

patterns.name: Application platforms and business judgment
patterns.context: Advises making an independent judgment about an application’s profitability on a platform, based on data.

patterns.name: Evaluation of Observable notebook tools
patterns.context: An approving comment on the experience of using Jupyter notebooks after using Observable.

11_399.concept: 数学排版与零散英语
11_399.description: 激活最集中于科学公式中的数字、运算符及 LaTeX 数学命令；其余散布在英语功能词、否定程度表达和多种领域词汇中，无法由单一语义或句法模式解释。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的数值与运算符
patterns.context: 数值或运算符嵌在公式、LaTeX 数学排版或数学定义中；激活常落在数字和相邻符号上。

patterns.name: 公式中的函数与括号结构
patterns.context: 数学表达式中的函数、变量、括号或 LaTeX 命令周围，通常与数字模式同时出现。

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词及短语
patterns.context: 普通英语句子中，激活散布于代词、介词、助动词和短语里的词；没有明显统一句法位置。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 对话及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 否定与程度表达
patterns.context: 出现否定、程度或比较表达时有局部激活，但这些词并非所有段落共有。
patterns.domain: 医学文本、论坛讨论、法律论述

patterns.name: 数字及数字评价
patterns.context: 数字出现在评分、尺寸或公式中；可能只是数字形式与其他模式偶然重叠。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、科研描述与公式

patterns.name: 抗体与实验材料术语
patterns.context: 实验方法叙述中，涉及囊泡、膜、抗体及材料制备。

patterns.name: 法律程序及当事人权利词汇
patterns.context: 讨论证词评价、陪审团职权及被告行使宪法权利的法律论述。

patterns.name: 高尔夫经历与评分
patterns.context: 个人评论高尔夫球具或球场体验，提到轮次、球场和评分。

patterns.name: 应用平台与商业判断
patterns.context: 建议根据数据自行判断应用在某平台上的盈利可能。

patterns.name: 可观察笔记本工具的评价
patterns.context: 以夸赞口吻评论使用 Observable 后对 Jupyter notebooks 的体验。

en.concept: Professional argumentation and evaluative text fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated in legal argumentation and rule provisions; it also appears in mathematical definitions, theorems, and formula fragments, as well as sports reporting that evaluates teams or athletes. Trigger words and genres vary widely.

patterns.name: Legal evidence rules and disputes
patterns.context: Discusses admissibility of evidence, expert qualifications, jury functions, or defendant rights; common in continuous judicial reasoning and rule provisions.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, judicial opinions and evidence rules

patterns.name: Findings of fact about employment relationships
patterns.context: Compares whether different entities are employers and explains what the evidence can or cannot establish.

patterns.name: Insurance fraud and coverage-condition clauses
patterns.context: Lists conditions under which an insurer may refuse coverage or pertaining to a policy, in itemized-clause format.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, insurance statutes or quoted opinions

patterns.name: Formal mathematical definitions and propositions
patterns.context: Introduces a statistical definition or states an inequality over the real numbers; often accompanied by LaTeX, headings, and theorem formatting.

patterns.name: Fractions and powers in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Formula fragments in mathematical Q&A, containing powers, numerators, denominators, and variables; no explicit natural-language trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Praise in sports reporting
patterns.context: Quotes a coach discussing a college football team’s performance, or praises and evaluates a baseball pitcher.

11_399.concept: 专业论证与评价文本片段
11_399.description: 激活集中于法律论证和规则条文，也见数学定义、定理及公式片段，以及体育报道中对球队或运动员的评价；触发词与文体跨度较大。

patterns.name: 法律证据规则及其争议
patterns.context: 讨论证据能否采纳、专家资格、陪审团职能或被告权利；常见于连续的判决论证和规则条文。

patterns.name: 法律中的雇佣关系事实认定
patterns.context: 比较不同主体是否为雇主，并说明证据所能或不能证明的事实。

patterns.name: 保险欺诈及承保条件条款
patterns.context: 列举保险人拒绝承保或保单相关的条件，呈现分项条款格式。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，保险法条文或判决引文

patterns.name: 形式化数学定义与命题
patterns.context: 引入统计定义，或陈述实数范围内成立的不等式；常伴随 LaTeX、标题和定理格式。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的分数与幂
patterns.context: 数学问答中的公式片段，含幂次、分子分母及变量；未见明确自然语言触发词。

patterns.name: 体育报道中的夸赞性描述
patterns.context: 引述教练谈大学橄榄球队的成绩，或以棒球投手为对象的赞誉与评价。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻或体育题材叙述

en.concept: Local word forms and domain terms as triggers
en.description: Trigger patterns are not uniform: they include a superlative suffix, an English negative contraction, randomly selected wording, and terms or evaluative expressions from sports, biomedicine, and law. The legal passages share themes of evidence and procedure; the rest have only local word-form or domain cues.

patterns.name: Superlative form -est
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the adjective superlative suffix -est; the word describes a team's historical record.

patterns.name: Randomly selected picked
patterns.context: A mathematical text describes how elements in a finite-field vector space are randomly selected; activation falls on picked.

patterns.name: can't after a negated auxiliary
patterns.context: In an informal sports forum, activation falls on the negative contraction part of can't; the similar form won't also appears.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and qualification
patterns.context: A legal ruling discusses hearsay evidence, the qualification of witnesses or experts, sufficiency of evidence, a defendant's adopted statements, and jury selection; broadly distributed across legal reasoning and procedural language.

patterns.name: Evaluations of sports figures and teams
patterns.context: Positive evaluations of pitchers, teams, season performance, or championship prospects; activation involves evaluative words and related expressions.

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro contrast
patterns.context: A biomedical paper presents in vivo and in vitro experimental results in parallel; activation is distributed across multiple tokens in conjunctions and phrases.

11_399.concept: 局部词形与领域词语触发
11_399.description: 触发模式并不统一：包括最高级后缀、英语否定缩写、随机抽取用语，以及分属体育、生物医学和法律的术语或评价表达。法律段落共享证据与程序主题；其余仅有局部词形或领域线索。

patterns.name: 最高级形态 -est
patterns.context: 激活集中在形容词最高级后缀 -est；该词描述球队项目的历史成绩。

patterns.name: 随机抽取的 picked
patterns.context: 数学文本中描述有限域向量空间里的元素如何被随机选取，激活落在 picked。

patterns.name: 否定助动词后的 can't
patterns.context: 口语化体育论坛中，激活落在 can't 的否定缩写部分；另有 won't 同类形式。

patterns.name: 法律证据与资格认定
patterns.trigger: admission ... into evidence；expert ... qualified；jury ... credible ... sufficient；accused ... adoption；prosecutor ... peremptory challenges
patterns.context: 法律判决中讨论传闻证据、证人或专家资格、证据充分性、被告采纳陈述及陪审员遴选；较广泛地分布于法律推理与程序用语。

patterns.name: 体育人物与球队评价
patterns.trigger: greatest pitchers；world-beater；winningest football program；playoffs ... win it all
patterns.context: 围绕投手、球队、赛季表现或夺冠前景的正面评价；激活涉及评价性词语及相关表达。

patterns.name: in vivo / in vitro 对照
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中对体内与体外实验结果作并列说明；激活分布在连接词和短语内部多个 token。

en.concept: Terms and judgment fragments across domains
en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematics papers, case law, everyday narratives, and biomedical texts; local cues include formulas and terminology, legal judgment words, expert qualifications and “recklessly,” as well as vaccine vocabulary. No single stable semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Traces of character-level/subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented word fragments rather than consistently corresponding to any complete word; examples include ordinary text, legal text, and paper terminology.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and formula-adjacent positions
patterns.context: Punctuation and word fragments near mathematical symbols, formulas, or definitions; activation does not fall only on symbols.

patterns.name: Qualification, adjudication, and rule language in legal arguments
patterns.context: In legal argument, evidence review, or statutory application, qualification judgments, the rights of parties, and adjudicative standards commonly appear.

patterns.name: Wording about dangerous conduct in statutes
patterns.context: Describes elements of conduct that creates a danger to property or people; in this example, activation is prominent on “recklessly”.

patterns.name: Personal narrative by a restaurant owner
patterns.context: First-person, colloquial self-narration; the speaker discusses their own abilities and experience running a restaurant.

patterns.name: Random selection and vector-space definitions
patterns.context: A mathematical definition of a finite field and vector space explains how vectors are randomly selected.

patterns.name: Immunity and vaccine terminology
patterns.context: Mentions an immune response and a safe Salmonella vaccine strain.

patterns.name: Bayesian estimation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses posterior information and point-estimation methods in Bayesian inverse problems, especially MAP estimation.

patterns.name: Value of home improvements and compensation
patterns.context: A case discusses whether a jury may award damages based on the value of home improvements, along with related litigation disputes.

patterns.name: Legal claims and judgment standards
patterns.context: A case cites established facts and explains the requirements for obtaining summary judgment.

patterns.name: Statutory defenses and current statutory wording
patterns.context: When a defendant raises a statutory defense, the court discusses their right to rely on the text of current statutes.

11_399.concept: 跨领域的术语与判断片段
11_399.description: 激活分散于数学论文、判例、生活叙述和生物医学文本；局部线索包括公式及术语、法律判断词、专家资格与“recklessly”，以及疫苗词汇。未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 逐字母/子词切分痕迹
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词片段上，而非稳定对应某一完整词；包括普通文本、法律文本和论文术语。

patterns.name: 数学记号与公式邻接位置
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或定义附近的标点和词片段；激活分布并不只落在符号上。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的资格、裁判与规则用语
patterns.context: 法律论证、证据审查或法规适用语境中，常见资格判断、当事人权利和裁判标准。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的危险行为措辞
patterns.context: 描述造成财产或人身危险的行为要件；该例中激活突出落在“recklessly”。

patterns.name: 餐馆经营者的个人叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称、口语化自述；说话者谈及自身能力与经营餐馆的经历。

patterns.name: 随机抽取与向量空间定义
patterns.context: 有限域及向量空间的数学定义中，说明向量如何被随机选取。

patterns.name: 免疫与疫苗名词串
patterns.context: 提及免疫反应以及安全的沙门氏菌疫苗菌株。

patterns.name: 贝叶斯估计术语
patterns.context: 讨论贝叶斯逆问题中的后验信息和点估计方法，尤指 MAP 估计。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 统计/计算方法论文

patterns.name: 住宅改良价值与赔偿
patterns.context: 判例讨论陪审团是否可按房屋改良价值判赔，以及相关诉讼争议。

patterns.name: 法律主张与判决标准
patterns.context: 判例援引既有事实并说明取得简易判决所需条件。

patterns.name: 法规抗辩与现行法律文字
patterns.context: 被告提出法规抗辩时，法院讨论其援引现行法规文本的权利。

en.description: Most activation comes from legal texts, especially the admission of evidence, parties' authority, statutory requirements, and jury discretion; other examples include vaccine immunogenicity, viral antibody targets, Bayesian estimation, and uniform distributions in scientific texts. No single clear semantic trigger point is apparent.

patterns.name: Admission of legal evidence and statements
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence, statements, or facts may be admitted, and the related rules, exceptions, and conditions
patterns.domain: Legal rulings or rules of evidence

patterns.name: Authorization, rights, or judgment in litigation
patterns.context: Describes the authority, rights, burden of proof, or litigation decisions of parties, juries, or prosecutors

patterns.name: Statements of legal conditions and standards
patterns.context: States conditions necessary for applying the law, proof requirements, or standards of discretion

patterns.name: Insufficient vaccine immunogenicity
patterns.context: Describes the difficulty of eliciting an immune response after administering a candidate vaccine

patterns.name: Bayesian posterior point estimation
patterns.context: Introduces posterior information and point-estimation methods in Bayesian inverse problems

patterns.name: Uniform distribution of a random variable
patterns.context: A formula states that a variable follows a uniform distribution over a set

patterns.name: Antibody targets on viral envelopes
patterns.context: Describes regions of viral envelope glycoproteins and their epitopes being targeted by neutralizing antibodies

patterns.name: Statutory citations and grounds for a defense
patterns.context: Cites a repealed statute and discusses the defendant's right to rely on the text of current statutes

patterns.name: Jury verdicts and the value of home improvements
patterns.context: Compares the value of home improvements with material and labor costs to discuss a damages award

patterns.name: Jury selection and discrimination standards
patterns.context: Discusses prosecutors' use of peremptory challenges and whether this meets the non-discrimination standard

patterns.name: Random occurrence of a generic authorization expression
patterns.context: The phrase itself occurs in a summary judgment context, surrounded by discussion of whether the facts support summary judgment

11_399.concept: 法律判断与科学技术陈述
11_399.description: 多数激活来自法律文本，尤其是证据采纳、当事人权限、法定条件与陪审团裁量；另有疫苗免疫原性、病毒抗体靶点、贝叶斯估计及均匀分布等科学文本，未见同一明确语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法律证据采纳与陈述
patterns.context: 讨论证据、陈述或事实是否可被采纳，以及相关规则、例外和条件

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的授权、权利或判断
patterns.context: 描述当事人、陪审团或检方的权限、权利、举证责任及诉讼判断

patterns.name: 法律条件与标准的表述
patterns.context: 陈述法律适用的必要条件、证明要求或裁量标准

patterns.name: 疫苗免疫原性不足
patterns.context: 描述候选疫苗经给药后引发免疫反应的困难

patterns.name: 贝叶斯后验点估计
patterns.context: 介绍贝叶斯反问题中的后验信息及点估计方法

patterns.name: 随机变量的均匀分布
patterns.context: 公式中说明变量服从某个集合上的均匀分布

patterns.name: 病毒包膜抗体靶点
patterns.context: 描述病毒包膜糖蛋白区域及其表位被中和抗体靶向

patterns.name: 法条引注与抗辩依据
patterns.context: 援引已废止法条，并讨论被告依赖现行法规文本的权利

patterns.name: 陪审团裁决与房屋改良价值
patterns.trigger: “jury”“award”“value of improvements to the house”“cost of materials and labor”
patterns.context: 比较房屋改良价值与材料、人工成本，以讨论损害赔偿裁决

patterns.name: 陪审团选择与歧视标准
patterns.context: 讨论检察官使用无因回避权及其是否符合非歧视标准

patterns.name: 随机出现的通用权限表达
patterns.context: 短语本身出现在总结判决语境中，附近围绕事实能否支持简易判决

en.description: Most passages are legal texts, especially those involving evidence, burden of proof, experts, or adjudication; other isolated patterns include website license grants, mathematical property statements, sports praise, and first-person, self-effacing narratives.

patterns.name: Legal argument and evidence review
patterns.context: Legal documents discuss admissibility of evidence, burden of proof, expert qualifications, adjudication, or fact-finding; activation often falls on argument terms and adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Case law, litigation opinions, and rules of evidence

patterns.name: Grant of rights in license terms
