patterns.context: Website terms of use state what rights the website receives when a user uploads content.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and regularity statements
patterns.context: Formulas describe the support of a function or measure and state properties such as continuity and positivity.

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures and team achievements
patterns.context: Comments on a player's performance, praising consistency, clutch play, and contribution to a championship.

patterns.name: Humbly denying expert status
patterns.context: First-person, colloquial self-narration; the speaker modestly or self-deprecatingly says they will not become an expert.

11_399.concept: 专业判断与资格
11_399.description: 多数段落是法律文本，尤其涉及证据、举证责任、专家或裁决；另有网站许可授予、数学性质陈述、体育赞誉和第一人称谦逊自述等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律论证与证据审查
patterns.context: 在法律文书中讨论证据可采性、举证责任、专家资格、裁决或事实认定；激活常落在论证词及其相邻 token 上。
patterns.domain: 判例、诉讼意见与证据规则

patterns.name: 许可条款中的权利授予
patterns.context: 网站使用条款说明用户上传内容后授予网站何种使用权。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款／法律文本

patterns.name: 数学定义与正则性陈述
patterns.context: 以公式描述函数或测度的支撑集，并陈述其连续性、正性等性质。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，LaTeX 技术文本

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉与团队成就
patterns.context: 评论球员表现，称赞其稳定、关键时刻发挥及对夺冠的贡献。

patterns.name: 谦逊地否认专家身份
patterns.context: 第一人称、口语化自述；说话者以自我贬抑或谦逊语气否认自己会成为专家。
patterns.domain: 个人博客或访谈式散文

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in legal texts concerning the sufficiency of evidence, reasonable fact-finding, admissibility of evidence, and conditions for adjudication; a few other patterns include the legal modal will, strict positivity in mathematics, sports praise, and software recommendations.

patterns.name: Evidentiary standards and reasonable inferences
patterns.context: Concerns whether evidence supports a ruling and whether a factfinder can reasonably reach a conclusion; often co-occurs with modals such as could, would, permitted and with inference or proof standards.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, evidence law, and appellate review

patterns.name: will in legal sentences
patterns.context: Appears in statements of legal rules or reasoning to indicate an evidentiary effect or purpose of a rule; activation is especially strong in paragraph 1.

patterns.name: Admissibility of evidence and consequences for adjudication
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence is admissible, whether a jury may award damages, or whether a ruling is supported.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, rules of evidence, and civil disputes

patterns.name: Judgment summaries and sufficiency of facts
patterns.context: Summarizes litigation facts and determines whether they meet legal conditions for judgment or formation of an offer.

patterns.name: Numerical support and continuous positivity
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas describe a function's or distribution's support, continuity, and positivity; activation falls on the word strictly.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, especially probability or analysis

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures
patterns.context: Praises someone's consistent performance and reliability in clutch situations, emphasizing their contribution to the team's championship.

patterns.name: Software or tool recommendations
patterns.context: Users or reviewers share software or API prices, personal trial impressions, and recommendations from others.

11_399.concept: 语境依赖的评价与判定
11_399.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本中证据的充分性、合理事实认定、证据采纳及裁判条件；另见法律情态will、数学中的严格正性、体育赞誉和软件推荐等少数模式。

patterns.name: 证据证明标准与合理推断
patterns.trigger: «evidence»、«clear and convincing evidence»、«reasonable inferences»、«probative evidence»、«reasonable trier of fact»、«reasonable factfinder»
patterns.context: 围绕证据能否支持裁决、事实认定者能否作出合理判断，常与 could、would、permitted 等情态词及推断、证明标准搭配。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据法及上诉审查

patterns.name: 法律语句中的 will
patterns.context: 位于法律规则或推理表述中，说明某种证明效果或规则目的；第1段中激活尤其强。

patterns.name: 证据采纳与裁判后果
patterns.context: 讨论证据是否可采、陪审团能否裁定赔偿或某项裁判是否有依据。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据规则与民事争议

patterns.name: 判决摘要与事实是否充分
patterns.context: 概述诉讼事实，并判断事实能否满足判决或要约成立等法律条件。

patterns.name: 数值支持集及连续正性
patterns.context: 数学公式中描述函数或分布的支持集、连续性和正性；激活落在 strictly 一词上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏概率或分析

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉
patterns.context: 称赞某人表现稳定、关键时刻可靠，并强调其对球队夺冠的贡献。

patterns.name: 软件或工具推荐
patterns.context: 用户或评论者分享软件、API 的价格、个人试用评价及他人推荐。

en.description: Activation spans multiple domains: evaluations of sports figures and players, positive assessments of ability or services, legal arguments about evidence, introductions to people and their awards, and mathematical norm inequalities. The commonality is weak; the main shared feature is complete descriptive statements.

patterns.name: Athlete performance and honors
patterns.context: Statistics, scouting evaluations, team drafts, or descriptions of player performance; may involve American football, hockey, and other sports
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, player evaluations, and game commentary

patterns.name: Professional ability and positive recommendations
patterns.context: Personal experiences evaluating products, services, or people, using positive judgments, descriptions of competence, or recommendations

patterns.name: Legal standards of proof and evidentiary reliability
patterns.context: Courts or legal texts discuss standards of proof, the evidentiary basis, and credibility

patterns.name: Career honors and awards
patterns.context: Introduces a person's business or industry honors, with the year and awarding organization
patterns.domain: Biographies, business news, or encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Norm conditions in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Conditions or estimates expressed using derivatives, norms, and inequalities

11_399.concept: 描述性陈述与评价
11_399.description: 激活覆盖多种领域：体育人物与球员评价、正面能力或服务评价、法律证据论述、人物奖项介绍，以及数学范数不等式；共同点较弱，主要是结构完整的描述性陈述。

patterns.name: 运动员表现与荣誉
patterns.trigger: “tackles”, “sacks”, “All-America”, “All-Big 12”；“championship”, “hands”, “clutch”；“Islanders”, “pick”, “goal-scoring winger”, “shot”, “speed”；“played both defensive end and tight end”, “Rivals.com 250”, “four-star rating”
patterns.context: 体育人物的统计数据、球探评价、球队选秀或球员表现介绍；可涉及美式足球、冰球及其他运动
patterns.domain: 体育传记、球员评价与赛事评论

patterns.name: 专业能力与正面推荐评价
patterns.context: 以个人经验评价产品、服务或人员，使用正面判断、能力描述或推荐语

patterns.name: 法律证明标准与证据可靠性
patterns.trigger: “Clear and convincing evidence”, “degree of proof”, “fact-finder”；“matter of law”, “evidentiary foundation”, “untrustworthy”
patterns.context: 法院或法律文本中论述举证标准、证据基础及可信性

patterns.name: 人物职业荣誉与奖项
patterns.context: 介绍人物获得的商业或行业荣誉，并附年份、授奖机构
patterns.domain: 人物传记、商业新闻或百科条目

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的范数条件
patterns.context: 以导数、范数和不等式写出的条件或估计

en.concept: Evaluative statements in legal texts and sports reporting
en.description: Activation spans legal rulings, evidence and statutes, as well as football player profiles, platform licenses, and family quotations; legal passages repeatedly involve juries, rulings, and evidentiary judgments, while sports passages focus on player performance, statistics, and honors.

patterns.name: Reasonable-jury standard in legal rulings
patterns.context: Legal opinions or rulings discuss whether evidence is sufficient to support a jury finding, especially in the context of summary judgment

patterns.name: Jury authority and award amounts
patterns.context: Discusses whether a jury has authority to make a particular ruling, award damages, or determine value

patterns.name: Assessment of evidentiary reliability and admissibility
patterns.context: A court evaluates the evidentiary basis and credibility of a third-party letter

patterns.name: Privacy disclosure exceptions in statutory text
patterns.context: Lists categories of information that may be exempt from disclosure, including medical records
patterns.domain: Statutory text or legal citations, freedom of information and privacy

patterns.name: Legal authorization or evidentiary support for an award
patterns.context: Reviews whether evidence authorized a jury to award the value of home improvements, involving material and labor costs
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, property or civil damages

patterns.name: American football player statistics and honors
patterns.context: Biographical statements of player season statistics and college football honors

patterns.name: License wording in social platform terms
patterns.context: Explains the usage license granted to a platform after a user posts a photo
patterns.domain: Online news or discussion of terms of service

patterns.name: Family sentiments about parents, children, and birthdays
patterns.context: Social media photos or birthday-related quotations expressing time spent with a mother and son

patterns.name: Player performance and team results in sports commentary
patterns.context: Praises a player's reliable catching, clutch performance, and contribution to a championship

patterns.name: Football player and quarterback coordination
patterns.context: A coach or teammate evaluates a receiver's route running and catching, and their rapport with the passer

11_399.concept: 法律与体育报道中的评价性陈述
11_399.description: 激活跨越法律判决、证据与法规，以及橄榄球人物报道、平台许可和家庭引语；法律段落反复出现陪审团、裁定与证据判断，体育段落则集中于球员表现、数据和荣誉。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的合理陪审团标准
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决讨论证据是否足以支持陪审团认定，尤其是简易判决语境

patterns.name: 陪审团权限与裁决数额
patterns.context: 讨论陪审团是否有权作出某项裁决、损害赔偿或价值认定

patterns.name: 证据可靠性与可采性评价
patterns.trigger: “lacking in evidentiary foundation”及“authentically unreliable and untrustworthy”
patterns.context: 法院评估第三方信件的证据基础和可信度

patterns.name: 法律条文中的隐私披露例外
patterns.context: 列举可豁免披露的信息类别，包括医疗档案
patterns.domain: 法律条文或法律引文，信息公开与隐私

patterns.name: 法律授权或证据支持裁决
patterns.context: 回顾证据是否授权陪审团判给房屋改良价值，涉及材料、劳动成本
patterns.domain: 法律意见，财产或民事赔偿

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球球员数据与荣誉
patterns.context: 球员赛季统计及大学橄榄球荣誉的传记式陈述

patterns.name: 社交平台条款中的许可措辞
patterns.trigger: “you hereby grant … a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 说明用户发布照片后授予平台的使用许可
patterns.domain: 网络新闻或服务条款讨论

patterns.name: 亲子与生日家庭情感表述
patterns.trigger: “Spending the day with both her and my beautiful son”
patterns.context: 社交媒体照片或生日相关引语，表达与母亲和儿子共度时光

patterns.name: 体育评论中的球员表现与球队成绩
patterns.context: 称赞球员接球稳定、关键时刻发挥及对夺冠的贡献

patterns.name: 橄榄球球员与四分卫配合
patterns.trigger: “special player”“get open for any route”“great connection”“get him the ball”
patterns.context: 教练或队友评价外接手跑路线、接球及与传球手默契

en.concept: Positive evaluations and statements of achievement
en.description: Covers content licensing and irrevocable transfers, sports performance and honors, enthusiastic positive reviews, descriptions of interior colors and materials, and predictions of film awards; some passages match multiple patterns, with no unified trigger form apparent.

patterns.name: Content licensing and rights-transfer clauses
patterns.context: Describes usage rights granted to a platform or website after a user uploads content, or a permanent, irrevocable transfer of rights in a legal document; often appears alongside the scope of rights, beneficiaries, and legal status.
patterns.domain: Website terms of service, copyright licenses, legal documents

patterns.name: Sports performance and honors
patterns.context: Reports or evaluates players' on-field performance, team results, statistics, and honors; activation is scattered across sports narratives and award names.

patterns.name: Strong positive evaluations and recommendations
patterns.context: First-person statements or quotations enthusiastically praise an experience, person, or service; often includes exclamations, recommendations, or personal impressions.

patterns.name: Interior design and material/color descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the colors, materials, and visual coordination of kitchen spaces, furniture, or decor.
patterns.domain: Home design, product or interior-space descriptions

patterns.name: Film awards and competition predictions
patterns.context: Discusses a film and its screenwriter competing for awards, and predicts the likelihood of winning.

11_399.concept: 正面评价与成就表述
11_399.description: 覆盖内容授权与不可撤销转让、体育表现和荣誉、热情正面评价、室内配色材质描述及电影奖项预测；部分段落同时命中多个模式，未见统一触发形式。

patterns.name: 内容许可与权利转让条款
patterns.context: 描述用户上传内容后授予平台或网站的使用权，或法律文书中永久、不可撤销地转让权利；常与权利范围、受益方及法律身份并列。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款、版权许可、法律文书

patterns.name: 体育运动员表现与荣誉
patterns.context: 报道或评价球员的场上表现、球队成绩、统计数据及荣誉；激活分散在体育叙述和奖项名称中。

patterns.name: 强烈正面评价与推荐
patterns.context: 第一人称或引语中对体验、人物或服务作热情赞扬；常带有感叹、推荐或个人感受。
patterns.domain: 客户评价、推荐语、访谈引语

patterns.name: 室内设计与材质配色描述
patterns.context: 描述厨房空间、家具或装修材料的颜色、材质及视觉搭配。
patterns.domain: 家居设计、产品或室内空间描述

patterns.name: 电影奖项与竞争预测
patterns.context: 讨论电影及其编剧角逐奖项，并预测获奖可能性。

en.description: Covers emphatic evaluations in quotations, legal platform-license terms, percentage guarantees, the name of a festive plant, football statistics and honors, and five-star review promotions. Trigger word types and writing styles vary widely, with no stable single semantic pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Emphatic evaluations in quotations
patterns.context: In quotations or first-person impressions, evaluators use intensifiers to express satisfaction, amazement, or engagement; activation often falls on common colloquial words such as “is”, “just”, “literally”, “I’m”.
patterns.domain: News quotes, sports interviews, experience reviews

patterns.name: Legal terms granting a license
patterns.context: Terms of service describe a user granting a license to a platform; nearby language includes grant, a, non-exclusive, and royalty-free legal wording. Activation is particularly concentrated on frequent conjunctions and punctuation in license conditions.
patterns.domain: Website terms of service, copyright licenses

patterns.name: Percentage guarantees and ticketing promotions
patterns.context: Commercial advertising describes a ticketing service and makes a promise using a percentage and a guarantee; activation stands out on the percent sign, surrounded by price or guarantee language.

patterns.name: Plant word forms in product names
patterns.context: A gardening gift article introduces a festive plant; when the plant name is segmented or spelled out, activation appears within the word and in explanatory text.

patterns.name: Sports statistics and honor names
patterns.context: Player season data and honors; activation involves numbers and components of team or honor names.

patterns.name: Five-star review promotion
patterns.context: A law firm advertisement uses customer reviews and star ratings as proof of service quality; star ratings appear alongside review language.

11_399.concept: none
11_399.description: 涵盖引述中的强调评价、平台许可法律条款、百分比保证、节庆植物名、橄榄球统计荣誉及五星评价宣传。触发词类和文体差异很大，未见稳定的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 引述中的评价强调
patterns.trigger: “is literally all I could have asked for”；“It’s just incredible”；“I’m just trying”；“was nothing short of AMAZING”
patterns.context: 引述或第一人称感想中，评价者用强调词表达满足、惊叹或投入；激活常落在口语常见词上，如“is”“just”“literally”“I’m”。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、体育采访、体验评价

patterns.name: 授予许可的法律条款
patterns.trigger: “you grant Animal-World.com a perpetual, nonexclusive, and royalty-free”；“you hereby grant to Instagram a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 服务条款描述用户向平台授予许可，附近出现 grant、a、非独占及免版税等法律措辞；激活尤其集中于许可条件中的高频连接词和标点。
patterns.domain: 网站服务条款、版权许可

patterns.name: 百分比保证与票务宣传
patterns.context: 商业宣传描述票务服务并以百分比加保证作承诺；激活突出百分号，周围有价格或保证措辞。
patterns.domain: 本地商业广告、票务网站

patterns.name: 产品名中的植物词形
patterns.context: 园艺礼物文章介绍节庆植物；植物名被拆分或拼写时，激活出现在词内部及说明性文字中。

patterns.name: 体育统计与荣誉名称
patterns.trigger: “24.5 sacks”“47 tackles for loss”“consensus first-team All-America”
patterns.context: 球员赛季数据及荣誉统计；激活涉及数值、队名/荣誉名称构词部分。

patterns.name: 五星评价宣传
patterns.context: 律师事务所广告以客户评价和星级证明服务质量；星级数字与评价措辞共同出现。

en.concept: Web promotion and formal terms/introductory text
en.description: Activation appears across several web genres: emphatic positive reviews and service selling points in marketing copy, authorization or disclaimers in legal terms, institutional award introductions, and biomedical mechanism statements. No single obvious word form runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Excessive praise in advertising copy
patterns.context: Customer reviews or product recommendations express satisfaction through strongly positive evaluations and exclamations.
patterns.domain: Travel experiences, app product promotions or user reviews

patterns.name: Prominent selling points in commercial promotions
patterns.context: Commercial webpages or advertisements describe service or product advantages, often using superlatives, star ratings, or guarantees.
patterns.domain: Legal services, real estate, ticketing, and other marketing copy

patterns.name: Authorization and licensing language in legal terms
patterns.context: Terms specify the scope of the license a platform receives after a user uploads content or photos; focus on license terms such as grant, perpetual, nonexclusive, royalty-free.
patterns.domain: Website terms of use, content licensing terms

patterns.name: Disclaimer and legal remedies clauses
patterns.context: Legal text limits liability or the remedies users may claim.

patterns.name: Institutional biographies and award reporting
patterns.context: Third-person accounts report staff appointments, institutional awards, and award-winning projects.

patterns.name: Gene and mechanism descriptions in academic research
patterns.context: States epigenetic regulation, gene expression, and molecular mechanisms.

11_399.concept: 网页宣传与正式条款/介绍文本
11_399.description: 激活出现于多种网页文体：营销文案的强烈好评、服务卖点，法律条款的授权许可或免责，以及机构奖项介绍和生物医学机制陈述。没有单一明显词形贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 广告文案中的极端好评
patterns.trigger: “nothing short of A MA ZING!”；“absolutely love it!”
patterns.context: 客户评价或产品推荐中，用强烈正面评价和感叹表达满意。
patterns.domain: 旅游体验、应用产品的宣传或用户评价

patterns.name: 商业宣传中的突出卖点
patterns.trigger: “the best car accident lawyers”；“our 5-star client reviews”；“unrivaled selection”；“a 100% guarantee”
patterns.context: 商业网页或广告介绍服务、产品优势，常用最高级、星级或保证等宣传用语。
patterns.domain: 法律服务、房地产、票务等营销文案

patterns.name: 法律条款中的授权及许可措辞
patterns.trigger: “grant … a perpetual, nonexclusive and royalty-free”；“grant … a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free”
patterns.context: 用户上传内容或照片后，条款规定平台获得的许可范围；关注 grant、perpetual、nonexclusive、royalty-free 等许可术语。
patterns.domain: 网站使用条款、内容授权条款

patterns.name: 免责及法律救济条款
patterns.trigger: “disclaims all liability”；“YOU HAVE NO REMEDIES FOR NEGLIGENCE”
patterns.context: 法律文本限制责任或用户可主张的救济。
patterns.domain: 软件或内容服务的免责声明

patterns.name: 机构履历与奖项报道
patterns.context: 以第三人称报道机构人员任职、机构获奖及获奖项目。

patterns.name: 学术研究中的基因与机制描述
patterns.trigger: “Genome-wide profiling”；“upregulation of EZH2 target genes”；“SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex”
patterns.context: 陈述表观遗传调控、基因表达及分子机制。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and their subword fragments, opening words in titles, legal clause vocabulary, matrix in medical/programming contexts, and adjustments in emails; no unified semantic or stable syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of split proper nouns or variants of proper-noun forms, including personal names, place names, and event names; trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and event entries, code comments

patterns.name: Title words at the beginning of a sentence or entry
patterns.context: The context opens with a person’s name, an event title following a year, or “Incidence” in a paper title; activations concentrate on the opening word or its subword fragment.

patterns.name: Medical term matrix
patterns.context: In breast reconstruction and radiation therapy abstracts, refers to acellular dermal matrix; in a knitr question, refers to a matrix and its indexing.

patterns.name: Contract or disclaimer wording
patterns.context: In data-use terms, describes data as available for use while prohibiting its transfer to other people or entities; activations are scattered across restrictive clauses.

patterns.name: Adjustment items in email reports
patterns.context: A short email excerpt mentions GCP adjustments highlighted in red, with line breaks and list-style formatting nearby.

11_413.description: 激活分散于专名及其词片段、标题开头、法律条款词汇、医学/编程中的 matrix，以及邮件中的 adjustments；未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的专名或专名形态变体片段上；包括人名、地名及赛事名称，触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目与赛事条目、代码注释

patterns.name: 句首或条目开头的标题词
patterns.context: 上下文开头以人物名称、年份赛事标题或论文题名中的“Incidence”开篇；激活集中在开头词或其词片段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语 matrix
patterns.context: 出现在乳房重建与放射治疗摘要中，指无细胞真皮基质；另一次出现在 knitr 问题中，指矩阵及其索引。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 合同或免责声明措辞
patterns.context: 数据使用条款中，描述数据可供使用、禁止向他人或实体传递；激活词分散在限制性条款中。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件中的法律/许可文本

patterns.name: 邮件报告中的调整项
patterns.context: 简短邮件片段提及以红色突出显示的 GCP 调整项，周围有换行和列表式排版。

en.concept: Fragments of proper nouns and title text
en.description: Activations are distributed across names and their split fragments, encyclopedia proper nouns following years, numbered legal clauses, code copyright notices, and words in medical titles; the commonality is weak, though many high activations fall on proper nouns or their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Personal names and name components
patterns.context: Appears in personal names, often with a space between given and family names; sometimes the name is repeated after a line break or accompanied by biographical, gender, or other notes.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of years and proper nouns
patterns.context: A year is followed by a country, region, event, or place name split across multiple tokens; unmarked content appears in election, Grand Prix, or date-title contexts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles or title-like text

patterns.name: Numbered clauses and restrictive legal language
patterns.context: Clause numbers are embedded in formal use restrictions describing the scope of data availability and prohibiting transfer to other people or entities.
patterns.domain: Legal or compliance text in emails

patterns.name: Code copyright notices
patterns.context: Appears in code comments, preceded by a line break and comment marker, followed by the copyright holder and distribution notice.

patterns.name: Disease and population phrases in medical titles
patterns.context: Forms the opening of a research title, followed by disease incidence, exposure factors, and the study population.

11_413.description: 激活分布于姓名及其拆分片段、年份后接的百科专名、编号法律条款、代码版权声明和医学标题词语；共同点较弱，许多高激活落在专名或其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名组成部分
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名中，常有名字与姓氏之间的空格；有时姓名在换行后重复，或附带生平、性别等说明。

patterns.name: 年份与专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 年份后接被拆分成多个 token 的国家、地区、赛事或地名；未标记内容分别出现选举、大奖赛或日期标题语境。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题或标题式文本

patterns.name: 编号条款及限制性法律表述
patterns.context: 条款编号嵌在正式的使用限制条款中，说明数据可用范围及不得向他人或实体传递。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的法律或合规文本

patterns.name: 代码版权声明
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释中，前有换行和注释符号，随后为版权人及分发声明。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的疾病与人群词组
patterns.context: 组成研究标题的开头，后接疾病发生率、暴露因素及研究人群。

en.description: Strongly responds to the sentence-initial token “In”: one pattern opens patent background sentences, while another combines with “hibition of” to form the biomedical title phrase “Inhibition of”.

patterns.name: Opening of a patent background paragraph
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “In” introduces background descriptions, followed by discussion of mechanical design, communication networks, digital maps, or computer networks

patterns.name: Titles beginning with “Inhibition of”
patterns.context: “Inhibition” is split into the two tokens “In” and “hibition”, followed by the process, target, or object being inhibited
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstract openings

11_413.description: 对句首 token“In”反应强：一类开启专利背景句，另一类与“hibition of”相连，组成“Inhibition of”这一生物医学标题短语。

patterns.name: 专利背景段落开头
patterns.trigger: «In»，常接“the construction of”“conventional communication networks”或“recent years”
patterns.context: 句首以“In”引入背景描述，后续讲述机械设计、通信网络、数字地图或计算机网络

patterns.name: 以“Inhibition of”开头的标题
patterns.context: “Inhibition”被拆分成“In”与“hibition”两个 token，后接被抑制的过程、靶点或对象
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要开头

en.description: The most stable cue is sentence-initial «Either», which introduces alternatives in formal text; other highlights are scattered across patent titles, scientific-term subwords, and common function words, with no consistent semantics. Paragraphs 2, 4, and 8 lack «Either»; the source of their activations is unclear.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Either
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a new sentence or after a transition, followed by an alternative, experimental condition, or result; this marker appears in all ten excerpts, but the following content varies.
patterns.domain: Formal genres such as academic papers, patents, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Sentence boundary before Either
patterns.context: Either follows a complete statement, often introducing another possibility after the preceding sentence ends with a period; some excerpts show a complete period before Either, while others have a comma or truncated text.

patterns.name: Patent section headings and formatting
patterns.context: Numbered section headings in patent background sections and their title-style capitalization; although Either also appears in the same excerpt, the headings themselves may be additional local triggers.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in scientific terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments in terms or proper nouns across multiple disciplines; they are scattered, with no shared semantics or stable morphological pattern, and may reflect independent weak patterns or contextual coincidence.
patterns.domain: Physics, patents, biomedicine, military, and other scientific texts

patterns.name: Function and structural words in academic prose
patterns.context: These words appear in complex formal statements, method descriptions, or noun phrases; they are also often unmarked, so they cannot explain high activations on their own and may be influenced by local collocations or syntactic position.

11_413.concept: 句首 Either 引出的备选项
11_413.description: 最稳定的线索是句首 «Either»，用于正式文本中提出备选情形；其余高亮分散于专利标题、科学术语子词及常见功能词，缺少一致语义。第2、4、8段没有 «Either»，其激活来源不明。

patterns.name: 句首 Either
patterns.context: 作为新句或转折后的句首，后接备选情形、实验条件或结果；该标记在十段中全部出现，紧邻的后续内容各不相同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利及生物医学摘要等正式文体

patterns.name: Either 前的句界
patterns.trigger: 句号、问号或句子边界后接 «Either»
patterns.context: Either 位于完整陈述之后，常以句号结束前句后继续提出另一种情形；部分段落在 Either 前可见完整句号，部分截取处为逗号或截断文本。

patterns.name: 专利章节标题与格式
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的编号章节标题及其标题式大小写格式；虽同段也有 Either，但标题自身可能构成额外局部触发。

patterns.name: 科学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 多种学科术语或专名中的子词片段；它们分布零散，未见共同语义或稳定词形规律，可能是独立的弱模式或上下文偶然。
patterns.domain: 物理、专利、生物医学、军事及其他科学文本

patterns.name: 学术文体中的功能词与结构词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在复杂的正式陈述、方法描述或名词短语中；它们也大量未标记，不能单独解释高激活，可能受局部搭配或句法位置影响。

en.description: Activations occur across code punctuation, script variables, type definitions, comments, legal judgments and litigation titles, old-book dedications, and poetry collection contents; the common cue is unclear and may involve boundaries and formatting fragments in structured text.

patterns.name: Carriage returns/separators at the end of commands or methods
patterns.context: Activations often fall near the end of code statements, blocks, or functions, accompanied by line breaks, indentation, or punctuation; however, similar tokens also occur in non-code text.

patterns.name: Litigation relations and judicial wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in court docket titles or judgment text, involving parties, witnesses, motions, and rulings.

patterns.name: Echo commands and path variables in shell scripts
patterns.context: A shell script echoes a path concatenated from date and directory variables; paragraph 10 also contains «@echo off».

patterns.name: Names and institutions in book dedications
patterns.context: A copyright or dedication page lists the dedicatee and religious titles or institutions.

patterns.name: Titles, authors, and page numbers in poetry contents
patterns.context: Contents-style formatting, with poem titles, author names, and page numbers separated by spaces or underscores.

patterns.name: Type aliases and time-unit definitions
patterns.context: A C++ code block defines a type alias for a clock structure and a duration.

patterns.name: Login method comments and exception declarations
patterns.context: A PHP-style method comment describes login functionality, parameters, and exceptions.

patterns.name: State fields in Angular controllers
patterns.context: A JavaScript controller initializes scope properties and sets default values.

11_413.description: 激活分布于代码标点、脚本变量、类型定义、注释和法律判决、诉讼标题、旧书题献及诗集目录；共同线索不明确，可能偏向结构化文本中的边界与排版片段。

patterns.name: 命令或方法结束处的回车/分隔符
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码语句、块或函数结束附近，并伴随换行、缩进或标点；但同类 token 也出现在非代码文本中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼关系与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «Appellee»、«against»、«The child in question»、«principal witness»、«petitions for rehearing»、«are denied»
patterns.context: 出现在法院案卷标题或判决正文中，涉及当事人、证人、申请及裁判结果。

patterns.name: 命令行脚本中的回显与路径变量
patterns.context: shell 脚本中回显由日期和目录变量拼接的路径；第10段也出现 «@echo off»。

patterns.name: 书籍题献中的身份与机构名称
patterns.context: 版权页或题献页列出受献者及宗教职衔、机构。

patterns.name: 诗歌目录中的标题、作者与页码
patterns.context: 目录式排版，诗题、作者姓名和页码以空格或下划线分隔。

patterns.name: 类型别名与时间单位定义
patterns.context: C++ 代码块中定义时钟结构体的类型别名及 duration。

patterns.name: 登录方法注释与异常声明
patterns.context: PHP 风格方法注释说明登录功能、参数及异常。

patterns.name: Angular 控制器中的状态字段
patterns.context: JavaScript 控制器初始化作用域属性并设置默认值。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal document formatting, document references, code errors and assertions, commitments to work effort, contract disclaimers, energy-market text, and biomedical research; they span many fields, with no single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Date and case-number formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears at the top of a court document, where dates, filing/ruling information, and case numbers are formatted with aligned spaces and line breaks.

patterns.name: Document contents, page numbers, and cross-references
patterns.context: Describes where a section appears in the contents, mentioning page numbers, section order, or misplaced citations.

patterns.name: Error handling and assertions in code
patterns.context: Appears in code involving connection-failure messages, error objects, or test assertions.

patterns.name: Project effort, commitment, and work returns

patterns.name: 项目投入、承诺与工作回报

patterns.name: 合同免责声明与数据保证

patterns.name: 能源市场、价格与交易期限

patterns.name: 科研目标与生物学参数
patterns.context: 陈述研究目标，识别控制某种生物过程的参数。

en.description: Activations show several local patterns: constituents following its, sentence-initial The, fragments of proper nouns or identifiers, and template numbers and layout words; several semantically unrelated sporadic words cannot be grouped under a unified rule.

patterns.name: Nouns or noun phrases following its
patterns.context: The word or phrase immediately after “its” is marked; noun phrases, negation structures, and possessive structures all occur, with no stable semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: everyday narrative, spiritual writing, sports, technology, astronomy, business, etc.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper nouns, identifiers, or initial fragments of split words; subsequent text continues the word or name.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, spiritual prose, code, web templates

patterns.name: Sentence-initial The
patterns.context: The article The appears at the beginning of a paragraph or sentence; the subject or noun phrase follows the activation point.
patterns.domain: Popular science explanations, business arguments, statistical commentary

patterns.name: Template numbers and grid-layout terms
patterns.context: Appears in explanations of numbered steps and web-template file paths.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on general words and code variables
patterns.context: These activations occur in different semantic and syntactic environments; the samples do not reveal a shared, specific trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, spiritual prose, code, business writing

11_413.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：its 后续成分、句首 The、专名或标识符片段，以及模板编号和布局词；另有若干语义迥异的零散词，无法归为统一规则。

patterns.name: its 后接名词或名词短语
patterns.trigger: «its»（如“its dark”“its arrival”“its departure”“its higher frequency”“its wasn’t”“its supermassive”“its host galaxy’s”）
patterns.context: “its”后紧邻的词或词组被标记；名词性成分、否定结构及所有格结构均有，未见稳定的语义要求。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：日常叙述、灵性文字、体育、科技、天文学、商务等

patterns.name: 专名或词首片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、标识符或被切分的词的开头片段；后续文本继续补全该词或名称。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、灵性散文、代码、网页模板

patterns.name: 句首 The
patterns.context: 段落或句子开头出现冠词 The；激活点之后继续陈述主语或名词短语。
patterns.domain: 科普说明、商务论述、统计评论

patterns.name: 模板编号与网格布局语汇
patterns.context: 位于编号步骤及网页模板文件路径的说明中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／模板配置

patterns.name: 通用词与代码变量等零散激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同语义和句法环境中，无法从样本确认共同的特定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、灵性散文、代码、商务文字

en.concept: Note markers and sporadic vocabulary triggers
en.description: The most stable local trigger for strong activations is the sentence-initial explanatory marker Note (with a colon or that); other activations are scattered across story behind, cognition/doubt words, medical injury terms, and isolated examples in spiritual writing and IRC, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or in-sentence explanatory marker Note
patterns.context: The trigger is Note and its following punctuation when introducing an inference, explanation, or code documentation note; [3] is followed by a that-clause, [4] by a that-clause, and [6][9] by a colon.
patterns.domain: General articles, code comments, and technical documentation

patterns.name: story in references to a story or background
patterns.context: When questioning or commenting on someone’s experience or circumstances, story is followed by behind this, meaning the underlying reason.

patterns.name: Descriptions of health and nerve injury
patterns.context: Several words in medical descriptions activate in discussions of physical injury, innervation, and muscle symptoms.

patterns.name: Cognition- or confirmation-related expressions
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of knowing, questioning, or realizing; collocations and syntax vary, with no shared fixed local phrase.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony reported in prose, macroeconomics articles, fiction

patterns.name: Spiritual expressions about frequency and energy
patterns.context: These words activate near the end of a passage about harmonizing life energy with love and light and producing high-frequency effects.

patterns.name: Spanish-language disk-information context
patterns.context: A Spanish IRC conversation discusses disk information; higher activation falls on informacion, with no phrase around it that is notably shared with the other excerpts.

patterns.name: Expressions of awareness and contact in fiction
patterns.context: In a fictional narrative, personified it is unaware that it has previously had contact with someone; this is somewhat semantically related to the cognition words in [3][7], but the context differs.

11_413.concept: 说明标记及零散词汇触发
11_413.description: 强激活最稳定的局部触发是句首说明词 Note（含冒号或 that）；其余分散于 story behind、认知／质疑词、医学损伤术语，以及灵性文、IRC等孤例，未见统一语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 句首或句中说明标记 Note
patterns.context: 在提出推论、解释或代码文档说明时，触发词 Note 及其后的标点；[3] 后接 that 从句，[4] 后接 that 从句，[6][9] 后接冒号。
patterns.domain: 一般文章、代码注释及技术说明

patterns.name: 故事或来历的 story
patterns.context: 在质疑或评论某人经历、处境时，story 后接 behind this，表示背后缘由。

patterns.name: 健康与神经损伤描述
patterns.context: 讨论身体损伤、神经支配和肌肉症状时，对医学描述中的若干词有激活。

patterns.name: 认知或确认相关表达
patterns.context: 出现在表示知道、质疑或意识到的表达中；搭配和句法各异，未见共同的固定局部短语。
patterns.domain: 法律庭审转述、宏观经济文章、小说叙述

patterns.name: 频率与能量的灵性表述
patterns.context: 谈论以爱与光调和生命能量、并产生高频率影响时，段尾附近激活这些词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语磁盘信息语境
patterns.context: 西班牙语 IRC 对话中谈及磁盘信息；较高激活落在 informacion，周围没有与其他段显著相同的词组。

patterns.name: 小说中的认识与接触表达
patterns.context: 小说叙述中，拟人化的 it 没有意识到自己曾与某人接触；与[3][7]的认知词有一定词义联系，但语境不同。

en.description: Activations span texts from many domains and are scattered across words, phrases, and subwords that vary in semantics and form; the available samples are insufficient to infer a reliable shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Local activations on specific words or subwords
patterns.context: Trigger positions and neighboring phrases differ substantially across excerpts; no consistent morphological form, grammatical position, or stable contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal texts, medical papers, philosophy, literature, and parliamentary texts

11_413.description: 激活跨多领域文本，分散在语义和词形各异的词语、短语及子词上；现有样本不足以归纳可靠的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 特定词语或子词的局部激活
patterns.trigger: 高亮分布于不同词类与子词，如 “Among the latter”“upper chambers”“The bliss of Being”“hidden profoundness”“inflammatory influences”“interrogatories”“dat[i] commerciali”“приоритетите”
patterns.context: 各段触发位置及相邻词组差异很大；看不出一致的词形、语法位置或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学论文、哲学、文学、议会文本等多种文体

en.concept: Prominent word fragments in legal documents and miscellaneous items
en.description: Responds primarily and strongly to interrogatories in U.S. legal texts, with sporadic responses to legal terminology, courtroom dialogue, and injury clauses; other examples include impulses in literature, descriptions of health damage, and HTML/Latin fragments.

patterns.name: interrogatories in court proceedings
patterns.context: Appears in litigation texts such as court orders, special jury questions, or party responses; often adjacent to transcript, affidavits, answer, and similar terms.

patterns.name: indicia in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in judicial discussion of whether to hold an evidentiary hearing and whether the defendant can show that the request has a possible basis.

patterns.name: colloquy in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Appears in quoted dialogue between a defendant and a court, discussing whether a guilty plea was knowing and voluntary.

patterns.name: Moral or spiritual impulses
patterns.context: In passages about Socrates testing others through divine impulse, or motivating the publication and verification of ideas.

patterns.name: Mental and health damage
patterns.context: Describes the negative effects of drinking or similar things on a person’s health, nervous state, and behavior.

patterns.name: Legal clauses on harming children
patterns.context: Lists parents, guardians, or caregivers who intentionally cause or allow children to suffer physical, mental, or emotional harm.

patterns.name: HTML tags and Latin fragments
patterns.context: HTML page source containing an incomplete or split Latin sentence.

11_413.concept: 法律文书中的显著词片段及杂项
11_413.description: 主要在美国法律文本中强烈响应 interrogatories，并零星响应法律术语、审理对话和伤害条款；另见文学中的冲动、健康损害描写及HTML/拉丁文片段。

patterns.name: 法院书面程序中的 interrogatories

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 indicia

patterns.name: 道德或精神冲动
patterns.context: 在谈苏格拉底以神圣冲动检验他人、或推动发表和验证观念的论述中。

patterns.name: 精神与健康损害

patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页内容/标记语言

en.description: Activations often occur on subword fragments created by splitting words into tokens, across literature, legal text, pseudo-Latin placeholder text, and code; legal passages also cluster around judicial terminology, while code passages highlight Fill identifiers. The semantic themes are not unified.

patterns.name: Within-word subword boundaries and continuations
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments of words split into multiple tokens, especially word-medial or subsequent subwords; however, not all within-word splits are equally strong, and this alone cannot explain all examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including Latin placeholder text, legal text, prose, and code

patterns.name: Legal procedure and adjudication terminology
patterns.context: Appears in contexts related to court rulings or arbitration, discussing the right to counsel, evidence, arbitrator authority, or written jury questions; activations occur on terms and nearby within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, statutes, or judicial procedure texts

patterns.name: Word fragments in Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: In continuous pseudo-Latin placeholder passages, many words are split into subword tokens; prominent activations include «placer», «er», and are not limited to legal or specific semantic content.
patterns.domain: StackExchange example code or placeholder text

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Gutenberg prose
patterns.context: In narrative or rhetorical prose, activations fall on ordinary words, within-word splits, or adjacent fragments; the passages have varied topics and cannot be grouped under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fill fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In YAML-style configuration fields, identifiers repeatedly contain Fill, with activations concentrated on the identifier's subword fragments.

11_413.description: 激活多出现在词内拆分的子词片段，跨文学、法律、伪拉丁占位文本和代码；法律段落还聚集司法术语，代码段突出 Fill 标识符。各语义主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内子词边界与续接

patterns.context: 激活常落在一个词被拆成多个 token 的片段上，尤其是词中部或后续子词；但并非所有词内切分都同样强，无法单独解释全部例子。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，含拉丁占位文本、法律文本、散文及代码

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判术语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或仲裁相关语境，讨论辩护权、证据、仲裁员权限或陪审团书面问题；激活分布在术语及其附近的词内片段。

patterns.name: 拉丁占位文本中的词片段

patterns.name: Gutenberg散文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在叙事或修辞性散文中，激活落在普通词、词内切分或相邻片段上；这些段落主题各异，不能归为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 Fill 片段

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal wording, markup code, conjunctions in scripture, and pseudo-Latin text; more prominent local features include full, legal terminology, and statutory fragments, without a unified semantic or stable morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Emphatic adjective full

patterns.name: Parallel categories of children's physical and mental health in legal text

patterns.name: Emphasis on case in a legal ruling

patterns.name: Emphasis on legal precedent in a legal ruling
patterns.context: Appears in “any legal precedent,” describing precedent; other nearby words are also activated.

patterns.name: Fragments of statutory citation numbers in legal quotations
patterns.context: Appears in a statutory citation establishing jurisdiction, with activations on fragments of the number.

patterns.name: HTML class names and inheritance anchors
patterns.context: Appears in HTML list tags and anchor attributes pointing to inherited classes, forming code/markup fragments.

patterns.name: And in religious scripture
patterns.context: Connects preceding and following phrases in the parallel structure of a long scripture-like sentence.

patterns.name: Aliqu in Latin placeholder text
patterns.context: Appears in a pseudo-Latin placeholder passage, where words are split into subword tokens.

11_413.description: 激活分散在法律措辞、标记代码、经文连接词及伪拉丁文本中；较突出的局部包括 full、法律术语与法条片段，缺乏统一语义或稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: full 前置强调词

patterns.name: 法律文本中的全量/完整范围表述

patterns.name: 法律文本中的儿童身心健康并列

patterns.name: 法律判决中 case 的强调

patterns.name: 法律判决中 legal precedent 的强调

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法条编号碎片

patterns.name: Legal authority and jurisdiction

patterns.name: Legal rulings or procedural actions
patterns.context: Describes a court taking up a motion and deleting specific wording from a judgment or text.

patterns.context: Lorem ipsum-style Latin placeholder passages with split markup in HTML pages.
