en.description: Primarily responds to wording in rulings that defines the issue under review and evaluates the applicability or grounds of cited precedent, authority, and claims; also includes legal remedy terminology, title-page formatting, and a passage of Slovenian legal text.

patterns.name: Defining the issue under review
patterns.context: A judicial opinion states the sole issue the court must currently hear or review, often followed by a whether clause or the scope of review.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings and legal opinions

patterns.name: Citing precedent or authority and evaluating applicability
patterns.context: States that a point lacks grounds, is inapplicable, or is unjustified when discussing precedent, legal authority, or litigation claims.

patterns.name: Combinations of legal terms
patterns.context: Uses parallel terms for equitable and legal remedies; the passage also discusses contracts and disputed issues.

patterns.name: Typography and institutional names in judgment headings
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and capitalized institutional names are split across the title page or case-name field of a court document.

patterns.name: Slovenian legal wording
patterns.context: A Slovenian quotation concerning public safety and surveillance by judicial authorities; it differs from the repeated patterns in English legal opinions.

11_413.concept: 法律文书中的问题与依据评述
11_413.description: 主要响应判决中界定待审问题，以及援引判例、权威和主张后评估其适用性或依据的法律论证措辞；另见法律救济术语、标题排版和一段斯洛文尼亚语法律文本。

patterns.name: 界定待审问题
patterns.context: 司法意见中说明法院当前需要审理或复核的唯一问题，常接 whether 子句或 review 范围。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律意见

patterns.name: 援引判例或权威并评估适用性
patterns.context: 在讨论判例、法律权威或诉讼主张时，陈述缺乏依据、不可适用或没有理由。

patterns.name: 法律术语组合
patterns.context: 出现衡平法与法律救济的并列术语，段落亦在讨论合同及争议问题。

patterns.name: 判决书标题的排版与机构名称
patterns.context: 法院文书的标题页或案名栏中，换行、缩进及大写机构名称被拆分排印。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语法律表述
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语引文中关于公共安全及司法机关监控的表述；与英语法律意见的重复模式不同。
patterns.domain: 斯洛文尼亚语法律文本

en.concept: Lists of specific matters and components
en.description: Legal passages often introduce issues for adjudication, procedural developments, rights, or evidentiary questions; there are also strong activations on dense lists of building components and ornament in architectural descriptions. The shared feature is broad: describing and enumerating specific matters.

patterns.name: Introducing pending matters or issues
patterns.context: A judicial opinion turns to the current issues, defects, or matters to be decided in a case; often appears after the factual or procedural background.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Procedural status and readiness for adjudication
patterns.context: Describes the progress of a case through filing, hearings, trial, or litigation procedures.

patterns.name: Lists of architectural façade components and details
patterns.context: Uses parallel nouns and adjectives to describe a building's form, façade, openings, ornament, or components in detail.

patterns.name: Statements of legal rights and issues
patterns.context: Discusses whether a legal error affects a substantive issue, or the rights, immunities, and legal classification of litigants.

patterns.name: Testimony and credibility
patterns.context: Witness testimony, disputed facts, and witness credibility are central to the case determination.

11_413.concept: 具体事项与构件的列举
11_413.description: 法律段落多在引出待裁争点、程序进展、权利或证据问题；另对建筑描述中构件与装饰的密集列举有强激活。共同点较宽泛，均偏向具体事项的说明与列举。

patterns.name: 待决事项/争点的引入
patterns.trigger: “a decisive issue”“The matter is now fully submitted”“the only apparent defect”“a vital matter”“the only issue before the Court”“One of the issues”
patterns.context: 司法意见中转入案件当前争点、缺陷或待裁定事项；常出现在事实或程序背景之后。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律论证

patterns.name: 法律程序状态与裁判准备
patterns.trigger: “fully submitted”“ready for ruling”“at the hearing”“trial judge”“to proceed”“civil actions”
patterns.context: 叙述案件提交、听证、审判或诉讼程序的进展。

patterns.name: 建筑立面构件及细部的罗列
patterns.context: 以并列名词和形容词具体描述建筑的形制、立面、开口、装饰或构件。

patterns.name: 法律权利与法律问题的表述
patterns.context: 讨论法律错误是否影响实体问题，或诉讼当事人的权利、豁免及法律分类。

patterns.name: 叙述证词及可信度
patterns.trigger: “testified”“credibility was a decisive issue”“alleged heroin sales did not occur”
patterns.context: 以证人证词、争议事实及证人可信度作为案件判断的核心。

en.concept: Issues and adjudicative language in appellate rulings
en.description: Primarily responds to the identification of core issues in appellate rulings, as well as stock phrases about reviewing the record and law and affirming the lower court; also involves criminal convictions and sentencing, evidentiary standards, citations to procedural rules, and less common discussion of jury-trial rights.

patterns.name: Stating issues in appellate opinions
patterns.context: Identifies a case's core issue in a court opinion, often followed by whether, on trial, or an assessment of witness credibility; sometimes issue is adjacent to an adjective.

patterns.name: Reviewing judgments and affirming the lower court
patterns.context: After reviewing the record or law, an appellate court states that it affirms the trial court's ruling; common in concluding paragraphs, also appearing in expressions about review of the lower court's ruling.

patterns.name: Citation of statutory procedural rules
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a ruling paragraph as a citation to rules governing appeals or judgment procedure; the trigger prominently features the letter R followed by a formatted rule number.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentencing
patterns.context: Discusses criminal convictions, whether a sentence has expired, or jury trials in criminal cases; some words are split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and standards of proof
patterns.context: Discusses clear and convincing evidence required to prove abandonment, whether an evidentiary hearing was held, or whether the record supports the ruling.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, evidence, and standards of proof

patterns.name: Liberal construction of pleadings and failure-to-state-a-claim defenses
patterns.context: When considering a failure-to-state-a-claim defense, requires a liberal construction of the plaintiff's petition in the plaintiff's favor.

patterns.name: Legal status of jury trials
patterns.context: Historical or constitutional discussion distinguishing jury trial as part of governmental structure from a defendant's right or privilege.
patterns.domain: Legal history and criminal procedure discussion

patterns.name: Random numbers and fragments
patterns.context: Numbers appear near page numbers, citations, or truncated text, with no evident stable semantic or grammatical trigger.
patterns.domain: Citations or layout fragments in legal documents

11_413.concept: 上诉判决中的争点与裁判表述
11_413.description: 主要响应上诉判决中对核心争点的标示，以及审查案卷、法律并维持原判的套语；也涉及刑事定罪量刑、证据标准、诉讼程序引证和少见的陪审团权利论述。

patterns.name: 上诉意见中的争点表述
patterns.trigger: « issue»9、« only»4« issue»9、« crucial»6« issue»9、« decisive»9« issue»6
patterns.context: 在法院意见中标示案件核心争点，常接 whether、on trial 或对证人可信度的判断；有时 issue 与形容词相邻。

patterns.name: 判决审查与维持原判
patterns.trigger: « affirm»3、« judgment»1、« trial»3« court»2、« review»1、« record»5、« applicable»7« law»4
patterns.context: 上诉法院回顾记录或法律后，说明维持审判法院裁决；常见于结论段，也有对原判的审查表述。

patterns.name: 法定程序规则引证
patterns.context: 出现在判决段落末尾，作为上诉权或判决程序规则的引证；触发点突出字母 R 及其后的格式化规则编号。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与量刑
patterns.context: 讨论刑事定罪、刑期是否届满或刑事案件中的陪审团审判；部分词被分词拆开。

patterns.name: 法律证据与证明标准
patterns.context: 谈到证明遗弃所需的清楚且令人信服的证据，或是否举行证据听证、案卷是否支持裁决。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、证据与证明标准

patterns.name: 诉状宽松解释及诉因抗辩
patterns.trigger: « petition»、« liber»«ally»、« plaintiff»、« no»« cause»« of»« action»
patterns.context: 在审理无诉因抗辩时，要求对原告诉状作有利于原告的宽松解释。
patterns.domain: 路易斯安那州民事诉讼判决

patterns.name: 陪审团审判的法律地位
patterns.context: 历史或宪法性论述中，区分陪审团审判作为政府结构的一部分还是被告的一项权利或特权。

patterns.name: 随机数字及残片
patterns.context: 数字出现在页码、引证或截断文本附近，未见稳定的语义或语法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的引证或版面残片

en.concept: Within-word fragments and statements of significance
en.description: Activations are distributed across legal issues, significance, and several within-word fragments in legal text; they also appear on lawless in scripture, spatial adjectives in fiction, constateren in Dutch, and octagonal in architectural terminology. There is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Stating legal issues
patterns.context: Introduces an issue to be decided in a legal opinion or ruling, often in structures such as “the issue … is whether” or “only issue before us”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Decisive issue in litigation
patterns.context: Emphasizes the importance of evidence, credibility, or a jury trial in a criminal proceeding.

patterns.name: Subword activation in lawless
patterns.context: Religious text includes “every lawless deed”; activations concentrate on subwords in lawless, semantically referring to unlawful or wrongful acts.

patterns.name: Spatial adjectives and landscape description
patterns.context: Describes a high place, a wide railing, and the surrounding environment in a landscape or architectural passage; nearby text also includes “from a high bank” and “on a wide railing”.

patterns.name: Local legal vocabulary in general legal text
patterns.context: Legal text includes statements about being adversely affected, race-neutral reasons, or not needing to restate something; activations fall on within-word substrings, with no unified syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Dutch
patterns.context: In a Dutch European Parliament speech, activation occurs within the word “constateren” (to state, observe); the surrounding text discusses the impact of the crisis on women.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment in architectural terminology
patterns.context: In a description of church architecture, activation occurs within “octagonal”, describing an octagonal skylight.

11_413.concept: 词内片段及重要性表述
11_413.description: 激活分布于法律文本的争点、重要性及若干词内片段，也见经文lawless、小说空间形容词、荷兰语constateren和建筑术语octagonal；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律争点表述
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决中引出待裁定问题，常见于“the issue … is whether”或“only issue before us”等结构

patterns.name: 诉讼中决定性争点
patterns.context: 刑事诉讼叙述中强调证据、可信度或陪审团审判对案件的重要性

patterns.name: lawless 的分词激活
patterns.context: 宗教文本中出现“every lawless deed”；激活集中在 lawless 的子词，语义上指违法、不法行为

patterns.name: 空间形容词及景物描写
patterns.context: 景物或建筑叙述中，形容高处、宽阔栏杆及周边环境；同时附近有“from a high bank”“on a wide railing”

patterns.name: 一般法律文本中的局部法律词汇
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现受不利影响、种族中立理由或无需复述等表述；激活落在词内子串，未见统一句法触发

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语欧洲议会发言中，激活出现在“constateren”（指出、观察到）一词内部；周围讨论危机对女性的影响

patterns.name: 建筑术语中的形态片段
patterns.context: 教堂建筑描写中，激活落在“octagonal”内部，描述八角形天窗

en.concept: Features of varied narrative and legal phrases
en.description: Activations cover juries and constitutional rights in legal text, fixed issue expressions, trustee and property-damage accounts, as well as reclining postures, descriptions of spatial arrangements, and chapter formatting in fiction; no single triggering theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Jury-trial rights and constitutional protections
patterns.context: Discusses the right to a jury trial in criminal proceedings, whether a defendant knew and understood their rights, and the legal status of the jury system; activations concentrate on related legal language.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, criminal procedure, and constitutional legal writing

patterns.name: “central issue” discourse frame
patterns.context: A legal document turns to an issue or focus of argument, especially in the fixed phrase “central issue”; this pattern is independent of the specific dispute.

patterns.name: A character leaning or reclining
patterns.context: Describes a character leaning or reclining; both passages include leaned, but one depicts standing while leaning on a hand, and the other reclining against a chair.

patterns.name: Descriptions of spatial layout and interior furnishings
patterns.context: Provides successive details about a house, terrain, furniture, or light, including location, dimensions, spatial relationships, and other visual information.

patterns.name: Fire-related property loss
patterns.context: Lists damage caused by a fire and personal property that was damaged or insured.
patterns.domain: Insurance- or bankruptcy-related legal fact statements

patterns.name: Trustee role and business control
patterns.context: Courtroom questions and answers discuss whether a party acknowledges the trustee's full role in operating a business.

patterns.name: Printed chapter headings and character entrance action
patterns.context: Illustration markers and all-caps chapter headings in scanned or typeset text are followed by a description of the protagonist reclining in a chair; this may overlap with the “character reclining” pattern, but the heading format itself does not appear in other passages.

11_413.concept: 多类叙事与法律短语特征
11_413.description: 激活覆盖法律文本中的陪审团与宪法权利、固定争点表达、受托人及财产损害叙述，也覆盖小说里的倚靠姿势、空间陈设描写和章节版式；没有单一触发主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 法庭陪审团权利与宪法保障
patterns.context: 讨论刑事审判中的陪审团审判权、被告是否知悉并理解权利，以及陪审团制度的法律地位；激活集中在相关法律论述词句。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、刑事诉讼与宪法法律文体

patterns.name: “central issue”论述框架
patterns.context: 法律文书转入争点或论证焦点时，尤其是固定搭配“central issue”；此模式与具体争议内容无关。

patterns.name: 人物倚靠或后仰
patterns.trigger: « leaned»«eas»ily» upon … hand；« leaned» back … in his chair
patterns.context: 叙述人物以身体倚靠、后仰的姿势；两处均出现 leaned，但一处为倚手站立，一处为靠椅后仰。

patterns.name: 空间布置与室内陈设描写
patterns.context: 以连续细节描写房屋、地形、家具或光线，包含位置、尺寸、空间关系等视觉信息。

patterns.name: 火灾财产损失
patterns.context: 列举火灾造成的损害及受损、投保的个人财产。
patterns.domain: 保险或破产相关法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 受托人角色与企业控制
patterns.context: 庭审问答中讨论当事人是否承认受托人在企业经营中的完整角色。

patterns.name: 印刷章节标题及人物出场动作
patterns.context: 扫描或排版文本中的插图标记、全大写章节标题之后，叙述主人公坐在椅中后仰；可能与“人物后仰”模式重叠，但标题格式本身不见于其他段。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several unrelated phrases: expressions of spatial paths, issues and emphatic wording in legal reasoning, a verb for trampling in poetry, within-word fragments in Polish, maxillofacial medical terminology, and a metaphor of emotional brokenness; no stable semantic feature spans all passages.

patterns.name: Spatial prepositional phrases and direction
patterns.context: Describes a view, path, or positional relationship extending outward or upward from somewhere, often using successive prepositions and article phrases.

patterns.name: Issues and emphatic words in legal discussion
patterns.context: When legal text states an issue, legal right, rule's effect, or case question, activated words fall on argumentative nouns and emphatic modifiers.

patterns.name: Trampling imagery in poetry
patterns.context: In an imperative poetic line, a verb means to trample; the preceding text compares something to a pillow, and the following text turns it into something to be stepped on.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Polish word forms
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Polish subword fragments involving expressions about other institutions, the top priority, and being involved in something.

patterns.name: Maxillofacial and joint anatomy terminology
patterns.context: Describes clinical findings and imaging results related to bone, occlusion, and the temporomandibular joint.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, orthodontics and temporomandibular joint

patterns.name: Metaphor of emotional harm as brokenness
patterns.context: Describes an intense emotional reaction to being hurt by a loved one, using “broken” as a metaphor.

11_413.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的词句：空间路径表达、法律论证中的争点与强调语、诗歌践踏动词、波兰语词内片段、颌面医学术语及情感破碎隐喻；未见贯穿各段的稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 空间介词短语与方向
patterns.context: 描写从某处向外或向上延伸的视线、路径或位置关系，常见连续介词和冠词短语
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、自然景物描写

patterns.name: 法律论述中的争点与强调词
patterns.context: 法律文本在陈述争点、法律权利、规则效力或案件问题时，激活词落在论证性名词和强调性修饰语上

patterns.name: 诗歌中的践踏意象
patterns.context: 命令式诗句中，动词表示践踏；前文将某物比作枕头，后文转为踩踏用途

patterns.name: 波兰语词形中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在波兰语词内部的子词片段，涉及与其他机构、第一优先事项及涉及某事等表达

patterns.name: 颌面与关节解剖术语
patterns.context: 描述骨骼、咬合及颞下颌关节的临床表现和影像所见
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，正畸/颌面关节

patterns.name: 情感伤害的破碎隐喻
patterns.context: 描述被所爱之人伤害时的强烈情绪反应，以“破碎”作比喻

en.description: Mainly appears in case law, highlighting the importance and effect of issues, legal rights, or matters; there are also two isolated patterns: “wide railing” in literature and “trample on” in poetry.

patterns.name: Discussion of legal issues and grounds for judgment
patterns.context: Legal text raises an issue, explains the effect of a law or a right, and uses abstract evaluative terms to emphasize its importance or completeness; not every adjacent word is marked.
patterns.domain: Case law and criminal and civil legal reasoning

patterns.name: Wide railing in a residential setting
patterns.context: Describes a wide railing on the porch of a residence; activations concentrate on the adjective wide and nearby material.

patterns.name: Trampling action in poetry
patterns.context: A poetic line commands that something be used for trampling; activation falls on the verb trample and the following preposition.

11_413.description: 主要出现在判例中，突出争点、法律权利或事项的重要性与效力；另有文学中的“wide railing”和诗句中的“trample on”两种孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律问题的论述与裁判理由
patterns.context: 法律文本中提出争点、说明法律效力或权利，并以抽象评价词强调其重要性或完整性；不是每处相邻词都被标记
patterns.domain: 判例、刑事与民事法律论证

patterns.name: 住宅景物中的宽阔栏杆
patterns.context: 叙述住宅门廊时，描述栏杆宽阔；激活集中在形容词 wide 及其邻近部分

patterns.name: 诗句中践踏的动作
patterns.context: 诗歌句中命令某物被用作践踏之物，激活落在动词 trample 及后接介词

en.description: Mixed activation patterns: the most concentrated activations occur in email archive headers, whitespace, and proper-name fragments; others are scattered across subword fragments, math problems, medical phrases, and patent terminology, with no consistent cross-segment semantics.

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries within compound words
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented subword fragments, including word-final or word-initial fragments. These fragments occur in different contexts, with no consistent semantic function.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, math problems, patent text, and other genres

patterns.name: Email forwarding headers and whitespace fields
patterns.context: Near email header fields such as addresses, dates, and recipients, especially in formatted regions containing tabs and newlines; strong activation often occurs in whitespace between fields.

patterns.name: Entity-name or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Proper names such as people’s names, email addresses, and organization names are split into multiple tokens; activation occurs across name fragments and nearby email-header formatting, making it unclear whether it responds to the names themselves or the email format.

patterns.name: Need in a piano-related question
patterns.context: In the title-style question “First, How Long Does a Piano Need to Be”, Need has the strongest activation; there is insufficient context to establish a more general semantic trigger.

patterns.name: prime factors in math problems
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in problems asking for the prime factors of integers; nearby are numbers and comma-separated answers.

patterns.name: in vitro model phrase
patterns.context: In a medical abstract title, “in vitro” is followed by whole bladder model; activation may relate to this fixed phrase or associated medical vocabulary.

patterns.name: Effect of polar surface-area ratio
patterns.context: In a regression-analysis passage discussing peptide retention and the nonpolar/polar surface-area ratio, the verb occurs where the variable’s effect is described.

patterns.name: Occluding component in a patent
patterns.context: In a patent description of image display and selection methods, «masked» modifies parts of array; a single passage is insufficient to infer broader trigger conditions.

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 激活模式混杂：邮件归档的头部、空白和专名片段最集中；其余分散在词内片段、数学题、医学短语及专利术语中，未显出跨段统一语义。

patterns.name: 合成词内部的词素边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内片段上，包含词尾或词首片段；这些片段各自出现在不同语境中，未见一致的语义功能。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、数学题、专利文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 邮件转发头部与空白字段
patterns.context: 邮件地址、日期、收件人等邮件头字段附近，尤其是含制表符和换行的格式化区域；多处在字段间空白处强激活。

patterns.name: 实体名称或标识符片段
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱地址、组织名等专名被拆成多个 token；激活分布在名称片段及其邻近邮件头格式中，无法确定是对专名本身还是邮件格式的反应。

patterns.name: 钢琴相关问句中的 Need
patterns.context: 标题式问句“First, How Long Does a Piano Need to Be”中，Need 获得最强激活；没有足够上下文证明更一般的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 prime factors
patterns.context: 反复出现在要求列出整数质因数的题目中；附近还有数字与逗号分隔的答案。

patterns.name: 体外模型短语
patterns.context: 医学摘要的标题中，“in vitro”后接 whole bladder model；这段激活可能与该固定短语或相关医学词汇有关。

patterns.name: 极性表面积比的影响
patterns.context: 讨论肽保留率及非极性/极性表面积比的回归分析段落中，动词出现在说明变量影响的位置。

patterns.name: 专利中的遮挡部件
patterns.context: 图像显示与选择方法的专利描述中，«masked» 修饰 array 的 parts；单段证据不足以归纳更广触发条件。

en.description: Diverse activation patterns: the clearest is sentence-initial After; other examples include subword fragments, list remnants, great product, mathematical terminology, and uppercase state names in legal text. Aside from After, the patterns have no clear shared semantic or syntactic features.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial After
patterns.context: After occurs at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a time, experience, or event; sometimes a following word also activates, such as «retiring», «a».
patterns.domain: Narrative, biographies, educational experience, and general web text

patterns.name: Name or within-word fragment
patterns.context: Subword fragments within names or words are marked, with no shared syntactic or semantic context.

patterns.name: List and spelling remnants
patterns.context: Short, incompletely formatted, or possibly noisy web-text fragments.

patterns.name: Evaluative product collocation
patterns.context: great modifies product, followed by punctuation and a number on a new line.

patterns.name: Mathematical term third derivative
patterns.context: third modifies derivative, followed by a mathematical expression.

patterns.name: Uppercase state-name phrase
patterns.context: In an all-uppercase state-name phrase, some word fragments in STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA activate.

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 激活模式多样：最明显的是句首 After；另见词内片段、列表残片、great product、数学术语及法律文本中的大写州名。除 After 外，各模式间缺乏明显共同语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: After 句首
patterns.context: After 位于句首，后接时间、经历或事件；有时后续词也激活，如 «retiring»、«a»。
patterns.domain: 叙述、人物简介、教育经历及一般网页文本

patterns.name: 姓名或词内片段
patterns.context: 姓名或词语内部的子词片段被标记，缺乏共同的句法或语义上下文。

patterns.name: 列表与拼写残片
patterns.context: 短小、格式不完整或疑似噪声的网页文本片段。

patterns.name: 评价性 product 搭配
patterns.context: great 修饰 product，随后是标点和换行数字。
patterns.domain: 网页文本或商品相关文本

patterns.name: 数学术语 third derivative
patterns.context: third 修饰 derivative，后接数学表达式。

patterns.name: 州名大写短语
patterns.context: 全大写的州名短语中，STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA 的部分词片段激活。

en.description: Responds to prominent heading information in legal document headers, especially unpublished markings and court names; also responds to publication status, state names, volume numbers, and header text such as FILED.

patterns.name: Unpublished-decision marking and court heading
patterns.context: The first-page heading area of a court opinion or decision, often with uppercase UNPUBLISHED followed by the court name on the next line; also includes other court headings

patterns.name: Other uppercase heading information in decision headers
patterns.context: Header or title position on the first page of a legal document, including publication status, jurisdiction, volume number, and filing marker

11_647.concept: 法律文书首页页眉
11_647.description: 对法律文书首页页眉中的显著标题信息有反应，尤其是未刊标记和法院名称；也响应出版状态、州名、卷号及 FILED 等页眉文字。

patterns.name: 未刊判决标记与法院标题
patterns.trigger: «UN»PUBLISHED«；«UNITED» STATES COURT；«UNITED» STATES DISTRICT« COURT；«Fourth Court of Appeals»
patterns.context: 法院意见或判决的首页标题区域，常在大写的 UNPUBLISHED 后换行接法院名称；也包括其他法院标题

patterns.name: 判决页眉中的其他大写标题信息
patterns.trigger: «NOT FOR PUBLICATION»；«STATE» OF WEST VIRGINIA；«148» T.C. No. 10；«FILED»
patterns.context: 法律文书首页的页眉或标题位置，包含出版状态、司法管辖区、卷号及提交标记

en.description: Primarily responds to HTML/XML markup, angle-bracket tags, and their indentation and newline structure, covering tables, lists, links, layout, and configuration tags; also activates on front-end styles/templates and navigation text, with one bare news headline and URL.

patterns.name: HTML markup and structural tags
patterns.context: HTML snippets contain dense tags, often with attributes, indentation, and newlines; activation spans tag names, angle brackets, and some adjacent text.
patterns.domain: Web source code, templates, and documentation

patterns.name: Navigation or link text in HTML lists
patterns.context: Text appears within link or navigation structures such as `<li><a ...>`; some text itself also activates.
patterns.domain: Web navigation and interface source code

patterns.name: HTML/CSS styles and front-end templates
patterns.context: HTML elements contain CSS classes, style declarations, or Angular template directives.

patterns.name: Structured-document tags
patterns.context: XML fields or configuration elements are organized using angle-bracket tags.
patterns.domain: XML format documentation and Maven configuration

patterns.name: HTML table heading structure
patterns.context: Row and column heading tags appear consecutively at the start of a table.

patterns.name: Web URL and news headline
patterns.context: A one-line news-link headline and its URL, with no obvious HTML tag structure.

11_647.concept: 标记语言结构
11_647.description: 主要响应 HTML/XML 标记、尖括号标签及其缩进换行结构，涵盖表格、列表、链接、布局和配置标签；也激活于前端样式/模板与导航文字，另有一段裸新闻标题和网址。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与结构标签
patterns.context: HTML 片段中标签密集出现，常伴随属性、缩进与换行；激活遍布标签名、尖括号及部分相邻文本。

patterns.name: HTML 列表中的导航或链接文字
patterns.context: 文字位于 `<li><a ...>` 等链接或导航结构内，部分文字本身也有激活。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 样式与前端模板
patterns.context: HTML 元素带有 CSS 类、样式声明或 Angular 模板指令。

patterns.name: 结构化文档标签
patterns.context: XML 格式的字段或配置元素以尖括号标签组织。
patterns.domain: XML 文件格式说明与 Maven 配置

patterns.name: HTML 表格标题结构
patterns.context: 表格开头的行与列标题标签连续出现。
patterns.domain: 代码文档中的 HTML 表格

patterns.name: 网页 URL 与新闻标题
patterns.context: 单行新闻链接标题及其网址，没有明显 HTML 标签结构。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on within-word fragments beginning with recon or unw, but spans different meanings; there are also glossary attributes and a Triggers fragment in code, which do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in re- prefixed words
patterns.context: High activation falls on the within-word fragment recon; it appears in different words such as reconvey, reconsider, reconvene, reconstitute, and reconnaissance, which do not share the same meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, scientific papers, encyclopedia text, and other prose

patterns.name: Within-word unw- fragment
patterns.context: High activation falls on word fragments beginning with unw, forming unwounded and unwinding; the words have different meanings.

patterns.name: glossary attribute and interface text
patterns.context: The glossary attribute in an HTML button link, near interface words and tags such as View All, active, and card.

patterns.name: Storyboard transition-name fragment
patterns.context: In a XAML-style Storyboard/Trigger configuration, activation falls on a within-word fragment in Triggers; the same passage also contains identifiers such as BeginStoryboard and SlideInRight.

11_647.concept: 词内片段触发
11_647.description: 激活主要集中于若干以 recon 或 unw 开头的词内片段，但涉及多种不同词义；另有 glossary 属性与代码中的 Triggers 片段，无法归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: re- 前缀词的词内片段
patterns.trigger: « recon»9vey、« recon»9sidered、« recon»9vened、« recon»9sidered、« recon»9stituted、« recon»9naissance
patterns.context: 高激活落在 recon 这一词内片段；出现在 reconvey、reconsider、reconvene、reconstitute、reconnaissance 等不同词中，语义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、科学论文、百科全书等正文

patterns.name: unw- 词内片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在 unw 开头的词片段，分别构成 unwounded 与 unwinding；两词语义不同。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 科学摘要

patterns.name: glossary 标记及界面文本
patterns.context: HTML 按钮链接中的 glossary 属性，附近有 View All、active、card 等界面词及标签。

patterns.name: 故事板过渡名称片段
patterns.context: XAML 风格的 Storyboard/Trigger 配置中，激活落在 Triggers 的词内片段；同段还有 BeginStoryboard、SlideInRight 等标识符。

en.description: All passages activate the within-word fragment «Sp» in different words or proper names, across varied domains and contexts. There are also local activations on names, email addresses, citations, titles, and medical terms, but no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Sp-initial words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words or proper names beginning with Sp; meanings, capitalization, and syntactic positions vary, with no stable additional contextual requirement
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, religious discourse, law, medicine, directories, and encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Name and address substrings in email
patterns.context: People’s names and email addresses in email signatures, with activation across multiple substrings of names or addresses

patterns.name: Number and citation-format fragments
patterns.context: Local strings in numbering, statutory citations, or case citations; activation points do not form a unified numeric or citation format

patterns.name: Title and category-list structure
patterns.context: Titles after line breaks, directory entries, or category entries; apart from co-occurring with Sp-initial words, no reliable independent structural trigger is evident

patterns.name: Ordinary medical-term fragments
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in medical titles or experimental measures; activation is scattered and cannot be attributed solely to medical semantics
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts and body text

11_647.concept: 词内 Sp 子串
11_647.description: 所有段都在不同词或专名中激活词内片段 «Sp»，涵盖多种领域与语境。另有姓名、邮箱、引文、标题及医学术语等局部激活，但未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Sp开头的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Sp 开头的词或专名内部；词义、大小写和句法位置不同，未见稳定的额外上下文要求
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、宗教论述、法律、医学、目录与百科分类

patterns.name: 邮件中的姓名与地址子串
patterns.context: 邮件签名中的人名及邮箱地址，激活分布在姓名或地址的多个子串上

patterns.name: 数字及引文格式片段
patterns.context: 编号、法规引文或判例引文中的局部字符串；激活点不构成统一的数字或引用格式

patterns.name: 标题及分类列表结构
patterns.context: 换行后的标题、目录条目或分类条目；除与 Sp 开头词同时出现外，未显示可靠的独立结构触发规律

patterns.name: 常规医学术语片段
patterns.context: 医学标题或实验指标中的词内片段；激活分散，不能归为仅由医学语义触发

en.description: Most activations are concentrated on URLs, domains, and paths, and also respond to email addresses, dates in URLs, and PDF filenames; a few occur on adjacent titles, bylines, internal hostnames, phone numbers, and Polish text fragments. Overall, the pattern favors structured strings used for web and contact information.

patterns.name: Domains and URL structure in web addresses
patterns.context: Occurs in links, URLs, or domains; activation often spans multiple adjacent URL tokens, especially the domain.
patterns.domain: Web links, news links, blogs, and personal websites

patterns.name: Email addresses and accounts
patterns.context: Occurs in email addresses, usually alongside domain suffixes and punctuation; some usernames also activate strongly.
patterns.domain: Blog metadata, paper bylines, corporate email signatures

patterns.name: Numeric dates or paths in URLs
patterns.context: Numbers or months embedded in URL paths, especially news article dates and file paths; not all numbers activate.

patterns.name: Titles or web metadata next to links
patterns.context: Ordinary text is adjacent to a hyperlink or serves as a link title, author name, or site name; title activation is sporadic, while most activation remains concentrated in the following link.

patterns.name: Document/attachment filenames
patterns.context: PDF filenames and extensions appear at the end of a link or path.
patterns.domain: Attachment links in email signatures, encyclopedia/web citation files

patterns.name: Isolated «sk» fragment
patterns.context: An isolated word fragment occurs in one passage about Poland, surrounded by prose and a URL; it is unclear whether it shares a cause with the other URL activations.

patterns.name: Paper bylines and editorial information
patterns.context: Occurs in editor/author addresses and byline formatting for a journal database topic.

patterns.name: Corporate email-system hostname
patterns.context: In corporate email describing remote access addresses for Outlook/Internet Explorer, activation occurs on an internal hostname.

patterns.name: Phone and fax numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in phone and fax number formats in signature blocks; the same passage also contains a highly activating URL.

11_647.concept: 网址及联系信息字符串
11_647.description: 多数激活集中于 URL、域名及路径，也响应邮箱地址、网址日期和 PDF 文件名；少量落在相邻标题、署名、内部主机名、电话号码及波兰文本片段上。整体偏向网页/联系信息的结构化字符串。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与 URL 结构
patterns.trigger: 如 «http»、«www»、«.»、«/»，以及 URL 域名和路径中的连续片段
patterns.context: 出现在链接、网址或域名中；激活常沿网址的多个相邻 token 分布，尤其是域名部分。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻链接、博客与个人网站

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与账号
patterns.context: 出现在电子邮件地址中，通常伴随域名后缀和标点；部分用户名也有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 博客元数据、论文署名、企业邮件签名

patterns.name: 网址中的数字日期或数字路径
patterns.context: 数字或月份嵌在 URL 路径中，尤其是新闻文章日期、文件路径；激活并非所有数字均有。

patterns.name: 链接旁的标题或网页元数据
patterns.trigger: 如 «skip»«p»«richard»«.»«com»，以及链接前的标题文本和署名
patterns.context: 普通文本紧邻超链接或作为链接标题、作者名、站点名；标题本身的激活零散，主要仍集中在后续链接。
patterns.domain: 博客、新闻聚合页、网页元数据

patterns.name: 文档/附件文件名
patterns.context: 在链接或路径末尾出现 PDF 文件名及扩展名。
patterns.domain: 邮件签名中的附件链接、百科/网页引用文件

patterns.name: 孤立的 «sk» 片段
patterns.context: 一处出现在波兰相关文本中的独立词片段，周围是散文和网址；无法确认是否与其他 URL 激活同因。

patterns.name: 论文署名与编辑信息
patterns.trigger: «ark»、«nar»、«gmail»、«Database Issue Editor»附近的姓名及邮箱片段
patterns.context: 出现在期刊数据库专题的编辑/作者地址和署名排版中。

patterns.name: 企业邮件系统主机名
patterns.context: 企业邮件中介绍 Outlook/Internet Explorer 远程访问地址，激活位于内部主机名。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件与 IT 指引

patterns.name: 电话号码与传真号码
patterns.context: 出现在签名档的电话号码和传真号码格式中；该段同时含有高激活网址。

en.concept: Links and metadata in web documents
en.description: Patterns include copyright and license text, HTML navigation, software names and URLs, paper DOIs and supplementary-material links, CGI download addresses, and numbered citations and blog-paper links; they mainly share structured link text in web pages or documents.

patterns.name: License and copyright text
patterns.context: Occurs in copyright notices, license identifiers, or passages explaining how to obtain a license; two license explanations are nearly identical.
patterns.domain: GitHub repository license and copyright files

patterns.name: HTML document navigation markup
patterns.context: Trigger points occur in navigation snippets composed of HTML anchors, list items, and document index links.

patterns.name: Software names and web links
patterns.context: Product names and their URLs occur near the title and link in a HackerNews post.

patterns.name: Paper DOI and supplementary-material links
patterns.context: Supplementary materials are listed after a paper identifier and linked to external resources.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers and supplementary materials

patterns.name: External CGI file links
patterns.context: Links point to CGI download endpoints on scripts.iucr.org, with parameters containing filenames or MIME types; similar formats recur.

patterns.name: Paper or article link lists
patterns.context: Numbered citations in square brackets and links to blog papers appear in article body text or posts.

11_647.concept: 网页文档中的链接与元数据
11_647.description: 模式涵盖版权与许可证文本、HTML 导航、软件名称及网址、论文 DOI 与补充材料链接、CGI 下载地址，以及编号引用和博客论文链接；主要共享网页或文档中的结构化链接文本。

patterns.name: 许可证及版权文本
patterns.context: 出现在版权声明、许可证标识或说明如何获取许可证的段落中；两段许可证说明几乎重复。
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库许可与版权文件

patterns.name: HTML 文档导航标记
patterns.context: 触发点位于 HTML 锚点、列表项和文档索引链接组成的导航片段中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 生成的 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 软件名称与网页链接
patterns.context: 产品名及其网址出现在 HackerNews 帖子的标题和链接附近。

patterns.name: 论文 DOI 与补充材料链接
patterns.trigger: DOI 数字段（如«10»«.»«110»...）及«Additional supplementary materials:»、«crystallographic information»
patterns.context: 论文标识符之后列出补充材料，并链接到外部资源。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文及补充材料

patterns.name: 外部 CGI 文件链接
patterns.context: 链接指向 scripts.iucr.org 上的 CGI 下载端点，参数包含文件名或 MIME 类型；相似格式重复出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 外部补充文件链接

patterns.name: 论文或文章链接列表
patterns.context: 文章正文或帖文中出现带方括号编号的引用及指向博客论文的链接。

en.description: Activation is distributed across structural-text boundaries and formatting sequences in multiple genres: legal citations, book line breaks and layout, fixed license wording, medical statistical symbols, and URL delimiters; no unified semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in legal citations and decisions
patterns.context: Court rules, statute numbers, and legal discussion occur near line breaks, paragraphs, or page breaks; activation falls on formatting boundaries, punctuation, and citation characters.

patterns.name: Layout boundaries in book text, contents, and bylines
patterns.context: In narrative text or book front/back matter, line breaks separate paragraphs, bylines, dates, or table-of-contents headings; activation is scattered across line breaks and adjacent word fragments.

patterns.name: Copyright and licensing language in license templates
patterns.context: In fixed open-source license phrasing, especially near template words such as Software, following conditions, and permission, and at clause line breaks.

patterns.name: Statistical numbers and symbols in medical papers
patterns.context: Values, percentages, P values, confidence intervals, and statistical symbols occur together in research results or scale reliability reports.

patterns.name: Delimiters and fragments in URLs and paths
patterns.context: In news links or web addresses, activation is concentrated on URL protocol, domain, and path components.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本格式与分隔符
11_647.description: 激活分布于多种文体中的结构化文本边界和格式序列：法律引文、书籍换行与版式、许可证固定措辞、医学统计符号，以及网址分隔符；未见统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 法律引文与判决文本中的格式标记
patterns.context: 换行、段落或分页符附近出现法院规则、法条编号及法律论述；激活落在格式边界、标点和引文字符上。

patterns.name: 书籍正文与目录、署名等版式边界
patterns.context: 叙述正文或书籍前后置材料中，换行分隔段落、署名、日期或目录标题；激活分散在换行及相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 许可证模板中的版权与许可措辞
patterns.context: 开源许可证固定句式中，尤其在 Software、following conditions、permission 等模板词附近及条款换行处。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的统计数字与符号
patterns.context: 研究结果或量表信度报告中，数值、百分比、P 值、置信区间及统计符号相邻出现。

patterns.name: 网址与路径中的分隔符及片段
patterns.context: 新闻链接或网页地址中，激活集中于 URL 协议、域名和路径组成部分。

en.concept: Symbols and formatting in structured text
en.description: Activation covers symbols, letters, and numeric formats in statistical results; case and statute citation markers in legal material; and punctuation, line breaks, and equations in mathematical sequences. There are also line breaks in legal fact passages and institutional abbreviations.

patterns.name: Statistical symbols and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Near results for statistical tests, correlations, or significance, activation falls on statistical symbols, variable letters, and decimal/numeric formats; includes contexts reporting significance thresholds and test results.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory markers
patterns.context: In case citations, statutes, or regulatory numbers, activation is concentrated on citation formats, abbreviations, and clause markers.

patterns.name: Numeric sequences and equation punctuation
patterns.context: In numeric sequences, equations, and apparent sequence problems, activation occurs around commas, line breaks, and equation numbers or operators.

patterns.name: Paragraph formatting in legal case fact narratives
patterns.context: In case fact narratives, line breaks separate paragraphs, and activation also occurs near institutional-name abbreviations; unlike legal citation formatting, the pattern is mainly layout and abbreviation.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与格式
11_647.description: 激活覆盖统计结果中的符号、字母和数字格式，法律材料中的判例与法规引文标记，以及数学数列中的标点、换行和算式；另有法律事实段落的换行及机构缩写。

patterns.name: 统计符号与数值表达
patterns.context: 统计检验、相关性或显著性结果附近，激活落在统计符号、变量字母及小数/数值格式上；包括报告显著性阈值和检验结果的语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及统计文本

patterns.name: 法律引文与法规标记
patterns.context: 判例引文、法条或法规编号中，激活集中在引文格式、缩写和条款标记上。

patterns.name: 数字序列与算式标点
patterns.context: 数字序列、算式和疑似数列题目中，激活出现在逗号、换行及算式数字或运算符周围。

patterns.name: 法律案件事实叙述中的分段格式
patterns.context: 案件事实叙述中，以换行分隔段落，机构名称缩写附近也有激活；与法律引文格式不同，主要表现为版式和缩写。
patterns.domain: 儿童福利案件法律文书

en.description: Activations occur in legal citations, code, negative-number sequences, paper statistics, unit-conversion problems, and biblical text. They often fall on abbreviations, punctuation, numbers, or specific subword fragments; no stable semantic trigger spanning domains is evident.

patterns.name: Ill. abbreviation in legal citations
patterns.context: In Illinois case citations, Ill. and nearby volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, or punctuation activate; nearby elements such as v, Dec, and N.E. in the same citation may also be marked.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Configuration identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: In C code, u near type or array declarations is marked; the number 4 after a newline at the end of a line also activates. These triggers may reflect local formatting or character patterns; evidence is insufficient to establish a semantic connection.

patterns.name: Minus signs in negative-number sequences
patterns.context: When terms in a math problem's sequence are negative, the minus sign is marked; one example asks for the next term, another for the ith term. Activations mainly fall on the minus sign, not on sequence content as a whole.

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and abbreviations in statistical results
patterns.context: When papers report scale reliability, confidence intervals, means and standard deviations, or correlations and significance, activations occur near statistical symbols, formatting components of numerical values, and abbreviations; the specific triggers are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Quantitative results in medical and social-science papers

patterns.name: Numbers in numerical unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Numbers or question marks activate near unit-conversion questions and their answers; the problems involve converting hours to microseconds, but the markers seem more like local responses to numbers or symbols.

patterns.name: Unusual word forms in biblical narrative
patterns.context: In a narrative about Jesus and his disciples, the Mount of Olives, and a colt, fragments of Olives and ass are marked; this single passage does not establish a more general religious semantic pattern.

11_647.concept: 格式化文本中的局部符号
11_647.description: 激活分散于法律引文、代码、负数数列、论文统计结果、单位换算题和圣经文本；局部多落在缩写、标点、数字或特定词片段，未见贯穿各领域的稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Ill. 缩写
patterns.context: 伊利诺伊州判例引文中，Ill. 及其后的卷号、报告集缩写或标点附近激活；在同一引文中的 v、Dec、N.E. 等邻近成分也可能被标记。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与判例引证

patterns.name: 代码中的配置标识符片段
patterns.context: C 代码中，类型或数组声明附近的 u 被标记；行结束换行后出现的数字 4 也激活。两类触发可能是局部格式或字符模式，证据不足以确定其语义联系。

patterns.name: 负数数列的负号
patterns.context: 数学题列出的数列项为负数时，负号被标记；一个例子要求求下一项，另一个要求求第 i 项。激活主要落在负号，而非统一的数列内容上。

patterns.name: 统计结果中的数字、符号和缩写
patterns.context: 论文报告量表信度、置信区间、均值和标准差，或相关系数与显著性时，统计符号、数值中的格式成分及缩写附近激活；具体触发并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学与社会科学论文的定量结果

patterns.name: 数值单位换算题中的数字
patterns.context: 单位换算问题及其答案附近出现数字或问号激活；题目涉及小时换算为微秒，但标记更像数值或符号局部反应。

patterns.name: 《圣经》叙述中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 耶稣与门徒、橄榄山及驴驹的叙述中，Olives 一词的片段和 ass 被标记；仅此一段，不能确认更一般的宗教语义模式。

en.description: Activations span heterogeneous text types: in arithmetic problems, they particularly favor numbers, symbols, and operation instructions; they also occur in medical statistical tables and age statistics, as well as legal citations and sentencing discussions. The common thread is weak.

patterns.name: Numerical values and operators in math problems
patterns.context: In arithmetic exercises, trigger locations are densely populated with numbers, plus/minus signs, decimal points, and operations; questions often ask for a calculation, a product, or the distance between two numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical values in unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: A sequence of time-unit conversion questions is presented, with activations around the values and target units.

patterns.name: Punctuation, numerical values, and fields in statistical tables
patterns.context: Medical research papers present fields such as participants/sex alongside results tables; formatting markers, abbreviations, and numerical values are mixed together.

patterns.name: Age statistics in study-sample descriptions
patterns.context: The methods or results sections report patient age ranges, means, and standard deviations.

patterns.name: Statute names and citations in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal text cites the Anticybersquatting Consumer Protection Act and sections of the U.S. Code.

patterns.name: Sentencing procedure and prosecution statements
patterns.context: Court opinions or case records discuss sentencing hearings, sentencing records, and the prosecution's response to the trial court's findings.

11_647.concept: 数字与结构化文本片段
11_647.description: 激活覆盖多类异质文本：算术题中尤其偏向数字、符号和运算指令；另见医学统计表格与年龄统计，以及法律法规引证和量刑论述。共同线索较弱。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算符
patterns.trigger: 数字片段及运算符，如«-»、«.»、«+»、«*»，以及«Calculate»、«Work out»、«What is the distance»
patterns.context: 算术练习题中，触发位置密集出现数字、正负号、小数点和运算；题目常要求计算、求积或求两个数之间的距离。

patterns.name: 单位换算题中的数值
patterns.trigger: «278 years in decades»、«8924.379 weeks in seconds»、«456»、«centuries»、«decades»
patterns.context: 连续提出时间单位换算问题，数值及单位转换目标周围有激活。

patterns.name: 统计表格中的标点、数值与字段
patterns.context: 医学研究论文中呈现被试/性别等字段及统计结果表格；格式标记、缩写和数值混杂。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文/统计表格

patterns.name: 研究样本描述中的年龄统计
patterns.context: 研究方法或结果段落报告患者年龄范围及均值、标准差。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的法案名称与引证
patterns.context: 法律文本引用《反网络抢注消费者保护法》及美国法典条款。

patterns.name: 判刑程序及州方陈述
patterns.context: 法院意见或案件记录讨论量刑听证、量刑记录及州方对审判法院认定的回应。

en.description: Covers abbreviations, percentages, and numbers in medical statistical tables; bases and time values in math problems; URL fragments in webpage titles; Russian regex/IP technical text; and slash-number sequences preceding code.

patterns.name: Statistical abbreviations and values in tables
patterns.context: Statistical measures, demographic variables, and numerical columns appear together in medical paper tables or results text

patterns.name: Numbers, bases, and time formats in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers appear in math Q&A or exercises as base arithmetic, time notation, or calculation problems

patterns.name: Character fragments in links and URLs
patterns.context: A webpage link follows a title or explanatory text; activations fall on URL punctuation, domains, and path tokens
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, forum links, and online articles

patterns.name: Russian regex expressions and IP-address text
patterns.context: Russian technical Q&A discusses regular expressions and searching for IP addresses, and provides example links

patterns.name: Repeated code data composed of slashes
patterns.context: Repeated slashes and numbers appear as test data before C++ source code

11_647.concept: 结构化数字与标点文本
11_647.description: 覆盖医学统计表格的缩写、百分比与数字，数学题中的进制和时间数字，网页标题中的 URL 片段，俄语正则/IP 技术文本，以及代码前斜杠数字序列。

patterns.name: 表格中的统计缩写与数值
patterns.trigger: “*M*”“*SD*”“95%CI”“P value”“n (%)”“Male, n (%)”及其邻近数字、百分号和表格分隔
patterns.context: 医学论文表格或结果文本中，统计指标、人口统计变量和数字列并列出现
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术医学文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字、进制与时间格式
patterns.trigger: “In base 3”“In base 14”“In base 15”、时间串“8:10 AM”“12:54 PM”及问题中的数字
patterns.context: 数学问答或练习题中，数字以进制运算、时间读写或计算题形式出现

patterns.name: 链接与 URL 的字符片段
patterns.trigger: “https://”“www.”以及 URL 中被拆分的域名和路径片段
patterns.context: 标题或说明文字后附带网页链接；激活落在 URL 的标点、域名和路径 token 上
patterns.domain: 网页标题、论坛链接及网络文章

patterns.name: 俄语正则表达式与 IP 地址文本
patterns.context: 俄语技术问答中讨论正则表达式及 IP 地址搜索，并给出示例链接

patterns.name: 斜杠组成的重复代码数据
patterns.context: C++ 源码前出现重复斜杠和数字构成的测试数据

en.concept: Numbers and markers in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to the formatting of numerical research results in papers: statistical symbols, numbers, variable categories, citations, and table layout; there are also distinct patterns in legal conclusions, news links, and remainder exercises.

patterns.name: Statistical quantities and numerical comparisons
patterns.context: In results, sample descriptions, or model reports, numbers occur alongside statistical measures; activations often fall on numerical, symbolic, punctuation, and formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Group and category comparisons
patterns.context: When research variables, categories, between-group proportions, or correlations are presented, especially alongside statistical numbers and comparative language.

patterns.name: Academic citations and bibliographic markers
patterns.context: Author-year citations, reference keys, and literature-link markers in body text or figure captions.

patterns.name: Table layout and column alignment
patterns.context: Table borders, column headers, or aligned cells; numbers and category fields are embedded in the layout structure.

patterns.name: Conclusions and footnote introductions in legal opinions
patterns.context: After reaching a conclusion, a judicial opinion transitions to citations of legal provisions or notes.

patterns.name: News headlines and URL paths
patterns.context: News-link titles and their URL paths, where activations span segmented URL tokens.

patterns.name: Question prompts and answer sequences in remainder problems
patterns.context: A series of integer-division remainder questions, each followed by a short numerical answer.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的数值与标记
11_647.description: 主要响应论文中数值化研究结果的格式：统计符号、数字、变量类别、引用及表格排版；另有法律结论、新闻链接和余数练习等独立的结构化文本模式。

patterns.name: 统计量与数值比较
patterns.trigger: 数字、百分比及统计符号，如 «=», « », «P», «p», «CI», «M», «SD»
patterns.context: 在研究结果、样本描述或模型报告中，数值与统计指标相邻；激活常落在数字、符号、标点及格式片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及量化研究

patterns.name: 分组与类别对照
patterns.context: 呈现研究变量、类别、组间比例或相关性时，尤其与统计数字和比较表述并列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、统计表格

patterns.name: 学术引文与文献标记
patterns.context: 正文或图表说明中的作者年份式引用、参考文献键及文献链接标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（主要为 PMC 文本）

patterns.name: 表格排版与列对齐
patterns.context: 表格边界、列标题或对齐后的单元格；数字和类别字段嵌在排版结构中。

patterns.name: 法律意见书结尾与脚注引入
patterns.context: 裁判意见在作出结论后转入法律条文引用或注释。

patterns.name: 新闻标题与 URL 路径
patterns.context: 新闻链接标题及其网址路径中，激活覆盖被拆分的 URL 词段。

patterns.name: 余数题的问句和答案序列
patterns.context: 连续列出整数除法余数问题，问句后接简短数值答案。

en.concept: Symbols and numbers in structured text
en.description: Activations occur in paper statistics and numerical results, medical tables/filtering results, and also legal case records and definitions, code diffs, and math answers. Common surface features are mostly structured symbols, numbers, and formatting markers; there is no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Statistical symbols and numerical results
patterns.context: Statistical measures, Greek letters, equal signs, and their values appear in paper text or results tables; triggers often fall on symbol or numerical fragments.

patterns.name: Court-record headings and case numbers
patterns.context: Formal heading information such as court level, jurisdiction, and case number in the layout of court opinions or case records.

patterns.name: Definitions and line breaks in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal argument introduces a term definition or quoted material, with a line break before the quotation.

patterns.name: Code-diff file headers
patterns.context: File paths, old/new version markers, and code-block location markers occur together in patches or diffs.

patterns.name: Survey exclusions and sample counts
patterns.context: Methods or sample-selection results list invalid/missing consent and corresponding counts item by item.
patterns.domain: Medical research surveys and participant screening

patterns.name: Numerical answers and rounding instructions in math exercises
patterns.context: Math problems specify decimal places or rounding, followed by a calculated value or answer.

patterns.name: Table rules and tabular numerical layout
patterns.context: Plain-text tables in papers mix aligned columns, dividers, and category/numerical cells.

patterns.name: Truncated or anomalous number/symbol fragments
patterns.context: Tables are truncated, columns misaligned, or OCR/extraction formatting is corrupted; triggers cluster around comparison symbols and numerical fragments.
patterns.domain: Extracted text from medical data tables

patterns.name: Medical terms and diagnostic test results
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report disease subtypes, suspected diagnoses, and comparisons of detection rates; this may overlap with the statistical-results pattern.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数值
11_647.description: 激活分布于论文统计符号和数值、医学表格/筛选结果，也见法律案卷与定义、代码 diff、数学题答案；共同的表面特征多为结构化符号、数字及格式标记，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 统计符号与数值结果
patterns.context: 论文叙述或结果表中出现统计量、希腊字母、等号及其数值；触发常落在符号或数字片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与统计报告

patterns.name: 法庭案卷标题与案号
patterns.trigger: “IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF OHIO”“Nos. L-17-1290”
patterns.context: 法院判决或案卷排版中，法院层级、辖区、案件编号等正式标题信息。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的定义与换行
patterns.context: 法律论证引出术语定义或引用材料，换行后开始引文。

patterns.name: 代码差异文件头
patterns.context: 补丁或 diff 中，文件路径、旧新版本标记和代码块位置标识相邻出现。

patterns.name: 问卷排除项与样本计数
patterns.context: 研究方法或样本筛选结果中，逐项列出无效/缺失同意及对应人数。
patterns.domain: 医学研究问卷与受试者筛选

patterns.name: 数学练习的数值答案与舍入指令
patterns.trigger: “to three dps.”、“Round i to the nearest integer.”及其后的数值
patterns.context: 数学题目要求小数位数或取整，随后给出计算值/答案。

patterns.name: 表格线与表格化数值排版
patterns.context: 论文中的纯文本表格，列对齐、分隔线和类别/数值单元格混杂。

patterns.name: 残缺或异常数字/符号片段
patterns.context: 表格被截断、列错位或 OCR/抽取格式混乱，触发集中于比较符号和数字片段。
patterns.domain: 医学数据表格抽取文本

patterns.name: 医学术语与诊断检验结果
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告疾病分型、疑似诊断及检测率比较；可能与统计结果模式重叠。

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations span multiple text types and often fall on newlines, delimiters, and structural boundaries; they also occur in chemical figure captions, statistical tables, code type declarations, and paper titles, making them difficult to attribute to a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Symbols and line breaks in math problems
patterns.context: An arithmetic expression or problem is followed by a newline and an answer/next problem; activations cluster near line breaks and some punctuation and numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical markers in chemical structure captions
patterns.context: Chemical paper captions discuss atoms, bond lengths, displacement ellipsoids, and structure diagrams; markers also occur near image filenames.

patterns.name: Delimiters in URLs and URL paths
patterns.context: In news links and their slugs, activations occur around URLs, path separators, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Table layout and statistical values
patterns.context: Activations occur near horizontal rules, inter-column spaces, line breaks, and statistical data in paper results tables.

patterns.name: Integer width in type declarations
patterns.context: An integer type and bit width follow a field name in code; activations also cover some identifiers.

patterns.name: Section and table-structure markers in papers
patterns.context: Occurs when paper text transitions from a results paragraph to a section heading or table reference.

11_647.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
11_647.description: 激活跨多种文本类型，常落在换行、分隔符及结构化边界；另在化学图注、统计表、代码类型声明和论文标题处出现，难以归结为单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号与换行
patterns.context: 算术表达式或题目后接换行和答案/下一题；激活集中在换行及部分标点、数字附近。

patterns.name: 化学结构图说明中的数字标记
patterns.context: 化学论文图注，涉及原子、键长、位移椭球和结构图；标记也落在图像文件名附近。

patterns.name: URL 与网址路径中的分隔符
patterns.context: 新闻链接及其 slug 中，激活分布在网址、路径分隔符和连字符附近。

patterns.name: 表格排版及统计数值
patterns.context: 论文结果表格中，横线、列间空白、换行及统计数据附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 类型声明中的整数宽度
patterns.context: 代码中字段名后接整数类型及位宽；激活也覆盖部分标识符。

patterns.name: 论文章节与表格结构标记
patterns.context: 论文正文从结果段落转入章节标题或表格引用时出现。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent pattern occurs in math problems: negative numbers, operators, sequences, comparison prompts, and nearby problem delimiters. There are also sporadic responses to demographic number formats, punctuation in legal quotations, table fields, and news URL fragments, which cannot be reduced to a single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Minus signs in math problems
patterns.context: A minus sign precedes a value, often near comparisons, sequences, or negative numbers in algebraic expressions; the activation marker does not always cover the entire number.

patterns.name: Operators and expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Operators occur in algebraic expressions, sequence problems, or integer-division/remainder problems, including expressions composed of variables and numbers.

patterns.name: Ordinal/ranking language in math problems
patterns.context: Questions ask for a term in a sequence or the maximum, minimum, or rank of a set of numbers; activations favor short function words and related symbols in the prompt.

patterns.name: Answers or delimiters in math problems
patterns.context: Activations occur near newlines and punctuation separating problems, choices, answers, or adjacent problems.

patterns.name: Numbers and parentheses in demographic statistics
patterns.context: Activations occur near formatting in demographic sentences, such as prepositions, parentheses, and percentages around values.

patterns.name: Quotation punctuation in judicial opinions
patterns.context: When a legal opinion introduces court instructions or a quotation, activations occur on the colon, newline, and quotation onset.

patterns.name: Table fields and country names
patterns.context: In a suspected email table with aligned columns, activations occur near country names, indentation, and numerical columns; the trigger relationship is unclear.

patterns.name: URL and news-headline word fragments
patterns.context: In webpage links and news headlines, activations occur near URL segmentation, hyphens, and segmented English words.

11_647.concept: 数学题标记及局部符号
11_647.description: 最强且反复的模式出现在数学题：负数、运算符、数列和大小比较题干，以及题目分隔符附近。另对人口统计数字格式、法律引述标点、表格字段和新闻网址词片段有零星响应，不能化为单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负号
patterns.context: 负号出现在数值前，常与比较大小、数列或代数表达式中的负数相邻；激活标记并不总覆盖整个数字。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算符与表达式
patterns.context: 运算符出现在代数式、数列题或整除求余题中；包括变量与数字构成的表达式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的序数/排名表述
patterns.trigger: «the»1 smallest value、«the»1 second biggest value、«i'th term»
patterns.context: 询问数列的某项或一组数中的最大、最小及其次序；激活偏向题干中的短功能词及相关符号。

patterns.name: 数学题的答案或分隔符
patterns.context: 题目、选项、答案或相邻题目之间的换行与标点附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 人口统计中的数字与括号
patterns.context: 人口统计句中，数值前后的介词、括号和百分比等格式化文本附近激活。

patterns.name: 判决书引述标点
patterns.context: 法律判决在引出法院指示或引文时，冒号、换行及引文起始处激活。

patterns.name: 表格字段及国家名称
patterns.context: 疑似邮件中的对齐表格，国家名称、缩进及数值列附近有激活；触发关系不明确。

patterns.name: 网址与新闻标题词片段
patterns.context: 网页链接及新闻标题中，网址分段、连字符和被切分的英文词附近激活。

en.description: Responses are diverse: numbers, minus signs, and operations in math problems; structured keys and values, punctuation, and line breaks in code configuration; and also legal narrative, demographic figures, and HTTP cache headers. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Legal citations and testimony narratives
patterns.context: In legal opinions discussing evidence, witness statements, or cross-examination, activations fall on line breaks after quotations, delimiters, and adjacent text.

patterns.name: JSON/Jupyter structure and indentation
patterns.context: In serialized notebooks or application configuration, keys and values, quotes, commas, brackets, and line breaks form structured data.

patterns.name: Configuration entries and numerical parameters
patterns.context: Configuration files list options, Boolean values, and numbers consecutively; activations cluster near indentation, key names, or punctuation.

patterns.name: Demographic numbers and percentages
patterns.context: Demographic or regional-statistics narratives contain consecutive quantities with thousands separators and percentages.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and numerical sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Arithmetic, sequence, ordering, or comparison problems contain minus signs, numbers, and operation instructions; sometimes problems and answers appear consecutively.

patterns.name: HTTP cache-control directives
patterns.context: HTTP response headers list cache policies as key-value pairs, including hyphenated directives.

patterns.name: Ordinary negative numbers and numerical comparisons
patterns.context: Math word problems mix variables, equations, ordering, and signed values; they share number and minus-sign features with other math problems but are not necessarily pure arithmetic.

11_647.concept: 结构化数字与标点模式
11_647.description: 响应范围较杂：数学题中的数字、负号与运算，代码配置中的结构化键值、标点和换行，另见法律叙述、人口统计数字及HTTP缓存头；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律引文与证词叙述
patterns.context: 法律意见中讨论证据、证人陈述或交叉询问时；激活落在引文后的换行、分隔符及相邻文本上。

patterns.name: JSON/Jupyter结构与缩进
patterns.context: 序列化的笔记本或应用配置中，键值、引号、逗号、括号和换行构成结构化数据。

patterns.name: 配置项与数值参数
patterns.context: 配置文件中连续列出选项、布尔值和数字，激活集中于缩进、键名或标点附近。

patterns.name: 人口统计数字及百分比
patterns.context: 人口或地域统计叙述中，连续出现带千位分隔符的数量和百分比。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数与数字序列
patterns.context: 算术、数列、排序或比较题中出现负号、数字及运算指令；有时题目与答案连续排列。

patterns.name: HTTP缓存控制指令
patterns.context: HTTP响应头以键值形式列出缓存策略，包含连字符连接的指令。

patterns.name: 普通负数与数值比较
patterns.context: 数学文字题中混合变量、方程、排序与带符号数值；与其他数学题共享数字和负号特征，但未必是纯算术题。

en.description: Patterns span numerical tables and arithmetic, formatting anomalies in patent text, HTML/JSON code, and legal narratives; trigger points vary, with some clustering around numbers and punctuation, but overall there is no unified semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: Number strings with decimals and symbols
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, punctuation, and surrounding spaces; numbers often appear as decimals, negatives, percentages, or consecutive values in tables.
patterns.domain: Medical statistical tables, math problems, and numerical calculations; paragraphs 2, 4, 9, 10

patterns.name: Sparse or misaligned whitespace
patterns.context: The text consists mostly of extensive whitespace, isolated letters, and mathematical symbols, without readable continuous sentences; occurs in patent background material.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent text (this fragment appears to have formatting or extraction anomalies)

patterns.name: HTML tags and template concatenation
patterns.context: Code generates a page template containing HTML tags through string concatenation; activations occur near tags, quotation marks, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Quotations and procedural language in court records
patterns.context: Legal narrative or trial transcript contains court statements, procedural language, and quotations.

patterns.name: Testimony and cross-examination in legal opinions
patterns.context: Opinions recount the credibility, testimony, and questioning of witnesses or parties.

patterns.name: Keys, values, and nested fields in JSON configuration
patterns.context: Machine-readable configuration organizes data as JSON-style key-value pairs, arrays, and nested objects.

patterns.name: Jupyter Notebook code-cell structure
patterns.context: JSON metadata in a Notebook export is followed by code source content.

patterns.name: Kinematics terms in tables
patterns.context: Anatomical or movement-item names are presented alongside adjacent measurement values.
patterns.domain: Medical tables (possibly range-of-motion or physical-examination data)

11_647.concept: none
11_647.description: 模式横跨数值表格与算术、格式异常的专利文本、HTML/JSON 代码及法律叙述；可见触发点各异，部分集中在数字和标点，整体缺少统一语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 带小数与符号的数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、标点及其周围空格上；数字常以小数、负数、百分比或连续数值表格形式出现。
patterns.domain: 医学统计表格、数学题及数值计算；段2、4、9、10

patterns.name: 稀疏或错位的空白字符
patterns.trigger: 段3中反复出现的长空格串，以及“⁢”“⁡”等符号
patterns.context: 文本主要由大量空白、少量孤立字母和数学符号组成，缺少可读的连续语句；在专利背景材料中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利文本（此片段疑似格式或抽取异常）

patterns.name: HTML 标签与模板拼接
patterns.context: 代码通过字符串拼接生成含 HTML 标签的页面模板，激活分布在标签、引号和换行附近。

patterns.name: 法庭记录中的引语及程序用语
patterns.trigger: “THE COURT: Mr. Pend”“the court addressed the possibility of consecutive sentencing”
patterns.context: 法律叙述或庭审逐字记录中出现法院发言、程序性表述及引语。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的证词与交叉询问
patterns.context: 判决叙述证人或当事人的可信度、证词及调查过程。

patterns.name: JSON 配置中的键值与嵌套字段
patterns.context: 机器可读配置以 JSON 风格的键值对、数组和嵌套对象组织数据。

patterns.name: Jupyter Notebook 代码单元结构
patterns.context: Notebook 导出数据的 JSON 元信息后接代码源内容。

patterns.name: 表格中的运动学术语
patterns.context: 解剖或动作项目名称与相邻测量数值并列呈现。
patterns.domain: 医学表格（可能为活动度或体格检查数据）

en.description: Activations are scattered across corpora: newlines, indentation, and punctuation in code and structured data; email-address delimiters; whitespace in patent-formula layout; legal quotation markers; and number boundaries and minus signs in math problems. No clear shared semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in code or structured files
patterns.context: Triggers cluster at line starts, indentation boundaries, or punctuation in structured fields; the content of the code and data itself is not consistent
patterns.domain: Github code, JSON, Jupyter notebooks, and dependency configuration

patterns.name: Email addresses and recipient delimiters
patterns.context: Occurs in recipient lists in email headers, where addresses and names are separated by punctuation

patterns.name: Sparse formula layout and whitespace
patterns.context: Characters are embedded in mathematical or technical layout fragments with large amounts of whitespace, without forming recognizable natural-language expressions
patterns.domain: Formula/layout content in USPTO patent background text

patterns.name: Quotations and transcription in legal text
patterns.context: Newlines and punctuation introduce statements by parties or the court in legal arguments or trial records

patterns.name: Math answers and number boundaries
patterns.context: Math problems and calculated results appear adjacent; activations fall on minus signs, numbers, or near answers, and problem types are not fully consistent
patterns.domain: Math word problems and numerical calculations

11_647.concept: 格式边界与分隔符
11_647.description: 激活分散在不同语料：代码与结构化数据中的换行、缩进和标点；邮件地址分隔符；专利公式排版空白；法律引述标记；以及数学题里的负号和数字边界。没有明显的共同语义触发点。

patterns.name: 代码或结构化文件中的格式标记
patterns.trigger: 换行符 «↵»、空格缩进，以及 JSON/配置中的引号、冒号、逗号和括号
patterns.context: 触发点集中在行首、缩进边界或结构化字段的标点处；代码和数据的内容本身并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码、JSON、Jupyter notebook 与依赖配置

patterns.name: 邮件地址与收件人分隔符
patterns.trigger: «@»、电子邮件地址中的点号，以及逗号和换行
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头部的收件人列表中，地址和姓名由标点分隔

patterns.name: 稀疏公式排版与空白
patterns.trigger: 长串空格，以及 «⁢»、«⁡»、希腊字母 «π» 等公式排版字符
patterns.context: 字符嵌在大幅空白构成的数学或技术排版片段中，未形成可辨认的自然语言表达
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景文本中的公式/排版内容

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引述与转写
patterns.trigger: «↵»、引号 «“»、冒号 «:» 及 «THE COURT:» 等引述标记
patterns.context: 法律论述或庭审记录中，换行和标点用于引出当事人陈述或法庭发言

patterns.name: 数学题答案及数字边界
patterns.trigger: 负号 «-»、数字串、等号式问答中的换行与结果
patterns.context: 数学题目和计算结果相邻；激活落在负号、数字或答案附近，题目类型并不完全相同
patterns.domain: 数学文字题与数值计算

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to two types of text: “Rat” at the beginning of a sentence to denote a laboratory animal in biomedical contexts, and “import” statements in source code from multiple languages on GitHub. The two trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: Biomedical text beginning with Rat
patterns.context: “Rat” appears at the beginning of a sentence to denote a laboratory animal, followed by its exposure conditions or physiological function; activation is concentrated on Rat, with weaker activation on adjacent words.

patterns.name: import statements in code
patterns.context: A code line begins with import, followed by a module name, imported symbol, or from clause; repeated instances of import also activate.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code in JavaScript/TypeScript, Swift, Python, and other languages

11_706.concept: 特定语料中的句首标记
11_706.description: 神经元主要响应两类文本：生物医学语境中句首表示实验动物的“Rat”，以及 GitHub 多种语言源代码中的“import”导入语句；两类触发形式不同。

patterns.name: Rat 开头的生物医学文本
patterns.context: 句首以 Rat 指实验动物，后接其暴露条件或生理功能；激活集中在 Rat，后续相邻词也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目文本、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 代码中的 import 语句
patterns.context: 代码行以 import 开始，后接模块名、导入符号或 from 子句；重复出现的 import 也会激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码，涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript、Swift、Python 等

en.description: Activation is concentrated on «Rat» and «import» at the beginning of a sentence or line: the former appears in rat research contexts, while the latter appears in import statements across multiple programming languages.

patterns.name: Biomedical phrases beginning with Rat
patterns.context: “Rat” is a noun referring to a laboratory animal or research subject, followed by an organ, function, or experimental description

patterns.name: import statements in code
patterns.context: A code line begins with import, followed by a module, symbol, or package path; import sometimes appears again in the same snippet

11_706.concept: 常见记录/语句开头
11_706.description: 激活集中在句首或行首的 «Rat» 和 «import»：前者出现在大鼠研究语境，后者出现在多种语言的代码导入语句中。

patterns.name: 以 Rat 开头的生物医学短语
patterns.context: “Rat”作为实验动物或研究对象的名词，后接器官、功能或实验描述
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目资料

patterns.name: 代码中的 import 语句
patterns.context: 代码行以 import 开始，后续是模块、符号或包路径；有时同一片段中再次出现 import

en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic formulas and their symbols, variables, and operation instructions, especially operators and variables within formulas; also activates on long strings of spaces, email finance terminology, and descriptions of medical staining appearances.

patterns.name: Punctuation and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: These symbols occur in formulas, algebraic expressions, or equations; most are mathematical notation split by formatting or tokenization.

patterns.name: Algebraic operation instructions such as expand
patterns.context: Instructions before or after a formula requesting factoring, expansion, or solving.

patterns.name: Variables and function notation
patterns.context: Letters serve as algebraic variables, unknowns, or function arguments, embedded in formulas or problem text.

patterns.name: Consecutive spaces
patterns.context: Large spans of whitespace are marked on their own; nearby text is sporadic, possibly reflecting formatting, padding, or anomalous whitespace.

patterns.name: Transaction terminology in email
patterns.context: The phrase «volume represents sell-side only», concerning the basis of trading volume or sell-side data.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, financial or business writing

patterns.name: Pathology staining description
patterns.context: A numbered description after a line break explains the appearance of the background color and regular lines.
patterns.domain: Medical or histological descriptions in PubMed

11_706.concept: 数学符号与格式边界
11_706.description: 主要响应代数公式及其符号、变量和操作指令，尤其是公式中的运算符与变量；另对长串空格、邮件金融术语和医学染色外观描述有激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的标点与运算符
patterns.context: 这些符号位于公式、代数式或方程中；多为排版或分词后拆开的数学记号。
patterns.domain: 数学题目、符号化代数文本

patterns.name: 展开等代数操作指令
patterns.context: 作为公式前后的操作指令，要求因式分解、展开或求解。

patterns.name: 变量及函数记号
patterns.context: 字母充当代数变量、未知数或函数自变量，嵌入公式或题目文字中。

patterns.name: 连续空格
patterns.context: 大段空白字符本身被标记；附近只有零散文本，可能反映格式、填充或异常空白。

patterns.name: 邮件中的交易术语
patterns.context: 短语 «volume represents sell-side only»，涉及成交量口径或卖方侧数据。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、金融或商业文字

patterns.name: 病理染色描述
patterns.context: 在换行后的编号式描述中，说明背景颜色及规则线条的外观。
patterns.domain: PubMed 中的医学或组织学描述

en.concept: English articles and local word-form fragments
en.description: Activation most consistently occurs on the definite article “the” and indefinite articles “a/an” in academic text; sporadic activation also falls on fragments within technical terms, hyphens, units, and citation formats. Some fragments are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: English article the
patterns.context: The definite article before a noun phrase; occurs across different subject areas

patterns.name: English article a/an
patterns.context: The indefinite article before a noun phrase

patterns.name: Nouns or modifiers following articles
patterns.context: Marked words occur at sentence beginnings or in structures involving prepositions, conjunctions, and similar elements; they do not appear to share a stable semantic trigger and may relate to local collocations or tokenization boundaries

patterns.name: Numerical values and units
patterns.context: Markers are concentrated in concentration ranges and unit expressions for plasma glycoproteins

patterns.name: Medical term fragment
patterns.context: Occurs inside the word “hyperstimulation”, concerning ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome

patterns.name: Comparison symbol or hyphen
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound term “spin--charge”

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation marker
patterns.context: Activation covers part of a citation marker, with no stable correspondence to the cited content observed

patterns.name: Local word fragments or noise
patterns.context: Markers fall within words or near boundaries between coordinated written forms, such as “and/or”, “monocytes/macrophages”, and “extinction/repopulation”; no unified semantic trigger can be inferred

11_706.concept: 英语冠词及局部词形片段
11_706.description: 激活最稳定地出现在学术文本中的定冠词“the”和不定冠词“a/an”；另有零散激活落在术语内部片段、连接符、单位及引文格式处，部分片段难以解释。

patterns.name: 英文冠词 the
patterns.context: 名词短语前的定冠词；在不同专业主题中均出现

patterns.name: 英文冠词 a/an
patterns.context: 名词短语前的不定冠词

patterns.name: 冠词后接名词或修饰语
patterns.context: 所标记词出现在句首或介词、连词等结构中，不像同一稳定语义触发；可能与局部搭配或分词边界有关

patterns.name: 数值与单位表达
patterns.context: 标记集中在血浆糖蛋白的浓度范围及单位表达中

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“hyperstimulation”一词内部，涉及卵巢过度刺激综合征

patterns.name: 比较符号或连接符
patterns.context: 出现在复合术语“spin--charge”中

patterns.name: 文献引用标记
patterns.context: 激活覆盖引文标记的一部分，未见与引用内容稳定对应

patterns.name: 局部词语片段或噪声
patterns.context: 标记落在单词或并列书写的词语边界附近，如“and/or”“monocytes/macrophages”“extinction/repopulation”，无法归纳为统一语义触发

en.description: All snippets activate on the capitalized article “An” at sentence beginnings or paragraph boundaries, followed by different noun phrases; domains and semantic content vary, with no evident shared theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial article An
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the capitalized article “An” at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a noun phrase; it often appears after a line break or paragraph boundary, opening a new sentence or paragraph.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, encyclopedias, academic papers, emails, and web text

11_706.concept: 句首大写冠词 An
11_706.description: 所有片段都在句首或段落边界处激活于大写冠词“An”，后接不同名词短语；领域和语义内容各异，没有明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 句首冠词 An
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在句首的大写冠词“An”，后接名词短语；常位于换行或段落边界后，开启新句或新段。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括专利、百科、学术论文、邮件及网页文本

en.description: Activations occur across diverse technical content: Android XML, hardware lists, Japanese and Chinese technical text, LaTeX equations, and warranty emails. Their visible common features are not specific enough to reduce to a single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Android XML tags and attributes
patterns.context: Activation appears around tags, attribute names, and values in Android layout or manifest XML code.

patterns.name: Hardware configuration lists
patterns.context: Computer components and configurations are listed on separate aligned lines; activation also occurs near numbers, units, and product names.
patterns.domain: Computer quotes or configuration lists in Enron emails

patterns.name: Japanese support or explanatory text
patterns.context: Continuous Japanese text; examples describe an account/IPN issue and UI text, respectively.
patterns.domain: Japanese technical support content and Japanese UI documentation

patterns.name: Chinese code comments and callback explanation
patterns.context: Chinese code comments explain a callback function and its arguments.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expression
patterns.context: A recursive definition contains a radical expression, followed by a question about n.

patterns.name: Warranty coverage explanation
patterns.context: Explains whether a computer is still covered by its original or extended warranty; activation is distributed across phrases in the email body.

11_706.concept: none
11_706.description: 激活出现在多种技术内容中：Android XML、硬件清单、日中技术说明、LaTeX 数学式及保修邮件。它们共有的可见特征不够具体，无法归结为单一触发模式。

patterns.name: Android XML 标记与属性
patterns.context: Android 布局或 manifest 的 XML 代码中，标签、属性名及其值附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 硬件配置清单
patterns.context: 以分行、对齐的字段列出电脑部件和配置；数字、单位及产品名附近也有激活。

patterns.name: 日语支持或说明文字
patterns.context: 日语连续文本；分别是账户/IPN 问题说明和界面文本说明。
patterns.domain: 日语技术支持内容及日语 UI 文档

patterns.name: 中文代码注释与回调说明
patterns.context: 代码注释用中文解释回调函数及传入参数。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式
patterns.context: 递归定义含根式的数学式，后接关于 n 的提问。

patterns.name: 保修范围说明
patterns.context: 解释电脑是否仍在原厂或延长保修期内；激活分布于邮件正文短语中。

en.concept: Technical and document markers across domains
en.description: Activation spans legal citations, configuration or web contexts containing universal, software code and UI markers, and various patent terminology and formulaic phrases; no single stable trigger word is evident, and the activations appear to be domain-specific fragments.

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural provisions
patterns.context: Occurs in U.S. court opinions or pleadings, concerning statutes, case citations, and code section numbers; activation is distributed across citation punctuation and legal terminology.

patterns.name: KCL abbreviation and cultural center description
patterns.context: In descriptive text about water features, pedestrian bridges, and a cultural/music center, the abbreviation KKL appears near articles and place descriptions.

patterns.name: universal configuration field
patterns.context: In a JSON-style object, universal is the value of an idiom field and is adjacent to scale, filename, and an image filename.

patterns.name: Web server resources and compression
patterns.context: A technical Q&A discusses website traffic, server resources, and page loading, then mentions compressing JS files and Angular Universal.

patterns.name: Motor vehicle transmission and motor/generator
patterns.context: A patent description discusses continuously variable transmission ratios, a locking device, and speed control of a first motor/generator.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and embodiment boilerplate
patterns.context: Patent background or specification text states the invention's purpose using fixed expressions such as “another object of the invention”, “present invention”, and “preferred embodiments”.

patterns.name: Java methods and TODO comments
patterns.context: Method declarations, layout operations, and unfinished TODO comments in Java code.

patterns.name: UI XML and component tags
patterns.context: XML layout or UI configuration snippets contain video wrappers, components, and application tags, followed by Q&A text about a receiver page.

patterns.name: Permanent magnet materials and embodiments
patterns.context: Patent text describes coercivity grades or rare-earth materials for permanent magnets across different embodiments.

11_706.concept: 多领域技术与文档标记
11_706.description: 激活涵盖法律引文、含 universal 的配置或 Web 语境、软件代码与 UI 标记，以及多类专利术语和套语；未见单一稳定触发词，呈现多种领域特定片段。

patterns.name: 法律引文与程序条款
patterns.context: 出现在美国法判决或诉状文本中，围绕法案、判例引文和法典章节编号；激活分布于引文标点及法律术语。

patterns.name: KCL 缩写与文化中心描述
patterns.context: 在介绍水景、步行桥及文化／音乐中心的说明文字中，缩写 KKL 前后有冠词和地点描述。

patterns.name: universal 配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格的对象中，universal 作为 idiom 字段值，并与 scale、filename 及图像文件名相邻。

patterns.name: Web 服务器资源与压缩
patterns.context: 技术问答讨论网站流量、服务器资源和页面加载，随后提及压缩 JS 文件及 Angular Universal。

patterns.name: 机动车传动与电机／发电机
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中讨论连续可变传动比、锁定装置及第一电机／发电机的转速控制。

patterns.name: 专利发明目的与实施例套语
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书以“another object of the invention”“present invention”“preferred embodiments”等固定表达陈述发明目的。

patterns.name: Java 方法与 TODO 注释
patterns.context: Java 代码中的方法声明、布局操作与未实现的 TODO 注释。

patterns.name: 界面 XML 与组件标签
patterns.context: XML 布局或 UI 配置片段，包含视频包装器、组件和应用标签，后接关于 receiver page 的问答文字。
patterns.domain: 软件界面开发／技术问答

patterns.name: 永磁体材料与实施例
patterns.context: 专利文本按不同实施例描述永磁体的矫顽力等级或稀土材料。
