en.description: Activation spans software Q&A, code comments, and chemical, materials, and legal texts. Technical passages often contain negation words such as not/don't, to followed by an action verb, and prescriptive explanations; other passages contain domain-specific terminology and do not form a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “not” in negation and necessity statements
patterns.context: Technical explanations or recommendations negate an operation, modification, or requirement; the strongest trigger is not, often in a “do not …” structure
patterns.domain: Software engineering documentation, technical Q&A, and code comments

patterns.name: Infinitive to and implementation/action verbs
patterns.context: to is followed by action verbs in software development, especially implement, define, extend, or write code; activation is stronger in paragraphs 1 and 3
patterns.domain: Software engineering Q&A and development documentation

patterns.name: Prescriptive/explanatory wording in technical documentation templates
patterns.context: Describes the purpose of a framework or generated code, default handling, and content that must not be modified

patterns.name: Web performance and resource constraint discussion
patterns.context: Discusses server RAM/CPU, page loading, traffic, or performance-related issues such as compression

patterns.name: React component updates and comparison logic
patterns.context: Repeated component rendering, connecting higher-order components, and adding a check at a setInfo call

patterns.name: Dependency injection and custom type converters
patterns.context: Asks how to define a Dozer custom converter with dependencies injected by Spring

patterns.name: Chemical reactions and photoredox catalysis
patterns.context: An abstract introduces radical cascade reactions, bond formation/cleavage, and photoredox catalysis

patterns.name: Polyurethane materials and nonionic compatibilizers
patterns.context: Cites a technical paper on rigid polyurethane foam and existing nonionic compatibilizers

patterns.name: Special or local legislation in legal provisions
patterns.context: A pleading cites constitutional limits on special acts or local laws passed by state legislatures

patterns.name: Redux connection and action binding explanation
patterns.context: Explains rules for using connect, dispatch, props, and bindActionCreators

11_706.concept: 否定与操作说明词
11_706.description: 激活覆盖软件问答、代码注释及化学、材料、法律文本。技术段常出现否定词 not/don't、to 加动作动词和规范说明；其余段各有领域术语，未形成共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 否定与必要性说明中的“not”
patterns.trigger: « not»10（第2、4段）；«no»2 need« to»5（第1段）；另有«don't»9（第10段）
patterns.context: 技术说明或建议中，否定某项操作、修改或需求；最强触发集中在 not，且常处于“do not …”结构
patterns.domain: 软件工程文档、技术问答及代码注释

patterns.name: 不定式 to 与实现/操作动词
patterns.trigger: « to»10 hard«code»（第1段）；« to»7« implement»（第5段）；« to»7« subclass»、« to»10« re»implement»（第3段）；« to»7« define»（第6段）
patterns.context: to 后接软件开发中的动作动词，尤其实现、定义、扩展或编写代码；第1、3段触发较强
patterns.domain: 软件工程问答与开发文档

patterns.name: 技术文档模板中的规范性/说明性措辞
patterns.trigger: « Required»5 method« for»4 Designer support« -»1 do« not»10« modify»5；« In»5« most»2« cases»1 you… can… leave… as-is（第2、3段）
patterns.context: 描述框架或生成代码的用途、默认处理方式及不可修改的内容

patterns.name: Web 性能与资源限制讨论
patterns.trigger: « your»5 webserver is limited« in»2 RAM«/»4CPU；« compression»；« not»10« need»5（第4段）
patterns.context: 讨论服务器 RAM/CPU、页面加载、流量或压缩等性能与资源问题

patterns.name: React 组件更新与比较逻辑
patterns.trigger: « every»1« time»1« your»3 component« will»2 re«-»1render；« custom»5 compare；« not»7« calling»5（第5段）
patterns.context: 组件重复渲染、连接高阶组件以及在 setInfo 调用处添加检查

patterns.name: 依赖注入与自定义类型转换器
patterns.trigger: «Custom»2 converter« with»2« Spring»4 dependency injection；« a»9« Spring»6 bean（第6段）
patterns.context: 询问如何定义由 Spring 注入依赖的 Dozer 自定义转换器

patterns.name: 化学反应与光氧化还原催化
patterns.trigger: « radical»5 cascade reaction；« bond formation»/«cle»avage；« phot»2ored«ox»2 catalysis（第7段）
patterns.context: 摘要介绍自由基级联反应、成键/断键及光氧化还原催化

patterns.name: 聚氨酯材料与非离子相容剂
patterns.trigger: « Poly»2urethane Rigid Foams；« non»9«ionic»6 compatibility agents（第8段）
patterns.context: 引述聚氨酯硬质泡沫技术论文及既有非离子相容剂
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、材料化学

patterns.name: 法律条文中的特殊或地方立法
patterns.context: 诉状引述宪法对州议会特别法或地方性法律的限制

patterns.name: Redux 连接与 action 绑定说明
patterns.trigger: « a»5 mapDispatch«To»3Props；« don»'t»9« need»6« to»6« use»6« bind»1ActionCreators（第10段）
patterns.context: 说明 connect、dispatch、props 与 bindActionCreators 的使用规则

en.concept: Local features of software technical text
en.description: Activation often occurs in software engineering text: code identifiers, annotations, and calls; Android XML attributes; and design terminology and recommendations in technical Q&A. Legal rhetoric also appears. The triggers do not share a unified narrow feature.

patterns.name: Android XML attributes and layout values
patterns.context: Attribute names and assignments are marked as fragments in Android layout XML, often in groups of widget configurations

patterns.name: Code identifiers and surrounding method calls
patterns.context: Syntactic elements in source code or code snippets, often co-occurring with indentation, parentheses, line breaks, and method/class structures; the triggered elements are not fully consistent

patterns.name: Software design terminology
patterns.context: Natural-language passages in technical Q&A explaining design patterns, frameworks, or implementation choices

patterns.name: Reader-facing recommendations or instructions
patterns.context: Appears in technical Q&A when giving operational advice, next steps, or reference links; often adjacent to code examples

patterns.name: Method names as Android click attributes
patterns.context: Discusses specifying a click-handler method in an Android XML attribute and contrasting it with `OnClickListener` in code

patterns.name: Emphatic rhetoric in legal documents
patterns.context: Emphatic or evaluative wording advances criticism of an appeal in legal argument

patterns.name: Ordinary connectives and references in mixed technical text
patterns.context: Natural-language explanations between or after code examples; difficult to classify as a specific technical-syntax trigger

11_706.concept: 软件技术文本局部特征
11_706.description: 激活多见于软件工程文本：代码标识符、注解与调用，Android XML 属性，以及技术问答中的设计术语和建议语句；另有法律文书修辞。不同触发并无统一窄特征。

patterns.name: Android XML 属性与布局值
patterns.trigger: `android:` 后接 `layout_width`、`layout_height`、`orientation`、`context` 等属性，以及 `match_parent`、`fill_parent`、`vertical` 等值
patterns.context: Android 布局 XML 中，属性名和赋值被分段标记；常见于成段的控件配置

patterns.name: 代码标识符与方法调用周边
patterns.trigger: 代码中的 `@include`、`@if`、`@Override`、`onClick`、`@implementation`、`return`、`base.Dispose` 等标识符、注解或调用
patterns.context: 源码或代码片段中的语法元素，常与缩进、括号、换行及方法/类结构共现；触发对象不完全一致

patterns.name: 程序设计概念术语
patterns.context: 技术问答中解释设计模式、框架或实现选择的自然语言段落

patterns.name: 面向读者的建议或指引语句
patterns.trigger: `you could`、`you can`、`I’d suggest`、`if you want to know` 等表达
patterns.context: 技术问答在给出操作建议、后续步骤或参考链接时出现；多与代码示例邻接

patterns.name: 方法名作为 Android 点击属性
patterns.context: 讨论在 Android XML 属性中指定点击处理方法，并与代码里的 `OnClickListener` 对照

patterns.name: 法律文书中的强调性修辞
patterns.trigger: `to top it all off`、`obviously meritless appeal`
patterns.context: 法律论述中以强调或评价性措辞推进对上诉的批评

patterns.name: 混合技术文本中的普通关联词与指代
patterns.trigger: `and`、`in another module`、`Then` 等普通衔接语
patterns.context: 代码示例之间或代码之后的自然语言说明；难以归为特定技术语法触发

en.description: Activation examples cover several types of software development text (Android, CSS, Spring, web registration and validation), as well as legal argument, casual conversation, and product copy. Trigger words differ substantially across passages, making it difficult to infer a stable lexical or semantic feature.

patterns.name: Sass/CSS mixin and clearing
patterns.context: Code and comments discuss whether to create a mixin for Clearing, involving Sass/CSS class names.

patterns.name: Android click handling and attributes
patterns.context: Explains placing a method name in the Android XML onClick attribute; nearby is Java click callback code.

patterns.name: Android style XML
patterns.context: Defines a style inheriting from an Android ActionBar theme and sets a background color.

patterns.name: Legal appeal and oral argument
patterns.context: Describes a court panel finding oral argument unnecessary and characterizing the appeal as meritless.

patterns.name: Jiu-jitsu self-introduction
patterns.context: A forum conversation asks about a martial art; the respondent mentions Brazilian jiu-jitsu and a brown belt.

patterns.name: Laptop cooler product description
patterns.context: Describes product features of a laptop cooler, including fans and low-power magnetic fasteners.

patterns.name: Spring configuration recommendation
patterns.context: Discusses singleton scope and Spring property configuration in a web application, offering an alternative recommendation.

patterns.name: Registration and authentication controller
patterns.context: Describes a controller that uses a trait by default to implement new-user registration and existing-user authentication behavior.

patterns.name: Portuguese HTTP validation error
patterns.context: Explains returning 422 and JSON errors when validation fails, and compares related concepts or time.

patterns.name: Stylesheet and HTML refactoring
patterns.context: Discusses needing to change only the stylesheet during a redesign rather than editing HTML as well, and avoiding old habits.

11_706.concept: none
11_706.description: 激活样例涵盖多类软件开发文本（Android、CSS、Spring、Web 注册与验证），也包括法律论述、闲聊和商品文案。各段触发词差异很大，难以归结为稳定的词法或语义特征。

patterns.name: Sass/CSS mixin 与 clearing
patterns.context: 代码及其注释讨论是否为 Clearing 创建 mixin，涉及 Sass/CSS 类名。

patterns.name: Android 点击处理与属性
patterns.context: 说明把方法名写入 Android XML 的 onClick 属性；附近有 Java 点击回调代码。

patterns.name: Android 样式 XML
patterns.context: 定义继承 Android ActionBar 主题的样式并设置背景色。

patterns.name: 法律上诉与口头辩论
patterns.context: 描述法院小组认为无需听取口头辩论，并评价上诉缺乏依据。

patterns.name: 柔术自我介绍
patterns.context: 论坛对话询问武术类型，回答者提及巴西柔术及棕带。

patterns.name: 笔记本散热器商品描述
patterns.context: 介绍笔记本散热器的风扇、低功耗磁性搭扣等产品特性。

patterns.name: Spring 配置建议
patterns.context: 讨论 Web 应用中的单例作用域及 Spring 属性配置，给出替代方案建议。

patterns.name: 注册与认证控制器
patterns.context: 描述控制器默认用 trait 实现新用户注册和既有用户认证行为。

patterns.name: 葡语 HTTP 验证错误
patterns.context: 说明验证失败时返回 422 及 JSON 错误，并比较相关概念或时间。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 Web 开发问答

patterns.name: 样式表与 HTML 重构
patterns.context: 讨论改版时只需改样式表而非同时操作 HTML，并避免旧习惯。

en.description: Activation samples include separators in English negative contractions, technical identifiers, and legal compounds, as well as legal section headings, Portuguese technical responses, and patent material classifications; these domains and wording patterns are not uniform.

patterns.name: Negative contractions
patterns.context: A negative contraction appears in English dialogue or narration; in [3], “'t” is at the end of the truncated word “don't”.

patterns.name: Separators in technical identifiers
patterns.context: A colon or hyphen appears in an Android attribute name, XML tag name, or legal compound; subwords near these symbols also activate.

patterns.name: Legal appellate headings
patterns.context: In court opinions, appellate jurisdiction section headings and surrounding procedural narration.

patterns.name: Portuguese technical explanations
patterns.context: A Portuguese answer explains a validation error using HTTP status code 422 and compares two cases.

patterns.name: Material classifications in patents
patterns.context: Classifies two types of charge-transport media and gives polymers and low-molecular-weight photoconductive compounds as examples.

11_706.concept: none
11_706.description: 激活样本包含英语否定缩写、技术标识符及法律复合词中的分隔符，也覆盖法律章节标题、葡语技术答复和专利材料分类；这些领域与措辞模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 否定缩写
patterns.context: 英语对话或叙述中出现否定缩写；[3] 的 “'t” 位于截断的 “don't” 词尾。

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的分隔符
patterns.context: 冒号或连字符出现在 Android 属性名、XML 标签名或法律复合词中；这些符号附近的子词也有激活。

patterns.name: 法律上诉标题
patterns.context: 法院判决中，上诉管辖权章节标题及其前后的程序叙述。

patterns.name: 葡语技术说明
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语回答以 HTTP 状态码 422 解释验证错误，并比较两种情况。

patterns.name: 专利中的材料分类
patterns.context: 按两类电荷传输介质分类，并举出聚合物与低分子光导化合物。

en.concept: Mixed local word forms and token patterns
en.description: The most stable shared phenomenon is strong activation on the t in English don’t, across various negative sentences and everyday contexts. Other high activations involve Portuguese principal, inert in a patent, data indentation, and sporadic subword fragments, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: don’t in negative evaluation phrases
patterns.context: In the English contraction don’t, activation falls on the token “t” after the apostrophe; the preceding text often contains I, followed by verbs such as have, like, eat, or remember. It is not limited to any particular emotion or collocation.

patterns.name: A “principal”-related fragment within a Portuguese word
patterns.context: In Portuguese technical Q&A about HTTP 422 and validation errors, strong activation is concentrated on the complete word principal, in the surrounding “a principal diferença” construction; other labels are scattered across Portuguese word fragments.

patterns.name: inert in chemical patent text
patterns.context: In patent-style lists of chemical reaction conditions, inert modifies solvent near descriptions of solvents, bases, and reactants.

patterns.name: Tabs/indentation in code or data
patterns.context: In code/data table snippets with hexadecimal values and equals signs, the label falls on an indentation tab; several numbers and letter tokens in the same passage also activate weakly.

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word or punctuation-adjacent activations
patterns.context: Beyond the clearer local patterns above, activation is also distributed across line breaks, pronouns, Portuguese word fragments, and common words; there is no consistent trigger across passages, so these cannot be classified as a stable semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Mixed forum, Q&A, and web text

11_706.concept: 混合局部词形与 token 模式
11_706.description: 最稳定的共同现象是英语 don’t 中 t 的强激活，出现在多种否定句和日常语境。其余高激活分别涉及葡语 principal、专利中的 inert、数据缩进及零散词片段，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 否定评价短语中的 don’t
patterns.trigger: «don»? 标注实际集中在 “don’t” 的 “10”：[1] don«'t»10 have；[2] don«'t»10 like；[4] don’«t»10 eat；[5] don«'t»10 like；[7] don«'t»10 really like；[9] don«'t»9 even remember
patterns.context: 英语缩写 don’t 中，激活落在撇号后的 token “t”；前文通常含 I，后续接 have、like、eat、remember 等动词。并非只限于某一种情绪或搭配。

patterns.name: 葡语词内部的“principal”相关片段
patterns.trigger: [3] «a»7 «principal»10；同段另有分词切分的葡语词片段，如 «S»3«endo»6
patterns.context: 葡语技术问答中谈 HTTP 422 与验证错误，强激活集中在完整词 principal，周围是“a principal diferença”结构；其他标注分散在葡语词片段中。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 化学专利文本中的 inert
patterns.context: 化学反应条件的专利式列举中，inert 修饰 solvent，处于溶剂、碱及反应物说明附近。

patterns.name: 代码或数据中的制表符/缩进
patterns.context: 十六进制数值与等号排列的代码/数据表片段中，标记落在缩进制表符；同段也有若干数字和字母 token 的弱激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或结构化数据

patterns.name: 零散的词内或标点邻接激活
patterns.context: 除上述较明显局部外，激活还分布在换行、代词、葡语词片段及常见词上；缺乏跨段一致的具体触发条件，不能据此归为稳定语义模式。
patterns.domain: 混合论坛、问答与网页文本

en.concept: Local frequent words and terminology fragments
en.description: Activation spans Portuguese function words and subword fragments, English technical phrases, and topics including chemical reagents, patent devices, programming troubleshooting, biomedicine, political elections, and catalyst synthesis; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Portuguese conjunctions and syntactic elements
patterns.context: In continuous Portuguese sentences, articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and relational words are highlighted; strong activation falls on common words or their subword fragments.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial or structural phrases
patterns.context: In English technical or academic text, short function words and local expressions near noun phrases for types, states, or methods activate.

patterns.name: Chemical reagents, solvents, and materials terminology
patterns.context: Chemical descriptions of reactants, solvents, preparation conditions, or material composition; activation covers both chemical nouns and common structural words around them.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and PubMed Central Methods sections

patterns.name: Descriptions of technical objects' types or construction
patterns.context: Patent text describes devices such as pumps, seals, and locking mechanisms, along with their types, construction, or operating conditions.

patterns.name: Software programming and exception troubleshooting
patterns.context: Transferring or accessing data between Android Activities, describing crashes and their causes.

patterns.name: Protein isoforms and immune responses
patterns.context: Biomedical descriptions of myosin proteins, antibody recognition, and non-muscle forms.

patterns.name: Election and human-rights topics
patterns.context: Portuguese political speeches or parliamentary discussions mention human rights, members of parliament, and elections.

patterns.name: Applied nanocatalyst synthesis
patterns.context: Describes spinel compositions and green synthesis involving plant extracts; stronger activation is concentrated in synthesis-method phrases.

11_706.concept: 局部高频词与术语片段
11_706.description: 激活跨葡语功能词与子词片段、英语技术短语，并覆盖化学试剂、专利装置、编程排错、生物医学、政治选举及催化剂合成；未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 葡语连接词与句法成分
patterns.trigger: « a»8 «principal»10 «diferen»5«ça»3« entre»5« el»5«es»4« é»4 «o»6 «tempo»2；« que»…« à»5«s»3« ele»9«i»1«ções；«Con»5«form»5«e»6
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语连续句子中，冠词、介词、连接词及句法关系词被突出；强激活落在普通词或其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 英语句首或结构性短语
patterns.trigger: « this»9 type；« a»5 saturated；« in»5 the line；« a»6 simple
patterns.context: 英语技术或学术文本中，类型、状态或方式等名词短语附近的短功能词及局部表达被激活。
patterns.domain: 专利、论文及问答技术文本

patterns.name: 化学试剂、溶剂与材料术语
patterns.trigger: « organic»4 base；« alkali»4« metal»4 hydride；« inert»9 solvent；« saturated»9 solution；« analytical»3-grade ethanol
patterns.context: 涉及反应物、溶剂、制备条件或材料组成的化学叙述；激活同时覆盖化学名词及其前后的常见结构词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与 PubMed Central 方法部分

patterns.name: 技术对象的类型或构造描述
patterns.trigger: « this»9 type；« this»9；« locking» element arrangement；« simple»4 mechanical design
patterns.context: 专利文本描述泵、密封、锁定机构等装置及其类型、构造或运行条件。

patterns.name: 软件编程与异常排错
patterns.context: Android Activity 间传递或访问数据，描述崩溃及异常原因。

patterns.name: 蛋白质同工型与免疫反应
patterns.trigger: « heavy»6 chain isoform A；« anti»-isoform B；« non»-«mus»cle
patterns.context: 对肌球蛋白蛋白质、抗体识别及非肌肉形式作生物医学描述。

patterns.name: 选举与人权议题
patterns.context: 葡语政治演讲或议会讨论中谈及人权、议员和选举。

patterns.name: 应用型纳米催化剂合成
patterns.context: 描述尖晶石组成及植物提取物参与的绿色合成；较强激活集中在合成方法短语。

en.description: Activation is distributed across common function words in biomedical abstracts, non-heme iron terminology, and diverse biomedical topics; it also appears in Ionic frontend words, HTML tags, and catalyst synthesis descriptions. No single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Functional phrases in biomedical text
patterns.context: Appears in coherent biomedical abstracts or project summaries, often in sentences describing proteins, enzymes, diseases, or physiological measures; triggers are distributed across different sentence positions, with no fixed grammatical position.
patterns.domain: Biomedical academic prose in PubMed Abstracts, PubMed Central, and NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: Non-heme iron-related terminology
patterns.context: Appears in terms such as “non-heme iron” when describing iron sites, structure, or composition in enzymes or proteins.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, enzymology papers, or project summaries

patterns.name: Split subwords in technical terms
patterns.context: These fragments appear near Ionic projects or web resource names, where technical words are split into multiple tokens; passage 2 is a development question, and passage 9 is an HTML comment.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Github webpage source

patterns.name: “novel”-type phrases in research abstracts
patterns.context: Appears as the naming suffix of a newly identified bacterial species, immediately after the species name and in the same sentence as its isolation source.

patterns.name: Myosin types and unconventional features
patterns.context: Discusses myosin types, antibody responses, and similarities or differences from known forms.

patterns.name: Catalysts and green synthesis descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of spinel nanocatalyst synthesis, especially simple or plant-extract-assisted green synthesis.
patterns.domain: Materials chemistry and catalysis paper abstracts

patterns.name: Web viewport and frontend framework tags
patterns.context: Appears in HTML viewport metadata or comments, alongside webpage framework and icon library names.

patterns.name: Vitamin E and bone density research
patterns.context: Reports associations between serum vitamin E or α-tocopherol and bone metabolism or bone density.
patterns.domain: Population health and nutritional epidemiology abstracts

patterns.name: Interleukins and arthritis
patterns.context: Describes interleukins and extra-articular and intra-articular manifestations of rheumatoid arthritis, along with related comorbidities.

11_706.concept: none
11_706.description: 激活分布在生物医学摘要中的常见虚词、非血红素铁术语及多种生物医学主题，也出现在 Ionic 前端词、HTML 标记与催化剂合成描述中；看不出单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的功能性短语
patterns.trigger: «a»、«the»、«for»、«in»、«and»、«of»、«with» 等常见虚词；如 «a»« vital»、«in»« the»、«for»
patterns.context: 出现在连贯的生物医学摘要或项目摘要中，常位于蛋白质、酶、疾病或生理指标的说明句里；触发分散在句子不同位置，并无固定语法位置。
patterns.domain: PubMed Abstracts、PubMed Central、NIH ExPorter 的生物医学学术文体

patterns.name: 非血红素铁相关术语
patterns.context: 描述酶或蛋白质的铁位点、结构或组成时，出现在“non-heme iron”一类术语中。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、酶学论文或项目摘要

patterns.name: 技术名词中的拆分子词
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在 Ionic 项目或网页资源名称附近，表现为技术词被拆成多个 token；段2是问答中的开发问题，段9是 HTML 注释。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 网页源码

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的“novel”类短语
patterns.context: 作为新菌种学名的命名后缀，紧接菌种名称，并在同一句中说明分离来源。

patterns.name: 肌球蛋白类型与非常规特征
patterns.context: 讨论肌球蛋白类型、抗体反应及其与已知形式的异同。
patterns.domain: 蛋白质与肌肉生物学摘要

patterns.name: 催化剂与绿色合成表述
patterns.context: 出现在尖晶石纳米催化剂的合成描述中，尤其涉及简便或植物提取物辅助的绿色合成。
patterns.domain: 材料化学、催化剂论文摘要

patterns.name: 网页视口与前端框架标记
patterns.context: 位于 HTML 的 viewport 元数据或注释中，伴随网页框架和图标库名称。

patterns.name: 维生素E与骨密度研究
patterns.context: 报道血清维生素E或α-生育酚与骨代谢、骨密度之间的关联。
patterns.domain: 人群健康与营养流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 白介素与关节炎
patterns.context: 描述白介素及类风湿关节炎的关节内外表现和相关共病。

en.concept: Proper nouns, terminology, and word fragments in text
en.description: Primarily responds to Swedish parliamentary speech, including personal and demonstrative pronouns and legislative debate expressions; it also activates on Flutter/Ionic/Bootstrap frontend and mobile-development terminology, as well as sporadic Swedish word forms.

patterns.name: Personal and demonstrative expressions in Swedish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In continuous Swedish speeches, speakers state positions, report actions, or directly address parliamentary listeners; « vi» recurs across multiple passages, and « jag» and « ni» also activate strongly.

patterns.name: Parliamentary procedure and policy discussion terms
patterns.context: Discusses signing legislative proposals, resolutions, committees, debates, or EU policy issues; often occurs near terms for parliamentarians and formal statements.

patterns.name: Flutter and mobile platform development
patterns.context: Asks about or describes using Flutter to develop apps for both iOS and Android; activation falls on technical terms and fragments of platform names.

patterns.name: Ionic resource comments in web templates
patterns.context: Resource or icon-library comments in HTML template code, containing Ionic-related names.

patterns.name: Bootstrap navbar class names and controls
patterns.context: HTML defines a dark, fixed-position responsive navbar and its collapse button; activation concentrates on Bootstrap class names and control tags.

patterns.name: Formal parliamentary address and reporting expressions
patterns.context: Polite forms of address and titles, as well as expressions for explaining or reporting observations in parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Sporadic Swedish common words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Common adverbs, adjectives, modal expressions, or within-word subword fragments appear in different syntactic environments; these isolated triggers do not support a distinct, stable semantic condition.

11_706.concept: 文本中的专名、术语与词片段
11_706.description: 主要响应瑞典语议会发言中的人称指示词及立法辩论表达；另对 Flutter/Ionic/Bootstrap 前端与移动开发术语激活，并有零散瑞典语词形触发。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会发言中的人称与指示表达
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续发言中，发言者陈述立场、报告行动或直接称呼议会听众；其中« vi»在多个片段反复出现，« jag»和« ni»也显著激活。

patterns.name: 议会程序与政策讨论用语
patterns.trigger: « under»teck«na» lag«stiftningspaketet»、« resolution»、« kommission»ens»、«deb»atten»、« gemensamt»« vid»arebosättningsprogram»
patterns.context: 谈论签署立法方案、决议、委员会、辩论或欧盟政策议题；常与议员称谓和正式陈述相邻。

patterns.name: Flutter 与移动平台开发
patterns.context: 询问或介绍同时面向 iOS 与 Android 开发应用的 Flutter 用途；激活落在技术名词及平台名的片段上。

patterns.name: 网页模板中的 Ionic 资源注释
patterns.context: HTML 模板代码中的资源或图标库注释，出现 Ionic 相关名称。

patterns.name: Bootstrap 导航栏类名与控件
patterns.context: HTML 中定义深色、固定位置的响应式导航栏及其折叠按钮，激活集中在 Bootstrap 类名和控件标记。

patterns.name: 正式议事称谓与报告表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中的礼貌称谓、职位称呼，以及说明或报告观察结果的表达。

patterns.name: 零散的瑞典语常用词及词形片段
patterns.trigger: « skulle»、« verkl»ig»en»、« natur»ligt»vis»、« ka»ot»iska»、« möjlighet»、« ham»nat»
patterns.context: 在不同句法环境中出现的常用副词、形容词、情态表达或词内子词片段；难以从这些孤立触发项归纳出单独的稳定语义条件。

en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is the substring al, appearing in common words, software names, and identifiers; other high activations fall on the Czech preposition, the Gson name, Polish within-word fragments, a Swedish pronoun, and the initial letter of a place name.

patterns.name: Substring al
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring al inside different words or identifiers; no fixed syntactic or semantic context is required
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patent text, Java/Python code, and dependency configuration

patterns.name: Czech preposition k
patterns.context: The Czech preposition k, meaning “to/toward,” followed by the relative pronoun kterém

patterns.name: g in the Gson identifier
patterns.context: The Gson library name in Java code or error messages; activation is at the start of the identifier

patterns.name: Polish within-word fragment ac
patterns.context: The substring within the Polish word harmonizację, with no clear independent semantic or syntactic trigger

patterns.name: Swedish jag
patterns.context: The Swedish first-person pronoun appearing in parliamentary speech to express “I”

patterns.name: English pronoun I
patterns.context: The initial letter I in the Romanian city name Iasi; context is a personal introduction in a forum

11_706.concept: 偏好特定子词片段
11_706.description: 最突出的重复模式是 al 子串，出现在普通词与软件名称、标识符中；其余高激活分别落在捷克语介词、Gson 名称、波兰语词内片段、瑞典语代词及地名首字母上。

patterns.name: al 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词或标识符内部的 al 子串；不要求固定句法或语义上下文
patterns.domain: 百科、专利文本、Java/Python 代码与依赖配置

patterns.name: 捷克语介词 k
patterns.context: 捷克语中表示“向/对”的介词 k，后接关系代词 kterém

patterns.name: Gson 标识符中的 g
patterns.context: Java 代码或异常信息中的 Gson 库名；激活位于标识符开头

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段 ac
patterns.context: 波兰语词 harmonizację 内部的子串，无明显独立语义或句法触发条件

patterns.name: 瑞典语 jag
patterns.context: 瑞典语第一人称代词，出现在议会发言中表达“我”

patterns.name: 英语代词 I
patterns.trigger: «I»9（“Iasi”中的首字母；上下文随后写有“I'm from Iasi”）
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚城市名 Iasi 的首字母，大小写为 I；上下文为论坛个人介绍

en.concept: Word-form fragments and common word patterns
en.description: The most stable cue is Swedish inte, especially inte hade; jag redan har anaphoric expressions and redan är här also occur. The Czech relative pronoun kterém and Java method declarations are isolated patterns and cannot be grouped with these Swedish cues.

patterns.name: Swedish negation word
patterns.context: The negation word inte itself is marked; it often appears in subordinate or longer sentences, with varying negated content.
patterns.domain: Primarily Swedish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: inte in Swedish anaphoric expressions
patterns.context: inte is followed by hade, negating the past perfect; appears in statements about missing details, lacking an opportunity, or not making a suggestion.
patterns.domain: Swedish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Swedish “I have already said”
patterns.context: The first person jag is followed by redan har, forming an anaphoric expression meaning “I have already…”.
patterns.domain: Swedish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Swedish “already here”
patterns.context: redan modifies är här, expressing existence or presence, and inte appears in the same sentence.
patterns.domain: Swedish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Czech relative pronoun
patterns.context: The token marker falls on the relative pronoun spelled kterém; the surrounding text is Czech parliamentary speech.
patterns.domain: Czech speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Java method declaration
patterns.context: A method declaration and annotation in a Java Activity callback; this passage contains no Swedish inte.

11_706.concept: 词形片段与常见词句模式
11_706.description: 最稳定的线索是瑞典语 inte，尤其 inte hade；另有 jag redan har 回指表达及 redan är här。捷克语关系代词 kterém 和 Java 方法声明是孤立模式，不能并入这些瑞典语线索。

patterns.name: 瑞典语否定词
patterns.context: 否定词 inte 本身被标记；常出现在从句或较长句子中，具体否定内容不同。
patterns.domain: 主要是欧洲议会瑞典语发言

patterns.name: 瑞典语回指表达中的 inte
patterns.context: inte 后接 hade，否定过去完成时；出现在关于错过细节、没有机会或未提出建议的表述中。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“我已经说过”
patterns.context: 第一人称 jag 后接 redan har，构成“我已经……”的回指表达。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“已经在这里”
patterns.context: redan 修饰表示存在或在场的 är här，且同句出现 inte。

patterns.name: 捷克语关系代词
patterns.context: 分词标记落在分词拼写的关系代词 kterém 上；周围为捷克语议会话语。

patterns.name: Java 方法声明
patterns.context: Java Activity 回调中的方法声明及注解；此段没有瑞典语 inte。

en.concept: English function-word combinations and local structures
en.description: Primarily activates on structures such as “under the” that introduce rules, provisions, standards, or requirements in U.S. legal text; also appears in legal fixed phrases, HTML form code, Portuguese technical forum fragments, and Swedish parliamentary speeches, across differing languages and registers.

patterns.name: “under the” in legal contexts
patterns.context: Introduces a law, regulation, constitutional provision, review standard, or specific requirement in legal discussion; can also introduce a theory or circumstance.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Articles and prepositions in legal expressions
patterns.context: Fixed collocations or argumentative phrases in legal text; even without the full “under the,” nearby articles, prepositions, and legal terms activate.

patterns.name: English HTML form code
patterns.context: Near HTML/frontend code tags and attributes; activation falls on code markers and attribute tokens.

patterns.name: Portuguese algorithm/forum text
patterns.context: A Portuguese forum answer fragment containing algorithm-related words and technical terms such as MVC; no clear legal expressions are present.

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary records discuss whether parliamentarians missed details or whether speakers had an opportunity to speak; this differs from the English legal pattern.

11_706.concept: 英语功能词组合及局部结构
11_706.description: 主要在美国法律文本引出规则、条款、标准或要求的“under the”等结构中激活；另见法律固定措辞、HTML 表单代码、葡语技术论坛片段和瑞典语议会发言，语言与语域并不一致。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的“under the”
patterns.context: 法律论述中引出法律、法规、宪法条款、审查标准或特定要求；也可引出某种理论或情形。

patterns.name: 法律表达中的冠词与介词组合
patterns.trigger: « a»…« Alabama»、«a»…« de» novo、« the»…« particular» circumstances
patterns.context: 法律文本中的固定搭配或论证措辞；虽未出现完整“under the”，仍激活了邻近冠词、介词及法律术语。

patterns.name: 英文 HTML 表单代码
patterns.context: HTML/前端代码标签与属性附近；激活落在代码标记及属性 token 上。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语算法/论坛文本
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语论坛回答片段，包含算法相关词语和 MVC 等技术术语；未见明显法律表达。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 葡萄牙语技术问答

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会发言
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会记录中讨论议员是否错过细节、发言人是否有机会发言；与英语法律模式不同。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple languages and domains: articles and determiners in English legal review formulas form the clearest group; other local patterns include Portuguese “outra,” Swedish “inte,” “the” in technical contexts, “a” in patents, and formatting line breaks.

patterns.name: Portuguese “another/other” after a list
patterns.context: After listing methods, matters, or fields, the text introduces another matter for consideration; passage 4 also contains adjacent «uma» and «área».
patterns.domain: Portuguese StackExchange discussions and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Determiners and formulas in English legal review standards
patterns.context: Legal opinions describe how courts review summary judgment or sentencing, especially sentences meaning “apply the same standard” or describing “de novo” review.

patterns.name: English definite article in technical contexts
patterns.context: Refers to a specific object or string in technical explanations; in passage 7, activation is concentrated on «the» around an error message.

patterns.name: «a» in English patent text
patterns.context: Uses an indefinite article to introduce a process when describing an injection molding machine, parameters, and computer simulations.

patterns.name: Swedish negation word
patterns.context: Expresses negation in parliamentary speeches; the surrounding text concerns whether parliamentarians missed details or had an opportunity to speak.

patterns.name: Line-break tokens in Portuguese and English corpora
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks; legal documents and Q&A text both have paragraph or formatting breaks, and not every passage has consistent neighboring words.

patterns.name: Individual marked token «Al»
patterns.context: Appears only in the name Al Gore at the beginning of a Portuguese answer, with no confirmed recurring context.

11_706.concept: unclear
11_706.description: 激活分散在多语种、多领域：英语法律审查套语中的冠词与限定词最成组；另有葡语“outra”、瑞典语“inte”、技术语境的the、专利中的a及格式换行等局部模式。

patterns.name: 葡语列举后的“另一/其他”
patterns.context: 前文列出方法、事项或领域，随后引入另一个可考虑的事项；第4段还出现相邻的 «uma»、«área»。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 讨论与欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 英语法律审查标准中的限定词与套语
patterns.trigger: «a» 与 «de novo»、«the same legal standard»、«applying» 等司法审查表述相邻；第3段另有 «a de novo standard of review»
patterns.context: 法律判决描述法院如何审查简易判决或量刑，尤其是“适用相同标准”或“de novo”审查的句式。

patterns.name: 英语技术语境中的定冠词
patterns.context: 技术说明中指称特定对象或字符串；第7段激活集中在异常信息前后的 «the»。

patterns.name: 英语专利文本中的 «a»
patterns.context: 描述注塑机、参数及计算机模拟时，用不定冠词引入一个过程。

patterns.name: 瑞典语否定词
patterns.context: 议会发言中表达否定；周围是关于议员是否遗漏细节、发言机会的陈述。

patterns.name: 葡语及英语语料中的换行 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行附近；法律文书和问答文本均有段落或格式换行，且并非每段都有一致的邻接词。

patterns.name: 个别标记 token «Al»
patterns.context: 只在葡语回答开头的人名 Al Gore 中出现，缺少可确认的重复上下文。

en.concept: Article a and legal review phrasing
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the article a and fixed phrases about review standards and legal rules in legal text, especially those involving summary judgment, de novo, same standard, Fourth Amendment, and deferential review. There are also activations on Portuguese a/uma/outra and word fragments beginning with a, plus san in an email address, which cannot be grouped into the same clear syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Articles in legal review standards
patterns.context: The article appears in fixed legal phrases about review, applying a standard, or legal principles; the specific collocations vary somewhat across passages
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Portuguese “another/one” expressions
patterns.context: In continuous Portuguese discussion or lists, indefinite articles/determiners appear with expressions meaning “another”
patterns.domain: Portuguese forum answers, European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Local collocations of Portuguese preposition a
patterns.context: A preposition or article appears within a Portuguese phrase; it is the same surface token as in English legal text but occurs in a different context

patterns.name: Prepositions and articles in English legal text
patterns.context: Noun phrases in general legal argument, not necessarily part of a unified fixed phrase for a review standard
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Portuguese word fragments beginning with a
patterns.context: Only activation on local word fragments is visible, making it difficult to identify shared syntactic conditions beyond spelling

patterns.name: san in an email address
patterns.context: Part of an email address domain, rather than an ordinary natural-language word

11_706.concept: 冠词 a 与法律审查句式
11_706.description: 主要在法律文本中对冠词 a 及审查标准、法律规则等固定句式敏感，尤其常见于 summary judgment、de novo、same standard、Fourth Amendment 和 deferential review。另有葡语 a/uma/outra 及 a 起始词片段的激活，外加邮件地址中的 san，无法归入同一明确句法模式。

patterns.name: 法律审查标准中的冠词
patterns.trigger: “a”及紧随其后的“de novo”“same”“deferential”等审查标准表达；多处“the … standard”“under a …”
patterns.context: 法律句子中冠词处于审查、适用标准或法律原则的固定句式内；不同段落具体搭配不完全相同

patterns.name: 葡语“另一/一”类表达
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语连续讨论或列举事项时，出现不定冠词/限定词与“另一”表达
patterns.domain: 葡语论坛回答、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语介词 a 的局部搭配
patterns.context: 葡语句法中介词或冠词出现在短语内部；与英文法律文本中的字面 token 相同，但语境不同

patterns.name: 英文法律文本中的介词与冠词
patterns.trigger: “a”出现在“a standard”“a matter of law”“a free citizen”等短语中
patterns.context: 一般法律论证中的名词短语，未必属于统一的审查标准固定搭配

patterns.name: 葡语以字母 a 开头的词片段
patterns.trigger: “áreas”“ainda”“área”“aplicado”等带 a/á 起始的词或子词片段
patterns.context: 仅能看到局部字词片段的激活，难以确认除拼写外有共同句法条件

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的 san
patterns.context: 作为电子邮件地址域名的一部分，而非通常的自然语言词语
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头/联系人列表

en.description: Activations commonly occur on commas and preceding proper names, forms of address, or list items. They also appear in email salutations, dates, technical names, and punctuation in copyright notices. Across multiple genres, this appears more sensitive to punctuation separators and local formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Comma after a form of address
patterns.context: A comma immediately follows a person or entity name; occurs in email salutations, entry headings, or name lists.

patterns.name: Email opening and salutation
patterns.context: The email body opens with Hi followed by the recipient’s name and a comma; in some cases, the body continues on the next line.

patterns.name: Date and time format
patterns.context: A date composed of a weekday, month, day, and year, followed by a line break and colon-containing text.

patterns.name: Repeated name and line break
patterns.context: The same botanical name repeats across lines in an encyclopedia entry, followed by a comma and an explanation of the name.

patterns.name: Comma after technical terms and product names
patterns.context: Patent background text lists technical systems, examples, and manufacturers’ product names, with commas separating the items.

patterns.name: Punctuation in copyright notices
patterns.context: Periods and commas in company names and legal-entity abbreviations in copyright notices.

patterns.name: Sentence-internal comma in email body
patterns.context: An email sentence begins with Actually, contains only mid-sentence, and ends with a comma leading into what follows.

11_849.concept: 逗号与格式边界
11_849.description: 激活常见于逗号及其前的专名、称呼或列表项，也见于邮件称呼、日期、技术名称和版权声明中的标点；跨多种文体，较像对标点分隔及局部格式边界敏感。

patterns.name: 称呼后的逗号
patterns.context: 姓名或实体名称之后紧接逗号；邮件称呼、条目标题或名称列表中均出现。

patterns.name: 邮件开头与称呼
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头以 Hi 加收件人姓名及逗号起句，部分随后换行进入正文。

patterns.name: 日期时间格式
patterns.context: 星期、月份、日期和年份组成的日期，后接换行及带冒号的文本。

patterns.name: 重复名称与换行
patterns.context: 百科条目中同一植物学名称跨行重复，名称后接逗号及释名说明。

patterns.name: 技术术语与产品名后的逗号
patterns.context: 专利背景文字列举技术系统、示例及制造商产品名，逗号分隔成分。

patterns.name: 版权声明中的标点
patterns.context: 版权声明中公司名称及法律实体缩写的句点、逗号。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的句间逗号
patterns.context: 邮件语句以 Actually 起头，句中出现 only，末尾逗号承接后文。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on punctuation commas: commas after email salutations or sentence-opening markers, and commas in Wednesday date formats. Web dates are often followed by a blank line; the opening body fragments vary, with no shared lexical meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Comma after an email salutation
patterns.context: A comma immediately follows an email opening salutation or sentence-initial discourse marker; the comma is the strongest trigger token.

patterns.name: Weekday date heading
patterns.context: A complete date follows Wednesday, separated by a comma, and is followed by a line break; dates vary.
patterns.domain: Date headings in web text or blogs

patterns.name: Line break after a date
patterns.context: A blank line follows a complete date heading, after which the body begins; this pattern occurs together with weekday date formats.

11_849.concept: 逗号及格式化文本边界
11_849.description: 激活主要集中于标点逗号：邮件称呼或句首标记后的逗号，以及 Wednesday 日期格式中的逗号。网页日期后常有空行；正文起始片段各异，未见共同词义。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼后的逗号
patterns.context: 邮件开头称呼或句首话语标记后紧接逗号；逗号是最强触发 token。

patterns.name: 星期日期标题
patterns.context: Wednesday 后以逗号分隔完整日期，随后出现换行；各日期不同。
patterns.domain: 网页文本或博客中的日期标题

patterns.name: 日期后换行
patterns.trigger: 年份后 «↵»«↵»，再接正文首词或片段，如 «I'm»、«Been»、«14»、«S»、«I»、«Natural»
patterns.context: 完整日期标题之后空一行，正文开始；该模式与星期日期格式同时出现。

en.description: Activations occur on line breaks, indentation, punctuation, and field boundaries across many document types. There are also localized responses to legal document headings, code tags, news clippings, parliamentary records, and arithmetic layout, with no single semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Document structure markers and line breaks
patterns.context: Frequent line breaks, indentation, tag boundaries, or delimiters in structured documents; whitespace and punctuation also activate.
patterns.domain: Layout and formatting structures in mixed corpora

patterns.name: Legal appellate court heading
patterns.context: Court names appear in uppercase across multiple lines, often followed by a docket number, party roles, and litigants.

patterns.name: XML-style tags and field names
patterns.context: Field names are enclosed in angle-bracket tags, with query statements, status codes, or URLs embedded between tags.

patterns.name: Class definitions and code comments
patterns.context: Component/class definition snippets organized with semicolon comments and line breaks.

patterns.name: Date, news headline, and summary
patterns.context: Dates, news headlines, and sources appear together in a clipping or summary list format.

patterns.name: Baltic-language parliamentary records
patterns.context: Headings and chairperson remarks in parliamentary debate records, including Latvian diacritics.

patterns.name: Numeric equations and answer prompt
patterns.context: Multiline numerical operations or arithmetic exercises, ending with a “Work out” prompt.

patterns.name: Publication and litigant layout
patterns.context: A document begins with a published/unpublished designation, followed by uppercase names and aligned formatting to identify party roles.

patterns.name: Comment heading after a date
patterns.context: A date or author information is followed by a line break and a short comment heading; this passage has no clear template shared with the other samples.

patterns.name: Local anomaly in mathematical number strings
patterns.context: Symbols and decimal points occur in row-and-column arithmetic numbers; the specific calculation structure is incomplete.

11_849.concept: 文档格式与结构边界
11_849.description: 激活分布于多种文档的换行、缩进、标点和字段边界；另对法律文书标题、代码标签、新闻剪报、议会记录及算术排版有局部响应，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 文档结构标记与换行
patterns.context: 结构化文档中频繁出现的换行、缩进、标签边界或分隔符；也会对空白及标点激活。
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的版式与格式结构

patterns.name: 法律上诉法院标题
patterns.trigger: «UNITED» « STATES» « COURT» « OF» « APPEALS» «FOR» « THE» « FOUR» «TH» « CIRCUIT»
patterns.context: 法院名称以大写、分行形式出现，常跟随案号、当事人身份与诉讼双方。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决文书

patterns.name: XML式标签与字段名
patterns.context: 字段名被尖括号标签包围，标签间嵌入查询语句、状态码或 URL。

patterns.name: 类定义与代码注释
patterns.context: 以分号注释和换行组织的组件/类定义片段。

patterns.name: 日期及新闻标题摘要
patterns.context: 日期、新闻标题和新闻来源并列，呈剪报或摘要列表形式。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻摘录

patterns.name: 波罗的海语种议会记录
patterns.context: 议会辩论记录的标题及主席发言，含拉脱维亚语变音字符。

patterns.name: 数字算式与作答提示
patterns.context: 多行数字运算或算术练习，末尾出现“Work out”提示。

patterns.name: 出版与诉讼当事人版式
patterns.context: 文书以已出版/未出版标识起始，随后用大写姓名和对齐排版标出当事人身份。

patterns.name: 日期后接评论标题
patterns.context: 日期或作者信息后接换行和简短评论标题；该段未呈现其他样本中的明确模板。

patterns.name: 数学数字串的局部异常
patterns.context: 行列排列的算术数字中出现符号与小数点；具体计算结构不完整。

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic and web text, commonly occurring on hyphenated compounds, chemical formulas, abbreviations, numeric formats, and paper layout markers. They also cover isolated forms such as ethnic group names and web headings, making it difficult to attribute them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Hyphens in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compound modifiers, chemical names, or terms in scientific and technical text; the tokenization token itself may also trigger.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and stoichiometric notation
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of reagents, solution composition, or coordination polymer structures.

patterns.name: Small-caps heading markers in papers
patterns.context: Formatting markers or heading-style labels occur in the main text of papers or near figure/section headings.

patterns.name: Values, units, and formatted numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in experimental procedures, dose/quantity descriptions, or web headings; there is no consistent numeric semantics.

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and measurement terms
patterns.context: Abbreviations occur alongside neuroscience, clinical care, or pulmonary function measurement terms.

patterns.name: Race/ethnic group names
patterns.context: Appears as a demographic category for children or a study population.

patterns.name: Web headings and link/formatting fragments
patterns.context: Non-paper page elements such as web headings, URLs, bylines, or divider lines.

patterns.name: General academic terminology and methods discussion
patterns.context: Formal academic prose describing research background, methods, or results, with no single shared term apparent.
patterns.domain: Evolutionary analysis, clinical research, and experimental methods, [2][3][10]

11_849.concept: 科学文本格式与符号
11_849.description: 激活分散于学术与网页文本，常见于连字符复合词、化学式、缩写、数字格式及论文排版标记；另覆盖族群名称和网页标题等孤立形式，难以归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 科学术语中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接科学或技术文本中的复合修饰语、化学名称或术语；也可能是分词 token 本身触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、化学及学术论文，[1][4][10]

patterns.name: 化学式与计量符号
patterns.trigger: 带上下标或分隔符的化学式，如“Na«~»2«~»SO«~»4«~»”“CaCl«~»2«~»”及“[Cu(333)(btc)(2)]”
patterns.context: 出现在试剂、溶液组成或配位聚合物结构描述中。

patterns.name: 论文小型大写标题标记
patterns.context: 论文正文或图表/章节标题附近，含排版标记或标题式标签。

patterns.name: 数值、单位与格式化数字
patterns.context: 数值嵌在实验步骤、剂量/数量说明或网页标题中；没有统一的数值语义。

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写与测量术语
patterns.context: 缩写与神经科学、临床护理或肺功能测量术语相邻。

patterns.name: 种族/族群名称
patterns.context: 作为儿童人口学或研究对象类别出现。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/研究对象描述，[6]

patterns.name: 网页标题与链接/格式残片
patterns.trigger: “How I made $2,000 in 20 seconds”“http://”“======”及换行符
patterns.context: 网页标题、URL、署名或分隔线等非论文页面元素。

patterns.name: 一般学术术语与方法叙述
patterns.context: 以正式论文语体叙述研究背景、方法或结果，未见单一共享术语。
patterns.domain: 进化分析、临床研究及实验方法，[2][3][10]

en.description: Activations occur across heterogeneous text: scientific terms, hashes and numeric data, legal layout boundaries, paper figure numbers, code delimiters, and opening HTML tags. A notable recurring cue is punctuation, line breaks, or boundaries in structured text, though trigger locations vary across passages.

patterns.name: Electrohydrodynamics terminology
patterns.context: The word electrohydrodynamic appears in a scientific abstract and is split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on the word-initial «electro».

patterns.name: Alphanumeric strings in hashes or checksums
patterns.context: Long hexadecimal hash strings in YAML/JSON-style fields; activations fall on characters and fragments within the hash.

patterns.name: Numeric table rows
patterns.context: Continuous numeric tables or data sequences separated by line breaks and commas; activations occur on numbers, commas, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Line-break/formatting boundaries in legal text
patterns.context: Legal opinions contain line breaks, carriage returns, and indentation spaces between paragraphs or lines; triggers do not consistently fall on legal vocabulary.

patterns.name: Supplementary figure references
patterns.context: References to Supplementary Figure numbers in paper text, with activations on tokens near the numbers; also occurs in medical research results sections.

patterns.name: Code comments and divider lines
patterns.context: Comment or divider regions in source code composed of semicolons, long dashes, and line breaks, with graphics-related identifiers nearby.

patterns.name: HTML document opening tags
patterns.context: The doctype declaration and html tag at the beginning of an HTML document; activations also cover tag boundaries and line breaks.

11_849.concept: 结构化文本边界及片段
11_849.description: 激活分布于异质文本：科学术语、哈希与数字数据、法律排版边界、论文图号、代码分隔符及 HTML 起始标签。较显著的重复线索是结构化文本中的标点、换行或边界，但各段触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 电水动力学术语
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现 electrohydrodynamic 一词，且该词被拆成多个 token；激活集中在词首 «electro»。

patterns.name: 哈希或校验值中的字母数字串
patterns.context: YAML/JSON 样式字段中的长十六进制哈希字符串，激活落在哈希内部字符和片段上。

patterns.name: 数字表格行
patterns.context: 换行分隔、逗号分列的连续数字表格或数据序列；激活在数字、逗号和换行符上。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的换行/排版边界
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，段落或行之间有换行、回车及缩进空格；触发并非稳定落在法律词汇上。

patterns.name: 补充图表引用
patterns.context: 论文正文中的 Supplementary Figure 编号引用，编号附近的 token 激活；也出现在医学研究结果段落中。

patterns.name: 代码注释与分隔线
patterns.context: 源码中由分号、长横线及换行构成的注释或分隔区域，附近混有图形绘制相关标识符。

patterns.name: HTML 文档起始标签
patterns.context: HTML 文档开头的 doctype 声明及 html 标签，激活也覆盖标签边界与换行。

en.description: Activations occur widely in formatted, fragmented text: numbers, spaces, punctuation, line breaks, and split words, especially in tables, addresses, numbered items, and legal documents. They also involve academic proper names, chemical names, email addresses, case details, demographic fields, and technical prose, with no single semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Fragmented numbering, tables, and punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers or fields are split into short fragments by delimiters, commonly in line-break lists, tables, addresses, or structured text; the numbers need not have a specific meaning.
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses, statistical tables, code/data, legal documents, and other formatted text

patterns.name: Whitespace and legal citations in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal opinions or case text, whitespace and words and numbers around statutory and regulatory citations are marked as split; the legal context is clear, but activations also fall on many spaces and numbers.

patterns.name: Academic entities and split proper names
patterns.context: Institutions, place names, companies, or product names occur in formal academic text, such as addresses, acknowledgments, or materials sources; proper names may be split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Consecutive chemical/pharmacological names and formula fragments
patterns.context: Substance names, drug names, chemical formulas, and quantities in specialist chemical or pharmacological text; names are often split into multiple subwords.

patterns.name: Email addresses and email headers
patterns.context: Quoted email, sender fields, and addresses; activations concentrate on split email characters and punctuation.

patterns.name: Actions and monetary descriptions in legal cases
patterns.context: Describes defendant conduct, convictions, or case evidence; words are often accompanied by formatting delimiters, numbers, or cited statutes.

patterns.name: Control, sensors, and attackers in technical papers
patterns.context: Discusses control systems and attackers learning the relationship between sensor outputs; this passage has no clear numbering/table formatting trigger and may reflect a different lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Conversational narrative in email body
patterns.context: First-person conversational narrative in an email body, with activated fragments adjacent to a forwarded email header.

patterns.name: Demographic fields in statistical tables
patterns.context: A table lists marital status, education level, and age categories; fields and values are adjacent and split by delimiters.
patterns.domain: Statistical tables in PubMed Central papers

11_849.concept: 碎片化结构文本与分隔符
11_849.description: 激活广泛落在格式化、碎片化文本：数字、空格、标点、换行和被拆分的词，尤其是表格、地址、编号及法律文书；另涉及学术专名、化学名、邮箱、案情、人口学字段和技术叙述，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 碎片化编号、表格与标点
patterns.trigger: 数字、逗号、空格、换行和其他分隔符交替出现，如 «13» «↵» «16» «,»；«Marital stage» « » «Married/cohabiting»；«Wisconsin» «537» «06»
patterns.context: 数字或字段被分隔符切成短片段，常见于换行列表、表格、地址或结构化文本；未必要求数字具有特定含义
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、统计表、代码/数据、法律文书及其他格式化文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的空格与法条编号
patterns.context: 法律判决或案情文字中，空格及法条、法规编号周围的词和数字被切分标记；法律语境明显，但激活也落在大量空格和编号上

patterns.name: 学术实体名称及其被切分的专名
patterns.context: 机构、地名、公司或产品名出现在地址、致谢或材料来源等正式学术文本中；专名可能跨多个 token 切分
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: 连续出现的化学/药理名称与公式片段
patterns.context: 专业化学或药理文本中的物质名、药物名、化学式与数量；名称常被拆成多个子词

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与邮件头
patterns.context: 邮件引用、发件人字段及地址；激活集中在被拆分的邮箱字符和标点

patterns.name: 法律案情中的行为及金额描述
patterns.context: 陈述被告行为、定罪或案件证据，词语附近常伴随格式分隔、数字或引文法条

patterns.name: 技术论文中的控制、传感器与攻击者
patterns.context: 讨论控制系统及攻击者学习传感器输出关系；该段没有明显的编号/表格格式触发，可能是不同的词义模式

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的口语叙述
patterns.trigger: «maybe»、«i was dying»、«rebecca sent it to me»
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的第一人称口语叙述，激活片段与后续转发邮件头相邻

patterns.name: 统计表中的人口学字段
patterns.trigger: «Marital stage»、«Married/cohabiting»、«Divorced/not cohabiting»、«Education»、«Age of child at first interview»
patterns.context: 表格列出婚姻、教育程度及年龄类别，字段与数值挨近并被分隔符切开
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文中的统计表

en.description: Activations span code identifiers, numeric lists, proper names, and rare word fragments; they often fall on word fragments and punctuation in structured text, without a consistent domain or semantic theme.

patterns.name: Identifiers and member access in code
patterns.context: Appears near code declarations, test assertions, object properties, or variable assignments; activations often fall on identifier fragments and punctuation.

patterns.name: Numeric sequences and table-style data
patterns.context: Many repeated numbers or pairs of numbers, separated by commas or arranged in lists; may also appear in mathematical sets.
patterns.domain: StackExchange sequences, tables, or number puzzles

patterns.name: Proper names and their alphanumeric components
patterns.context: Proper names, abbreviations, or specialized terms occur in factual statements, often alongside numbers, punctuation, or domain terminology.
patterns.domain: Sports news, astronomy papers, encyclopedia biographies

patterns.name: Complex word forms and spelling fragments
patterns.context: Long or rare words are split into multiple subword fragments; there is no consistent semantic or domain condition.

11_849.concept: 结构化文本中的显著片段
11_849.description: 激活分布跨代码标识符、数字列表、专名及罕见词片段；常落在结构化文本中的词片段和标点，领域与语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: 出现在代码声明、测试断言、对象属性或变量赋值附近；激活常落在标识符片段及标点上。

patterns.name: 数字序列与表格样式数据
patterns.context: 大量重复的数字或成对数字，以逗号分隔或排列成列表；也可能出现在数学集合中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数列、表格或数字谜题

patterns.name: 专名及其字母数字构成
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或专有术语处于事实陈述中，周围常有数字、标点或领域术语。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、天文学论文、百科传记

patterns.name: 复杂词形与拼写片段
patterns.context: 较长或罕见的词被拆成多个子词片段；缺乏统一语义或领域条件。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、微生物学论文

en.description: Activations occur in many contexts, including sports competitions and teams, names and subword fragments, numeric amounts and durations, conversational evaluations, music bands, and imagery of winning. Some common words and punctuation activate weakly, with no stable single semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Sports teams and match narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of team level, match performance, goals conceded or scored, or steals; strong activations fall on different words in different passages.
patterns.domain: Sports text such as hockey, soccer, or basketball

patterns.name: Fragments within names and forms of address
patterns.context: Strong activations occur on partial characters or subwords in names, nicknames, or forms of address, usually embedded in biographies, dialogue, or narrative; not all names trigger equally.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, novels, sports reporting, legal testimony

patterns.name: Subword boundaries in words and phrases
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall on word-internal segments or adjacent punctuation and numbers; they occur in general narrative, proper names, and numbered expressions, without a consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Numeric, unit, and monetary expressions
patterns.context: When numeric expressions with currency symbols, quantities, or time units appear, some tokens near the numbers activate; the semantic uses vary across examples.

patterns.name: Expression and evaluation in dialogue
patterns.context: When a person or interviewee expresses judgments, feelings, or evaluations, individual content words and punctuation activate; no fixed phrasing is apparent.

patterns.name: Low-intensity triggers on function words and punctuation
patterns.context: Common words or commas also activate weakly in some passages, but their distribution is broad and intensity low, so no specific condition can be established from them alone.

patterns.name: Musical instruments and band narratives
patterns.context: When a speaker discusses using a bass guitar, a school band, and musician roles, nouns in the instrument/band context and list punctuation activate.

patterns.name: Gambling or imagery of winning
patterns.context: Appears when discussing when to return to the winner’s circle and future destinations; it may relate to the sports pattern, but the passage itself could also refer to gambling or career success.

11_849.concept: none
11_849.description: 激活分布于体育比赛及球队、人名和子词片段、数字金额与时长、对话评价、音乐乐队、获胜意象等多种语境；部分普通词和标点仅弱激活，未见稳定单一语义条件。

patterns.name: 运动队与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 出现在球队级别、比赛表现、进球失分或抢断等体育叙述中；不同片段里强激活落在不同词语上。
patterns.domain: 冰球、足球或篮球等体育文本

patterns.name: 人名与称谓内部片段
patterns.trigger: « Rebels»3、« pap»3«a»1、« M»4«ee»2«ks»2、« Popeye»（分成«P»5«ope»3«ye»3）、« Marc»3«ão»2、« Pedro»4« Cary»1
patterns.context: 强激活出现在姓名、绰号或称谓的部分字符/子词中，通常嵌在人物介绍、对话或叙事里；并非所有姓名都同样触发。
patterns.domain: 百科、小说、体育报道、法律证词

patterns.name: 词语与短语中的子词边界
patterns.context: 激活有时落在词内分段或相邻标点、数字上；可见于普通叙述、专名及带编号的表达，缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字、单位与金额表达
patterns.context: 出现带货币符号、数量或时间单位的数字表达时，数字附近部分 token 激活；不同例子的语义用途不一。
patterns.domain: 科技商业讨论、镜头分析

patterns.name: 对话中的表达与评价
patterns.trigger: « know»2« exactly»4、« mean»1«,»7、« thought»2« the»5« team started»、« sharp»3
patterns.context: 人物或受访者表达判断、感受和评价时，个别内容词及标点激活；未见固定句式。
patterns.domain: 小说对话、体育赛后引语

patterns.name: 低强度功能词与标点触发
patterns.context: 若干片段中常见词或逗号也有弱激活，但分布广、强度低，不能单独确定具体条件。

patterns.name: 音乐器乐及乐队叙述
patterns.context: 说话者谈及自己使用贝斯吉他、校乐队及乐手角色时，乐器/乐队语境中的名词和列举标点激活。

patterns.name: 博彩或获胜意象
patterns.context: 谈到何时重返胜者圈、以及未来去处时出现；与体育比赛模式可能有关，但该段本身也可指博彩或事业成就。

en.description: All activated passages describe results and performance in sports or political competitions: scoring, wins and losses, rankings, or changes in seats in soccer, rugby, cricket, horse racing, and party elections.

patterns.name: Soccer matches and player performance
patterns.context: Describes team or player match performance, goals scored/conceded, points, or goalkeeper saves, commonly in sports news or player profiles.

patterns.name: Rugby events and scoring
patterns.context: Describes rugby matches, national team selection, and whether points were scored.

patterns.name: Cricket match statistics
patterns.context: Describes the progress of a cricket match, batting/bowling performance, and the score.

patterns.name: Horse racing placements and races
patterns.context: Describes race results in terms of horses leading, winning, and finishing positions.

patterns.name: Election results and seat changes
patterns.context: Reports party candidates, election votes, or gains and losses of seats.

11_849.concept: 竞赛结果与表现
11_849.description: 激活段落均为体育或政治竞赛的结果与表现叙述：涵盖足球、橄榄球、板球、赛马，以及政党选举中的得分、胜负、名次或席位变化。

patterns.name: 足球比赛与球员表现
patterns.context: 叙述球队、球员的比赛表现、进球/失球、得分或门将扑救，常见于体育新闻或球员资料。

patterns.name: 橄榄球赛事与得分
patterns.context: 描述橄榄球比赛、入选国家队及是否得分。

patterns.name: 板球比赛统计
patterns.context: 描述板球比赛进程、击球/投球表现与比分。

patterns.name: 赛马名次与赛程
patterns.trigger: “take the lead”“win by two and three quarter lengths”“third”
patterns.context: 按马匹领先、获胜及到达名次描述赛果。

patterns.name: 选举结果与席位变化
patterns.context: 报告政党候选人、选举得票或席位得失。

en.concept: Results and statistics in competition reporting
en.description: Activations occur mainly in sports reporting, especially around scoring/not scoring, cricket terminology, soccer teams, and match statistics. They also include motocross, helicopter news, and counts and results in political elections, so triggers are not limited to sports.

patterns.name: Infinitives and verb complements
patterns.context: Occurs in sports narratives describing scoring, goals, or match results; activations are especially concentrated on «scoring».
patterns.domain: Sports news, player profiles, and cricket terminology explanations

patterns.name: Cricket terminology and statistics
patterns.context: Cricket match reports, player biographies, or terminology explanations; often adjacent to information about innings, scores, or match days.

patterns.name: Soccer teams and player reporting
patterns.context: Discusses team lineups, wingers, fouls, scoring form, or coaching candidates.

patterns.name: Match results and scoring verbs
patterns.context: Describes results as scoring, not scoring, winning, or failing to win a seat; also used for election results outside sports.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting; also political election reporting

patterns.name: Competition counts and statistical figures
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to counts such as match innings, days, games, candidates, or seats.

patterns.name: Helicopters and accident-related narratives
patterns.context: Describes helicopter departures, passengers, and journeys.

patterns.name: Motocross events
patterns.context: Reports a motocross rider’s performance in the first and second rounds.

patterns.name: Political elections and seats
patterns.context: Describes party nominations, election alliances’ votes, and seat results.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens; they co-occur with relevant sports reporting only in specific contexts and cannot independently establish a trigger function.

11_849.concept: 竞赛报道中的结果与统计
11_849.description: 激活主要见于体育报道，尤与得分/未得分、板球术语、足球球队和赛事统计相关；另有摩托越野、直升机新闻及政治选举中的计数与结果表述，触发并不局限于体育。

patterns.name: 不定式与动词补语
patterns.context: 出现在体育叙述中，描述得分、进球或比赛结果；激活尤其集中于 «scoring»。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、球员简介及板球术语解释

patterns.name: 板球赛事术语与统计
patterns.context: 板球比赛报道、球员履历或术语说明；常与局数、分数、比赛日等信息相邻。

patterns.name: 足球队伍与球员报道
patterns.context: 讨论球队阵容、边路球员、犯规、进球状态或教练人选。

patterns.name: 比赛结果与得分动词
patterns.context: 以得分、未得分、获胜或未获席位来描述结果；除体育语境外也用于选举结果。
patterns.domain: 体育报道；另见政治选举报道

patterns.name: 竞赛数量与统计数字
patterns.context: 数字紧邻比赛局数、天数、场次、候选人或席位等计数信息。

patterns.name: 直升机与事故相关叙述
patterns.context: 叙述直升机出发、机上人员及行程。

patterns.name: 摩托越野赛事
patterns.context: 报道摩托越野选手在首轮及第二轮的表现。

patterns.name: 政治选举与席位
patterns.context: 描述政党提名、选举联盟得票及席位结果。

patterns.name: 人名与专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被切分成多个 token；仅在具体语境中与相关体育报道共现，不能单独确定触发作用。

en.concept: Obtaining or not obtaining a result
en.description: Primarily responds to “score” in sports contexts and statements about not yet scoring the first point. It also responds to “win/seat/vote” in election results, sports victories, and a few distinct patterns related to player recruitment and protein domain similarity.

patterns.name: Not yet scoring the first goal/point
patterns.context: A player or athlete has not scored their first goal or point by a given time; “score” and its contextual tokens show strong activation.

patterns.name: Winning seats or votes in elections
patterns.context: Describes a party or candidate winning or not winning seats or vote share in an election; activation is concentrated near win and outcome words such as seat and vote.

patterns.name: Winning a match or award
patterns.context: Recounts a team winning a championship or an athlete receiving an award; uses win in the sense of achieving victory or a result, as in elections, but in a sports context.

patterns.name: Similarity between biomolecular domains
patterns.context: Discusses similarities between protein subfamilies in cytoplasmic or extracellular domains.

patterns.name: Player recruitment and transfers
patterns.context: A club or team considers recruiting or loaning players, listing player names and joining status; the preceding scoring/victory patterns are not observed.

11_849.concept: 取得或未取得结果
11_849.description: 主要响应体育语境中“score”及尚未取得首分的表述，也响应选举结果中的“win/seat/vote”、体育获胜，以及球员招募和蛋白质结构域相关性等少数不同模式。

patterns.name: 尚未取得首个进球/得分
patterns.trigger: “to score”及其附近的“yet”“still”“first”，如 “yet to score his first career goal”“yet to score his debut goal”“still has to score his first points”
patterns.context: 球员或运动员截至某时仍未取得首个进球或得分；“score”及其上下文 token 激活明显。
patterns.domain: 体育人物传记与比赛报道

patterns.name: 选举中赢得席位或投票
patterns.trigger: “win”与选举结果搭配，如 “win the highest share of the vote”“failed to win a seat”“did not win a single seat”
patterns.context: 描述政党或候选人在选举中取得或未取得席位、选票份额；激活集中在 win 及 seat、vote 等结果词附近。

patterns.name: 比赛或奖项获胜
patterns.trigger: “won”，如 “had won the FAW Women’s Cup”“won both the Golden Boot”
patterns.context: 回顾球队夺冠或运动员获得奖项；与选举中的 win 同属取得胜利/结果的用法，但体育语境不同。

patterns.name: 生物分子结构域的相关性
patterns.trigger: “related”及结构域术语，如 “related … in their cytoplasmic domains”“extracellular domains”
patterns.context: 讨论蛋白质亚家族在细胞质或细胞外结构域上的相似关系。

patterns.name: 球员招募与转会
patterns.context: 俱乐部或球队考虑招募、租借球员，列举球员姓名与加盟情况；未见前述得分/获胜触发。

en.concept: The contrastive conjunction but and what follows
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the contrastive conjunction but and subsequent content, including concessions, negation, supplementary restrictions, and conditions. It also occurs in cricket, football statistics, and not only…but also contexts; triggering may depend on word order and local syntax.

patterns.name: Contrastive construction with “but”
patterns.context: In contrastive or concessive sentences, but introduces a restriction, addition, or contrast to preceding content; it is sometimes followed directly by a comma or occurs in a not only…but also construction.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, forums, and code-test text

patterns.name: Cricket scores and match statistics
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in match narratives indicate scores, batting figures, or scores; this co-occurs with the stronger “but” pattern.

patterns.name: Matches and goals in football statistics
patterns.context: Statistics on football players’ or teams’ goals, appearances, and recent records; includes numbers and league names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia player articles and sports news

patterns.name: Parallelism with but also in medicine
patterns.context: Academic sentences use not only…but also to coordinate pathological processes or affected entities.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts; related constructions also occur in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Negation or exception after “but”
patterns.context: But introduces a sole choice, a negative result, or a mismatch between expectation and reality; these are not from the same domain.

patterns.name: Contrastive responses in English questions
patterns.context: First expresses uncertainty or asks for feedback, then offers a tentative response.

patterns.name: Contrast and test evaluation in code assertions
patterns.context: Test code or comments first acknowledge that a test is unsatisfactory, then use but to shift to an evaluation or explanation.

patterns.name: Contrast in manuscript acceptance conditions
patterns.context: First states that submissions are welcome, then uses but to introduce required conditions.

11_849.concept: 转折词 but 及其后续
11_849.description: 主要对转折词 but 及其后续内容敏感，涵盖让步、否定、补充限制与条件；另有板球、足球统计及 not only…but also 等语境，触发可能受词序和局部句法影响。

patterns.name: 转折结构“but”
patterns.context: 转折或让步句中，but 引出对前述内容的限制、补充或对照；有时紧接逗号或 not only…but also 结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域 prose、论坛及代码测试文本

patterns.name: 板球比分与赛况数字
patterns.context: 数字嵌在比赛叙述中，表示得分、击球数或比分；与较强的 “but” 模式并存。

patterns.name: 足球统计中的比赛与进球
patterns.context: 足球运动员或球队的进球、出场及近期战绩统计；包含数字与联赛名称。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 球员条目及体育新闻

patterns.name: 医学中的 but also 并列
patterns.context: 学术句中以 not only…but also 并列病理过程或受影响对象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要；专利背景亦出现相关结构

patterns.name: “but”后的否定或例外
patterns.context: but 后引出唯一选择、否定结果或预期与实际不符；并非同一领域。
patterns.domain: 商业评论、代码错误信息

patterns.name: 英语问句中的转折答复
patterns.context: 先表达不确定或请求反馈，再提出推测性回应。

patterns.name: 代码断言中的转折与测试评价
patterns.context: 测试代码或注释先承认测试不理想，再以 but 转向评价或说明。

patterns.name: 稿件接收条件中的转折
patterns.context: 先说明稿件欢迎投稿，随后以 but 提出必须满足的条件。

en.concept: English contrastive and additive markers, and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: Activation mainly falls on contrastive and additive structures such as but/not only…but also, and also appears in responses or hedging expressions beginning with not. Other instances include Polish, Skopje, and fragments within various biomedical terms and proper names, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Response or uncertainty after negation
patterns.context: A response, degree of certainty, or judgment follows the negator not; typically conveys concession or reservation.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: In negative or emphatic parallel constructions, extends the entities or aspects of a claim.

patterns.name: English but contrast or comparison
patterns.context: But introduces a clause or phrase that contrasts with, compares with, or adds to preceding content; not only need not be present.

patterns.name: Poland-related terms
patterns.context: The token Polish is split into marked pieces and occurs in country- or sports-related noun phrases.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in the place name Skopje
patterns.context: The place name Skopje occurs in narratives about a player’s team and season; activation falls on a split subword fragment.

patterns.name: Local fragments in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Occur respectively within a coagulation protein name and an immune cell phenotype marker, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Other within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur within proper names, protein or virus names, or other word fragments; contexts differ and cannot be grouped under a consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Fragments span biographies, sports honors, track-and-field classifications, and spatial tree algorithms; activation is scattered and cannot be sufficiently explained by the patterns above.

11_849.concept: 英文转折与并列标记及零散词片段
11_849.description: 激活主要落在 but/not only…but also 等转折、并列结构，也出现在 not 开头的回应或保留表达；另有 Polish、Skopje 及多种生物医学和专名词内片段，缺少一致语义规律。

patterns.name: 转折后的回答/不确定表达
patterns.trigger: not« answer»…« your»…« question»…« completely»；not« sure»
patterns.context: 否定词 not 后接回应、确信程度或判断；通常是让步或保留语气。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: not only« … but also …»；“not« only» … «but also»”
patterns.context: 在否定式或强调式并列中，扩展同一论断的对象或方面。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 英文 but 转折/对照
patterns.context: but 引入与前文形成转折、对照或补充的从句/短语；未必出现 not only。

patterns.name: 波兰相关词项
patterns.context: 词项 Polish 被拆分标记，出现在国家/体育相关名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育与人物条目

patterns.name: 地名 Skopje 的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在球员效力球队及赛季叙述中的地名 Skopje；激活落在拆分后的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 维基百科足球人物条目

patterns.name: 生物医学词项局部片段
patterns.context: 分别位于凝血蛋白名称和免疫细胞表型标记中，未显示稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 其他词内子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、蛋白/病毒名称或词内片段中，语境不同，无法归为一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: 未见明确共享触发模式
patterns.trigger: «op»、«je» 等词内片段以及零散功能词标记
patterns.context: 片段涵盖人物传记、体育荣誉、田径分类及空间树算法；激活位置分散，不能由上述模式充分解释。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、专利技术文本

en.concept: Contrast and progression structures introduced by negation
en.description: Primarily responds to progressive parallelism introduced by negative forms such as not only…but also. It also occurs in reformulations after negation, exclusions defining the scope of a review, and incomplete responses in Q&A. Activation often spans the negator, parallel markers, and related predicates.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: In contrastive or progressive parallelism, activation spans not, only, and subsequent elements, often strongest near a comma; the construction may extend over a long distance.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic papers, patents, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Contrast or reformulation after negation
patterns.context: First rejects one interpretation, then introduces an alternative explanation with rather; activation is concentrated near the negation and causal explanation.

patterns.name: Negative scope limitation
patterns.context: A review states that a category of entities is outside the scope of discussion; activation falls on words such as is, the, not, and discussed.

patterns.name: Hedging in Q&A responses
patterns.context: A respondent acknowledges that the reply may not fully resolve the question while offering help; activation is concentrated on answer, question, and completely.

11_849.concept: 否定引出的对比与递进结构
11_849.description: 主要响应 not only…but also 这类否定形式引出的递进并列，也见于否定后改述、综述范围排除及问答中的不完全回应。激活常分布在否定词、并列标记和相关谓语上。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only” / “not only that” 与后续 “but also”
patterns.context: 在对比或递进并列中，激活分布于 not、only 及其后续成分，常在逗号附近较强；结构可跨较长距离延续。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、议会文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 否定后的对照或改述
patterns.context: 先否定某种解释，再以 rather 引出替代解释；激活集中于否定及因果说明附近。

patterns.name: 否定性的范围限定
patterns.context: 在综述中说明某类对象不在讨论范围内，激活落在 is、the、not、discussed 等词上。

patterns.name: 问答回应中的缓和表达
patterns.context: 回答者承认回复可能不完全解决提问，同时提供帮助；激活集中于 answer、question、completely。

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on intra-sentence commas, especially commas in progressive, contrastive, and adversative structures with not only…but also, but, or rather. A few exceptions include negated search statements and mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Comma in concessive or progressive structures
patterns.context: A comma occurs in contrastive, progressive, or corrective structures such as not only…but also, rather than, and not … but, or before an interrupting contrast within a sentence.
patterns.domain: General written language, medical and academic writing, online comments

patterns.name: Progressive expression with “not only”
patterns.context: The negator not and only form “not only,” often followed by but also to introduce additional information; activation also falls on the associated comma.
patterns.domain: Academic, medical, and general explanatory writing

patterns.name: Comma introducing contrast or correction
patterns.context: After a comma, rather it or but introduces a contrast or correction to a preceding explanation or judgment.

patterns.name: Intra-sentence comma and contrastive addition
patterns.context: A comma separates elements in a list or comparison, followed by but not to restrict the contrasting item.

patterns.name: Comma introducing supplementary information
patterns.context: But also after a comma adds parallel information; not only need not occur earlier.

patterns.name: Passive expression of negative search results
patterns.context: Describes literature or records not being retrieved by a database, ending with searches; activation falls on searches.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A polynomial expression in a derivatives problem; activation falls near numbers and the minus sign, unlike the syntactic punctuation pattern in other examples.

patterns.name: Other weakly associated punctuation positions
patterns.context: A comma occurs near an in-sentence list or clause, but the excerpts are insufficient to determine a more specific structure.

11_849.concept: 句中逗号及对照递进结构
11_849.description: 主要激活于句中逗号，尤其是 not only…but also、but 或 rather 等递进、对照和转折结构中的逗号；另有检索否定句、数学表达式等少数异例。

patterns.name: 让步或递进结构中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号出现在 not only…but also、rather than、not … but 等对照、递进或纠正结构中，或位于句中插入性转折前。
patterns.domain: 一般书面语、医学与学术写作、网络评论

patterns.name: “not only”递进表达
patterns.context: 否定词 not 与 only 构成“not only”，常接 but also 引出补充信息；激活点也落在相关逗号上。
patterns.domain: 学术、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 逗号连接转折或纠正
patterns.context: 逗号后用 rather it、but 等引出对前述解释或判断的转折、修正。

patterns.name: 句中逗号与对比补充
patterns.context: 在列举或比较中用逗号分隔成分，随后以 but not 限定对照项。

patterns.name: 逗号引出补充说明
patterns.context: 逗号后以 but also 补充并列信息；前面不一定出现 not only。

patterns.name: 否定检索结果的被动表达
patterns.context: 描述文献或记录未被数据库检索到，句末以 searches 收束；激活落在 searches。
patterns.domain: 系统综述、学术方法描述

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 导数题中的多项式表达式，激活落在数字和减号附近，与其他样例的句法标点模式不同。

patterns.name: 其他弱关联的标点位置
patterns.context: 逗号出现在句中列举或从句附近，但样例片段不足以确定更具体的结构。

en.concept: Progressive parallel expressions and discourse connectors
en.description: Primarily responds to progressive parallelism with “not only…but also,” with activation near its connectors or parallel content. It also responds to Q&A words, self-deprecating identity statements, and a few evaluative or colloquial words.

patterns.name: “not only … but also” parallel construction
patterns.context: Adds a progressive element to two parallel constituents in expressions such as “not only X but also Y”; activation may fall on only, but, also, or adjacent words.

patterns.name: Complete answers or questions
patterns.context: Answers a question or asks one in a Q&A context; may also involve self-deprecating claims that a question is stupid.

patterns.name: Negative self-positioning
patterns.context: A speaker denies being a fan or expert in a field, often to lower expectations about their stance or credentials.

patterns.name: Controversial or astonishing evaluation
patterns.context: Describes reactions of strong surprise or anger caused by a revelation, news, or similar event.

patterns.name: Colloquial contrast and closing expressions
patterns.context: In colloquial discussion, refers back to prior content, signals contrast, strengthens negation, or summarizes similar matters with “and such”; trigger words are scattered, with no unified construction apparent.

11_849.concept: 递进并列表达及话语连接
11_849.description: 主要响应“not only…but also”递进并列结构，且激活可落在其连接词或并列内容附近；另对问答词、自我否定式身份表述及少数评价、口语词有反应。

patterns.name: “not only … but also”并列结构
patterns.trigger: «not» / «only» 与后续 «but»，或同一结构中的并列结果词
patterns.context: 在“not only X but also Y”一类表达中，对两个并列成分作递进补充；激活可落在 only、but、also 或相邻词上。

patterns.name: 完整回答或问题
patterns.context: 回答提问，或在问答语境中提出问题；也可能涉及对问题是否愚蠢的自谦说法。

patterns.name: 否定式自我立场
patterns.context: 说话者否认自己是某领域的爱好者或专家，常用于降低立场或资历预期。

patterns.name: 争议或惊人评价
patterns.context: 描述揭露、消息等造成强烈惊讶或愤怒的反应。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、流行文化讨论

patterns.name: 口语转折与收束表达
patterns.context: 在口语讨论中指代前文、转折、加强否定或以“and such”概括同类事项；此处触发词分散，未见统一句式。

en.description: The most concentrated pattern is parallelism, progression, or scope expansion introduced by not only, often co-occurring with but, also, more importantly, and commas. There are also ordinary but contrasts, domain-specific terms, Q&A additions, and isolated collocations; it is unclear whether all are triggered by the same mechanism.
