patterns.name: “not only…but (also)” construction
patterns.context: After the negative qualifier not only, lists parallel, progressive, or expanded properties, entities, or scope; activation often falls on subsequent content, punctuation, and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Common argumentative constructions in academic papers, research abstracts, and online comments

patterns.name: Supplementary or contrastive connectors
patterns.context: After a concession, negation, or contrast, but introduces additional information, an opposing result, or further explanation; some examples do not contain not only.
patterns.domain: Q&A, research abstracts, and academic text

patterns.name: Emphatic progressive expression
patterns.context: After a similarity or argument has been established, the phrase marks a more important addition; observed in only one passage.

patterns.name: Comma before parallel content
patterns.context: A comma marks a syntactic boundary in a contrast, parenthetical, or list; this token is marked in several passages, but an isolated comma does not establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Q&A addition after but
patterns.context: A respondent acknowledges that the answer is incomplete, then offers a helpful starting point; distinct from the contrastive use in scientific text.

patterns.name: Biomedical abbreviations and alphanumeric combinations
patterns.context: A mouse strain name occurs next to a species name; activation may target a split abbreviation token or collocation, but the specific mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: Adverbial phrase indicating degree
patterns.context: Describes how a model responds to drug intervention; lacks a clear not only/but construction and is an isolated example.

patterns.name: Words expressing surprise and emotion
patterns.context: A but contrast links emotional evaluations of the same thing; activation spans adjectives and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Online book reviews or entertainment discussions

patterns.name: Scientific term and scope qualification
patterns.context: Explains that the degree of tumor vascular leakage varies across tumors of the same type and within a single tumor; aside from the but construction, whether the noun itself triggers activation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Paired listing of medical terms
patterns.context: Lists similarities between disease models and multiple sclerosis, then continues with a progression using but more importantly; evidence that the terms themselves independently trigger activation is limited.

patterns.name: Parallel treatment conditions
patterns.context: Compares two arginine treatments and uses but not to explicitly deny the effect of one of them.

patterns.name: Evaluation of an article and its insights
patterns.context: A commenter says that a passage from an article was very insightful to them and anticipates that readers may disagree; no not only construction is present, and the trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Parallel dietary restrictions
patterns.context: Clinical text describes whether guidance to restrict fluids or sodium is accepted; this recurs without an obvious but/not only construction.

11_849.concept: 递进对照与补充表达
11_849.description: 最集中模式是 not only 引出的并列、递进或范围扩展，常与 but、also、more importantly 和逗号共现。另有普通 but 对照，以及若干领域术语、问答补充和孤立搭配，无法确认均由同一机制触发。

patterns.name: “not only…but (also)”结构
patterns.trigger: “not only”以及其后的对照或递进成分，如 “not only … but also”“not only … but more importantly”“not only among … but even …”
patterns.context: 在否定限定 not only 后列举并列、递进或扩展的性质、对象或范围；激活常落在后续内容、标点及相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研摘要及网络评论中的常见论述句式

patterns.name: 补充或转折连接词
patterns.trigger: “but”及其后续成分，如 “but might give”“but not D-arginine”；另有 “but also”
patterns.context: 前文提出让步、否定或对照，but 引出补充、相反结果或进一步说明；部分例子并不含 not only。
patterns.domain: 问答、科研摘要与学术文本

patterns.name: 强调性递进表达
patterns.context: 在已有相似性或论据之后，以该短语标出更重要的补充；只见于一段。

patterns.name: 并列内容前的逗号
patterns.trigger: “,”，包括 “but … ,”以及复杂并列结构中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号处于对照、插入或列举的句法边界；多段中该 token 被标记，但孤立逗号不足以确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: but 后的问答补充
patterns.trigger: “but might give you a head start”
patterns.context: 回答者承认回答不完全，再提供有帮助的起点；区别于科学文本中的对照用法。

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写及字母数字组合
patterns.context: 小鼠品系名称与物种名相邻；激活可能针对拆分后的缩写 token 或搭配，具体机制不明。

patterns.name: 限定程度的副词短语
patterns.context: 描述模型对药物干预的反应方式；没有明确的 not only/but 结构，属于孤例。

patterns.name: 惊讶与情绪评价词
patterns.context: 以 but 转折连接对同一事物的情绪评价；激活跨越形容词和标点。

patterns.name: 科学名词及限定范围
patterns.context: 说明肿瘤血管渗漏程度在同类肿瘤之间及同一肿瘤内部存在差异；除 but 结构外，该名词本身是否触发不确定。

patterns.name: 成对列举的医学术语
patterns.context: 列举疾病模型与多发性硬化症的相似之处，并由 but more importantly 继续递进；术语本身的独立触发证据有限。

patterns.name: 并列治疗条件
patterns.context: 比较两种精氨酸处理，并用 but not 明确否定其中一种的效果。

patterns.name: 文章与洞见的评价
patterns.context: 评论者说明某段文章内容对自己很有启发，并预想读者可能不以为然；未见 not only 结构，触发原因不确定。

patterns.name: 饮食限制项目并列
patterns.context: 临床文本描述是否接受限制液体或钠的指导；重复出现，但没有明显的 but/not only 句式。

en.description: Most passages contain a “not only…but also” parallel construction, with activation on parallel constituents or the comma between them. Other instances include commas at citation boundaries and local word activations in comments and Q&A, which are difficult to explain fully with one structure.

patterns.name: not only…but also parallel construction
patterns.context: Explicit “not only X but also Y” parallel or expansion structure; activation may fall on words on the not only side, words on the Y side, or the comma before but, and is not necessarily fixed on the connector itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain argumentative, academic, and commentary writing

patterns.name: Comma and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: A comma occurs at the boundary of parallel constituents or structures such as quotations and parentheses; some instances are near not only…but also, while others are not.

patterns.name: Local complete expressions or words
patterns.context: Activation covers adjacent words or phrases; the given excerpts have no clear not only…but also construction, and comma position does not always explain it.

11_849.concept: 并列与逗号边界
11_849.description: 多数段落含“not only…but also”并列结构，激活位置可落在并列成分或其间逗号；另有引文边界逗号及评论、问答中的局部词语激活，难以由单一结构完全解释。

patterns.name: not only…but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: “not only”及其后续“but also”，常在 but 前的逗号附近出现标记，如 [1] “at« risk»7 … «virus»10”及 [2] “conformational« changes»3 … global« regulation»3«,»10”
patterns.context: 明确的“not only X but also Y”并列或扩展结构；激活可落在 not only 一侧的词、Y 侧的词或 but 前逗号，未必固定在连接词本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论述、学术写作及评论性文字

patterns.name: 逗号及标点边界
patterns.context: 逗号位于并列成分或引文、括号等结构的边界；部分出现处邻近 not only…but also，另一些则不是。
patterns.domain: 学术论文引文格式、评论文字

patterns.name: 局部完整表达或词语
patterns.context: 激活覆盖相邻的词语或短语；给定片段中没有明显的 not only…but also 结构，也不总是由逗号解释。

en.description: Activation is mainly concentrated on commas before the contrastive conjunction but and words in contrastive parallel structures such as not only … but also. A few activations fall on local words such as success, strange, and it, possibly influenced by nearby contrastive structures.

patterns.name: But in concession or contrast
patterns.context: But follows a comma and connects a contrast, concession, or addition; sometimes but is adjacent to a marked full word such as «it» or «either», which may also belong to this local structure.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, news, forums, scientific text

patterns.name: not only … but also parallel construction
patterns.context: Occurs in a not only … but also construction; the marker falls on content words after not only or on adjacent parallel constituents, including word forms spanning multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, parliamentary texts, online comments

patterns.name: Positive outcome and success
patterns.context: When discussing a colony’s appeal to settlers and its results, success occurs in the contrastive construction not alone … but likewise.

patterns.name: Strong evaluative word
patterns.context: In a personal account of the sound and feel of a golf club hitting the ball, but introduces an observation contrary to expectations or the norm.
patterns.domain: Sports equipment or personal experience reviews

patterns.name: It in a preference or choice
patterns.context: A luxury or expensive item is introduced, then but is used to explain that the speaker would not choose it.

patterns.name: But after a dash
patterns.context: After an inserted clarification following a dash, but introduces another option or contrast.

11_849.concept: 转折与对照结构
11_849.description: 激活主要集中于转折连词 but 前的逗号，以及 not only … but also 等对照并列结构中的词；少数激活落在 success、strange、it 等局部词上，可能受邻近转折结构影响。

patterns.name: 让步或对照中的 but
patterns.context: 逗号后接 but，连接前后对照、让步或补充转折；有时 but 紧邻标记的完整词，如 «it»、«either»，也可能属于这一局部结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、新闻、论坛、科学文本

patterns.name: not only … but also 并列结构
patterns.context: 处于 not only … but also 结构中，标记落在 not only 后的内容词，或相邻并列成分；包含跨词、跨 token 的词形。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、议会文本、网络评论

patterns.name: 正面结果与成功
patterns.context: 谈论殖民地吸引定居者及其结果时，success 出现在 not alone … but likewise 的对照结构中。

patterns.name: 强烈评价词
patterns.context: 球杆击球的声音和手感的个人体验中，but 引出与预期或常态相反的观察。
patterns.domain: 体育器材或个人体验评论

patterns.name: 偏好或选择中的 it
patterns.context: 先提出奢侈品或高价商品，再以 but 转折说明个人不会选择它。

patterns.name: 破折号后的 but
patterns.context: 破折号插入补充说明后，由 but 引出另一种选择或对照。

en.concept: Contrast and supplementary connection with but
en.description: Activation most often occurs in contrastive, concessive, or supplementary structures with but and nearby punctuation; not only…but also is a prominent subtype. A few markers fall on local words or subwords, and it is unclear whether they have the same cause.

patterns.name: Contrast or addition after but
patterns.context: A concession, negation, or incomplete judgment precedes but, which introduces a contrast, restriction, or addition; sometimes activation falls on a word near but.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, news, and general argumentation

patterns.name: but also parallel construction
patterns.context: After stating a result, reason, or property, uses but also to add another item; activation is distributed over but and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, commentary, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Inter-sentence connection with comma followed by but
patterns.context: But follows a comma to introduce a contrast, supplementary restriction, or new clause; activation often falls on the punctuation and near but.

patterns.name: Local lexical or segmentation trigger
patterns.context: Some activations fall on words or subwords not directly adjacent to a but construction, possibly influenced by tokenization, syntactic position, or other local features; these examples do not establish a stable condition.

11_849.concept: but 转折与补充连接
11_849.description: 激活最常出现在 but 转折、让步或补充结构及其邻近标点；not only…but also 是突出子型。少数标记落在局部词汇或子词上，不能确定是否同因。

patterns.name: but 后的转折或补充
patterns.trigger: « but»（如 [2] 的 «it» 后接 «but»、[6] 的 «strange» 后接 but、[10] 的 «completely» 后接 but）
patterns.context: 在 but 前出现让步、否定或不完整判断，but 引出对照、限制或补充；有时激活落在 but 邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、新闻与一般论述

patterns.name: but also 并列结构
patterns.trigger: « but» 后接 «also»，与前文 not only 或 only 构成并列
patterns.context: 先陈述一项结果、理由或性质，再用 but also 添加另一项；激活分布在 but 及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、评论及一般说明文

patterns.name: 逗号后 but 的句间衔接
patterns.context: 逗号后由 but 引出反差、补充限制或新的分句；激活常落在标点及 but 附近。

patterns.name: 局部词汇或切分触发
patterns.context: 个别激活落在与 but 结构不直接相邻的词或子词上，可能受分词、句法位置或其他局部特征影响；无法从这些例子确定稳定条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、新闻、学术文献

en.description: Strongly responds to StackExchange questions beginning with Q: followed by a newline, and favors contexts about beginners, new versions, or new projects containing new; it also covers various programming question phrasings and code topics. One passage is an encyclopedia biography, unlike the main format.

patterns.name: StackExchange question opening
patterns.context: Begins with Q: and a blank line, followed by a question title, as commonly seen in StackExchange posts; this format appears in most samples.

patterns.name: Beginner or new-thing phrasing
patterns.context: Technical questions about being a beginner, a new version, a new project, or a newly created object; «new» has strong activation in several passages.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia biographical narrative
patterns.context: A coherent third-person biographical account mentioning a sales career, professional achievements, and career subsections; not in Q&A format.

patterns.name: Programming titles and code content
patterns.context: The question title or body contains a specific language, framework, API, test, or code; sample topics differ but all concern technical help.

patterns.name: Help-seeking tone and question phrasing
patterns.context: Asks about procedures or causes using questions, or states beginner status or apologizes in the body; not all questions use this phrasing.

11_971.concept: 技术问答中的新手提问
11_971.description: 强烈响应 StackExchange 的 Q: 换行式问题开头，并偏好含 new 的新手、新版本或新项目语境；也覆盖多种编程问题措辞与代码主题。另有一段百科人物传记，和主要格式不同。

patterns.name: StackExchange 问题开头
patterns.context: 以 Q: 和空行开头，后接问题标题，常见于 StackExchange 帖子；该格式出现在大多数样本中。

patterns.name: 新手或新事物表述
patterns.trigger: «new»，以及 «I am new to»、«new Python version»、«new project»
patterns.context: 围绕新手身份、新版本、新项目或新建对象的技术提问；«new» 在多段中激活较强。

patterns.name: 百科人物传记叙述
patterns.context: 连贯的第三人称生平介绍，提及销售职业、事业成就和生涯小节；不属于问答格式。

patterns.name: 编程标题与代码内容
patterns.context: 问题标题或正文包含具体语言、框架、API、测试或代码；样本主题彼此不同，但都属于技术求助。

patterns.name: 求助语气与提问措辞
patterns.context: 以疑问句提出操作或原因问题，或在正文中声明新手身份、表达歉意；并非所有问题都有这些措辞。

en.description: All passages contain highly activated «of»; in addition, words such as documentation, Similar, may, and asking also activate strongly in a few passages, with no shared condition yet explaining this.

patterns.name: 8 after of
patterns.context: The preposition of connects neighboring constituents in a noun phrase or sentence; the content on either side varies.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including PubMed, NIH, patents, and email

patterns.name: Other highly activated function words
patterns.context: Words other than of also activate strongly in a few passages; no consistent syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Other localized word activations
patterns.context: These words or characters activate in their respective contexts, but no shared semantic or structural feature is apparent.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, email, patent backgrounds, PubMed

11_971.description: 所有段均含高激活的 «of»；此外，少数段中的 documentation、Similar、may、asking 等词也强激活，尚无共同条件可解释。

patterns.name: of 后的 8
patterns.context: 介词 of 在名词短语或句子中连接前后成分；前后内容不固定。

patterns.name: 其他高激活功能词
patterns.context: 在少数段中，非 of 的词也出现强激活；没有明显一致的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、邮件

patterns.name: 其他局部词语激活
patterns.context: 这些词或字符在各自上下文中激活，但未见共同语义或结构特征。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、邮件、专利背景、PubMed

en.description: Activation falls mainly on the English word new, replication in life-science contexts, and of in mathematical problem phrases; the first two categories recur across passages, while the mathematical category appears in only two passages, making it difficult to determine whether they share a mechanism.

patterns.name: New/innovation topic word new
patterns.context: Activation centers on new, with surrounding mentions of materials and treatment directions, streetcars, and genetic technology; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, entertainment text, technical introductions

patterns.name: Replication-related word replication
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical contexts, referring to DNA, viruses, or cell replication; the word itself is strongly activated in each case.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research project descriptions

patterns.name: of in mathematical text
patterns.context: Appears in phrases in mathematical expressions or problem text, near numbers, powers, or decimals; the trigger mechanism relative to other patterns is unclear.

11_971.description: 激活主要落在英文 new、生命科学语境中的 replication，以及数学题短语中的 of；前两类跨段重复明显，数学类仅见两段，难以确定是否同一机制。

patterns.name: 新／创新主题词 new
patterns.trigger: «new»（第1段另有«directions»，第2段有«a new»，第7段有«A new»）
patterns.context: 激活集中在 new，周围提到材料与治疗方向、街车、遗传技术；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、娱乐文本、技术介绍

patterns.name: 复制相关词 replication
patterns.trigger: «replication»，常见搭配为«DNA replication»、«HIV replication»、«cell replication»、«viral replication»
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学语境中，指 DNA、病毒或细胞的复制；该词本身均有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与研究项目描述

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 of
patterns.trigger: «of»（第9段为«ple»8« of»5« d»；第10段为«power»3« of»5）
patterns.context: 出现在数学表达或题目文字的短语中，邻近数字、幂或小数；触发机制与其他模式不明。

en.description: Responds to LaTeX formulas, symbols, and formulaic statements in mathematical and mathematical physics corpora, covering measure theory, number theory, particle physics, electromagnetism, vectors, Galois theory, and harmonic analysis; many passages also exhibit paper-abstract or mathematical Q&A genres.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and LaTeX formulas
patterns.context: Primarily in mathematical or physics texts, activation centers on symbols, commands, and some formula punctuation; specific topics vary considerably across passages.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and physics paper abstracts and Q&A

patterns.name: Measure and measurability
patterns.context: Occurs when measure spaces, measurable functions, or measure-related objects appear; passage 1 discusses measurability relative to a generated sigma algebra, and passage 2 concerns metric measure spaces.

patterns.name: Introductory phrasing in mathematical abstracts
patterns.context: Statements in abstracts introducing new objects, theories, or research; not all abstract passages clearly exhibit the same phrasing.

patterns.name: Crystal fields and rotational invariants
patterns.context: A physics research context discussing crystal field strength and alternative measures of it.

patterns.name: Number-theoretic function and Carmichael function
patterns.context: Defines a function and describes it through its multiplicativity and values on prime powers.

patterns.name: Neutrino oscillation
patterns.context: Introduces neutrino generation mixing and the probability of one type changing into another.

patterns.name: Relative motion and charge density
patterns.context: Describes moving objects, directions, and a charged rod in different reference frames.

patterns.name: Variable ranges and inequalities
patterns.context: Introduces real variables and constrains their values with formulaic inequalities; the specific physical meaning is incomplete in the fragment.

patterns.name: Vector angle construction problem
patterns.context: A Q&A problem asks for constructing vectors with a given angle.

patterns.name: Algebraic numbers and Galois problem
patterns.context: A StackExchange question and follow-up definition construct an algebraic number using recursive square roots and ask about its Galois properties.

patterns.name: Harmonic functions and half-space
patterns.context: A paper abstract proposes studying a class of harmonic functions on the positive half-space.
patterns.domain: Partial differential equations or harmonic analysis

11_971.description: 对数学与数学物理语料中的 LaTeX 公式、符号和公式化陈述有反应，涉及测度、数论、粒子物理、电磁学、向量、伽罗瓦理论及调和分析；多段还呈现论文摘要或数学问答体裁。

patterns.name: 数学符号与 LaTeX 公式
patterns.context: 主要在数学或物理文本中，激活集中于公式中的符号、命令及部分公式标点；各段具体主题差异很大。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理学论文摘要与问答

patterns.name: 测度与可测性
patterns.context: 出现测度空间、可测函数或测度相关对象时；段1讨论相对于生成的 sigma 代数的可测性，段2涉及度量测度空间。

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要的介绍句式
patterns.trigger: 「A new measure」「is defined」「We apply this theory」「In this paper, we consider」
patterns.context: 论文摘要中介绍新对象、理论或研究内容的陈述句；不是所有摘要段都明显呈现同一句式。

patterns.name: 晶体场与旋转不变量
patterns.context: 讨论晶体场强度及其替代度量的物理研究语境。

patterns.name: 数论函数与 Carmichael 函数
patterns.context: 定义一种函数，并用其乘性与在素数幂上的取值描述。

patterns.name: 中微子振荡
patterns.context: 介绍中微子代际混合及一种类型转变为另一类型的概率。

patterns.name: 相对运动与电荷密度
patterns.context: 在不同参考系中描述运动物体、方向及带电杆。
patterns.domain: 电磁学或狭义相对论问答

patterns.name: 变量范围与不等式
patterns.context: 给出实变量并以公式不等式限定其取值；具体物理含义在片段中不完整。

patterns.name: 向量夹角构造问题
patterns.context: 问答题要求构造具有给定夹角的向量。

patterns.name: 代数数与伽罗瓦问题
patterns.context: StackExchange 提问及后续定义，用递归平方根构造代数数并询问伽罗瓦性质。

patterns.name: 调和函数与半空间
patterns.context: 论文摘要中提出在正半空间上研究某类调和函数。
patterns.domain: 偏微分方程或调和分析

en.description: Primarily responds to period punctuation, especially sentence-final periods in medical abstracts; also covers periods in software names, website domains, journal abbreviations, and near citations. Triggers depend on surrounding punctuation formatting and occur across genres.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation after decimal points in medical abstracts
patterns.context: In medical abstract titles or body text, a period is followed immediately by a newline or a new sentence; it often appears next to technical terms or titles.

patterns.name: Modelica namespace separator
patterns.context: A period separates software library, module, or type names, such as “Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Frames.Quaternions”.

patterns.name: Volume and page-number punctuation in citations
patterns.context: A period appears in journal abbreviations and bibliographic information such as volume and page numbers, e.g., “J. Clin. Invest., Vol. 79, pp. 15...”.

patterns.name: Website domain separator
patterns.context: A period separates subdomains and domains in URLs, such as “phdcn.harvard.edu” and “nimh.nih.gov”.

patterns.name: Periods in decimals or numerical expressions
patterns.context: A period occurs in abbreviations or number-related expressions, such as “e.g.” and near numbers in journal citations; the exact trigger location may depend on tokenization.
patterns.domain: NIH project text and patent citations

patterns.name: Period inside reference markers
patterns.context: A period occurs near a bracketed citation marker, surrounded by reference number ranges.

11_971.description: 主要响应句点标点，尤其医学摘要的句末句点；也覆盖软件命名、网址域名、期刊缩写及引文附近的句点。触发受标点周边格式影响，跨文体出现。

patterns.name: 医学论文摘要中的小数点后句末标点
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题或正文中，句号后紧接换行或新句；常与专业词、标题相邻。

patterns.name: Modelica 命名空间分隔符
patterns.context: 句点用于分隔软件库、模块或类型名称，如“Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody.Frames.Quaternions”。

patterns.name: 文献引文中的卷页数字标点
patterns.context: 句点出现在期刊缩写及卷、页等书目信息中，如“J. Clin. Invest., Vol. 79, pp. 15...”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的参考文献

patterns.name: 网址域名分隔符
patterns.context: 句点分隔网址中的子域名和域名，如“phdcn.harvard.edu”“nimh.nih.gov”。

patterns.name: 小数或数值表达式中的句点
patterns.context: 句点出现在缩写或数值相关表达中，例如“e.g.”以及期刊引文数字附近；具体触发位置可能受分词影响。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本及专利引文

patterns.name: 参考文献标记内部的句点
patterns.context: 句点位于方括号引文标记附近，周围是参考文献编号范围。

en.description: All passages are mathematical technical text, with activation centered on LaTeX formulas and their structured symbols; topics span analysis, algebra, topology, set theory, and statistics, alongside mathematical discussion and Q&A in formula contexts.

patterns.name: Measure, metric, and function-space symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical papers discuss completeness, metric measure spaces, function spaces, or local $L^2$ solutions; activation often falls on multiple tokens in mathematical symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, functional analysis, and related StackExchange/ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Structural objects in algebra and topology
patterns.context: Algebra, topology, or logic papers introduce abstract structures, functors, or algebraic objects, often with $\mathcal{}$, superscripts, and subscripts
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry, set theory, homological algebra, topology

patterns.name: Formula fragments with parameters and subscripts
patterns.context: Formulas contain parameterized operators, subscripts, and equalities; the surrounding text is mathematical derivation, but the passage is insufficient to determine the specific topic

patterns.name: Likelihood function and probability question
patterns.context: A StackExchange question asks how to specify a probability function and gives a likelihood definition

patterns.name: Set cardinality and counterexample argument
patterns.context: Calculates cardinality for a singleton case and shows a proposition is false; a specific counterexample or boundary-case argument

patterns.name: Complex LaTeX notation in mathematical text
patterns.context: Activation covers letters, parentheses, superscripts, subscripts, and command-split tokens inside formulas; it occurs across different mathematical topics and may reflect formula-dense typesetting

11_971.description: 所有段落均为数学技术文本，激活集中在 LaTeX 公式及其结构化符号；主题横跨分析、代数、拓扑、集合论和统计，另有公式上下文中的数学论述与问答。

patterns.name: 测度、度量与函数空间符号
patterns.trigger: “metric space”、“metric measure spaces”及“$L^2$”，并伴随“$(X,d)$”“$(\mathcal M,d,\mu)$”等符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中讨论完备性、度量测度空间、函数空间或局部 $L^2$ 解；激活常落在数学符号的多个 token 上
patterns.domain: 数学分析、泛函分析及相关 StackExchange/ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 代数与拓扑中的结构对象
patterns.context: 代数、拓扑或逻辑论文中引入抽象结构、函子或代数对象，常有 $\mathcal{}$、上标及下标记号
patterns.domain: 代数几何、集合论、同调代数、拓扑

patterns.name: 含参数与下标的公式片段
patterns.context: 公式中出现参数化算子、下标和等式；周围是数学推导，但该段不足以判定具体主题
patterns.domain: 数学论文，具体子领域不明

patterns.name: 似然函数与概率提问
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中询问如何设定概率函数，并给出似然定义

patterns.name: 集合基数与反例论证
patterns.trigger: “exactly one element”、“$|X^{\mathbb N}|$”及“not true”，并提到“proper subset”
patterns.context: 通过单元素情形计算基数，指出命题不成立；是具体的反例或边界情形论证

patterns.name: 数学文本中的复杂 LaTeX 记号
patterns.context: 激活覆盖公式内部的字母、括号、上下标及命令拆分 token；跨不同数学主题出现，可能反映公式密集的排版特征

en.description: Primarily responds to abbreviations, numbering, punctuation, and litigation terminology in U.S. court opinions and regulatory citations; it also responds to substituent definitions in patent chemistry, formulas and results in mathematical papers, and document fields such as judgment dates.

patterns.name: Legal abbreviations and numbering in regulatory citations
patterns.context: In U.S. statute or regulation citations, activation is distributed across numbers, letter abbreviations, punctuation, and section numbers; often appears in sentences arguing for regulatory standards or citing authority.

patterns.name: Fixed legal terminology in court documents
patterns.context: In judicial review, administrative adjudication, or disability-benefit disputes, litigation role terms and evidentiary review terms appear in legal arguments or procedural descriptions.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in court opinions and litigation documents
patterns.context: Near the opinion body, citations, volume/page identifiers, panel information, or attorney appearance records; activation involves punctuation, line breaks, and document fields.

patterns.name: Variables and substituents in patent chemical definitions
patterns.context: Defines compound substituents using numbered R variables and lists options such as hydrogen, lower alkyl, or aryl.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and chemical patent text

patterns.name: Results and estimates in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Mathematical research papers state main results, optimal bounds, or function estimates, and include mathematical fonts and formula symbols.

patterns.name: Court opinions and judgment dates
patterns.context: Case document metadata records the filing date of an opinion; surrounding text may also include court district and attorney information.

11_971.description: 主要响应美国法律判决及法规引文中的缩写、编号、标点和诉讼术语；也响应专利化学取代基定义、数学论文公式与结果表述，以及判决日期等文书字段。

patterns.name: 法规引用中的法律缩写与编号
patterns.context: 美国法规或规章引文中，激活分布在数字、字母缩写、标点及章节编号上；常出现在论证法规标准或引用依据的句子里。

patterns.name: 判决文书中的固定法律术语
patterns.context: 司法审查、行政裁决或残障福利争议中，诉讼角色称谓与证据审查术语出现在法律论证或程序描述里。

patterns.name: 判决及诉讼文书的格式标记
patterns.context: 判决正文、引证、卷页标识、分庭信息或律师出庭记录附近；激活涉及标点、换行及文书字段。

patterns.name: 专利化学定义中的变量与取代基
patterns.context: 以 R 编号变量定义化合物取代基，列举氢、低级烷基或芳基等可选项。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与化学专利文本

patterns.name: 数学论文的结果与估计表述
patterns.context: 数学研究论文陈述主要结果、最优界或函数估计，并出现数学字体及公式符号。

patterns.name: 法院意见与判决日期
patterns.context: 案件文书元数据中记录意见书的提交日期，周边还可能包含法院分区与律师信息。

en.description: Activation often falls on abbreviations segmented unusually in medical and sports text (especially MT and WC), as well as metrics and units, and also appears in numerical formats; there are also subword segmentations in tread-mill and Earth-quake.

patterns.name: Letter combination MT in abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on professional abbreviation fragments beginning with M and T; subsequent letters vary by field.

patterns.name: Abbreviations ending in WC
patterns.context: In body-measurement or abdominal-obesity contexts, especially labeling waist circumference abbreviations.

patterns.name: Other alphanumeric professional abbreviations
patterns.context: Medical text contains abbreviations for metrics, outcomes, time points, or physiological variables; activation often falls inside or at the boundary of the abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, physiology, and medical research papers

patterns.name: Numerical and unit expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, statistics, or concentration units appear densely, especially alongside medical measurement results.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of exercise equipment terms
patterns.context: A word is split into subwords and refers to exercise equipment or an exercise intervention.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation in an earthquake nickname
patterns.context: An English compound in a name or nickname is split; this does not clearly match the professional abbreviation pattern.

patterns.name: Range and measurement formats
patterns.context: Gives a survival-time range and follow-up duration using square brackets or adjacent time units.

11_971.description: 激活多落在医学与运动文本中被特殊切分的缩写（尤其 MT、WC）、指标及单位，也见数值格式；另有 tread-mill 和 Earth-quake 的子词切分。

patterns.name: 缩写中的字母组合 MT
patterns.context: 激活标记落在由 M、T 开头的专业缩写片段；其后续字母因领域而异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学缩写及体育缩写

patterns.name: 以 WC 结尾的缩写
patterns.context: 身体测量或腹部肥胖语境中，尤其是 waist circumference 的缩写标注。
patterns.domain: 医学、营养学和流行病学论文

patterns.name: 其他字母数字型专业缩写
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现测量指标、结局、时间点或生理变量的缩写；激活位置常在缩写内部或边界。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、生理学和医学研究论文

patterns.name: 数值及单位表达
patterns.context: 数值、统计量或浓度单位密集出现，尤其与医学测量结果并列时。

patterns.name: 运动训练器材词的子词切分
patterns.context: 词语被切成子词，且指向训练器材或运动干预。

patterns.name: 地震绰号中的子词切分
patterns.context: 人名或绰号中的英文复合词被拆分；与专业缩写模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 范围和计量格式
patterns.context: 以方括号或邻近时间单位给出生存时间范围与随访时长。

en.description: Activation often appears in expressions evaluating suitability, comfort, effectiveness, or enjoyment, and also in advertising calls to action, medical measurements, legal time formats, and health advice; these sporadic patterns cannot be sufficiently explained by a single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Describing comfort, convenience, or suitability
patterns.context: Describes whether an object, plan, activity, or solution is suitable, easy to use, effective, or enjoyable; common structures use degree or evaluation words to modify a quality, and include evaluative sentences such as “make … more functional” and “is … acceptable”.
patterns.domain: Broad coverage across lifestyle advice, product and activity copy, military training plans, and medical or public health text

patterns.name: Specific quantity or unit expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls near numbers, units, or abbreviations, used respectively for conversational emphasis, medical measurement units, and time markers in legal narratives; no unified local syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Online conversational language, medical abstracts, legal text

patterns.name: Promotional titles and calls to action
patterns.context: A title or advertising-style text uses an imperative, title case, or direct appeal for readers to take action.

patterns.name: Experimental results and threshold descriptions
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report samples, measurements, and thresholds; activation in this passage is scattered near sentence-final punctuation, numbers, and units, making it difficult to group with other patterns.

patterns.name: Time abbreviations in legal narratives
patterns.context: Describes the time law enforcement officers observed and entered a room; activation centers near the time format.

patterns.name: Target dietary patterns in health advice
patterns.context: Summarizes public health advice about dietary goals for lowering cholesterol and coronary heart disease risk; activation falls near goal verbs and diet-related words.

11_971.description: 激活常见于评价适宜性、舒适度、效果或愉悦感的表达，也出现在广告号召、医学测量数值、法律时间格式和健康建议等不同语境；这些零散模式无法由单一稳定触发条件充分解释。

patterns.name: 形容舒适、便利或合适程度
patterns.context: 描述某物、计划、活动或方案是否适合、容易使用、效果好或令人愉快；常见结构是程度或评价词修饰性质，也包括“make … more functional”“is … acceptable”等评价句。
patterns.domain: 生活建议、产品与活动文案、军事训练计划、医学或公共卫生文本；覆盖较广

patterns.name: 特定数量或单位表达
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、单位或缩写附近，分别用于口语强调、医学测量单位和法律叙述中的时间标记；未见统一的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 网络口语、医学摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 宣传式标题与行动号召
patterns.trigger: “Make your camping experience memorable and enjoyable”“Go Get Your Nails Done”
patterns.context: 标题或广告式文本，以祈使句、标题大小写或直接号召读者采取行动。
patterns.domain: 户外用品宣传、生活方式博客

patterns.name: 实验结果及数值阈值叙述
patterns.trigger: “Two-thirds had normal fasting insulin (less than 13 mU/L)”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告样本、测量结果和阈值；本段激活分散在句末标点、数字及单位附近，难以归入其他模式。

patterns.name: 法律叙事中的时间缩写
patterns.context: 描述执法人员观察与进入房间的时间，激活集中在时间格式附近。

patterns.name: 健康建议中的目标饮食模式
patterns.trigger: “to achieve a dietary pattern that is low in saturated fat and cholesterol”
patterns.context: 总结公共卫生建议，谈论降低胆固醇与冠心病风险的饮食目标；激活落在目标动词及饮食模式相关词附近。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或营养学摘要

en.description: Activation often appears in expressions of positive effects, comfort and enjoyment evaluations, and efficiency comparisons, especially near connectors or structural words such as and, is, and to; it also occurs in weight-loss diets, medical technology, product descriptions, and formatting anomalies, and cannot be reduced to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Descriptions of comfortable, enjoyable experiences
patterns.context: In promotional text about lodging, travel, or outdoor experiences, describes an experience as enjoyable, comfortable, or memorable; evaluative words connected by and often occur nearby.

patterns.name: Positive evaluative words in recommendations or effects
patterns.context: Evaluates a state, solution, or procedure in health advice, medical or product descriptions, and parenting experiences; activation often falls on the conjunction and or the degree/evaluative expression that follows it.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent descriptions, health and parenting text

patterns.name: Efficiency or degree comparisons
patterns.context: Describes a relatively faster, easier, more efficient, or larger-quantity result, usually in a comparison or improvement context.
patterns.domain: Product technical descriptions, parenting experiences, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Nutrition and metabolism-related expressions
patterns.context: Discusses dietary goals or weight-loss mechanisms; strong activation occurs on words such as is/to in infinitive structures.

patterns.name: Expressions of existence or necessity
patterns.context: Technical or academic descriptions state a condition, need, or recommendation; trigger locations are inconsistent in this pattern.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, weight-loss advertising

patterns.name: Participle and degree-adverb collocation
patterns.context: Describes facilities or environments as highly comfortable or enjoyable; activation falls on be and very.

patterns.name: Emphasis on experiences in product titles
patterns.context: An outdoor gear promotional title or slogan emphasizes that a camping experience is memorable.

patterns.name: Words in special formats or text structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs in locally formatted material such as split words, all-caps emphasis, or medical parameter units, with no unified semantic context.
patterns.domain: Web text, forum text, medical technical text

11_971.description: 激活常见于正向效果、舒适愉悦评价及效率比较，尤见 and、is、to 等连接或结构词附近；也出现在饮食减重、医疗技术、产品说明和格式异常片段中，不能归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 舒适、愉悦的体验描述
patterns.context: 在住宿、旅游或户外体验的宣传文字中，形容某项体验令人愉快、舒适或难忘；附近常有 and 连接的评价词。

patterns.name: 建议或效果中的正向评价词
patterns.context: 在健康建议、医疗或产品说明以及育儿经验中，评价某种状态、方案或操作；激活常落在连接词 and 或其后的程度／评价表达上。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利说明、健康与育儿文本

patterns.name: 效率或程度比较
patterns.context: 描述相对更快、更容易、更有效率或数量更多的结果，通常处于比较或改善语境。
patterns.domain: 产品技术说明、育儿经验、医学摘要

patterns.name: 营养与代谢相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论饮食目标或减重机制，较强激活出现在不定式结构中的 is/to 一类词。
patterns.domain: 营养学摘要与减重宣传

patterns.name: 存在或必要性表达
patterns.context: 技术或学术说明中陈述某条件、需求或建议；本模式的触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、专利背景、减重宣传

patterns.name: 分词与程度副词搭配
patterns.context: 描述设施或环境达到较高的舒适、愉悦程度，激活落在 be 和 very。

patterns.name: 产品标题中的体验强调
patterns.trigger: «Camping» Gears for Your Next Outdoor Adventure；«Make» your «camping» «experience»10 «memorable»
patterns.context: 户外用品推广标题或广告语，强调露营体验值得回忆。

patterns.name: 特殊格式或文本结构中的词
patterns.context: 激活出现在被切分的词、全大写强调或医学参数单位等局部格式中，缺少统一语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛文本、医学技术文本

en.description: Activations occur in coordinated evaluative words describing attributes or effects, as well as in discussions of healthy diets, clinical treatment evaluations, and medical classification thresholds. Across travel, lifestyle, and medical texts, the overall tendency is toward evaluative or normative descriptions.

patterns.name: Positive attributes of evaluated objects
patterns.context: When describing facilities, products, treatments, or spaces, lists advantages using coordinated adjectives; a common structure is and + evaluative word.
patterns.domain: Travel accommodations, interior design, health products, medicine

patterns.name: Evaluation of healthy diets and effects
patterns.context: Descriptions of diet, nutrition, or health effects involving healthfulness, fat, or cholesterol.

patterns.name: Attributes and suitability of medical interventions
patterns.context: Describes treatment thresholds, drug regimens, or efficacy, safety, and cost in clinical studies.

patterns.name: Statistical classifications and thresholds
patterns.context: Defines populations or diagnostic cutoffs using numbers, units, and comparison symbols.

11_971.description: 激活见于描述对象属性或效果的并列评价词，也见于健康饮食、临床方案评价及医学分类阈值；跨旅游、生活方式和医学文本，整体偏向评价性或规范性描述。

patterns.name: 评价对象的正面属性
patterns.context: 在描述设施、产品、治疗或空间时，用并列形容词列举优点；常见结构为 and + 评价词。
patterns.domain: 旅游住宿、室内设计、健康产品、医学

patterns.name: 健康饮食及效果评价
patterns.context: 饮食、营养或健康效果的描述，涉及健康性、脂肪或胆固醇。

patterns.name: 医学方案的属性与适用性
patterns.context: 临床研究中描述治疗阈值、药物方案或疗效、安全性及成本。

patterns.name: 统计分类与阈值
patterns.context: 以数字、单位和比较符号给出人群定义或诊断界值。

en.description: Activations most consistently occur in medical efficacy evaluations such as “safe and effective.” They also cover spatial comfort and flow, travel experience promotions, and specialized medical descriptions of diabetes trials, obesity thresholds, and prostate anesthesia.

patterns.name: “safe and effective” evaluative collocations
patterns.context: Evaluates treatments, drugs, surgical techniques, or monitoring methods in medical abstracts; related words may be spread across longer sentences

patterns.name: “comfortable” and spatial design
patterns.context: Describes kitchen design and functional spaces; activations cluster around “comfortable” and “has”

patterns.name: Promotion of travel facilities and vacation experiences
patterns.context: Introduces resort facilities, locations, and services for travelers

patterns.name: Diabetes trials and blood glucose measures
patterns.context: Clinical trial titles or abstracts describing target populations, treatment regimens, and HbA1c inclusion ranges

patterns.name: Obesity definitions and BMI thresholds
patterns.context: Defines overweight or obese populations using waist circumference and BMI thresholds

patterns.name: Anesthetic blocks in prostate surgery
patterns.context: Discusses outpatient surgery, minimally invasive treatment, and medical costs for benign prostatic hyperplasia

11_971.description: 激活最一致地出现在“safe and effective”一类医学疗效评价中；此外也覆盖空间舒适与流畅、旅游体验宣传，以及糖尿病试验、肥胖阈值和前列腺麻醉等医学专门表述。

patterns.name: “safe and effective”评价搭配
patterns.trigger: “safe”邻近“and”及“effective”，常见为“safe and effective”或“effective and safe”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中评价治疗、药物、手术技术或监测方法；相关词可能被分散在较长句子中
patterns.domain: 医学论文，主要是 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: “comfortable”与空间设计
patterns.context: 描述厨房设计及功能性空间；激活集中在“comfortable”和“has”

patterns.name: 旅游设施与度假体验宣传
patterns.trigger: “amenities to suit the individual needs”及“promises a relaxing and wonderful visit”
patterns.context: 介绍度假村设施、位置与面向旅客的服务体验

patterns.name: 糖尿病试验与血糖指标
patterns.context: 临床试验标题或摘要，说明目标人群、治疗方案和 HbA1c 纳入范围

patterns.name: 肥胖定义与 BMI 阈值
patterns.context: 按腰围、BMI 阈值界定超重或肥胖人群

patterns.name: 前列腺手术麻醉阻滞
patterns.context: 讨论良性前列腺增生的门诊手术、微创治疗及医疗成本

en.description: Activations occur across medical, public health, forum, and marketing texts, often around continuations of predicates such as is/was/were, comparative structures with more, and adjectives or participles. Other fragments cover BMI cutoffs, drug doses, radiation safety, housing, and travel; no single stable theme is evident.

patterns.name: Continuation of the linking verb is
patterns.context: The trigger is is in a relative clause or attributive structure, followed by an adjective or complement; occurs in dietary advice and descriptions of living conditions.

patterns.name: more in comparative or degree constructions
patterns.context: more is followed by an adjective to express comparison or degree; appears in product promotions and discussions of treatment effects.

patterns.name: be + adjective/participle in medical texts
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describe measurements, patient status, study limitations, efficacy, or dose adjustments; activations are scattered across predicate structures.

patterns.name: BMI and cutoff expressions
patterns.context: Near quantitative definitions of body weight, obesity classifications, and waist circumference cutoffs.

patterns.name: Dietary advice and cardiovascular risk
patterns.context: Discusses blood lipids, coronary heart disease mortality, and promotion of a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol.

patterns.name: Housing choices and living conditions
patterns.context: Discusses finding a place to move that balances schools, a safe neighborhood, commuting, and housing.

patterns.name: Holiday toy shopping promotions
patterns.context: Marketing copy about holiday gifts and choosing toys for children.

patterns.name: Radiation doses and safety standards
patterns.context: Explains dose limits and the ALARA safety principle.

patterns.name: Specific drugs and treatment regimens
patterns.context: Describes drugs, doses, treatment courses, or therapy management guided by plasma concentrations.

patterns.name: Travel accommodation promotions
patterns.context: Highlights the location, facilities, and guest experience of vacation rentals.

patterns.name: Case recurrence and efficacy comparisons
patterns.context: Reports recurrence, compares treatment methods, and notes that further research is needed.

patterns.name: Scattered activation locations, difficult to assign to a thematic pattern
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across a truncated abstract on insulin measurement in diabetes; the fragment does not reveal a more specific shared trigger than predicate/text continuation.

patterns.name: Expressions of general ability or feasibility
patterns.context: Describes a goal or arrangement as achievable under reasonable conditions; specific meanings and domains vary considerably.

11_971.description: 激活分布于医学、公共卫生、论坛和营销文本，常落在 is/was/were 等谓语延续、more 比较结构及形容词或分词附近；另有 BMI 界值、药物剂量、辐射安全、住房与旅游等主题片段，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 关系词 is 的延续
patterns.context: 触发点是关系从句或定语结构中的 is，后接形容词或补语；出现于饮食建议和居住条件描述。

patterns.name: 比较或程度结构中的 more
patterns.context: more 后接形容词，表达比较或程度；分别出现在商品宣传和治疗效果讨论中。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 be + 形容词/分词
patterns.trigger: “was measured” / “had normal” / “is restricted” / “proved to be” / “were adjusted” / “are effective”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述测量、患者状态、研究限制、疗效或剂量调整；激活词分散在谓语结构中。

patterns.name: BMI 与界值表达
patterns.context: 体重、肥胖分类及腰围界值等定量定义附近。

patterns.name: 膳食建议与心血管风险
patterns.context: 讨论血脂、冠心病死亡率及倡导低饱和脂肪和胆固醇饮食。

patterns.name: 居住选择与生活条件
patterns.trigger: “a place to live” / “good schools” / “safe and nice neighborhood” / “commute”
patterns.context: 讨论搬迁时寻找兼顾学校、安全社区、通勤和住房的地点。

patterns.name: 节日玩具购物宣传
patterns.context: 以节日送礼和为孩子挑选玩具为主题的营销文案。

patterns.name: 辐射剂量与安全规范
patterns.trigger: “annual dose limit” / “100 mrem” / “as low as reasonably achievable”
patterns.context: 说明剂量限值及 ALARA 安全原则。
patterns.domain: 职业健康/辐射安全文本

patterns.name: 具体药物及治疗方案
patterns.context: 描述药物、剂量、疗程或血浆浓度指导下的治疗管理。

patterns.name: 旅游住宿宣传
patterns.trigger: “amenities” / “Ideally located” / “promises a relaxing and wonderful visit”
patterns.context: 突出度假屋的地段、设施和旅客体验。

patterns.name: 病例复发与疗效比较
patterns.context: 报告复发情况，比较治疗方法并指出仍需进一步研究。

patterns.name: 激活位置分散，难以归入主题模式
patterns.context: 激活散布在截断的糖尿病胰岛素测量摘要中，无法从片段确定比谓语/文本延续更具体的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 一般能力或可实现性表达
patterns.context: 形容目标或安排在合理条件下可实现；具体语义和领域差异明显。

en.description: Activations span insulin, diabetes, and ferritin measures in medicine; nutrition advice, accommodation promotions, standard legal-decision phrasing, and cost-effectiveness descriptions of anesthesia equipment. They cross domains, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Diet, blood lipids, and coronary heart disease risk
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between dietary patterns, blood cholesterol, and coronary heart disease mortality, and recommends that the public adopt a diet low in saturated fat.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts; nutrition and public health

patterns.name: Diabetes and insulin measures
patterns.context: Reports insulin measurements, insulin/glucose ratios, or HbA1c in studies of diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance; triggers are scattered across the measures and their testing context.

patterns.name: Accommodation facility descriptions in property promotions
patterns.context: Hotel or property descriptions use promotional language for the location, facilities, and lodging experience.

patterns.name: Favorable-viewpoint language in legal review of judgments
patterns.context: In discussing summary judgment, states that courts must view facts, evidence, or inferences in the light most favorable to the nonmovant or opposing party.

patterns.name: Elevated ferritin and transfusion cases
patterns.context: Mentions multiple transfusions and high ferritin levels in the context of sickle cell disease cases.

patterns.name: Cost-effectiveness attributes of anesthesia machines
patterns.context: Emphasizes cost-effectiveness when listing design requirements for portable field anesthesia machines; the same sentence also lists attributes such as safety, light weight, and ease of maintenance.

11_971.description: 激活涵盖医学中的胰岛素、糖尿病及铁蛋白指标，营养建议、住宿宣传、法律判决固定措辞，以及麻醉设备的成本效益描述；跨领域，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 饮食、血脂与冠心病风险
patterns.context: 描述饮食模式与血胆固醇、冠心病死亡率的关系，并建议公众采取低饱和脂肪饮食。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要；营养与公共卫生

patterns.name: 糖尿病与胰岛素指标
patterns.context: 糖尿病或糖耐量异常研究中，报告胰岛素测量、胰岛素/葡萄糖比值或 HbA1c；触发分散在指标及其检测语境中。

patterns.name: 房产宣传中的住宿设施描述
patterns.context: 酒店或房产介绍中，以宣传语描述地点、设施和住宿体验。

patterns.name: 法律判决审查中的有利视角措辞
patterns.context: 讨论 summary judgment 时，说明法院须从有利于非动议方或反对动议方的角度审视事实、证据或推论。

patterns.name: 铁蛋白升高与输血病例
patterns.context: 镰状细胞病病例背景下，提及多次输血及高铁蛋白水平。

patterns.name: 麻醉机的成本效益属性
patterns.context: 列举便携式野外麻醉机的设计需求时，强调成本效益；同句还列出安全、轻便、易维护等属性。
patterns.domain: 医疗设备说明／研究摘要

en.concept: Salient content words in specialized descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to highlighted measures, vitamin D, diet, and metabolic terms in medical and nutrition texts. There are also isolated activations for patent language about odor environments and accommodation promotions, with no single trigger feature that explains all patterns.

patterns.name: Vitamin D dosage and intake
patterns.context: Discussions of vitamin D dietary sources, intake, related genes, supplement doses, or blood concentrations

patterns.name: Biochemical measures and units
patterns.context: Medical texts reporting laboratory measurements, thresholds, or clinical measures, especially near numbers and units

patterns.name: Diet, nutrition, and metabolic health
patterns.context: Discusses food, dietary interventions, or their effects on blood lipids, satiety, and metabolic responses

patterns.name: Odor and environmental acceptability
patterns.context: Patent background describing fragrance materials or uses for improving environmental odors

patterns.name: Accommodation promotional language
patterns.context: Promotional descriptions of facilities, locations, and lodging experiences in hotel or property listings

11_971.concept: 专业描述中的显著内容词
11_971.description: 主要响应医学与营养文本中被重点标记的指标、维生素D、饮食及代谢词；另对气味环境专利措辞和住宿宣传语有孤立激活，未见能统一解释所有模式的单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 维生素 D 的剂量与摄入
patterns.context: 维生素 D 营养来源、摄入、相关基因、补充剂量或血液浓度的讨论

patterns.name: 生化指标及单位
patterns.context: 医学文本中报告实验室测量值、阈值或临床指标，尤其是数字和单位相邻处

patterns.name: 饮食、营养与代谢健康
patterns.context: 讨论食物、膳食干预或其对血脂、饱腹感及代谢反应的影响

patterns.name: 气味与环境可接受性
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述香味材料或改善环境气味的用途

patterns.name: 住宿宣传语
patterns.context: 酒店或房产介绍中的设施、位置及住宿体验宣传

en.concept: English articles and medical word-form fragments
en.description: The strongest reproducible signal is the English indefinite article a. Other activations include the definite article the, the initial H and hyper- in medical terms, and best within a Danish word. Other activations are sporadic and do not form stable patterns.

patterns.name: Article a
patterns.context: The English indefinite article a precedes a noun or noun phrase; it occurs across varied syntactic and content contexts
patterns.domain: English web pages, legal texts, nutrition texts

patterns.name: Article the
patterns.context: The English definite article the precedes a noun or an adjective-plus-noun phrase
patterns.domain: English web pages, legal texts, nutrition texts

patterns.name: H in hormone/metabolism terms
patterns.context: H occurs within the hormone-related word hormonal or the metabolic measure HOMA-IR; activation falls on the initial H
patterns.domain: PubMed nutrition, clinical, and metabolic research abstracts

patterns.name: hyper in hypercholesterolemia terms
patterns.context: hyper- is a medical term prefix followed by cholesterolemic or insulinemia

patterns.name: The sequence best within a Danish word
patterns.context: Occurs inside the Danish word “bestemmelser,” which is split into multiple subword tokens; context concerns instructions and their provisions

patterns.name: Sporadic whole-word or word-initial activations
patterns.context: These activations occur across general English web, legal, and medical texts, with no shared local lexical or syntactic condition

11_971.concept: 英语冠词及医学词形片段
11_971.description: 最强而可复现的信号是英语不定冠词 a；其余还包括定冠词 the、医学术语词首 H 与 hyper-，以及丹麦语词内 best。另有多种零散激活，未能归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 冠词 a
patterns.context: 英语中不定冠词 a 后接名词或名词短语；多种句法与内容环境中都出现
patterns.domain: 英语网页、法律文本、营养学文本

patterns.name: 冠词 the
patterns.context: 英语定冠词 the 后接名词或形容词加名词短语
patterns.domain: 英语网页、法律文本、营养学文本

patterns.name: 激素/代谢术语中的 H
patterns.context: H 出现在激素相关词 hormonal 或代谢指标 HOMA-IR 的词内；激活落在词首 H
patterns.domain: PubMed 营养、临床与代谢研究摘要

patterns.name: 高胆固醇术语中的 hyper
patterns.context: hyper- 作为医学术语前缀，后接 cholesterolemic 或 insulinemia
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内序列 best
patterns.context: 位于丹麦语词“bestemmelser”内部，词被切分为多个子词；上下文讨论指令及其条款

patterns.name: 零散的整词或词首激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在一般英语网页、法律及医学文本中，未见共同的局部词法或句法条件
patterns.domain: 酒店营销、法律、生物医学文本

en.concept: Sensitive to a and several local word forms
en.description: The most stable trigger is the article a, especially in a + noun/adjective phrases, across domains. There are also strong activations for the hyper subword in hypercholesterolemic and hyperinsulinemia, and for expressions of low cost or low expenses. Expressions of ease/pleasure in marketing contexts co-occur locally with step lists; paragraph 5 has no clear match.

patterns.name: Indefinite article a
patterns.context: The article a precedes a noun or adjective phrase; examples include “a pleasant experience,” “a breeze,” “a dietary pattern,” “a little more fit,” “a bit,” and “a whole.”
patterns.domain: Multidomain prose, including travel copy, marketing, health, blogs, and legal texts

patterns.name: Hypercholesterolemia and insulin-related terms
patterns.context: Medical terms are split into multiple subword tokens; triggers cluster at the initial hyper portion, especially in hypercholesterolemic and hyperinsulinemia.

patterns.name: Low-cost/low-expense expressions
patterns.context: Describes keeping costs or living expenses low, in contexts semantically related to low prices or saving.

patterns.name: Promotional process and experience expressions
patterns.context: In positive promotional contexts, describes a process as easy or a lodging experience as pleasant; both cases include a, but have different following collocations.

patterns.name: a in ordinary function words and phrases
patterns.context: The indefinite article a appears in various ordinary noun phrases, fixed expressions, or degree phrases, without requiring a particular domain or meaning.

patterns.name: Step-count cues in a final series list
patterns.context: A HackerNews post gives advice and then lists actions as numbered steps.

11_971.concept: 对 a 及若干局部词形敏感
11_971.description: 最稳定触发是冠词 a，尤其出现在 a + 名词/形容词短语中，跨领域出现；另对 hypercholesterolemic、hyperinsulinemia 的 hyper 子词及低成本、低开支表述有强激活。营销语境中的轻松/愉快表达与步骤列表仅局部共现；第5段无明显对应。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a
patterns.context: 冠词 a 后接名词或形容词短语；如 “a pleasant experience”“a breeze”“a dietary pattern”“a little more fit”“a bit”“a whole”。
patterns.domain: 多领域 prose，包括旅游文案、营销、健康、博客和法律文本

patterns.name: 超/高胆固醇与胰岛素术语
patterns.context: 医学术语被拆成多个子词 token；触发集中在 hyper 起始部分，尤其是 hypercholesterolemic 和 hyperinsulinemia。

patterns.name: 低成本／低开支表述
patterns.context: 描述把成本或生活开支维持在较低水平，低价或节省的语义邻近语境。
patterns.domain: 生活建议、消费服务说明

patterns.name: 宣传性过程与体验表达
patterns.context: 正面宣传语境中，称某项过程轻松，或住宿体验愉快；两处共同出现 a，但其后搭配不同。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、旅游住宿介绍

patterns.name: 普通功能词及短语中的 a
patterns.context: 不定冠词 a 出现在多种普通名词短语、固定表达或程度短语中，不要求特定领域或语义。

patterns.name: 末尾系列列表中的步数提示
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子给出建议后，以编号步骤列出行动。

en.description: High-activation locations are scattered across English articles, degree expressions, content words, medical values, mathematical phrases, and Danish word fragments; there is no stable cross-paragraph trigger, and several paragraphs can only be recorded as sporadic patterns.

patterns.name: Following tokens of the indefinite article a
patterns.context: Activation falls on the English indefinite article a in hotel copy, sales introductions, and a healthy recipe article; the topics and syntactic contexts differ.
patterns.domain: English web copy, marketing, lifestyle articles

patterns.name: Degree adverbs and evaluative expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions of comparison, degree, or change; [3] describes a holiday experience, [7] a healthier recipe, and [8] an increase in the frequency of pancreatitis attacks.

patterns.name: Content words or phrases in general text
patterns.context: Activations occur on words that do not fit the preceding patterns; no reliable shared meaning or fixed syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Travel, marketing, lifestyle, and medical web texts

patterns.name: Medical values and measure formats
patterns.context: In medical passages or nutrition research, activations occur near numbers, units, and laboratory measures; however, their locations are not fixed, and not all related tokens are highlighted.

patterns.name: English preposition in and mathematical discussion
patterns.context: Significant activation occurs only in this paragraph, within the phrase “in fact” in a StackExchange mathematics discussion; there is insufficient evidence to determine whether the trigger is the preposition, phrase, or mathematical context.

patterns.name: Danish word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on subword fragments within words in Danish parliamentary texts, with no stable correspondence to activations in English paragraphs.

patterns.name: Phrases in travel narratives
patterns.context: Activations cluster in a narrative describing things as “in full swing” after arriving at the accommodation; it is unclear whether the trigger is the fixed idiom or a general word sequence.

11_971.description: 高激活位置分散于英语冠词、程度表达、内容词、医学数值、数学短语及丹麦语词片段；没有稳定的跨段触发条件，多个段落只能作为零散模式记录。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 的后续 token
patterns.context: 激活落在英语不定冠词 a 上，分别出现在酒店文案、销售介绍以及健康食谱文章中；上下文主题和句法环境并不一致。
patterns.domain: 英语网页文案、营销、生活方式文章

patterns.name: 程度副词与评价性表达
patterns.context: 出现在比较、程度或变化表达中；[3] 描述节日体验，[7] 描述食谱更健康，[8] 描述胰腺炎发作频率增加。
patterns.domain: 生活方式网页、医学病例

patterns.name: 一般文本中的内容词或短语
patterns.trigger: « stay»8（[1]）；« process»8（[2]）；« holidays»5（[3]）；« things»5、« were»5（[5]）；« them»5、« it»7（[7]）；« persist»ently»7（[8]）
patterns.context: 激活分布在与前述模式不一致的词上；未见可靠的共同词义或固定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 旅游、营销、生活方式及医学网页文本

patterns.name: 医学数值与指标格式
patterns.context: 医学段落或营养研究中，数值、单位、实验室指标附近有激活；但激活位置并不固定，也并非所有相关 token 都高亮。

patterns.name: 英语介词 in 与数学论述
patterns.context: 仅此段出现显著激活，处在 StackExchange 数学讨论的短语“in fact”中；缺乏足够证据判断是否由介词、短语或数学语境触发。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在丹麦语议会文本的词内子词片段，无法与英语段落中的激活建立稳定对应。

patterns.name: 旅行叙述中的短语
patterns.context: 激活集中在到达住处后描述事情“正热火朝天地进行”的叙述中；是否响应固定习语或一般词语序列不明确。

en.description: Activations occur in lifestyle and home copy, household expense advice, quantified medical measures, and biomedical terms; there are also sporadic triggers in sales and travel narratives. Function words, topic words, and medical markers are difficult to unify under a single pattern.

patterns.name: “a / be …” structures
patterns.context: Weak function words are marked in syntactic structures, but also occur in other contexts and cannot alone explain the strongest activations.

patterns.name: Accommodation and home convenience
patterns.context: Describes accommodation experiences, holiday home life, or improvements to household tasks, emphasizing comfort, pleasure, or convenience.

patterns.name: Living expenses and cost control
patterns.context: Discusses reducing everyday expenses, budgeting, or household financial management.

patterns.name: Quantified lists and thresholds
patterns.context: Numbers and units are embedded in nutrition or medical measure lists; [3] also contains formal notation and stepwise argumentation, but does not show the same number-unit pattern.

patterns.name: Broad everyday topic words
patterns.context: Appear separately in a sales techniques introduction and a travel narrative, with no obvious shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Biomedical terms
patterns.context: Contexts involving insulin resistance, hyperinsulinemia, and cardiovascular disease research.

11_971.description: 激活分布在生活与居家文案、家庭开支建议、数字化医学指标及生物医学术语中；另有销售和旅行叙事中的零散触发。功能词、主题词及医学标记难以归为单一模式。

patterns.name: “a / be …”结构
patterns.context: 弱功能词在句法结构中被标记，但这些词也见于其他语境，难以单独解释最强激活。

patterns.name: 住宿与居家便利
patterns.context: 介绍住宿体验、节日居家生活或家庭事务改善，强调舒适、愉悦或便利。

patterns.name: 生活开销及费用控制
patterns.context: 讨论压低日常支出、预算或家庭财务管理。
patterns.domain: 论坛建议、家庭管理文案

patterns.name: 量化列表与阈值
patterns.context: 数字与单位嵌入营养或医学指标列表；[3]也有形式化记号及分步论述，但未呈现同样的数值单位模式。

patterns.name: 广义日常主题词
patterns.context: 分别出现在销售技巧介绍和旅行叙事中，缺乏共同的明显触发条件。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语
patterns.context: 胰岛素抵抗、高胰岛素血症与心血管疾病研究语境。

en.concept: Responses to multiple lexical items and phrases
en.description: Activations involve home life and expressions that make experiences more convenient or pleasant, as well as hyper- lipid terminology in medicine. There are also isolated patterns involving set-theoretic ZF and “in full swing.”

patterns.name: Home life and household chores
patterns.context: Discusses home, household management, home appliances, or making everyday life more convenient; common in promotional copy.

patterns.name: Expressions of comfort, convenience, and pleasure
patterns.context: In comparative or result expressions describing an experience, task, or life as easier or more pleasant because of something, strong activations often fall on degree words or the indefinite article.

patterns.name: hyperlipidemia-related word forms
patterns.context: Medical texts use lipid-disorder terms beginning with hyper-; activation falls on subword fragments within the terms.

patterns.name: Expressions meaning ongoing or in full swing
patterns.context: Describes activities or preparations as proceeding energetically or being fully underway.

patterns.name: ZF preceding a set theory term
patterns.context: ZF occurs in nearby context discussing the axiom of choice, set theory, and related consistency.

11_971.concept: 多模式词汇与短语响应
11_971.description: 激活涉及家居生活及使体验更便利愉快的表达，也包括医学中 hyper- 血脂术语；另有集合论 ZF 和“in full swing”两处孤立模式。

patterns.name: 家居生活与家务
patterns.context: 讨论家庭、家务管理、家居设备或让日常生活更便利时；常见于宣传性文案。
patterns.domain: 生活方式、家居与消费文案

patterns.name: 舒适、便利与愉悦表达
patterns.trigger: “stay a pleasant experience”“process a breeze”“much more enjoyable”“a lot easier”中的“a”“much”“more”“a lot”
patterns.context: 在描述体验、任务或生活因某事而更轻松愉快的比较或结果表达中，强激活常落在程度词或不定冠词上。

patterns.name: hyperlipidemia 相关词形
patterns.context: 医学文本中以 hyper- 开头的血脂异常术语；激活落在术语内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 进行中或全面展开的表达
patterns.context: 叙述活动或准备工作正在热烈、全面进行时。

patterns.name: 集合论术语前的 ZF
patterns.context: 讨论选择公理、集合论及相关数学一致性时，邻近上下文出现 ZF。

en.description: Activation sources are dispersed: including words such as succeeded and safer, as well as disease terms, mechanisms, technologies, models, and absorption terms in medical and research abstracts; no unified trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: Surname followed by parliamentary office
patterns.context: A biography describes someone succeeding another person to a seat or position; strong activation falls on succeeded.

patterns.name: Past participle succeeded
patterns.context: English sentences about completing or achieving something; here it refers respectively to succession, replacement, or military advance.

patterns.name: safer in a virtualization security comparison
patterns.context: Compares the security of containers and virtual machines; safer modifies choice.

patterns.name: Safety comparison between youth culture and real-world activities
patterns.context: Discusses teenagers’ online exploration and creative work, comparing their safety with real-life activities.

patterns.name: Medical term dyschondroplasia
patterns.context: A disease name is split into tokens in a medical abstract; activation is concentrated on the initial dys.

patterns.name: Wording in a mechanism research project
patterns.context: A project abstract introduces research into the basic mechanisms of some biological information.

patterns.name: Surgical technique phrase
patterns.context: A project abstract describes treatment methods with the phrase techniques for the treatment of...

patterns.name: Computer simulation model phrase
patterns.context: A project abstract mentions an existing computer simulation model and HIV disease.

patterns.name: Intestinal absorption phrase
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes the distribution of thyroxine absorption.

patterns.name: Remaining activations not clearly classifiable
patterns.context: Although some local markers are relatively strong, the excerpts are insufficient to confirm stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

11_1207.description: 激活来源分散：包括 succeeded、safer 等词，以及医学、科研摘要中的疾病词、机制、技术、模型和吸收等术语；尚无统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 姓氏后接议员职务
patterns.context: 人物传记中描述某人继承某人的议席或职位；强激活落在 succeeded。

patterns.name: 过去分词 succeeded
patterns.context: 与完成或达成某事相关的英语句子；此处分别指继任、取代或军事推进。

patterns.name: 虚拟化安全比较中的 safer
patterns.context: 比较容器与虚拟机的安全性，safer 修饰 choice。

patterns.name: 青春文化与现实活动的安全比较
patterns.context: 讨论青少年线上探索和创作，并与现实生活活动比较安全性。

patterns.name: 医学术语 dyschondroplasia
patterns.context: 医学摘要中疾病名称被分词切开；激活集中在词首 dys。

patterns.name: 机制研究项目措辞
patterns.context: 项目摘要介绍研究将探究某种生物信息的基本机制。

patterns.name: 手术技术短语
patterns.context: 项目摘要以 techniques for the treatment of... 描述治疗方法。

patterns.name: 计算机模拟模型短语
patterns.context: 项目摘要提及既有计算机模拟模型及 HIV 疾病。

patterns.name: 肠道吸收短语
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述甲状腺素吸收的分布。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的其余激活
patterns.trigger: 分散于普通功能词或词片段，例如 «of»、«will»、«and»；无清楚共同触发子串
patterns.context: 虽有局部较强标记，但片段不足以确认稳定的语义或句法条件。

en.description: Activation occurs on word-initial or internal subword fragments across domains, commonly in medical and biomedical terms, as well as philosophical terms, proper nouns, titles, and names of patented devices; no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Specific word-initial or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation on initial or internal subword fragments of words with varying meanings and full forms; some fragments recur across repeated titles.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, philosophical titles, patents, wiki entries, and web text

patterns.name: Biomedical topics and terminology
patterns.context: In medical or biomedical texts, activation falls on partial word fragments in terms for diseases, research mechanisms, and technologies; the specific word forms vary across passages.

patterns.name: Repeated titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation near the beginning of titles, entry names, or proper nouns; initial fragments recur in repeated names or titles.

patterns.name: Philosophical terms in academic titles
patterns.context: In titles of philosophical works, activation covers multiple tokenized fragments of terms and personal names, with no shared semantics with the medical fragments.

patterns.name: Device names in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A patent background uses the construction “commonly known as” followed by a device name in quotation marks; the name itself is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Surgical and disease names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in medical texts mentioning surgical techniques, conditions, or pain categories; trigger locations and term types vary.

11_1207.description: 激活分布于不同领域的词首或词内子词片段，常见于医学、生物医学术语，也见哲学术语、专名、标题及专利器械名称；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词首或词内特定片段
patterns.context: 对单词的开头或内部子词片段激活，词义和完整词形各异；有的片段跨重复标题再次出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、哲学标题、专利、维基条目及网页文本

patterns.name: 生物医学主题与术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学文本中，激活落在疾病、研究机制及技术术语的部分词片段上；不同段落中的具体词形并不相同。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 标题或专名的重复呈现
patterns.context: 标题、条目名或专名开头附近激活；重复出现的名称或标题中，词首片段再次激活。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的哲学术语
patterns.context: 哲学作品标题中，激活覆盖术语与人名的多个切分片段，未见与医学片段相同的语义。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的器械名称
patterns.context: 专利背景句式“commonly known as”后接引号中的器械名称，名称本身按子词切分。

patterns.name: 手术与疾病名称
patterns.context: 医疗文本中出现手术技术、病症或疼痛类别时有激活；触发位置和术语类型不一致。

en.description: All excerpts show significant activation on “as,” followed by an example or specific elaboration; topics and subsequent content vary, with no independent domain pattern evident.

patterns.name: as introducing examples
patterns.context: as is followed by one or more examples, category members, or specific instances; the word itself is the activation marker, while the surrounding examples vary
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, research project abstracts, medical abstracts, and news narratives

11_1207.description: 所有片段均在“as”处有显著激活，且后接示例或具体补充；题材和后续内容多样，没有显示出独立的领域模式。

patterns.name: as 引出例示
patterns.context: as 后接一个或多个示例、类别成员或具体实例；该词本身是激活标记，周围示例内容各不相同
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研项目摘要、医学摘要及新闻叙述

en.concept: patent technical fields and example introducers
en.description: Primarily responds to patent field/background headings, introductory sentences describing an invention as relating to or addressing a technology, and the example phrase “such as”; also responds to clicks, acceptance/rejection, and displayed results in an interface-operation Q&A passage.

patterns.name: Patent technical-field heading
patterns.context: Appears in section headings in patent style, often with numbering and line breaks, followed by a description of the invention’s field or background

patterns.name: Patent field-introduction construction
patterns.context: At the beginning of a patent paragraph, states the technology to which the invention relates or that it addresses; may be followed by a specific field or simply describe a device or method

patterns.name: “such as” introducing examples
patterns.context: The phrase introduces one or more examples, which may be systems, materials, devices, disease-related objects, etc.; not limited to patent text

patterns.name: Web interface actions and results
patterns.context: Describes corresponding messages displayed on different pages after a user selects accept or reject in an interface

patterns.name: Technical background section
patterns.context: A patent document opens an explanation of existing technology with a technical-background section heading

11_1207.concept: 专利技术领域与举例引导
11_1207.description: 主要响应专利文本的领域/背景标题、发明涉及或针对某技术的引入句，以及引例短语“such as”；另对一段界面操作问答中的点击、接受/拒绝及显示结果有响应。

patterns.name: 专利技术领域标题
patterns.trigger: «Field» of the Invention»；«Technical» Field»；«Description» of the Background» Art
patterns.context: 出现在专利文体的章节标题中，常带编号和换行，后接发明领域或背景说明

patterns.name: 专利领域引入句式
patterns.context: 专利段落开头用来说明发明涉及或针对的技术对象；可能接具体领域，也可能只描述装置或方法

patterns.name: “such as”举例引导
patterns.context: 该短语引出一个或多个示例，示例对象可为系统、材料、设备、疾病相关对象等；并非只限于专利文本
patterns.domain: 专利说明书及技术问答

patterns.name: 网页操作与结果表达
patterns.trigger: «As» the user clicks on «accept»；«reject» it should «display» «reject»
patterns.context: 描述用户在界面中选择接受或拒绝后，在不同页面显示对应消息

patterns.name: 技术背景章节
patterns.context: 专利文档中以背景技术章节标题开启对既有技术的说明

en.description: The strongest activation is concentrated on sentence-initial “As,” which typically connects to preceding text and introduces background, conditions, or explanations across genres; weaker related triggers include “As soon as” and “where” defining symbols after a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: As trigger after an in-sentence preposition
patterns.context: As appears at the beginning of a new sentence, followed by a past participle, adjective, or noun phrase; the preceding text typically completes a statement.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, news headlines, travel copy, mathematics papers, and biographical introductions

patterns.name: Sentence-initial As introducing a condition or temporal background
patterns.context: As appears sentence-initially and introduces a following clause or background expression; paragraph 9 has “As soon as,” whose syntax differs somewhat from the other examples.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, web descriptions, and general narratives

patterns.name: where in formulas
patterns.context: After a mathematical formula, where introduces variable definitions or conditions; activation falls on where rather than the formula symbols.

11_1207.concept: 句首连接与说明引导词
11_1207.description: 最强激活集中在句首“As”，通常承接前文并引出背景、条件或说明，跨多种文体出现；另有“As soon as”及数学公式后定义符号的“where”两类相关性较弱的触发。

patterns.name: 句内介词后的 As 触发
patterns.context: As 位于新句句首，后接过去分词、形容词或名词短语；前文通常已结束一个陈述。
patterns.domain: 专利、新闻标题、旅游文案、数学论文、人物介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 句首 As 引出的条件或时间背景
patterns.context: As 位于句首并引出后续从句或背景表达；第9段为“As soon as”，与其他例子的句法结构不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页说明及一般叙述

patterns.name: 公式中的 where
patterns.context: 数学公式后用 where 引入变量定义或条件，激活落在 where 而非公式符号上。

en.concept: specific word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to Steve at the beginning of names, including email salutations and biographical encyclopedia entries; also responds to the proper name Gukov in ArXiv, the term Asht(e)kar–Sen, and As at sentence or clause beginnings.

patterns.name: First word of a name: Steve
patterns.context: The first name or a name prefix, followed by a surname, colon, comma, or line break; common in email salutations/signatures or biographical encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Gukov-related proper name
patterns.context: A person’s name or term in mathematical physics literature, listed alongside objects related to SU(2)

patterns.name: Asht(e)kar–Sen term
patterns.context: In a theoretical context where the independent variables are the tetrad and spin connection, the term appears as a sentence-final phrase

patterns.name: High activation on As in mathematical sentences
patterns.context: An English connector at the beginning or within a sentence that marks a transition or introduces a subsequent statement; occurs with mathematical results, expansions, or predictions

11_1207.description: 主要对姓名开头的 Steve 强烈响应，覆盖邮件称呼及百科人物条目；另响应 ArXiv 中的 Gukov 专名、Asht(e)kar–Sen 术语，以及句首/句中的 As。

patterns.name: 人名首词 Steve
patterns.context: 作为姓名的名或姓前缀，后接姓氏、冒号、逗号或换行；常见于邮件称呼/署名或百科人物条目
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、Wikipedia 人物条目

patterns.name: Gukov 相关专名
patterns.context: 作为数学物理文献中的人名或术语名称，并与 SU(2) 相关对象并列

patterns.name: Asht(e)kar–Sen 术语
patterns.context: 独立变量为 tetrad 与 spin connection 的理论语境中，术语作为句末短语出现

patterns.name: 数学句中 As 的高激活
patterns.context: 句首或句中转折/引出后续陈述的英语连接词；与数学结果、展开或预测语境共现

en.description: Activation is dispersed across multiple texts, concentrated on tokenized proper-name fragments and internal fragments of Polish words; scattered triggers also include English function words, a voting term, the code value rtl, and patent-number digits, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Polish word-final and internal fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within inflected Polish words or stems, especially words with diacritics; the fragment may span multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Fragments in English names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Names of people, bands, or organizations are split into multiple tokens; activation often falls on a specific fragment within a name, and also occurs in lists dense with proper nouns.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia entries, directories, and web introductions

patterns.name: English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Common English prepositions, conjunctions, articles, or phrases occur in English narratives; there is no stable syntactic position, and many similar tokens are unmarked.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, web, and patent text

patterns.name: French voting instruction
patterns.context: In European Parliament voting procedures, instructs members to vote on an amendment; “hierop” recurs within a short span.

patterns.name: rtl in language-direction configuration
patterns.context: A code comment describes language reading direction and lists rtl as a possible value.
patterns.domain: CKEditor language configuration code on Github

patterns.name: Patent-number digits in English patent literature
patterns.context: The numeric token within patent citation number “3,954,1534”; nearby are other patent numbers and inventor names.

11_1207.description: 激活分散在多种文本中，集中于被拆分的专名片段和波兰语词内片段；另有英语功能词、表决词、代码值 rtl 及专利号数字等零散触发，未见一致语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语屈折词或词干内部，尤其是带变音符号的词；词片段可能跨多个子词元。
patterns.domain: 波兰语语料；欧盟议会文本（第10段）

patterns.name: 英语姓名及专名中的片段
patterns.context: 姓名、乐队名或组织名被拆分成多个 token；激活往往落在名字中的特定片段，也出现在专名密集的列表中。
patterns.domain: 英语百科条目、名录及网页介绍

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语片段
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现常见介词、连词、冠词或短语；没有稳定的句法位置，且大量同类 token 未标记。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、网页和专利文本

patterns.name: 法语表决指令
patterns.context: 欧洲议会表决程序中，指示议员对修正案投票；「hierop」在短时间内重复出现。

patterns.name: 语言方向配置中的 rtl
patterns.context: 代码注释描述语言阅读方向，并把 rtl 列为可能取值之一。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 CKEditor 语言配置代码

patterns.name: 英语专利文献中的专利号数字
patterns.context: 专利引证编号「3,954,1534」内部的数字 token；附近另有专利号和发明人姓名。

en.concept: patent invention-description boilerplate and adjacent technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to patent specification boilerplate about purposes, advantages, and phrases such as “According to the invention”; also commonly occurs in descriptions of engineering devices, materials, and manufacturing structures. It additionally covers a video-encoding citation, an ink-absorbing medium patent, and a private email about a sailing companion.

patterns.name: Patent purpose and invention-introduction boilerplate
patterns.context: Fixed phrases in patent backgrounds or specifications that state the invention’s purpose or advantages, or introduce a solution; activation falls on these phrases and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Mechanical and engineering component descriptions
patterns.context: Describes physical devices, components, materials, or structures and their functions, usually in patent technical descriptions; some examples co-occur with purpose boilerplate.

patterns.name: Materials, electronics, and manufacturing technology
patterns.context: Introduces material processing, magnetic-field devices, or semiconductor manufacturing structures, surrounded by technical terminology and invention-solution introductions.

patterns.name: Names in patent citations or document titles
patterns.context: Author names appear in technical patent passages; the trigger falls within a name fragment and does not clearly reflect patent-purpose boilerplate.

patterns.name: Recording media and ink-absorbing layers
patterns.context: Discusses coatings or layering methods to improve ink absorption and includes patent document numbers.

patterns.name: Sailing arrangements in a personal email
patterns.context: A private email mentions whether someone will go sailing after being widowed and finding assistance; its style differs from patent text.

11_1207.concept: 专利发明说明套语及邻近技术文本
11_1207.description: 主要响应专利说明书中目的、优点及“According to the invention”等套语，也常见于工程装置、材料和制造结构描述；另覆盖视频编码引文、吸墨介质专利，以及一段谈航行帮手的私人邮件。

patterns.name: 专利目的与发明引入套语
patterns.trigger: “objects and advantages”, “The object of the invention”, “According to the invention”
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中陈述发明目的、优点，或引出解决方案的固定句式；激活落在这些套语及其邻近词上。

patterns.name: 机械与工程部件描述
patterns.context: 描述实体装置、构件、材料或结构及其功能，通常位于专利技术说明中；部分与目的套语同时出现。
patterns.domain: 工程、机械及装置类专利

patterns.name: 材料、电子与制造技术
patterns.trigger: “molten jet of metal”, “magnetic field”, “wiring layer”, “semiconductor package”
patterns.context: 介绍材料加工、磁场装置或半导体制造结构，周围有技术术语和发明方案引入语。
patterns.domain: 材料、电子及半导体专利

patterns.name: 专利引用或文献标题中的姓名
patterns.context: 技术专利段落中出现参考文献作者姓名；触发位置在人名内部的词片段，不体现明显的专利目的套语。
patterns.domain: 视频编码专利及参考文献

patterns.name: 录制介质与吸墨层
patterns.context: 讨论改善吸墨性的涂层或成层方法，包含专利文献编号。

patterns.name: 个人邮件中的航行安排
patterns.trigger: “glad of some help to sail it”, “talking about sailing it”, “find some help”
patterns.context: 私人邮件提到某人丧偶后是否外出航行，以及寻找协助；与专利文本风格不同。

en.description: Primarily covers various internal subword fragments in Estonian parliamentary text; scattered trigger words also occur in English technical Q&A and patents, with no consistent meaning or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Estonian morphological fragments
patterns.context: Trigger points are dispersed within Estonian words, with no clear fixed meaning or syntactic position, reflecting subword-level tokenization

patterns.name: Local words in English technical phrases
patterns.context: Scattered throughout English technical Q&A or patent text, with no shared, clearly identifiable term or fixed collocation

11_1207.concept: 语言与子词片段混合触发
11_1207.description: 主要覆盖爱沙尼亚语议会文本中的多种词内子词片段；另有英语技术问答与专利中的零散触发词，未见一致词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语形态切分片段
patterns.context: 触发点分散在爱沙尼亚语词内部；没有明显固定词义或句法位置，呈现子词级切分

patterns.name: 英语技术词组中的局部词语
patterns.context: 散布于英语技术问答或专利文本；没有共同的明确词项或固定搭配

en.concept: spatial relation words and local terms
en.description: High activation often falls on spatial relation words in patent text (adjacent, proximate, opposite, distal, end); other triggers include reference indicators and scattered words or name fragments. The triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Morphological adjacency
patterns.context: Describes spatial relations between two regions, ends, or components, especially in patent technical text; in [1], “end” occurs in what appears to be Finnish text, so the semantic relation is uncertain.

patterns.name: Deictic words in references
