patterns.context: Refers to other documents, locations, or previously mentioned patent citations; the trigger may relate to reference or citation structure, but examples are limited.

patterns.name: Specific word fragment
patterns.context: Within a name in an ArXiv author list; no shared contextual condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a technical term
patterns.context: In a technical description of related filter bandwidth; this is a single instance and may simply be triggered by the term itself.

patterns.name: Other patent word fragments
patterns.context: In a patent description of varactor units and electrode structures; the highly activated words do not clearly share a trigger form with fragments in other examples.

11_1207.concept: 空间关系词及局部词项
11_1207.description: 高激活多落在专利文本中的空间关系词（adjacent、proximate、opposite、distal、end），另有引用指示词及零散词项、人名片段；触发并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 形态相邻处
patterns.context: 在描述两个区域、端部或部件之间的空间关系时，尤其是专利技术文本；[1]的 “end” 出现在疑似芬兰语文本中，不能确定语义关系。

patterns.name: 引用中的指示词
patterns.context: 提及其他文档、位置或前述专利引用时；触发点似乎可能与指代或引用结构有关，但实例有限。

patterns.name: 特定单词片段
patterns.context: ArXiv 作者名单中的人名内部；未见可确认的共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 技术术语内部片段
patterns.context: 相关滤波器带宽的技术描述中；这是单个实例，可能只是词项本身触发。

patterns.name: 其他专利词项片段
patterns.context: varactor 单元与电极结构的专利描述中；与其他片段中的高激活词没有明确共享触发形式。

en.concept: Mixed detection of citation markers and Estonian text
en.description: Activations mainly fall into two categories: references and citation statements in patent technical backgrounds, and Estonian parliamentary text. One StackExchange API Q&A passage also appears, showing a distinct Q&A and operational-guidance pattern.

patterns.name: Patent technical backgrounds and citations
patterns.context: References, patent numbers, or literature citations appear after technical explanations; often accompanied by periods, commas, and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds involving oxidation, interfaces, chemical reactions, thin films, Bayesian networks, and magnetic storage; covers passages 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

patterns.name: Estonian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Coherent Estonian word forms and sentence fragments, with punctuation such as commas and periods; no visible English patent-citation pattern.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian parliamentary speeches; covers passages 2, 8, 10.

patterns.name: English Q&A and API guidance
patterns.context: In a Q&A format, the answer advises how to create or use an API and points to a webpage link.

11_1207.concept: 引证标记与爱沙尼亚语文本的混合检测
11_1207.description: 激活样本主要分成两类：专利技术背景中的参考文献与引证语句，以及爱沙尼亚语议会文本；另有一段 StackExchange API 问答，呈现独立的问答和操作指引模式。

patterns.name: 专利技术背景与引证
patterns.context: 技术说明之后出现参考文献、专利号或文献引证；常伴随句号、逗号及缩写。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，涉及氧化、接口、化学反应、薄膜、贝叶斯网络和磁存储；覆盖段 1、3、4、5、6、7。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本
patterns.context: 连贯的爱沙尼亚语词形与句子片段，出现逗号、句号等标点；没有可见英文专利引证模式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会发言；覆盖段 2、8、10。

patterns.name: 英语问答及 API 指引
patterns.context: 问答格式中，回答给出如何创建或使用 API 的建议，并引向网页链接。

en.description: Activations are distributed mainly across Estonian and a few Slovenian subwords in multilingual European parliamentary text. They also appear in German parliamentary forms of address, two patent technical descriptions, and an English forum expression of wishes; apart from multilingual text fragments, there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Estonian word forms and text fragments
patterns.context: Across varied sentence structures and topics, activations are scattered across consecutive Estonian tokens; they do not respond only to a particular word or topic

patterns.name: Estonian report/meeting expressions
patterns.context: Slovenian subword fragments in report- or meeting-related expressions; activations in the passage also span multiple surrounding tokens

patterns.name: Address for a parliamentary president
patterns.context: An address for a female president in a formal parliamentary speech; activations concentrate on subwords in the title

patterns.name: Description of a compensation chamber in a patent
patterns.context: Patent background text describes an evaporator, compensation chamber, and working fluid in a technical explanatory style

patterns.name: Description of a radial servo burst in a patent
patterns.context: A patent claim describes servo wedge regions and burst signals extending radially along data tracks

patterns.name: Expression of wishes in an English forum post
patterns.context: An informal first-person post explains a goal the author hopes to achieve and requests advice

11_1207.description: 激活主要分布于多语种欧洲议会文本中的爱沙尼亚语及少量斯洛文尼亚语子词，也出现在德语议会称谓、两段专利技术描述和英语论坛愿望表达中；除多语种文本片段外无统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形与文本片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «an»、« 000»、«tööturuasutuste»、«valgust»、«hääletada» 等大量爱沙尼亚语子词片段
patterns.context: 跨多种句式和主题，神经元激活分散在连续的爱沙尼亚语 token 中；并非只对某个特定词或主题响应
patterns.domain: EuroParl 中的爱沙尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语报告/会议用语
patterns.context: 报告或会议相关表述中的斯洛文尼亚语子词片段；该段的激活也遍及周围多个 token
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 议会主席称呼
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中对女性主席的称呼，激活集中在称谓的子词

patterns.name: 专利中的补偿腔室描述
patterns.context: 专利背景技术以技术说明口吻描述蒸发器、补偿腔室和工作流体

patterns.name: 专利中的径向伺服突发描述
patterns.context: 专利权利要求中描述伺服楔形区及突发信号沿数据轨道的径向延伸

patterns.name: 英语论坛中的愿望表达
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称帖子中说明希望实现的目标，并请求建议

en.description: High activations often fall on intra-word fragments or subwords in Slovenian, Dutch, and German parliamentary text, as well as English comments and patent text. Four English comments jointly highlight think of; other cross-language triggers are not consistent.

patterns.name: Slovenian intra-word segmentation fragments
patterns.context: Activations are marked at short word-fragment boundaries, especially letters or subword fragments within words; all three passages are Slovenian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: English fixed expression think of
patterns.context: In English sentences, think of is followed by a use, idea, or object; sentences are often first-person negatives using I can't think of, but speakers and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Dutch intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within the Dutch verb brengen, in the context of a parliamentary report conclusion and a new initiative.

patterns.name: German intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within Abstimmung, a German parliamentary procedure term, in a formal statement about voting results.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in patent text
patterns.context: Activations are marked in a technical description in an English patent claim involving nanocolor films, electrodes, and dye molecules; the same passage also has several weaker intra-word or subword-fragment activations.

11_1207.description: 高激活多落在词内片段或子词上：斯洛文尼亚语、荷兰语、德语议会文本，以及英语评论与专利文本。四段英语评论共同突出 think of；其余跨语言触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活标在词语的短片段边界处，尤其是词中间的字母或子词片段；三段均为斯洛文尼亚语议会文本。

patterns.name: 英语 think of 固定表达
patterns.context: 英语句子中短语 think of 后接用途、想法或对象；句子多为第一人称否定式 I can't think of，也有不同说话者与上下文。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语动词 brengen 的词中片段，处于议会报告结论与新倡议的上下文。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于德语议会程序词 Abstimmung 的内部，出现在表决结果的正式发言中。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活标在英文专利权利要求的技术描述中，涉及纳米色膜、电极及染料分子；同段另有多个较弱的词内或词片段激活。

en.description: The activation pattern is not consistent: parliamentary text often highlights Slovenian and German intra-word fragments and procedural expressions; patent text contains technical terms, material lists, and citation formats; forum time expressions and business-contract amounts and durations also appear.

patterns.name: Slovenian inflectional morphemes and endings
patterns.context: Consecutive morpheme segmentation in Slovenian sentences, with activations highlighting intra-word fragments such as “sektorju” and “državne pomoči”; also includes « minimal»4«n»4«im»3« pr»4«ag»2«om»5.

patterns.name: Slovenian report and parliamentary expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to parliamentary-context terms for rapporteurs, report authors, and objectives; activations fall on Slovenian intra-word segments and inflected forms.

patterns.name: German procedural vocabulary
patterns.context: German words in parliamentary speeches concerning withdrawing a name, voting results, or voting procedures; activations concentrate within compound or inflected words.

patterns.name: German committee responses and agenda expressions
patterns.context: Formal expressions for committee responses, welcoming something, and placing an item on the agenda for a vote; highlighted fragments are distributed within German words and common words.

patterns.name: Slovenian committee and bill wording
patterns.context: Formal sentences about committee matters, legislative proposals, and bill text; activations concentrate on intra-word fragments, but no highlighted word is fully shared with other passages.

patterns.name: English causal and Bayesian network terminology
patterns.context: Technical explanation discussing causal relationships and Bayesian networks; activations are sporadic near time words, abbreviation endings, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Time expressions in a technical forum
patterns.context: Describes a temporary situation, followed by a technical discussion about collecting CPU, network, and IO utilization in the future.

patterns.name: Contract amounts, durations, and warranty clauses
patterns.context: Lists months, election periods, warranty periods, and amounts in a contract or business email; strong activations concentrate on numeric amount fragments and time units.

patterns.name: Patent measurement parameters and citation format
patterns.context: Describes impedance measurements, parameter sweeps, and frequency/temperature/bias values, followed by a U.S. patent citation format.

patterns.name: Materials and enumeration in patent claims
patterns.context: Patent claims or background passages describe electrochromic nanofilms, electrodes, semiconductor metal oxides, and dye molecules, with legal-style enumerations and citation wording.

11_1207.description: 激活模式并不统一：议会文本中常落在斯洛文尼亚语、德语词内片段及议事表达；专利文本有技术术语、材料列举和引证格式；另见论坛时间措辞与商务合同金额、期限。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语屈折词素与词尾
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语句子中的连续词素切分，激活突出词内片段，如“sektorju”“državne pomoči”；还包括« minimal»4«n»4«im»3« pr»4«ag»2«om»5。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语报告与议会表达
patterns.context: 与报告人员、报告起草者、目标等议会语境词语相邻；激活落在斯洛文尼亚语词内分段及屈折形式上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 德语议事程序词汇
patterns.context: 议会发言中有关撤回姓名、表决结果或表决程序的德语词语；激活集中于复合或屈折词的内部片段。

patterns.name: 德语委员会答复及议程表达
patterns.trigger: « An»6tw«ort»1；Kommiss«arin»4；« be»1grüße« es»5；« auf»5« der»4« T»1«ages»2«ord»1«n»2«ung»4；« Ab»9stimmun«g»4
patterns.context: 委员会答复、欢迎某事以及议题列入议程并提交表决的正式表达；高亮片段分布在德语词内部及常见词上。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语委员会与法案措辞
patterns.trigger: Komis«ije»1；« raz»7«vo»3«jem»3« iz»4«v»1«ajan»3«ja»5；« p»8«ak»5«eta»3« bes»3«ed»1«il»3；« b»9«ili»3
patterns.context: 说明委员会相关事项、立法方案及法案文本的正式句子；激活集中在词内片段，但未见与其他段完全一致的高亮词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语因果与贝叶斯网络术语
patterns.context: 讨论因果关系及贝叶斯网络的技术性说明；激活零散出现在时间词、缩写末尾及标点附近。

patterns.name: 技术论坛中的时间表达
patterns.context: 描述暂时情况，并接续未来会收集CPU、网络和IO利用率等技术讨论。

patterns.name: 合同金额、期限与保修条款
patterns.context: 合同或商业邮件中列出月份、选举期限、保修期及金额；强激活集中在数字金额片段和时间单位。

patterns.name: 专利测量参数与引证格式
patterns.context: 描述阻抗测量、参数扫描及频率/温度/偏置值，随后出现美国专利引证格式。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的材料与列举
patterns.trigger: « form»4« of»3；« plurality»5；« see»6«,»9« for»2« example»6
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或背景段落描述纳米变色膜、电极、半导体金属氧化物和染料分子，包含法律式列举及引证措辞。

en.description: Activations occur across multilingual and cross-domain text: Q&A, sports and automotive encyclopedias, parliamentary politics, institutional addresses, patent technology, and math problems. Highlighted word forms and topics vary by passage, with no stable shared lexical or semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Search intent and answer opening
patterns.context: Explains or confirms what someone is looking for, then offers something available; activations concentrate around “looking for”.

patterns.name: Soccer goalkeeper and match narration
patterns.context: Narrative facts about teams, players, and matches, with proper nouns split into subwords; a fragment in the opposing team’s name is highlighted.

patterns.name: Slovenian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Slovenian words appear as subwords, concerning committees, projects, and supplementary remarks; there is no apparent common trigger independent of the language content.

patterns.name: German parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Formal German parliamentary sentences involving emphasis on importance and oral questioning; activations are distributed across subwords of multiple German words.

patterns.name: Automotive specifications and engine parameters
patterns.context: Vehicle configurations and engine performance descriptions, with numbers, units, and specification terms occurring together.

patterns.name: German policy and institutional authority
patterns.context: Formal policy discussion about expanding the European Commission’s authority and Community air services.

patterns.name: University addresses and institutional names
patterns.context: Departments, university names, and postal codes in address or affiliation lists.

patterns.name: Patent technical description
patterns.context: Describes technical structures such as toroidal magnetic cores, magnetic-field uniformity, and electron-beam regions.

patterns.name: German discussion of diplomacy and international organizations
patterns.context: Political speech discussing a voluntary coalition, the UN Charter, and international organizations.

patterns.name: Prime factors in a math problem
patterns.context: A question using formulas, variables, and numerical values that asks for the prime factors of an integer.

11_1207.description: 激活出现在多语种及多领域文本中：问答、体育与汽车百科、议会政治、机构地址、专利技术和数学题。各段的高亮词形与主题各异，未见稳定共享的词汇或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 查找意图与回答开头
patterns.context: 解释或确认对方要找什么，随后给出可用的东西；激活集中在“looking for”一带。

patterns.name: 足球守门员与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 球队、球员和比赛事实叙述，专名被拆分成子词；突出对手队名中的片段。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语词语以子词形式出现，涉及委员会、项目及补充说明；没有显然独立于语言内容的共同触发词。

patterns.name: 德语议会发言
patterns.context: 德语正式议会语句，包含强调重要性及口头质询；激活分布在多个德语词的子词上。

patterns.name: 汽车规格与发动机参数
patterns.context: 车辆配置和发动机性能说明，数字、单位及规格词相邻出现。

patterns.name: 德语政策与机构权限
patterns.context: 正式政策论述，讨论欧委会权限扩大及共同体航空服务。

patterns.name: 大学地址与机构名称
patterns.context: 地址或署名列表中的院系、大学名称与邮政编码。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述
patterns.context: 描述环形磁芯、磁场均匀性及电子束区域等技术结构。

patterns.name: 德语外交与国际组织论述
patterns.context: 政治讲话谈及自愿者联盟、联合国宪章及国际组织。

patterns.name: 数学题中的素因数
patterns.context: 以公式、变量和数值设问，要求列出整数的素因数。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code resource-cleanup statements, patent and legal formats, academic affiliations and prose, mathematical notation, and garbled text; no clear commonality is apparent, though some activations may relate to tokenization boundaries and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols between markers
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions or structured text, short symbols such as line breaks and operators are marked separately; activations fall on or near the symbols or their boundaries.

patterns.name: Specific tokenization boundaries in text
patterns.context: In English scientific prose and citation markers, word fragments or citation numbers are segmented.

patterns.name: Resource-cleanup statements in program code
patterns.context: An Objective-C lifecycle callback explains releasing resources, invalidating timers, and saving state when an application enters the background.

patterns.name: Tokenization of institution names and proper nouns
patterns.context: German institution names and place names in author addresses or affiliations are split into multiple subwords.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: A case name is followed by a court, volume and page numbers, and case-reporter abbreviations, with punctuation adjacent to numbers.

patterns.name: Patent title and patent-number format
patterns.context: A patent specification cites prior patents, including titles, dates, U.S. patent numbers, and numbering punctuation.

patterns.name: Technical description in patent-claim style
patterns.context: “According to the invention” introduces structural relationships among device components, axes, and regions, with technical terms used repeatedly.

patterns.name: Corrupted or garbled text
patterns.context: Many broken, illegible character fragments appear after an HTML paragraph tag, with little clear meaning or normal syntax.

11_1207.description: 激活分布于代码资源清理语句、专利与法律格式、学术署名和正文、数学符号及乱码文本；共同点不明显，部分激活可能与分词边界和格式标记有关。

patterns.name: 标记之间的数字与符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或结构化文本中，换行、运算符等短符号被单独标记；激活落在符号或其边界附近。

patterns.name: 文本中的特定分词边界
patterns.context: 英文科学论文正文及引用标记中，单词片段或引用编号被分段标记。

patterns.name: 程序代码中的资源清理语句
patterns.context: Objective-C 生命周期回调中，说明应用进入后台时释放资源、使计时器失效并保存状态。

patterns.name: 机构名称与专名分词
patterns.context: 作者地址或机构署名中，德语机构名、地名被拆成多个子词。

patterns.name: 法律引文格式
patterns.context: 判例名称后跟法院、卷页码及判例汇编缩写，标点与数字紧邻。

patterns.name: 专利标题与专利号格式
patterns.context: 专利说明书引用既有专利，包含标题、日期、美国专利号及编号标点。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求式技术描述
patterns.trigger: «According»2« to»3« the»3« invention»1、« central»4« area»6« around»9
patterns.context: 以“According to the invention”引出装置组成、轴线和区域等结构关系，并反复使用技术名词。

patterns.name: 异常的损坏或乱码文本
patterns.context: HTML 段落标签之后出现大量破碎、难以辨认的字符片段，缺少清晰语义或正常句法。

en.description: Activations are scattered: often in proper nouns beginning with or containing B (such as Bayer, Bebek, Bremen), as well as German er- verbs, the word high in an HPLC phrase, commas in legal citations, and line-break markers; these patterns do not form a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: B in institution, company, or brand names
patterns.context: B occurs within or at the start of proper nouns, often company, brand, institution, or place names; the letter may be split by the tokenizer.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, academic addresses, parliamentary text, legal text, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: er in German word forms
patterns.context: In German sentences, word-initial er- appears in verb forms “erhält” and “erwarten”; activations fall on the prefix er.

patterns.name: High-performance liquid chromatography phrase
patterns.context: The adjective high is adjacent to “performance liquid chromatography”, forming the name of an analytical method.

patterns.name: Commas in legal case citations
patterns.context: Commas are used between court-report volume and page information in case citations.

patterns.name: Line-break markers before lists or tables
patterns.context: A line break follows TRT, then a hyphen separator; this appears more like a layout or text-boundary signal, with no other examples.
patterns.domain: Table or layout fragment in a medical paper

11_1207.description: 激活分散：常见于 B 开头或含 B 的专名（如 Bayer、Bebek、Bremen），另有德语 er- 动词、HPLC 短语 high、法律引文逗号及换行标记；这些模式未形成统一语义。

patterns.name: 机构、公司或品牌名称中的 B
patterns.trigger: « B»（包括被切分的后续字母，如 «B»10«ayer»1、«B»9«ismarck»2、«B»9«rem»2«en»2）
patterns.context: B 出现在专名内部或开头，常为公司、品牌、机构或地名；字母可能被 tokenizer 拆分。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、学术地址、议会文本、法律文本及百科条目

patterns.name: 德语词形中的 er
patterns.context: 德语句子中，词首 er- 出现在动词词形“erhält”“erwarten”中；激活落在前缀 er 上。

patterns.name: 高性能液相色谱短语
patterns.context: 形容词 high 紧邻“performance liquid chromatography”，构成分析方法名称。

patterns.name: 法律判例引文中的逗号
patterns.context: 判例引文中，法院报告卷页信息之间使用逗号。

patterns.name: 清单或表格引导处的换行标记
patterns.context: TRT 后出现换行，随后为横线分隔符；更像排版或文本边界信号，缺少其他例子。
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的表格或版式片段

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and styles, often falling on intra-word subwords, endings, or proper-noun fragments; punctuation and function words also appear. The corpora separately show German morphology, paper entities, patent chemical definitions, Slovenian word forms, and one English colloquial word fragment, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: German endings and agglutinative morphology segmentation
patterns.context: In continuous German prose, activations fall on internal fragments of compounds, inflected words, or participles and adjacent punctuation or function words; they are not tied to a fixed German word
patterns.domain: EuroParl German parliamentary speeches and PhilPapers German academic writing

patterns.name: Terms and entity fragments in scientific literature
patterns.context: Activations appear near terms, drug/company names, units, and their segmented word fragments in descriptions of methods or materials

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and definition text in patents
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds or claim-style definitions list chemical substituent symbols, atom names, and explanations of generic groups

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Slovenian sentences, activations are distributed across words with diacritics, affixes, or subword fragments; punctuation also appears

patterns.name: Ramble word fragment in English colloquial text
patterns.context: An informal forum reply in which the first-person author admits to going somewhat off topic; activations concentrate on an internal word fragment

11_1207.concept: 跨语种词片段/子词形态
11_1207.description: 激活跨多语种与文体，常落在词内部的子词、词尾或专名片段，也见标点和功能词；各语料分别呈现德语形态、论文实体、专利化学定义、斯洛文尼亚词形及一次英语口语词片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语词尾与黏着形态切分
patterns.trigger: 如 «-»、« und»、«heit»、«ung»、«en»、«er» 等词素或词尾
patterns.context: 德语连续正文中，激活落在复合词、屈折词或分词的内部片段及其相邻标点、功能词；并非固定某个德语词
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语议会发言与 PhilPapers 德语学术文字

patterns.name: 科学文献中的术语和实体片段
patterns.context: 论文方法或材料叙述中，术语、药品/公司名称、单位及其拆分词片段附近出现激活

patterns.name: 专利化学式与定义文本
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求式定义中，化学取代基符号、原子名称及通用基团解释并列出现

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语连续句子中，激活分布于带变音符号的词、词缀或子词片段，亦见标点
patterns.domain: EuroParl 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 英语口语中的 ramble 词片段
patterns.context: 非正式论坛回复中，第一人称承认自己说得有些跑题；激活集中于单词内部片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across German compounds, health and medical vocabulary, patent numbers and dates, legal affiliations, biomedical citations, and common words in an English comment; triggers vary across domains and positions.

patterns.name: German nouns and intra-word compounds
patterns.context: In German corpora, longer compounds, nouns, or nominalized expressions are split into multiple intra-word fragments; activations often fall near stems, affixes, and intra-word boundaries. Not all German words trigger them.

patterns.name: Health and medical topic words
patterns.context: Activations appear near vocabulary about health, body parts, diseases, and surgery in medical or public-health contexts; both German public-health expressions and English medical text occur.
patterns.domain: Public policy, PubMed medical text, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Patent numbers, dates, and citation formats
patterns.context: In patent documents, activations occur around numbers, U.S. patent identifiers, issue dates, and consecutive patent-number lists; they may fall on number fragments, punctuation, and formatting words.

patterns.name: Names, law firms, and place names
patterns.context: In legal document signatures or citations, activations occur when names, law-firm names, and city/state abbreviations are listed together.

patterns.name: Academic citations and biological terminology
patterns.context: In biomedical papers discussing proteins, experimental subjects, and literature citations, markers appear on citation numbers and related academic text; triggers are not limited to the terminology itself.

patterns.name: Word fragments in ordinary English prose
patterns.context: In HackerNews comments, several common words and sentence-initial words in ordinary English sentences also activate, with no clear medical, patent, or German topic condition.

11_1207.description: 激活分布于德语复合词、健康医疗词汇、专利编号日期、法律署名、生物医学引文及一段英语评论的常见词，跨领域且触发位置不一致。

patterns.name: 德语名词及词内复合结构
patterns.context: 德语语料中，较长的复合词、名词或名词化表达被拆分成多个词内片段；激活常落在词干、词缀和词内边界附近。不是所有德语词都触发。

patterns.name: 健康与医疗主题词
patterns.context: 医学或公共健康语境中，健康、身体部位、疾病及手术相关词汇附近激活；其中德语公共健康表述与英语医学文本均出现。
patterns.domain: 公共政策、PubMed 医学文本、专利背景

patterns.name: 专利编号、日期与引用格式
patterns.context: 专利文献中，编号、美国专利标识、签发日期及连续列举专利号时出现；激活可落在数字片段、标点和格式词上。

patterns.name: 人名、律师事务所与地名
patterns.context: 法律文书的署名或引注中，姓名、事务所名称及城市／州缩写成串列出时出现。

patterns.name: 学术论文引文与生物学术语
patterns.context: 生物医学论文叙述蛋白质、实验对象和文献引用时，标记出现在引文编号及相关学术文本中；触发位置并不只限于术语本身。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英语普通叙述中的词片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 评论中，普通英语句子里的若干常见词及句首词也有激活，未呈现明确的医学、专利或德语主题条件。

en.description: Activations span corpora without a consistent pattern: German intra-word fragments, legal and patent citation formats, English comment word fragments, and biomedical citations and experimental drug/supplier contexts all trigger. The passages share no stable lexical or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments in German compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented German morphemes or intra-word fragments, often in compounds, derived words, and adjacent function words; no specific syntactic position is required

patterns.name: Legal citations and proper-noun formats
patterns.context: Appears in formal legal text formats such as litigants, lawyer titles, patent numbers, or case citations
patterns.domain: FreeLaw opinions/litigation records and USPTO patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Local word fragments in English content words and collocations
patterns.context: In English comments, activations are distributed across ordinary words, phrases, and sentence transitions, with no single clear semantic or positional condition

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and literature markers
patterns.context: Appears in abstract-style paper narratives and author-year/literature-location markers

patterns.name: Experimental-animal anesthetics and dose units
patterns.context: Around injection doses, brand names, and supplier locations for Zoletil and Rompun

11_1207.description: 激活跨语料且不统一：德语词内片段、法律及专利引文格式、英文评论词片段，以及生物医学引文和实验药剂/供应商语境均有触发。各段没有稳定共享的词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 德语复合词中的词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的德语词素或词内片段上，常见于复合词、派生词及其周边功能词；无需特定句法位置
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语政治/政策发言

patterns.name: 法律引文与专名格式
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼当事人、律师职衔、专利号或判例引文等正式法律文本格式中
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决/诉讼记录与 USPTO 专利背景

patterns.name: 英文内容词及搭配中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 在英文评论中，激活分布于普通词、短语和句子连接处，没有单一明显的词义或位置条件

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与文献标记
patterns.trigger: «CR»、«10»、«227»、«1»（引用标记拆分）；上下文含 «acidic protein»、«nucleoli»、«Xenopus»、«NPM1»
patterns.context: 出现在论文摘要式叙述和作者-年份/文献定位标记中
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 实验动物麻醉剂与剂量单位
patterns.context: 围绕 Zoletil、Rompun 的注射剂量、商品名及供应商地点

en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres, mainly involving intra-word markers, commonly in words ending in “-ization”; they also occur on content words in emails, title-boundary elements, and biomedical term fragments, with no single semantic pattern explaining them.

patterns.name: English words containing “ization”
patterns.context: The marked portions are nominal forms ending in “-ization” or “ization”; some cover the suffix, others cover different parts of the word, and tokenization varies.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research project texts; also plan notification emails

patterns.name: Important content words in emails
patterns.context: Marked tokens are content words in email bodies, referring respectively to notification content and responses to feedback; no clear shared lexical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or phrase elements in titles
patterns.context: Elements near boundaries are marked in titles or author-affiliation text, with no consistent semantic or syntactic trigger.
patterns.domain: Philosophy paper titles and author affiliations

patterns.name: Fragments of immune-related molecule names
patterns.context: The marked portion occurs within the biomedical term “intercellular adhesion molecule”; however, the specific triggering fragment does not match the other segments.

11_1444.description: 激活分布在多种文体中，主要涉及词内标记，常见于以“-ization”结尾的词；另有邮件实词、标题边界成分及生物医学术语片段，难以用统一语义规律解释。

patterns.name: 英语词内含 “ization”
patterns.context: 被标记部分是以“-ization”或“ization”结尾的名词化词形；有的标记覆盖后缀，有的覆盖该词的其他部分，且 token 切分不一致。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目文本；另见计划通知邮件

patterns.name: 邮件中的重要信息词
patterns.context: 标记的是邮件正文中的实词，分别指通知内容和对意见作出反映；共同的词法触发条件不明显。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或短语成分
patterns.context: 标题或作者单位文字中标记边界附近的成分，未呈现一致的语义或句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文标题及作者单位

patterns.name: 免疫相关分子名称片段
patterns.context: 标记落在“intercellular adhesion molecule”这一生物医学术语内部；但具体触发片段与其他段并不吻合。

en.description: Activations occur in the segmented spellings of proper nouns, abbreviations, and medical terms, as well as in titles, repeated organization names, emphatic wording in emails, and document metadata; no single clear shared trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Capital-letter sequences in names, titles, or terms
patterns.context: Activations occur across multiple subword fragments of proper nouns, abbreviations, or technical terms; some fragments contain digits, hyphens, or slashes. The samples alone do not establish whether the trigger is tokenization boundaries, letter combinations, or the terms themselves.

patterns.name: Boundary between lowercase words and capitalized proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations occur at boundaries between common words and proper nouns, or between words in different capitalization forms; adjacent contexts include different capitalization forms of the same word stem.

patterns.name: Repeated title-style entity names
patterns.context: An organization name is repeated as an entry name after a line break, followed by the full company name or an abbreviation explanation.

patterns.name: Emphatic wording in formal emails
patterns.context: Business emails contain revision notes or important notifications to recipients; activations cover a range of common function and content words, with no clear fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Document metadata such as title, byline, and date
patterns.context: A short title is followed by a line break, then a weekday, date, and year; another example contains an academic paper title, authors, institution, date, and abstract label.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles/document metadata, academic paper front pages

11_1444.description: 激活见于专名、缩写及医学术语的分段拼写，也见于标题、重复机构名、邮件强调措辞和文档元数据；没有单一明确的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 名称、标题或术语中的大小写字母序列
patterns.context: 激活分布在专名、缩写或技术术语的多个子词片段中；有些片段包含数字、连字符或斜杠。单凭样本无法确定是分词边界、字母组合还是术语本身起作用。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、学术标题

patterns.name: 小写词与大写专名交界
patterns.context: 在普通词、专名或大小写形式的词交界处出现激活；包含同一词根不同大小写形式的相邻语境。

patterns.name: 重复的标题式实体名称
patterns.trigger: «All»iance for Open Society International»，其后再次出现 «All»iance for Open Society International»
patterns.context: 机构名称在换行后作为条目名称重复，并接续公司全称或缩写说明。

patterns.name: 正式邮件中的强调措辞
patterns.trigger: «Further» «changes» to «reflect» yours and Tracey's comments；«very important message»
patterns.context: 商务邮件中出现修改说明或面向收件人的重要通知；激活覆盖多种常见功能词和内容词，未见明确固定短语。

patterns.name: 标题、署名与日期等文档元数据
patterns.context: 短标题后换行，接着出现星期、日期和年份；另一例为学术论文标题、作者、机构、日期及摘要标签。
patterns.domain: 网页标题/文档元数据、学术论文首页

en.description: Activations favor document-layout markers formed by line breaks, blank lines, and visual separators, especially forwarded email headers, webpage link titles, and URLs; they also cover newsletter headings and PHP comment headers.

patterns.name: Title/email layout formed by line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around blank lines, line breaks, and visual separators between titles and body text; they typically occur around short titles, email paragraphs, or forwarded email headers.

patterns.name: Email forwarding headers and signature format
patterns.context: An email body is followed by a signature or a standard header indicating that someone forwarded it, containing slash-separated organizational paths, date, and time; the first segment has the style of a brief email notification.

patterns.name: Web links and preceding titles
patterns.context: News or discussion links following a line break; the title is usually a short English phrase, and the link often begins with a URL containing a domain and path.

patterns.name: Dated newsletter headings and news leads
patterns.context: A newsletter heading is followed by that day's news lead, date, and topic words.

patterns.name: PHP file headers and comment blocks
patterns.context: At the start of PHP source code, a comment banner made of asterisks follows the file header and precedes engine-related code.

11_1444.description: 激活偏向换行、空行和视觉分隔构成的文档布局标记，尤见邮件转发头、网页链接标题与URL；也覆盖简报标题和PHP注释头。

patterns.name: 换行与分隔符形成的标题/邮件布局
patterns.context: 激活集中在空行、换行及标题或正文之间的视觉分隔处；通常出现在短标题、邮件段落或转发邮件头周围。
patterns.domain: 邮件、链接聚合标题、代码文件

patterns.name: 邮件转发头与署名格式
patterns.context: 邮件正文后接署名或由某人转发的标准邮件头，含斜杠分隔的组织路径、日期和时间；第1段则是简短邮件通知样式。

patterns.name: 网页链接及其前置标题
patterns.context: 换行后的新闻或讨论链接，标题通常为英文短语，链接常以URL开头并带有域名和路径。

patterns.name: 带日期的简报标题与新闻导语
patterns.trigger: «Friday»«'s»« Daily»« P»«ulse»、«What»« you»« need»« to»« know»
patterns.context: 简报标题后接当日新闻导语、日期和主题词。

patterns.name: PHP文件头与注释块
patterns.context: PHP源码开头，文件头后以星号构成注释横幅并进入引擎相关代码。

en.description: Primarily responds to structural markers in source code or documents: HTML tags and section comments, as well as repeated equals-sign or hyphen separators after headings; also occurs on addiction-related terms, JavaScript grouping-wrapper code, and acknowledgment role labels, whose triggers do not fully match.

patterns.name: HTML document structure and section-separating comments
patterns.context: Near section boundaries, navigation bars, or data-like blocks formed by tags, anchors, and comments in code documentation or webpage HTML; [1] is Java class documentation, while the other segments are mostly webpage templates.
patterns.domain: HTML, JavaDoc, and webpage source on GitHub

patterns.name: Section headings with equals-sign or underscore separators
patterns.context: A heading or section name is followed by repeated equals signs or hyphens as a separator, often with a line break; examples include section headings in body text, paper abstract headings, and document titles.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, experimental materials lists, and structured documents

patterns.name: Addiction-related terms
patterns.context: An NIH project description discusses heroin addiction, curriculum design, and medical treatment; activations concentrate on disease/topic nouns.
patterns.domain: NIH grants and medical/public health texts

patterns.name: JavaScript grouping-wrapper code
patterns.context: A JavaScript code segment concatenates HTML strings and constructs grouping wrapper elements, with nearby variable assignments, tag strings, and closing control flow.

patterns.name: Role labels in acknowledgments
patterns.context: An acknowledgment or retrospective paragraph for a personal project first expresses thanks, then lists teachers' or mentors' names with role labels.

11_1444.concept: 结构化文档与代码标记
11_1444.description: 主要响应源码或文档中的结构标记：HTML 标签与章节注释，以及标题后重复等号/横线分隔；另见成瘾主题词、JavaScript 分组包装代码和致谢职务标签，触发条件并不完全相同。

patterns.name: HTML 文档结构与章节分隔注释
patterns.trigger: [1] «<!--» «========» «CON»«STRU»«CTOR»« SUMMARY»；[2–5] «<!--» «========» «START»« OF»« CLASS»« DATA»，以及 «END»« OF»« TOP»« NAV»«BAR»、«skip»«-»«navbar»；[3] 还包括 HTML 标签和注释中的 «//»«-->»
patterns.context: 代码文档或网页 HTML 中，尤其是标签、锚点和注释构成的章节边界、导航栏或类数据区块附近；[1] 为 Java 类文档，其他段多为网页模板。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML、JavaDoc 与网页源码

patterns.name: 等号下划线式章节标题
patterns.context: 标题或章节名后以重复等号或横线作分隔，常伴随换行；包括正文中的章节标题、论文摘要标题及文档标题。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、实验材料表及结构化文档

patterns.name: 成瘾主题词
patterns.context: NIH 项目描述中讨论海洛因成瘾、课程设计和医疗治疗；激活集中在疾病/主题名词上。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目与医学/公共卫生文本

patterns.name: JavaScript 分组包装代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 拼接 HTML 字符串并构造分组包装元素的代码段，附近有变量赋值、标签字符串和控制流闭合。

patterns.name: 致谢中的人名职务标签
patterns.context: 个人项目致谢或回顾段落，先表达感谢，再以职务标签列出教师或导师姓名。

en.description: Activations span email formatting, code comments and import paths, materials science, and medical/public health texts; no clear semantic theme runs across all corpora. Punctuation/formatting tokens are especially prominent in code paths and email separators.

patterns.name: Spaces and separators in email headers
patterns.context: An email body is followed by a signature, names/email addresses in the email header, and date/time fields; activations concentrate on spaces, line breaks, and punctuation and are not necessarily triggered by semantic words.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and email header formatting

patterns.name: C/C++ comments and path filenames
patterns.context: Directory/file paths or filenames separated by slashes occur in C/C++ source code comments.
patterns.domain: GitHub; C/C++ comments, header files, or source file paths

patterns.name: Go import statements and package paths
patterns.context: The package/import section of a Go file, especially quoted import paths separated by slashes and periods.

patterns.name: Time fields in email headers
patterns.context: A time-like fragment before an email quotation signature, followed by a contact and email header; the marked span is very short and may relate to email formatting rather than time semantics.

patterns.name: Nanoporous coordination polymer terminology
patterns.context: An academic abstract describing material preparation, adsorption properties, and controllable nano-/microporous structures.

patterns.name: Cross-species influenza virus reassortment terminology
patterns.context: A research description discussing avian and human influenza genes, viral reassortment, and internal genes.

patterns.name: Health behaviors and obesity risk factors
patterns.context: In a risk-factor statement, listing insufficient physical activity, unhealthy diet, and overweight/obesity.

patterns.name: Mathematical software project paths
patterns.context: A MathJax project directory-style path appears in a GitHub comment; it resembles general C/C++ file paths in form but contains a specific project name.

11_1444.description: 激活跨邮件格式、代码注释与导入路径、材料科学及医学公共卫生文本；没有贯穿所有语料的明确语义主题，代码路径和邮件分隔符中标点/格式 token 尤其突出。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的空格与分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文后接署名、邮件头中的姓名/邮箱及日期时间字段；激活集中于空格、换行和标点，未必由语义词触发。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件头格式

patterns.name: C/C++ 注释与路径文件名
patterns.context: C/C++ 源码注释中出现以斜杠分隔的目录/文件路径或文件名。
patterns.domain: GitHub；C/C++ 注释、头文件或源文件路径

patterns.name: Go 导入语句及包路径
patterns.context: Go 文件的 package/import 区域，尤其引号包围、以斜杠和点号分隔的导入路径。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的时间字段
patterns.context: 邮件引文署名之前的时间样式片段，后续跟着联系人和邮件头；标记范围很短，可能与邮件格式而非时间语义有关。

patterns.name: 纳米孔配位聚合物术语
patterns.context: 描述材料制备、吸附性质及可控纳米/微孔结构的学术摘要。

patterns.name: 跨物种流感病毒重配术语
patterns.context: 讨论禽流感与人流感基因、病毒重配及内部基因的研究描述。

patterns.name: 健康行为与肥胖风险因素
patterns.context: 以风险因素陈述为语境，列举体力活动不足、不健康饮食和超重/肥胖。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter；公共卫生/流行病学

patterns.name: 数学软件项目路径
patterns.context: GitHub 注释中出现 MathJax 项目目录式路径；与一般 C/C++ 文件路径有形式相似性，但这里是特定项目名称。

en.description: Covers loop indices, Go imports, configuration key-value pairs, email headers, HTML metadata, hardware inventories, and LaTeX commands in code; the shared feature is structural markers, fields, and separators in structured text.

patterns.name: C/C++ loops and index access
patterns.context: Code contains loop counters, array or pointer indexing, conditional checks, and item-by-item processing; indentation and bracket structures are common.

patterns.name: Go test files and import declarations
patterns.context: The package declaration and grouped import section of Go source code.

patterns.name: Key-value pairs and Boolean fields in structured configuration
patterns.context: Comma-separated fields, numbers, or Boolean values in a mapping/configuration-like structure.
patterns.domain: Code or configuration snippets on StackExchange

patterns.name: Email headers and MIME metadata
patterns.context: In email or HTTP-style headers, field names and colons are adjacent to media-type/charset values.
patterns.domain: Text or request data on Github; Enron email headers

patterns.name: HTML document headers
patterns.context: Comments, meta tags, and attributes in the HTML head section.

patterns.name: Hardware specification inventory
patterns.context: Device categories and model/specification values listed in space-aligned columns after colons.
patterns.domain: Computer configuration inventory in Enron emails

patterns.name: LaTeX Beamer titles and overlay commands
patterns.context: In a LaTeX presentation, a frame title contains an overlay command and angle-bracket parameters.

11_1444.description: 涵盖代码中的循环索引、Go 导入、配置键值、邮件头、HTML 元数据、硬件清单及 LaTeX 命令；共同点偏向结构化文本中的标记、字段和分隔符。

patterns.name: C/C++循环与索引访问
patterns.context: 代码中出现循环计数器、数组或指针索引、条件判断及逐项处理；常见缩进和括号结构。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: Go 测试文件与导入声明
patterns.context: Go 源码的包声明和分组导入区。

patterns.name: 结构化配置中的键值与布尔字段
patterns.context: 以逗号分隔的字段、数值或布尔值，含类似映射/配置项的结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的代码或配置片段

patterns.name: 邮件头与 MIME 元数据
patterns.context: 邮件头或 HTTP 风格头部中，字段名、冒号和媒体类型/字符集值相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 中的文本或请求数据；Enron 邮件头

patterns.name: HTML 文档头部
patterns.context: HTML head 区域中的注释、meta 标签及属性。

patterns.name: 硬件规格清单
patterns.context: 冒号后以空格对齐列出的设备类别与型号/规格。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的电脑配置清单

patterns.name: LaTeX Beamer 标题与覆盖命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 演示文稿中，帧标题包含覆盖层命令和尖括号参数。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 LaTeX 示例

en.description: Activations concentrate on contrast/alternative arguments introduced by sentence-initial “Instead” (2, 4, 7, 8, 9); they also cover code operations, build paths and configuration, conversational correction suggestions, and identity-based access control discussions.

patterns.name: Prefix decrement, shifts, and pointer-update code
patterns.context: In C/C++-style code, variable names, operators, numbers, and pointer increments are interleaved, involving shifts and memory operations.

patterns.name: Build and dependency configuration paths
patterns.context: Build arguments, library directories, Maven plugin coordinates, and XML file paths in command lines or configuration files; fragments in paths and punctuation are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: Github build logs/configuration; StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Instead contrast
patterns.context: After rejecting a previous proposal or view, English discourse uses sentence-initial “Instead” to introduce an alternative explanation or approach; commas are also often activated.

patterns.name: Direct corrections or suggestions in dialogue
patterns.context: Informal suggestions, corrections, or product-positioning discussions addressed to a reader or conversation partner; some examples also contain sentence-initial Instead.

patterns.name: Identity recognition and network access control
patterns.context: Discusses the identifiability of internet users and websites' use of blacklists, whitelists, and other access controls based on that identity.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions of online identity and privacy

11_1444.description: 激活集中在句首“Instead”引出的转折/替代论述（2、4、7、8、9）；另覆盖代码运算、构建路径与配置、对话式纠错建议及身份访问控制讨论。

patterns.name: 前缀递减、位移与指针更新代码
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，变量名、运算符、数字与指针递增交织，涉及位移和内存操作。

patterns.name: 构建与依赖配置路径
patterns.context: 命令行或配置文件中的构建参数、库目录、Maven 插件坐标及 XML 文件路径；路径和标点中的片段尤其突出。
patterns.domain: Github 构建日志/配置；StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 句首 Instead 转折
patterns.context: 英语论述在反驳前述方案或观点后，以句首“Instead”引出替代解释或做法；逗号也常有激活。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 对话体中的直接纠正或建议
patterns.trigger: «no»4...everyone else was wrong、«you can»4« directly»1« buy»4...、«you»2«'ll»5« probably»2« want»3
patterns.context: 面向读者或对话对象的非正式建议、纠错或产品定位讨论；部分例子同样含句首 Instead。

patterns.name: 身份识别与网络访问控制
patterns.context: 讨论互联网用户身份可识别性，以及网站据此执行黑名单、白名单等访问控制。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 关于网络身份与隐私的论述

en.concept: Features of multi-domain text and code fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across various code boundaries, identifier fragments, and English function words, and also occur in technology URLs, research aims, clinical recommendations, statistical groupings, customer-service conditions, and training promotions; no single stable semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Punctuation and code boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at boundary positions such as commas, parentheses, line breaks, and indentation in Java, C/C++ code, or command-line snippets; some activations fall directly on these symbols.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments and code identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur when code identifiers are split into multiple subword fragments, especially underscore-separated names and Kustomize-related word forms.

patterns.name: Scientific and technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in a URL pointing to Quantum Computing Stack Exchange, with activations concentrated on topic words and their subwords.
patterns.domain: Technology discussions and URLs in HackerNews

patterns.name: English conjunctions and function words
patterns.context: In conversational posts, multiple adjacent function words are activated near conditional or contrastive expressions; “than” also activates in comparative constructions.

patterns.name: Research purpose and objective statements
patterns.context: Occurs when research papers introduce their purpose, specific objectives, or questions to be answered, especially in sentences introducing a list of objectives.

patterns.name: Clinical decision-making and prevention support
patterns.context: Describes how tools support clinical decision-making, preventive care, and referral or community support for high-risk children.

patterns.name: Training service promotion and inquiries
patterns.context: Introduces optional corporate training services and ends with a request for more information or a call to action to get in touch.

patterns.name: Research or clinical recommendation phrasing
patterns.context: When discussing heart-failure risk groups, introduces dietary management guidelines from the government or professional societies as a starting point for recommendations.

patterns.name: Statistical groups and academic categories
patterns.context: Reports smoking rates and compares groups by age, school type, and other categories.

patterns.name: Certification and customer-service conditions
patterns.context: Discusses certification paths and future customer-service rules, centered on a condition like “if not certified by us.”

patterns.name: Exception handling and numeric parameters in code
patterns.context: Java code contains autogenerated exception handling, numeric writes, and function parameters; activations are distributed across code words and nearby parameters.

patterns.name: Embedded debugging and delays
patterns.context: A delay call follows a hardware debugging log, with a nearby Chinese comment explaining that it waits for data transmission to complete.

11_1444.concept: 多领域文本与代码片段特征
11_1444.description: 激活分布于多种代码边界、标识符碎片及英文功能词，也涉及科技网址、科研目的、临床建议、统计分组、客服条件和培训宣传；未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 标点及代码边界
patterns.context: 在 Java、C/C++ 代码或命令行片段中，逗号、括号、换行和缩进等边界位置出现激活；部分激活落在这些符号本身。

patterns.name: 分词碎片与代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码标识符被切分为多个子词时有激活，尤其是下划线分隔的名称及 Kustomize 相关词形。

patterns.name: 科学技术词汇
patterns.context: 出现在指向量子计算 Stack Exchange 的网址中，激活集中于主题词及其子词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中的科技讨论与网址

patterns.name: 英文连接与功能词
patterns.context: 在口语化帖子中，条件或转折表达附近出现多个相邻功能词激活；另有“than”等词在比较结构中激活。

patterns.name: 研究目的与目标陈述
patterns.trigger: « purpose»、« study»、« specifically»、« objectives»、« answer»、« following»
patterns.context: 研究论文介绍研究目的、具体目标或待回答问题时出现，尤其在引出目标列表的句子中。

patterns.name: 临床决策与预防支持
patterns.trigger: « inform»、« support»、« clinician»、« preventive»、« involving»、« community»
patterns.context: 描述工具如何支持临床人员决策、预防护理及对高风险儿童的转介或社区支持。

patterns.name: 培训服务宣传与询问
patterns.trigger: « more»、« Ask»、« for»、« details»、« about»、« sending»
patterns.context: 介绍企业可选培训服务，并以询问详情或联系行动号召收尾。

patterns.name: 研究或临床建议措辞
patterns.context: 讨论心衰风险人群时，引出政府或专业学会的膳食管理指南作为建议起点。

patterns.name: 统计分组与学术类别
patterns.context: 报告吸烟率，并按年龄、学校类型等群体分类比较。

patterns.name: 认证与客服条件表达
patterns.trigger: « At»、« least»、« stick»、« to»、« by»、« us»
patterns.context: 讨论认证路线及未来客服处理规则，以“如果未由我们认证”一类条件为核心。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理与数值参数
patterns.context: Java 代码包含自动生成的异常处理、数值写入及函数参数；激活分布在代码词和参数附近。

patterns.name: 嵌入式调试与延时
patterns.context: 硬件调试日志后接延时调用，且附近有中文注释说明等待数据发送完成。
patterns.domain: Github 嵌入式 C 代码

en.concept: Expressions of specific actions and operations
en.description: Activations concentrate on several local word forms and constructions: retrospective analysis/review in medical research, obligation structures with to do/use/go in technical explanations, and distinct collocations such as Bluetooth code, manually provided in patents, and scanned/sort in book apps.

patterns.name: Retrospective research narratives
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in medical research methods or abstracts, often alongside records, patient charts, or other research materials.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, PubMed abstracts, and PMC articles

patterns.name: Obligation constructions in programming instructions
patterns.context: In descriptions of operations, functions, or steps, to do/use/go infinitive constructions are prominent, especially in combination with expressions such as without and no longer.
patterns.domain: Technical tutorials, software, and device instructions

patterns.name: Bluetooth device identifier code
patterns.context: Near device variable names and MAC address interpolation in C# asynchronous Bluetooth device discovery code.

patterns.name: Manually provided information/address
patterns.context: Discusses directing information to a known storage address in a complex system, contrasting manually supplied addresses with subsequent access.

patterns.name: Book organization and retrieval
patterns.context: Introduces the core features of a book app and actions after scanning or searching for books.

11_1444.description: 激活集中于若干局部词形与句式：医学研究中的回顾性分析/审阅，技术说明中的 to do/use/go 义务结构，以及蓝牙代码、专利中的 manually provided 和图书应用中的 scanned/sort 等各自特定搭配。

patterns.name: 回顾性研究叙述
patterns.context: 触发词出现在医学研究方法或摘要中，常伴随病历、患者记录或图表等研究材料。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、PubMed 摘要及 PMC 文章

patterns.name: 编程说明中的义务结构
patterns.trigger: «to»10« do»8« any»10；«to»10« use»6；«to»9« go»5；«without»5« ever»8« having»6
patterns.context: 在说明操作、功能或步骤时，突出 to do/use/go 等不定式结构，尤其与 without、no longer 等表达组合。
patterns.domain: 技术教程、软件与设备说明

patterns.name: 蓝牙设备标识符代码
patterns.context: C# 异步蓝牙设备发现代码中，设备变量名及 MAC 地址插值附近。

patterns.name: 手动提供信息/地址
patterns.context: 讨论复杂系统中将信息导向已知存储地址，并对比人工提供地址与后续访问。

patterns.name: 图书整理与检索
patterns.context: 介绍图书应用的核心功能及扫描或搜索书籍后的操作。

en.concept: Fragmented word forms and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across multi/multiplex word forms, code and identifier fragments, medical research/data collection, and storage allocation terminology; there are also sporadic names in links, negation contractions, and function words near sentence boundaries, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: multi- / multiplex forms in technical vocabulary
patterns.context: Technical descriptions contain multi-related word forms or discuss multiple devices/tasks; however, the trigger position is not always a complete word
patterns.domain: Computing, electronic engineering, and mobile operating systems

patterns.name: Structured identifiers and code fragments in technical documents
patterns.context: Machine-generated or structured strings such as code, configuration, URLs, hashes, or paper citations; activations often fall on digits, punctuation, or split identifiers
patterns.domain: Code, API configuration, and academic paper citations

patterns.name: Medical research and data collection statements
patterns.context: Describes medical institutions, research methods, or the process of gathering data from survey participants

patterns.name: Storage capacity and resource allocation statements
patterns.context: Discusses write-triggered storage allocation, logical volume capacity, or reducing actual storage usage

patterns.name: Marshall/McLuhan strings in proper nouns
patterns.context: Names and domain paths in PDF transcript links, with activations on split spellings of names
patterns.domain: Web links, posts related to interview or speech transcripts

patterns.name: don't in expressions of negation or difficulty
patterns.context: Informal negation contraction occurring when discussing the absence of a DOM or the infeasibility of a method

patterns.name: Incomplete sentence openings and general function words
patterns.context: Near paragraph truncations or line breaks, triggers fall on common function words or boundary tokens, with no stable semantic condition

patterns.name: Unexplained fragments of medical citation numbers
patterns.context: Digits and hyphens in paper citation identifiers are split and activated; it is unclear whether citation formatting or the identifier content is responsible

11_1444.concept: 技术文本中的碎片化词形与标识符
11_1444.description: 激活分散于技术文本中的 multi/multiplex 词形、代码与标识符碎片、医学研究/数据收集，以及存储分配术语；另有零散人名链接、否定缩写和句界虚词，未显示统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 技术词汇中的 multi- / multiplex 词形
patterns.context: 技术描述中出现 multi- 相关词形，或讨论多个设备/任务；但触发位置并不总是完整单词
patterns.domain: 计算机、电子工程及移动操作系统

patterns.name: 技术文档中的结构化标识符与代码碎片
patterns.context: 代码、配置、URL、哈希或论文引用等机器生成/结构化字符串；激活常落在数字、标点或被拆分的标识符上
patterns.domain: 代码、API 配置及学术论文引用

patterns.name: 医学研究与数据收集语句
patterns.context: 描述医疗机构、研究方法或调查参与者与数据收集流程
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 存储容量与资源分配表述
patterns.context: 讨论写入触发的存储分配、逻辑卷容量或降低实际存储占用
patterns.domain: 专利背景、存储系统技术文本

patterns.name: 专有名词中的 Marshall/McLuhan 字符串
patterns.context: PDF transcript 链接中的姓名及域名路径，激活落在被拆分的人名拼写上
patterns.domain: 网页链接、访谈或演讲转录相关帖子

patterns.name: 否定或困难度表达中的 don't
patterns.context: 谈及缺少 DOM、某种方法不可行时出现的口语否定缩写

patterns.name: 残缺句首与一般功能词
patterns.context: 段落截断或换行附近，触发落在常见虚词或边界 token 上，未见稳定语义条件

patterns.name: 解释不清的医疗引用编号碎片
patterns.context: 论文引用标识中数字与连字符被拆分激活；无法确定是引用格式还是编号内容起作用

en.description: Activations occur across underscore identifiers, periods/URLs, code assignments, and hyphens, as well as English function words, apostrophes in contractions, and informal text. There is no single stable semantic trigger; the pattern looks more like a mixed response to punctuation and tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Underscores and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs inside code identifiers or at identifier boundaries, often adjacent to function calls, member names, or type names; no specific programming language is required to trigger it.

patterns.name: Function words and phrase transitions in technical prose
patterns.context: In continuous English medical abstracts, triggers are scattered across narrative sentences and descriptions of research methods, rather than tied to a specific medical term.

patterns.name: Hyphens in measurement terminology
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compound modifiers in research descriptions of pediatric assessment measures.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in URLs, domains, or links containing URLs; this passage also includes a product name.

patterns.name: Period-separated names in exceptions or proper nouns
patterns.context: Multiple periods connect namespaces, type names, or hostnames; activations are distributed across several fragments in the diagnostic line.

patterns.name: Possessives and contraction boundaries in informal English
patterns.context: Informal English in forums or comments; activations fall on apostrophe-related token fragments.

patterns.name: Python argument assignments and keyword arguments
patterns.context: Inside function-call parentheses, an argument name is followed by an equals sign and a value; the code line also contains commas, dictionaries, and newline indentation.

11_1444.description: 激活散见于下划线标识符、点号/网址、代码赋值与连字符，也出现在英文虚词、缩写撇号及口语文本；没有单一稳定语义触发，更多像对若干标点和分词边界的混合响应。

patterns.name: 代码中的下划线与标识符片段
patterns.trigger: «_»、«_»后接函数名或变量名片段，如 «_»5ogg«_»1free«(»、«_»4«pe»、«_»5«io»
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符内部或标识符边界，常与函数调用、成员名或类型名相邻；触发并不要求具体语言。

patterns.name: 技术文段中的虚词与短语衔接
patterns.trigger: «To»、« a»、« of»、« the»、« in»、« over»、« were» 等常见词，及 «more developed areas»
patterns.context: 连续英文医学摘要中，触发散布于叙述句和研究方法介绍，并非某个特定医学术语。

patterns.name: 测量术语中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合修饰语，出现在儿童评估指标的研究描述中。

patterns.name: 网络地址与域名片段
patterns.context: 出现在网址、域名或包含网址的链接中；本段同时有产品名称。

patterns.name: 异常或专有名称中的点号分隔
patterns.context: 多个点号连接的命名空间、类型名或主机名；激活分布在该诊断信息行的若干片段。

patterns.name: 口语英文中的所有格与缩写边界
patterns.context: 论坛或评论中的非正式英文；激活落在撇号相关的分词片段上。

patterns.name: Python 参数赋值与关键字参数
patterns.context: 函数调用括号内，参数名后接等号和值；代码行还含逗号、字典和换行缩进。

en.concept: Proper nouns and markers in technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of technical text, most prominently code identifiers, URLs, academic citations, and medical/scientific terminology; numbers, formula symbols, code keywords, and Portuguese strings also occur. The shared trigger mechanism across passages is not entirely clear.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and camel-case code
patterns.context: Mixed-case identifiers, type names, function names, or keys occur in code, logs, or JSON configuration; activations often fall on internal identifier fragments.
patterns.domain: Software development, debugging logs, and configuration text

patterns.name: URLs and domain paths
patterns.context: URL, domain, or URL path components, including code strings and Markdown links.
patterns.domain: Code, web links, and online discussions

patterns.name: Literature citations and reference numbers
patterns.context: Academic text with bracketed citations at sentence ends or within sentences; activation may also occur on numbers near citations.

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Disease, exposure, clinical trial, imaging, or research terminology in medical or biomedical discussion; some activations fall on terms or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numbers and scientific measurement symbols in text
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and Greek letters embedded in trial identifiers, citation numbers, formulas, or figure captions; no independent semantic trigger condition can be determined.

patterns.name: General code syntax and English keywords
patterns.context: Code keywords or ordinary English words in technical contexts; partly overlaps with identifier patterns, but the triggering role of these words themselves is uncertain.

patterns.name: Portuguese strings in code
patterns.context: String literals such as database or collection names in JavaScript examples.

11_1444.concept: 技术文本中的专名与标记
11_1444.description: 激活分布于多类技术文本：代码标识符、URL、学术引用及医学/科学术语最突出；另有数字、公式符号、代码关键字和葡萄牙语字符串。不同段的共同触发机制不完全明确。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与驼峰式代码
patterns.context: 代码、日志或 JSON 配置中出现大小写混合的标识符、类型名、函数名或键名；激活常落在标识符内部片段上。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、调试日志与配置文本

patterns.name: URL及域名路径
patterns.context: 网址、域名或 URL 路径成分；包括代码字符串和 Markdown 链接。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页链接与网络讨论

patterns.name: 文献引用与参考文献编号
patterns.context: 学术文本中句末或句中带方括号的文献标注；也可能在引用附近的数字上激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与医学/科学文献

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学论述中出现疾病、暴露物、临床试验、成像或研究术语；部分激活落在术语或缩写上。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究与生物医学

patterns.name: 文中数字与科学计量符号
patterns.context: 数字、字母和希腊字母嵌在试验编号、引用编号、公式或图表说明中；无法确定其独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 一般代码语法与英文关键词
patterns.context: 代码关键字或普通英文词在技术语境中出现；与标识符模式部分重叠，但这些词自身的触发作用不确定。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语代码字符串
patterns.context: JavaScript 示例中的数据库名或集合名等字符串常量。

en.description: Most samples concern technology and computing, including code/API, devices, and software descriptions, alongside medical risk-factor lists and Q&A advice. Activation locations are nonspecific and include body words, identifiers, proper nouns, numbers, and punctuation; the annotation syntax itself may create an apparent commonality.

patterns.name: Explicit highlighting or markup syntax
patterns.context: The context consists of token-by-token annotations. Trigger locations are not limited to words: ordinary prose, code, punctuation, and numbers may all be marked. This may be an artifact of the data display format.
patterns.domain: Annotation format across all corpus excerpts

patterns.name: Electronics, software, and programming topics
patterns.context: Involves applications, computer hardware, embedded devices, interfaces, or code implementation; some examples are tutorial or Q&A prose, others are program code.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, programming Q&A, encyclopedias, and tutorials

patterns.name: APIs, code identifiers, and program syntax
patterns.context: Function names, types, parameters, member access, or identifiers occur in code or API contexts; code identifiers may also be split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Operating advice for specific devices or peripherals
patterns.context: Q&A about using an expander to drive LEDs, finding example code, or connecting Raspberry Pi peripherals.

patterns.name: Instructional language and step-by-step tutorials
patterns.context: Presented as steps, recommendations, or reader-oriented instructions, including software setup and suggestions to consult documentation or obtain a name.

patterns.name: Risk-factor lists for specific diseases
patterns.context: Medical discussion of CTS enumerates possible associated risk factors in a noun-list construction; this is unrelated to the other technical topics.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, paths, and web references
patterns.context: URLs, software/platform names, place names, or hardware proper nouns occur in prose or around code; sometimes adjacent to links and version information.
patterns.domain: Web pages, GitHub, encyclopedias, and documentation

patterns.name: Numbers in identifiers, addresses, or version numbers
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in code parameters, web links, historical years, or hardware quantities; their semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Code, web references, historical narrative, and hardware documentation

11_1444.description: 样本多为技术与计算机相关内容，涵盖代码/API、设备和软件说明，也有医学风险因素列表及问答建议。激活落点不专一，包含正文词、标识符、专名、数字与标点；标注语法本身可能造成表面共性。

patterns.name: 显式高亮或标记语法
patterns.trigger: «token»k 这种带尖括号的激活标记；片段内部也出现「« [»」「«29»」「«:»」等被标记的标点或数字
patterns.context: 上下文由逐 token 标注构成，触发位置并不局限于词语，普通正文、代码、标点和数字都可能被标记；这可能是数据展示格式造成的伪模式。
patterns.domain: 全部语料片段的标注格式

patterns.name: 电子设备、软件与编程主题
patterns.context: 涉及应用程序、计算机硬件、嵌入式设备、接口或代码实现；有些例子是教程或问答正文，有些是程序代码。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、编程问答、百科与教程

patterns.name: API、代码标识符和程序语法
patterns.context: 代码或 API 语境中出现函数名、类型、参数、成员访问或标识符；代码标识符内部也可能被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 特定器件或外设的操作建议
patterns.trigger: 「I²C port expander」「sample code」「raspberry pi」「16 LEDS per chip」「8 chips」「multiplexing」
patterns.context: 问答中讨论用扩展器驱动 LED、查找示例代码或连接树莓派外设。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 硬件/电子制作问答

patterns.name: 操作说明和分步教程措辞
patterns.trigger: 「Step 1: Setting Up the Software」「latest version」「easier to program」「First get the name」
patterns.context: 以步骤、建议或面向读者的操作指引呈现；包括软件设置以及先查阅文档、获取名称等建议。

patterns.name: 特定疾病的风险因素罗列
patterns.trigger: 「advanced age」「repetitive use of hand and wrist」「obesity」「pregnancy」「diabetes mellitus」等
patterns.context: CTS 的医学论述中枚举可能相关的风险因素，句式为名词性列表；不属于其他技术主题。

patterns.name: 专名、路径及网页引用
patterns.context: 正文或代码周围出现 URL、软件/平台名、地名或硬件专名；有时与链接和版本信息相邻。

patterns.name: 标识符中的数字、地址或版本数字
patterns.context: 数字嵌在代码参数、网页链接、历史年份或硬件数量中；所处语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页引用、历史叙述与硬件说明

en.concept: Descriptions of processes and resource requirements
en.description: Common in research methods describing literature searches, data collection, and examination procedures; also occurs in technical text, especially descriptions of resource needs, hardware/software configurations, and solution capabilities. Cross-domain commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: Literature searches in systematic reviews
patterns.context: Describes searching literature, databases, or related publications in the methods section of a medical abstract or systematic review; the key trigger is “literature search,” strongly activated in both passages.

patterns.name: Standardized procedural descriptions in medical methods
patterns.context: Details procedures such as patient history, physical examination, interviews, or data collection in a methods section; a literature search need not be mentioned.

patterns.name: Negation and degree expressions
patterns.context: Describes required or unnecessary resources such as software, hardware, or infrastructure; activations fall on negation words or terms indicating degree of need.

patterns.name: Technical solutions and device capabilities
patterns.context: Introduces the purpose, configuration, and capabilities of software, imaging devices, computers, or modules; different texts involve GIS, HIFU, Qubes, and IoT.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, project abstracts, online discussions

11_1444.description: 常见于研究方法中描述文献检索、数据收集及检查流程；也见于技术文本，尤其资源需求、软硬件配置与方案能力说明。跨领域共同规律不够明确。

patterns.name: 系统综述中的文献检索
patterns.context: 在医学摘要或系统综述方法部分，描述检索文献、数据库或相关出版物；关键触发是“literature search”，且该短语在两段中强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、循证医学综述

patterns.name: 医学方法部分的规范化流程叙述
patterns.context: 研究方法部分中，交代患者病史、体格检查、访谈或数据收集等具体流程；不要求出现文献检索。

patterns.name: 否定词及程度表达
patterns.context: 描述所需或不需要的软件、硬件、基础设施等资源；激活落在否定词之后或需求程度词上。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、技术讨论、教程

patterns.name: 技术方案与设备能力描述
patterns.context: 介绍软件、成像设备、计算机或模块的用途、配置与能力；不同文本中涉及 GIS、HIFU、Qubes、IoT。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、项目摘要、网络讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across cautious review in professional texts, comprehensive materials, degree and quantity expressions, age groups, electronics Q&A, and local segmentation of technical terms; there is no single clear semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Thorough review and careful handling
patterns.context: Describes collecting medical history, conducting an examination, or reviewing evidence, records, and case facts; often occurs in procedural narratives.

patterns.name: Detailed, comprehensive descriptions or materials
patterns.context: When introducing guidelines, materials, products, or writing, emphasizes broad coverage, full functionality, or abundant information.
patterns.domain: Product marketing, online discussions, nutrition papers

patterns.name: Increase in degree or quantity; higher levels
patterns.context: Compares levels, describes quantities, or emphasizes exceeding a threshold; the specific meaning varies by context.
patterns.domain: Medical research, history of technology, legal argument

patterns.name: Age groups and developmental stages
patterns.context: Organizes information by age group, followed by discussion of growth charts and child health checks.

patterns.name: Device parameters, noise, and power supply discussion
patterns.context: Q&A about a microphone amplifier circuit, noting omitted power-supply information and discussing noise effects.

patterns.name: Local word forms or tokenization in technical terms
patterns.context: Technical terms are split at token boundaries; fragments concern GIS software, forensic medicine, clinical assessment, and fax technology, with no shared semantic condition evident.

11_1444.description: 激活分散于专业文本中的审慎审查、全面资料、程度数量表达，以及年龄分组、电子电路问答和专业词的局部切分；没有单一清晰的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 彻底审查与审慎处理
patterns.trigger: « carefully»10« taken»；« thoroughly»9« reviewed»；« after»6« reviewing»7« the»8« medical»10« evidence»
patterns.context: 描述收集病史、体检或审阅证据、记录和案情；常出现在程序性叙述中。

patterns.name: 详尽、全面的说明或资料
patterns.trigger: « comprehensive»；« extensive»9« scientific»8« data»；« fully»5« functional»
patterns.context: 介绍指南、资料、产品或写作内容时，强调覆盖充分、功能完整或资料丰富。
patterns.domain: 产品宣传、网络讨论、营养学论文

patterns.name: 程度或数量的增加、较高水平
patterns.trigger: « higher»1« frequency and severity»；« millions»；« more» than« sufficiently»
patterns.context: 比较水平、描述数量或强调超过某阈值；具体含义随语境变化。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、技术史、法律论证

patterns.name: 年龄分组与成长阶段
patterns.trigger: « Birth»«-»«35 years»；« 6-12 years, 13-18 years»；« Growing up»
patterns.context: 按年龄段组织信息，随后谈生长曲线及儿童健康检查。

patterns.name: 器件参数、噪声及电源讨论
patterns.trigger: « The bias resistor»；« noise»；« power supply»；« You»4« haven»5«'t»10« mentioned»
patterns.context: 针对麦克风放大电路的问答，指出遗漏的电源信息并讨论噪声影响。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的局部词形或断词
patterns.context: 专业词汇在 token 边界被切分；片段主题分别是 GIS 软件、司法医学、临床评估和传真技术，未见共同语义条件。

en.description: Strong activations fall on diverse local words or subwords: no, doctor, health, carefully, the drug-name fragment trim, physician, documentary/was, and the low and hospital prefixes in compound words. Contexts span software, medicine, law, and technology, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Negation word no
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “requires no other software” describing software requirements; the word itself has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Doctor-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in a description of children’s growth charts for doctors to review during visits; the specific trigger is doctor.

patterns.name: Healthcare word form
patterns.context: Occurs in the hyphenated “health-care”; activation falls on health, not care.

patterns.name: Medical records and examination wording
patterns.context: Modifies medical history taking; the same sentence also concerns history, medication, and physical examination, but the prominent activation falls on carefully.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment trim
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the combination antibiotic name “trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole”; the drug name is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Physician-patient phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the compound expression “physician-patient visits,” with strong activation on physician.

patterns.name: Evidence terminology
patterns.context: A court ruling argues that the damages amount lacks documentary evidence; strong activation falls on documentary and the following was.

patterns.name: Description of low-cost computing devices
patterns.context: Modifies an inexpensive single-board computer; strong activation falls on the hyphen token between low and priced in low-priced.

patterns.name: Survey research design terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in the research-design phrase “hospital-based and population-based cross-sectional.”

11_1444.description: 强激活落在多种局部词项或子词上：no、doctor、health、carefully、药名片段trim、physician、documentary/was，以及low和hospital复合词前缀。语境横跨软件、医学、法律与科技，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 否定词 no
patterns.context: 出现在描述软件使用要求的短语“requires no other software”中；该词本身激活最强。

patterns.name: 医生相关词语
patterns.context: 出现在儿童生长图表供医生就诊时查看的说明中；具体触发点是 doctor。

patterns.name: healthcare 词形
patterns.context: 出现在连字符连接的“health-care”中；激活落在 health 部分，而不是 care。

patterns.name: 医疗记录与检查措辞
patterns.context: 修饰病史采集；同句还涉及病史、用药及体格检查，但突出激活落在 carefully。

patterns.name: 药名片段 trim
patterns.context: 出现在抗生素复方药名“trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole”的开头；药名被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 医患关系词组
patterns.context: 出现在“physician-patient visits”这一复合表达中，强激活位于 physician 部分。

patterns.name: 证据词汇
patterns.context: 法院判决论证赔偿金额缺乏文件证据；强激活落在 documentary 和其后 was。

patterns.name: 低价计算设备描述
patterns.context: 修饰低价单板计算机；强激活位于 low-priced 中 low 与 priced 之间的连字符 token。

patterns.name: 调查研究设计词汇
patterns.context: 出现在“hospital-based and population-based cross-sectional”研究设计表述中。

en.description: The most stable formal cue is hyphens and the compounds they connect, especially research design, treatment, and management terminology in medical abstracts; a CSS background property and a few other contexts, including technical, scientific, and health-disclaimer text, also occur.

patterns.name: CSS background properties and values
patterns.context: Occurs in CSS declarations, especially coordinate lists for background positioning and repeated settings.

patterns.name: Hyphens in compound words
patterns.context: Hyphens connect compound modifiers or phrases, common in academic text; also occurs in code/technical text.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, technical text, and general professional writing

patterns.name: Medical study design and cohort descriptions
patterns.context: Describes study location, sample source, or study design, often alongside methods, participants, or statistical analysis.

patterns.name: Medical scales and treatment adherence
patterns.context: Discusses development or evaluation of patient-reported outcome measures and barriers to treatment adherence.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, especially patient outcomes and treatment adherence research

patterns.name: Compound drug names in medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in pharmacological contexts contrasting antiepileptic and non-antiepileptic drugs.

patterns.name: Medical quality measures and hospital management
patterns.context: Discusses the development of or consensus on hospital pain management and quality measures.

patterns.name: Computing resources and AI applications
patterns.context: Describes large-scale computing resource needs and tasks such as speech and image processing, virtual assistants, and autonomous driving.
patterns.domain: Technical introductions or popular computer science text

patterns.name: Diabetes prevention and evidence-based management
patterns.context: Lists diabetes prevention and control strategies, screening, monitoring, and diagnostic tools.

patterns.name: Research cores and data processing workflows
patterns.context: Explains the responsibilities of a research platform or core facility in measuring metabolites, processing data, and reanalyzing archived data.

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer and physician-patient relationship
patterns.context: Occurs in a disclaimer stating that the content does not constitute diagnosis, treatment advice, or a physician-patient relationship, and advising readers to consult a doctor.

11_1444.description: 最稳定的形式线索是连字符及其连接的复合词，尤其是医学摘要中的研究设计、治疗与管理术语；另有CSS背景属性和技术、科研、健康免责声明等少数不同语境。

patterns.name: CSS 背景属性和值
patterns.context: 出现在 CSS 声明中，尤其是背景定位的坐标列表及重复设置。

patterns.name: 复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合修饰语或词组，常见于学术文本；也出现在代码/技术文本中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术文本及一般专业写作

patterns.name: 医学研究设计与队列描述
patterns.context: 描述研究地点、样本来源或研究设计，周围常有研究方法、受试者或统计分析内容。

patterns.name: 医学量表与治疗依从性
patterns.context: 讨论患者报告结局量表的开发或评估，以及治疗依从性障碍。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，尤其是患者结局与治疗依从性研究

patterns.name: 医学术语中的药物复合名称
patterns.context: 出现在抗癫痫药与非抗癫痫药对照的药理学语境中。

patterns.name: 医学质量指标与医院管理
patterns.context: 谈及医院疼痛管理和质量指标的制定或共识。

patterns.name: 计算资源与人工智能应用
patterns.context: 描述大规模计算资源需求及语音、图像处理、虚拟助手和自动驾驶等任务。
patterns.domain: 技术介绍或计算机科学普及文本

patterns.name: 糖尿病防治与循证管理
patterns.context: 列举糖尿病防控策略、筛查、监测和诊断工具。

patterns.name: 研究核心与数据处理流程
patterns.context: 说明研究平台或核心设施对代谢物进行测量、数据处理及存档数据再分析的职责。
patterns.domain: 科研项目说明/生物医学研究基础设施

patterns.name: 医疗免责声明与医患关系
patterns.context: 出现在声明内容不构成诊断、治疗建议或医患关系，并劝告咨询医生的免责声明中。
patterns.domain: 健康信息网页免责声明

en.description: The most prominent common cue is hyphens, slashes, and intra-word segmentation boundaries; samples are mostly medical and clinical text, with a few exceptions such as legal testimony and Tangut entries.

patterns.name: Hyphens and compound-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall near hyphens or slashes, especially boundaries between English compound modifiers, compound nouns, and coordinated entities; also occurs in hyphenated Tangut entries.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal text, research funding descriptions, dictionary-like code/lists

patterns.name: Medical and clinical research contexts
patterns.context: Involves patients, clinical services, study design, medical data, or clinical personnel; some activations coincide with the compound-word boundaries above.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, clinical research, healthcare projects, and funding text

patterns.name: Intra-word English tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around segmented English word fragments or affixes; no specific medical meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal narrative, and general English text

patterns.name: Tangut entry numbering format
patterns.context: Dictionary-style entries use hyphens to mark components and list numbers and component names consecutively.

patterns.name: Legal testimony and cross-examination wording
patterns.context: Describes a witness being cross-examined at trial about matters such as conspiracy and smuggling.

patterns.name: Clinical assessment and follow-up measures
patterns.context: Lists measures and describes periodic reassessment after treatment.

patterns.name: Antiepileptic drug names
patterns.context: Drug names occur in a study title or abstract about the effects of antiepileptic versus non-antiepileptic drugs.

patterns.name: Clinical quality and institutional management
patterns.context: Discusses patient safety, clinical quality assurance, accreditation, and organizational management; also includes hyphenated job/department descriptions.
patterns.domain: Healthcare institution management and research project text

patterns.name: Health data networks and collaborative participation
patterns.context: Describes a national network integrating electronic medical records and claims data, with participation by patients, clinical personnel, and healthcare systems.
patterns.domain: Health informatics, research funding project descriptions

patterns.name: Study design terminology
patterns.context: Specifies whether a study is prospective or cross-sectional and how a questionnaire is sent or administered.
patterns.domain: Systematic review or medical methodology text

11_1444.description: 最突出的共同线索是连字符、斜线及词内切分边界；样本多为医学与临床文本，另有法律证词和 Tangut 词条等少数特例。

patterns.name: 连字符与复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符或斜线附近，尤其是英文复合修饰语、复合名词及并列实体的分界处；也见于 Tangut 词条中的连字符。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、科研资助说明、词典式代码/列表

patterns.name: 医疗与临床研究语境
patterns.context: 涉及患者、临床服务、研究设计、医疗数据或临床人员；部分激活与上述复合词边界同时出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、临床研究、医疗项目与资助文本

patterns.name: 英文词内部分词边界
patterns.context: 激活分布在被切分的英文词片段或词缀附近；不要求特定医学含义。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律叙述及一般英文文本

patterns.name: Tangut 词条编号格式
patterns.context: 词典式条目中以连字符标示构件，并连续列出编号和构件名称。

patterns.name: 法律证词与审讯措辞
patterns.context: 描述证人就共谋、走私等事项在审判中接受交叉询问。

patterns.name: 临床评估与随访指标
patterns.context: 列出指标并说明治疗后定期复评。

patterns.name: 抗癫痫药物名称
patterns.context: 药物名称出现在抗癫痫药与非抗癫痫药作用的研究标题/摘要中。

patterns.name: 临床质量与机构管理
patterns.context: 讨论患者安全、临床质量保证、认证和组织管理；也包含连字符复合职位/部门描述。
patterns.domain: 医疗机构管理与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 健康数据网络与参与协作
patterns.context: 描述全国性网络整合电子病历、理赔数据及患者、临床人员和医疗系统参与。
patterns.domain: 健康信息学、科研资助项目说明

patterns.name: 研究设计术语
patterns.context: 说明研究是否前瞻性、横断面以及问卷的发送或管理方式。
patterns.domain: 系统综述或医学方法学文本

en.description: Trigger contexts are scattered: medical health and research (databases, ethics approval, trials, diabetes, gynecology), as well as software installation, legal evidence, forum searches, and map links; no stable shared trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Women’s health and gynecological advice
patterns.context: Discusses women’s health, gynecological visits, or medical advice; highlighting occurs in contexts related to gynecological specialists, especially «must».

patterns.name: Medical research data and ethics
patterns.context: Describes study participants, routinely collected medical databases, ethics approval, or authorization from a research institution.

patterns.name: Medical screening and insurance process
patterns.context: An online medical screening tool lets users assess their health and purchase suitable travel insurance; highlighting is concentrated on «to run through».

patterns.name: Clinical trial registration
patterns.context: Mentions COVID-19 treatment research and its registration on ClinicalTrials.gov.

patterns.name: Software build commands
patterns.context: A user describes command-line steps for configuring Ubuntu, installing dependencies, and trying to run software.

patterns.name: Evidence and damages rulings
