en.description: Activations occur across various web texts: hyphenated URL paths, forum post metadata and quote formats, commercial question-and-answer copy, discussions of emotions and purchase motives, advertising measurement descriptions, and music reviews. The commonality is mainly web content and formatting cues; there is no evidence that they share a more specific semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Hyphenated path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Activation falls on hyphens in URL paths or their neighboring subwords, often in truncated, concatenated, or repeated URLs; path-word semantics are not fixed.

patterns.name: Forum topics and post metadata
patterns.context: Formatting metadata in forum posts, including titles, signatures, timestamps, user levels, and quote blocks.

patterns.name: Question-and-answer marketing/design copy
patterns.context: The body text introduces an explanation or evaluation with a question, involving topics such as flooring design and marketing strategy; triggers occur at or near the question.
patterns.domain: Business, design, and marketing web copy

patterns.name: Emotional expression and questions about reactions
patterns.context: First discusses emotional reactions, then asks about motivations for purchasing unique digital prints.
patterns.domain: Art and consumer preference questions or interviews

patterns.name: Media audience measurement and brand mentions
patterns.context: Describes advertising distribution and audience-monitoring uses, and mentions a measurement company.
patterns.domain: Media, advertising, and audience measurement descriptions

patterns.name: Car forum signatures and quotes
patterns.context: In car discussion forums, a topic about vehicle handling is followed by post time, username, quoted content, and similar formatting.

patterns.name: Music reviews and popular culture
patterns.context: Reviews pop singers and whether their color schemes allude to musicians, followed by the name of a music section or event.

11_2346.description: 激活分布于多种网页文本：连字符网址路径、论坛帖子元数据与引用格式、商业问答文案、情绪与购买动机讨论、广告测量说明及音乐评论。共同点主要是网页内容和格式线索，尚无证据表明它们共享更具体的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 网址中的连字符路径片段
patterns.trigger: 网址里连字符分隔的路径词，如 “client/article/…-writer-from-a-cracked”“working-at-superior-software”“getting-rich-from-zero-to-hero”
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL 路径的连字符或其邻近子词上，常见于被截断、拼接或重复展示的网址；路径词本身语义不固定。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 链接、网页 URL

patterns.name: 论坛主题与帖子元数据
patterns.trigger: “Post subject: Re:”“Posted: Fri Jan 17, 2014 8:13 pm”“Very Frequent Poster”“Quote:”“Originally Posted by”
patterns.context: 论坛帖子的标题、署名、时间戳、用户级别及引用区块等格式化元数据。

patterns.name: 问答式营销/设计文案
patterns.trigger: “How does the flooring play into your design?”、“does it have a future as part of your marketing strategy?”、“Is it effective?”
patterns.context: 正文以问题引出后续说明或评价，涉及地板设计、营销策略等；触发点位于疑问句及其附近。
patterns.domain: 商业、设计与营销网页文案

patterns.name: 情绪表达与反应提问
patterns.trigger: “angry, happy or any other emotion”“leave you cold”“Why do you think people want to buy”
patterns.context: 先谈情绪反应，再提出关于购买独特数字印刷品动机的问题。
patterns.domain: 艺术品、消费偏好类问答或访谈

patterns.name: 媒体受众测量与品牌提及
patterns.context: 说明广告投放分布、受众监测用途，并出现测量机构名称。
patterns.domain: 媒体、广告与受众测量说明

patterns.name: 汽车论坛签名与引用
patterns.context: 汽车讨论论坛中，车辆操控话题后接帖文时间、用户名、引用内容等格式。

patterns.name: 音乐评论与流行文化
patterns.trigger: “rockists”“young pop star”“red/white colour scheme”“Jack White”“Jukebox Junior”
patterns.context: 评论流行歌手及其配色是否影射音乐人，随后出现音乐栏目或活动名称。

en.description: Activations occur mostly at newline boundaries in concatenated web text, and sporadically within words, on punctuation, numbers, proper nouns, and headline questions; no single semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: English apostrophe word fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall within or near word boundaries, especially on word endings after apostrophes and on subword fragments; not every fragment is marked, and this does not explain all activations.

patterns.name: Newlines and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Activations cluster on consecutive newline markers, often separating web snippets or paragraphs; some text after the markers also activates.

patterns.name: Punctuation and number formats
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur around formats such as times, dates, colons, and quotation marks; conditions vary and may relate to text formatting or tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Web, news, and social media text

patterns.name: Name and proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Proper nouns or word-initial fragments are marked, often alongside web headlines, bylines, brands, or entity names; the examples share no clear semantic category.
patterns.domain: Entertainment, health, news, sports, and other web text

patterns.name: Web Q&A or headline fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur near questions, headlines, or transitions in the content, but instances are scattered and show no stable Q&A semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic words and phrases
patterns.context: A few activations fall on ordinary words, phrases, or headlines; these isolated examples do not reveal shared semantic conditions.

11_2346.description: 激活多出现在拼接网页文本的换行边界，并零散落于词内片段、标点、数字、专名及标题问句；尚无单一语义模式能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 英文撇号分词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内或词边界附近，尤其撇号后的词尾、被拆分的词片段；并非每段都出现，不能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 换行与段落边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在连续换行标记上，常见于不同网页片段或段落的分隔处；部分标记后的文字也有激活。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本、拼接语料

patterns.name: 标点及数字格式
patterns.context: 时间、日期、冒号、引号等格式符号周围出现零散激活；条件不统一，可能与文本格式或分词边界有关。
patterns.domain: 网页、新闻与社交媒体文本

patterns.name: 姓名与专名片段
patterns.context: 专名或词首片段被标记，往往伴随网页标题、署名、品牌或实体名称；各例不共享明确语义类别。
patterns.domain: 娱乐、健康、新闻、体育等网页文本

patterns.name: 网页问答或标题片段
patterns.trigger: «What»2、«Like this»:、«The blockchain industry… Why do you think this is?
patterns.context: 问句、标题或内容衔接位置附近有激活，但实例分散，未显示稳定的问答语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 零散词汇与短语
patterns.context: 少数激活落在普通词、短语或标题上，无法从这些孤立例子归纳共同语义条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across newlines, URL separators, hyphenated headlines, and subword fragments in web-scraped text; they also cover number formats, ad placeholders, and web content about sports, economics, education, games, and music, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: URLs, domains, and path markers
patterns.context: Protocols, domains, directories, and filenames in URLs or link paths; activations are scattered across URL separators and parts of strings.
patterns.domain: Web links, news, or forum pages

patterns.name: Hyphenated headlines or names
patterns.context: Hyphen-separated headlines, proper nouns, or product names; hyphenated headlines within URLs also appear.

patterns.name: English word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments rather than complete English words; examples span different contexts and have no unified meaning.
patterns.domain: News, sports, games, and forum text

patterns.name: Newlines and web-section separators
patterns.context: Newlines near web body text, headlines, or links, often accompanied by blank lines and a following section heading.

patterns.name: Number, percentage, and model formats
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation in values, percentages, or hardware models; some numbers occur in headlines or body text.

patterns.name: Ad prompts after body text
patterns.context: Standalone ad placeholder words appear between news body paragraphs, near newlines.

patterns.name: Sports reports and commentary
patterns.context: Discusses teams, players, games, or wrestling programs; activations mainly fall on newlines, word fragments, or punctuation, with no stable sports-specific trigger words.

patterns.name: Quotation and comment-section formatting
patterns.context: Interaction prompts, quotations, and punctuation in blog or comment text; activations fall on formatting symbols or adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: Economic data and forecasts
patterns.context: News sentences describing economic growth rates, quarters, and economists' forecasts.

patterns.name: Education scores and year references
patterns.context: Reports on school exam results, annual comparisons, and percentage values.

patterns.name: Game products and franchises
patterns.context: Discusses game consoles, sports games, and franchises; activations fall within words.

patterns.name: Popular music and cultural commentary
patterns.context: Comments on pop singers and music programs, including colors, artists, and program names.

11_2346.description: 激活分布于网页抓取文本的换行、URL分隔符、连字符标题及词内片段；也覆盖数字格式、广告占位和体育、经济、教育、游戏、音乐等网页内容，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: URL、域名与路径标记
patterns.context: 网址或链接路径中的协议、域名、目录和文件名；激活散布在 URL 的分隔符及部分字符串中。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻或论坛页面

patterns.name: 连字符连接的标题或名称
patterns.context: 连字符分隔标题、专名或产品名；也见网址内的连字符标题。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、游戏硬件网页

patterns.name: 英文词中部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的子词片段上，而非完整词；这些例子分属不同上下文，未见统一词义。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育、游戏及论坛文本

patterns.name: 换行与网页区块分隔
patterns.context: 网页正文、标题或链接附近的换行；常伴随空行及后续区块标题。

patterns.name: 数字、百分比及型号格式
patterns.context: 数值、百分比或硬件型号中的数字与标点；有些数字位于标题或正文中。

patterns.name: 正文后的广告提示
patterns.context: 新闻正文段落之间出现独立广告占位词，附近有换行。

patterns.name: 体育报道与评论
patterns.context: 谈论球队、球员、比赛或摔角节目；激活主要落在换行、词片段或标点上，未显示稳定的体育专属触发词。

patterns.name: 引用及评论区格式
patterns.context: 博客或评论文本中的互动提示、引语和标点；激活落在格式符号或紧邻片段。

patterns.name: 经济数据与预测表述
patterns.context: 描述经济增长率、季度及经济学家预测的新闻语句。

patterns.name: 教育成绩与年份表述
patterns.context: 学校考试成绩、年度比较和百分比数字的报道。

patterns.name: 游戏产品与特许系列
patterns.context: 讨论游戏主机、体育游戏及系列作品；激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: 流行音乐文化评论
patterns.context: 评论流行歌手及音乐节目，包含颜色、艺人和节目名。

en.description: Activations are scattered across punctuation, newlines, and number formats in web text, as well as subword fragments of names, proper nouns, and ordinary words. Content spans sports, entertainment, forums, games, politics, and food, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Occurs at sentence endings, parentheses, quotations, times, or compound words; activations fall on various punctuation marks and surrounding content varies.

patterns.name: Number and identifier formats
patterns.context: Numbers often appear alone after newlines, in dates and times, or in forum pagination strings; their meanings vary across snippets.
patterns.domain: Web layout, forum records, and dates and times

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur at the beginning or within names and proper nouns; they span different people, brands, or characters, with no clear shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Sports, entertainment, forums, and other web text

patterns.name: Common letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations cover complete words or parts of words, without forming a unified meaning or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Sports reports and team personnel
patterns.context: Professional football, wrestling, or American football reports and commentary; activation markers mainly fall on names, proper nouns, or adjacent formatting symbols, rather than consistent sports terminology.

patterns.name: Forum or web interface elements
patterns.context: Interface-like text such as quoted posts, pagination, timestamps, or page sections; ordinary body text is also mixed in.

patterns.name: Political and parliamentary discussion
patterns.context: Discusses Brexit, parliamentary sovereignty, and legislative review; apart from newline markers, the body text shows no clear vocabulary pattern shared with other activated fragments.

patterns.name: Pregnancy and celebrity news
patterns.context: Pregnancy or engagement rumors about celebrities or public figures; activations fall on formatting symbols and fragments within names.

patterns.name: Food flavors and menus
patterns.context: Introduces a specialty popcorn menu and its flavors; activations occur only on word-initial fragments, with no clear stable link to other patterns.

11_2346.description: 激活分散在网页文本的标点、换行和数字格式，以及人名专名或普通词的词内片段。内容横跨体育、娱乐、论坛、游戏、政治和美食，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 标点及格式符号
patterns.context: 在句末、括号、引语、时间或复合词等位置出现；激活落在多种标点符号上，周边内容并不一致。

patterns.name: 数字与编号格式
patterns.context: 数字常出现在换行后的独立位置、日期时间或论坛分页串中；不同片段中的数字含义不统一。
patterns.domain: 网页排版、论坛记录及日期时间

patterns.name: 人名或专名的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在姓名或专名的首部、内部片段；这些片段分属不同人物、品牌或角色，没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 体育、娱乐、论坛及其他网页文本

patterns.name: 词内常见字母片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖完整词或词的一部分，且未形成统一词义或固定搭配。

patterns.name: 体育报道与球队人员
patterns.trigger: « Rod»（Rodney Parade）、« McCl»（McClaren）、«D»（D and app）、« O»（O'…）；上下文包括“Scottish Premier League side”“Nottingham job”“starting lineup at right tackle”
patterns.context: 职业足球、摔角或美式橄榄球报道与评论；激活标记主要落在姓名、专名或相邻格式符号，而非一致的体育术语。

patterns.name: 论坛或网页界面元素
patterns.context: 帖子引用、分页、时间戳或页面栏目等界面化文本；同时混有普通正文。

patterns.name: 政治与议会论述
patterns.context: 谈论 Brexit、议会主权及立法审议；除了换行标记，正文没有明显与其他激活片段共享的词汇模式。

patterns.name: 怀孕与名人消息
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«Je»、«rem»；“Leah was pregnant again with twins”“deny the report”“confirmed the pregnancy news”
patterns.context: 名人或公众人物的怀孕、订婚传闻；激活落在格式符号和名字内部片段。

patterns.name: 食品口味与菜单
patterns.trigger: «Che»；“popcorn out of every flavour possible”“Cheese, Chocolate, Wasabi”
patterns.context: 介绍特色爆米花菜单及口味；激活仅见于词首片段，无法看出与其他模式的稳定联系。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in math problems that define a function, substitute values, and ask for the greatest common divisor; other examples include forum quote metadata, sports fan experiences, forwarded email headers, and trial reports, which are difficult to explain with one specific semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Substitute into a function and find the greatest common divisor
patterns.context: A math word problem first defines a polynomial or linear function, gives variable values, evaluates the function, and finally asks for the greatest common divisor of two numbers; activations often fall on the question mark, newline, and following problem text

patterns.name: Forum quotes and post metadata
patterns.context: A forum post quote section with dates, usernames, or quotation formatting; activations also occur near newlines and quote markers

patterns.name: Sports events and fan experiences
patterns.context: Recounts past experiences watching games or being a fan, mentioning teams, events, and circumstances such as using crutches after an injury

patterns.name: Email replies and forwarded headers
patterns.context: Email exchanges or forwarded-message headers containing dates, sender, and recipient; the body mentions handling matters on someone's behalf while they are away

patterns.name: Trial testimony and retrospective assessment
patterns.context: A news or legal report recounts a witness's courtroom statement, including an assessment of prior conduct

11_2346.description: 主要激活于定义函数、代入数值后询问最大公因数的数学题；另见论坛引用元数据、体育球迷经历、邮件转发头和庭审报道等不同文本，难以由同一具体语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 代入函数并求最大公因数题目
patterns.trigger: “What is the highest common factor of … and …?”、“What is the greatest common factor of … and …?”及其前面的函数定义、代入表达式
patterns.context: 数学文字题中先定义多项式或一次函数，再给变量数值、计算函数值，最后询问两个数的最大公因数；激活常落在问号、换行及其后的题目内容上

patterns.name: 论坛引用与帖子元数据
patterns.trigger: “Quote:”、“Originally Posted by PatM”、日期时间串“2012 06:41 AM”
patterns.context: 论坛帖子引用区，带有日期、用户名或引用格式；激活也出现在换行和引用标记附近

patterns.name: 体育赛事与球迷经历
patterns.context: 叙述过去看球或作为球迷的经历，提及球队、赛事及受伤后使用拐杖等背景

patterns.name: 邮件回复与转发头
patterns.context: 邮件往来或转发内容的头部，包含日期、发件人、收件人；正文提及外出期间代为处理事项

patterns.name: 庭审证词与事后评价
patterns.trigger: “told the jury”、“in hindsight not a good idea”、“admitted in court”
patterns.context: 新闻或法律报道中转述证人庭审陈述，涉及对先前行为的评价

en.concept: Key terms in sports discussions and specific Q&A
en.description: Activations occur mainly in sports discussions involving game performance, strategy, players, and lineups; other examples concern political and social issues and a question about TV recording equipment.

patterns.name: Athletic performance and game strategy
patterns.context: Discusses a team's or athlete's performance, game strategy, season results, or outcomes; includes football, hockey, basketball, and other competitions.

patterns.name: Team personnel, coaches, and roster changes
patterns.context: Discusses player assignments, coach or manager decisions, transfers, and future lineups; some content comes from wrestling discussions.

patterns.name: Social and political issues and activism
patterns.context: Discussion of extremism, political positions, or representation in a community.

patterns.name: TV equipment and watching another program while recording
patterns.context: Asks whether a recording device can record one channel while watching another, using TV programs as examples.

11_2346.concept: 体育讨论及具体问答中的关键术语
11_2346.description: 激活主要出现在体育讨论中，涉及比赛表现、策略、球员与阵容；另有政治社会议题和电视录像设备问答。

patterns.name: 运动表现与比赛策略
patterns.trigger: “win in SL”“played in that series”“get the puck out”“hard forechecking”“off-the-ball”“three point plays”“goalies”“last round”“podium”
patterns.context: 讨论球队或运动员的发挥、比赛策略、赛季表现或比赛结果；涉及橄榄球、冰球、篮球及其他竞赛。

patterns.name: 球队人员、教练与阵容变动
patterns.trigger: “Ballard”“AV”“Royal Rumble winner”“Taker”“losing Young and Downing”“quality prospects”“new man”
patterns.context: 讨论球员安排、教练或经理决策、转会及未来阵容；部分内容来自摔角讨论。

patterns.name: 社会政治与激进主义议题
patterns.trigger: “'radicals Islamists'”“extremist views”“extreme acts”“no taxation without representation”
patterns.context: 围绕社区中的极端主义、政治立场或代表权展开讨论。

patterns.name: 电视设备与同时录看节目
patterns.trigger: “record one channel while watching another”“Panasonic DVR”
patterns.context: 询问录像设备能否一边录制一个频道、一边观看另一个频道，并举电视节目为例。

en.description: The most consistent cue is a newline and short numbers after it as segmentation markers; other activations include mathematical operators, parentheses, sentence-ending or quotation punctuation, and a few in-word hyphens and uppercase subwords. Paragraph 8 has no clear corresponding cue.

patterns.name: Newlines and following numbers
patterns.context: Across multiple text segments, activations occur at newlines or on short number tokens after them; numbers often resemble line numbers or separators and may not belong to the body text.

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and parentheses
patterns.context: Operators and some numbers activate in expressions involving negative numbers, repeated subtraction, and nested parentheses.

patterns.name: Sentence-ending and quotation punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation may activate at the end of questions or sentences, or in direct quotations and possessives; not every occurrence of the same punctuation is activated.
patterns.domain: Prose such as Q&A, news, and commentary

patterns.name: In-word hyphens
patterns.context: Hyphens occasionally activate in compound words; the sample is small, and their similarity to the mathematical minus pattern may be superficial.

patterns.name: Isolated uppercase letter subwords
patterns.context: The initial subword occasionally activates when an uppercase word is split into subwords; two examples are insufficient to establish stable conditions.

11_2346.description: 最稳定的线索是换行及其后短数字等分段标记；另有数学运算符、括号、句末或引语标点，以及少数词内连字符和大写子词激活。第8段缺少明显对应线索。

patterns.name: 换行及其后的数字
patterns.context: 多段文本在换行处或换行后的短数字 token 上激活；数字常像行号或分隔标记，未必属于正文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域语料的文本分段格式

patterns.name: 数学运算符与括号
patterns.context: 负数、连续减法和嵌套括号计算式中，运算符及部分数字激活。

patterns.name: 句末及引号类标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在疑问句、句末或直接引语/所有格中时可激活；并非每处同类标点都激活。
patterns.domain: 问答、新闻及评论等散文

patterns.name: 词内连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接复合词时偶有激活，样本少，可能与数学减号模式仅表面相似。

patterns.name: 孤立的大写字母子词
patterns.context: 大写词被拆分成子词时，首部子词偶有激活；两例不足以确定稳定条件。

en.description: Activations mainly respond to punctuation and formatting in math exercises: minus signs before negative numbers, question marks at the ends of prompts, and periods at the ends of probability problems; they also occur in numerical columns of test tables and in number answers to fraction/least-common-multiple problems. Trigger locations and semantics are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation in probability problems
patterns.context: In problems involving drawing letters and giving probabilities, the period falls between the prompt and a subsequent answer or next question.

patterns.name: Minus signs in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Occurs in arithmetic expressions or sequence terms to indicate negative numbers; sometimes the minus sign and following number are marked separately.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and sequence problems

patterns.name: Question marks at the end of prompts
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of math problem prompts, such as after “What is next”, “What is the t'th term”, or “common denominator” questions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, sequence, algebra, and number theory exercises

patterns.name: Numerical fields in medical tables
patterns.context: Reference ranges, NI markers, and values follow test names; activations fall near table content and values.

patterns.name: Numerical answers in fraction or common-multiple problems
patterns.context: Prompts and numerical answers alternate in problems about denominators, fractions, or least common multiples; the exact trigger form is not fully consistent with other paragraphs.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, fraction and number theory exercises

11_2346.description: 主要响应数学练习中的标点与格式：负数前的负号、题干末尾问号，以及概率题句末句号；也见于检验表格数值栏和分数/公倍数题的数字答案。触发位置和语义并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 概率题的句末标点
patterns.trigger: “Give prob of picking 3 g and 1 s”后的«.»；“Give prob of picking 1 m and 1 c”后的«.»
patterns.context: 在抽取字母、给出概率的题目中，句号位于题面与后续答案或下一题之间。

patterns.name: 计算题中的负号
patterns.context: 出现在算术表达式或数列项中，表示负数；有时负号与后续数字被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 问句末尾的问号
patterns.context: 出现在数学题题干末尾，如“What is next”“What is the t'th term”或“common denominator”问题之后。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，数列、代数与数论练习

patterns.name: 医学表格中的数值栏位
patterns.context: 检验项目名后跟参考范围、NI 标记及数值；激活落在表格内容与数值附近。

patterns.name: 分数或公倍数题中的数值答案
patterns.context: 在分母、分数或最小公倍数题目中，题面与数字答案交替出现；具体触发形式与其他段不完全一致。

en.description: Activations mainly respond to operators, minus signs, and numeric formulas in math text; they also occur in number theory problems, true/false answers, sequences, and ones-digit questions. Additional activations appear on numeric percentages in paper tables and on shell, Python, and TensorFlow in technical tutorials.

patterns.name: Symbols and number strings in mathematical text
patterns.context: Numbers, operators, and variables form formulas or arithmetic expressions; activation markers often fall on operators or minus signs, followed by math problems or answers

patterns.name: Prime-number tests in math problems
patterns.context: Asks whether an expression or integer is prime or composite, often followed by True/False

patterns.name: True/false answers in math problems
patterns.context: A brief truth judgment follows a math question; the answer token itself is also activated in the snippets

patterns.name: Continuing sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Provides a number sequence and asks for the next number

patterns.name: Ones-digit questions in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the ones digit of a power or expression

patterns.name: Statistical numbers in tables
patterns.context: Counts and percentages appear side by side in table rows, with newlines and column alignment

patterns.name: Command-line and tool names in software installation instructions
patterns.context: Describes downloading and extracting files, then running Python in a shell and trying TensorFlow

11_2346.concept: 结构化符号与数值文本
11_2346.description: 主要响应数学文本中的运算符、负号与数字公式；在数论题、真假答案、数列和个位数题中也出现。另对论文表格的数值百分比及技术教程中的 shell、Python、TensorFlow 有激活。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的符号与数字串
patterns.context: 数字、运算符和变量组成公式或算术表达式；激活标记常落在运算符或负号上，随后出现数学题目或答案

patterns.name: 数学题中的素数判断
patterns.trigger: “Is w prime?”, “Is o a prime”, “Is r prime”, “Is a(57) composite?”
patterns.context: 询问表达式或整数是否为素数/合数，常跟随 True/False

patterns.name: 数学题中的真假答案
patterns.context: 数学问题之后给出简短真假判断；在片段中答案 token 本身也有激活

patterns.name: 数学题中的数列续写
patterns.context: 给出数字序列并询问下一个数

patterns.name: 数学题中的个位数问题
patterns.context: 询问某个幂或表达式的个位数

patterns.name: 表格中的统计数字
patterns.context: 表格行中并列出现计数和百分比，伴随换行与列对齐

patterns.name: 软件安装说明中的命令行/工具名称
patterns.context: 描述下载、解压文件后在 shell 中运行 Python 并尝试 TensorFlow

en.description: All samples strongly mark newlines; other activations are scattered across punctuation, hyphens, word-initial fragments, and amounts, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Newline characters
patterns.context: Occurs at sentence endings in news snippets or between headline and body fragments; present in all samples and is the strongest marker

patterns.name: Sentence-ending punctuation
patterns.context: Periods or commas occur next to newlines, quotations, or clause boundaries; there is no fixed collocation

patterns.name: Hyphenated structures
patterns.context: Hyphens connect words or numbers, with inconsistent local forms and meanings

patterns.name: Specific word-initial fragments
patterns.context: Appear at the beginnings of “U.N.”, “Anmer”, “Dentsu”, and “Uncertainty”; no shared semantic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Currency symbol and amount
patterns.context: A dollar sign before an amount, followed by “15m”

patterns.name: Number fragments
patterns.context: The number in “$15m”

patterns.name: Atypical in-word markers
patterns.context: Occur within proper nouns or at quotation boundaries, with no confirmed shared condition

11_2346.concept: 新闻文本中的换行边界
11_2346.description: 所有样本都强烈标记换行；其他激活分散于标点、连字符、词首片段及金额等，未显示稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 出现在新闻片段句末或标题/正文片段之间；在所有样本中均出现，且是最强标记

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 句点或逗号紧邻换行、引语或从句边界；并非固定搭配

patterns.name: 连字符结构
patterns.context: 连字符连接词语或数字，局部词形和语义不统一

patterns.name: 特定词首片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在“U.N.”、“Anmer”、“Dentsu”、“Uncertainty”词首，未见共同语义条件

patterns.name: 货币符号与金额
patterns.context: 金额前的美元符号，后接“15m”

patterns.name: 数字片段
patterns.context: 金额“$15m”中的数字

patterns.name: 非典型词内标记
patterns.context: 出现在专名或引号边界，缺少可确认的共同条件

en.concept: News text boundaries and word beginnings
en.description: Activations often fall on word beginnings or affixes, proper-noun fragments, and layout symbols such as periods, hyphens, and newlines in news headlines or reports; trigger locations vary across segments, making a single semantic theme difficult to establish.

patterns.name: Incomplete word forms at headline beginnings
patterns.context: Activations cluster on word beginnings or affixes at the start of news headlines or body text; some markers cover only the beginning of a word, with the unmarked remainder completing it. Also includes markers beginning with headline-like phrases.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial proper nouns or place-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs on capitalized place names or fragments of personal names in news body text, or on hyphens in compound adjectives; trigger location is influenced by proper nouns or word formation.

patterns.name: News layout markers
patterns.context: Activations also occur on punctuation or layout symbols such as newlines, periods, and hyphens; these symbols appear near headlines, body text, or paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: Isolated initial-letter fragments
patterns.context: Partial characters activate within or adjacent to proper nouns rather than consistently meaningful whole words; this may relate to uppercase abbreviations or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Word beginnings and compounds in headlines
patterns.context: In common compound forms in news headlines, such as “go-ahead”, the hyphen is marked separately and the remaining parts of the word also activate.

11_2346.description: 激活多落在新闻标题或报道中的词首/词缀、专名片段，以及句点、连字符和换行等版式符号；各段触发位置不一致，难以确认单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 标题开头的不完整词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在新闻标题或正文开头的词首/词缀，部分标记只覆盖单词开头，后续未标记部分补全该词；也包括以标题式短语起始的标记。

patterns.name: 句首专名或地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻正文中的大写地名、人名片段，或复合形容词中的连字符；触发位置受专名或词形构造影响。

patterns.name: 新闻版式标记
patterns.context: 激活还出现在换行、句点、连字符等标点或版式符号上；这些符号位于标题、正文或段落边界附近。
patterns.domain: 网页新闻及其抓取文本

patterns.name: 孤立首字母片段
patterns.context: 在专名内部或紧邻专名处激活部分字符，而非稳定完整词义；可与大写缩写或分词边界有关。

patterns.name: 标题中的词首与复合词
patterns.context: “go-ahead”等新闻标题常见复合形式中，连字符被单独标记，词的其余部分也有激活。

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and format strings
en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains and contexts: personal names, medical and chemical terms, German word forms, database and code text. Recurring salient cues include split subword fragments and specific strings such as formats and Co-occurrence, which cannot be explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Josephine Witt in a personal name
patterns.context: A personal name is split into multiple subword fragments, followed by a newline and a repeated name

patterns.name: Drug-form term in a clinical study title
patterns.context: In a clinical study title on misoprostol for labor induction, strong activation is concentrated on insert

patterns.name: Word-ending fragment in a German compound
patterns.context: In a German sentence, activation falls on an internal fragment of a word meaning “standard”
patterns.domain: German text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Format in structural database text
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of a macromolecular structure database and reading information from text files

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a chondrosarcoma name
patterns.context: A disease name in a medical title is split into multiple subwords; activation is concentrated on an internal fragment

patterns.name: occurrence in a comorbidity title
patterns.context: The word for co-occurrence is marked as split; appears in titles about mutations and disease comorbidity

patterns.name: acids in a microRNA term
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on acids in a micro-ribonucleic acid phrase

patterns.name: Format in code documentation
patterns.context: Appears when describing the format of a Lambda API response

patterns.name: metal-free and token fragments in a chemistry title
patterns.context: In a paper title on radical cyclization, chemical terms are split into subwords; activation is distributed across metal-free and fragments of the reaction name

11_2670.concept: 特定词片段与格式字符串
11_2670.description: 激活分散于不同领域和语境：人名、医学及化学术语、德语词形、数据库与代码文本；反复出现的显著线索是被拆分的词片段及 formats、Co-occurrence 等特定字符串，无法由单一语义规则解释。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Josephine Witt
patterns.context: 人名被拆分为多个子词片段，后接换行和重复姓名

patterns.name: 临床研究标题中的药物剂型词
patterns.context: 米索前列醇用于引产的临床研究标题中，强激活集中于 insert

patterns.name: 德语复合词中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 德语句子中，激活落在规范一词的内部片段上

patterns.name: 结构数据库文本中的格式一词
patterns.context: 介绍宏分子结构数据库及从文本文件读取信息时出现
patterns.domain: 生物信息学数据库说明

patterns.name: 软骨肉瘤名称中的内部片段
patterns.context: 医学标题中的疾病名称被拆成多个子词，激活集中于内部片段

patterns.name: 共病标题中的 occurrence
patterns.context: 共现一词被拆分标记；分别出现在突变和疾病共病标题中

patterns.name: 微RNA术语中的 acids
patterns.context: 微核糖核酸术语的词组中，激活集中于 acids

patterns.name: 代码说明中的格式一词
patterns.context: 描述 Lambda API 响应的格式时出现

patterns.name: 化学标题中的 metal-free 及分词片段
patterns.context: 自由基环化的论文标题中，化学术语被拆分为子词，激活分布于 metal-free 和反应名称片段

en.description: Activations span several heterogeneous local patterns: the word formats, subwords of medical terms, repeated personal names, short code or citation fragments near newlines, and Res in code documentation. No stable semantic or syntactic condition explains all examples.

patterns.name: String formats/format-related words
patterns.context: formats appears in descriptions of display data, image conversion, or mixed-language parsing; the main pattern is formats and its local syntactic context in technical text.

patterns.name: Split fragments of medical words
patterns.context: Medical terms are split across subwords; activation falls on word-initial fragments or fragments that form terms.

patterns.name: Subwords and repeated text in entity names
patterns.context: A personal name is repeated at the start of a sentence, followed by birth information in parentheses.

patterns.name: Short code or numbered fragments separated by newlines
patterns.context: Short strings or citation numbers occur near newlines; activation is distributed across letter, number, and punctuation fragments, with no single consistent format.

patterns.name: Response identifier in code
patterns.context: The code-like identifier Res in API documentation appears in a sentence describing Lambda return values.

11_2670.description: 激活分布在若干异质局部模式：formats 一词、医学术语子词、人名重复、换行附近的短代码或引文片段，以及代码说明中的 Res。未见能统一解释所有段的稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 字符串 formats/格式相关词
patterns.context: formats 出现在对 display data、图像转换或混合语言解析的描述中；主要是技术文本中的 formats 及其局部句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 专利、软件文档、网页文案

patterns.name: 医学词语的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语跨子词切分；激活落在词首片段或构成术语的片段上。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的子词与重复文本
patterns.context: 人名在句首被重复列出，后接括号中的出生信息。

patterns.name: 换行分隔的短代码或编号片段
patterns.context: 短字符串或引文编号周围有换行，激活分布于字母、数字及标点片段；具体格式并不相同。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目、法律判例引文

patterns.name: 代码中的 Response 标识符
patterns.context: API 说明中的代码式标识符 Res 出现在描述 Lambda 返回结果的句子里。

en.description: The most stable cue is literal double asterisks and asterisk delimiters, spanning legal footnotes, medical tables, mathematical expressions, and code. A Ninth Circuit nonprecedential-opinion disclaimer template also occurs near asterisks in this corpus, but does not explain the nonlegal examples.

patterns.name: Double-asterisk footnote marker at the end of a legal opinion
patterns.context: Double asterisks appear in many kinds of structured text: in legal opinion headings or footnotes, beside tables or separator lines, at the end of mathematical expressions, and in C/C++ comments or pointer declarations. Surrounding layout, semantics, and domains vary widely; the trigger appears to be the literal double asterisk rather than specific semantics.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical tables, mathematical text, forum tables, and code

patterns.name: Ninth Circuit nonprecedential disclaimer in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a footnote-style disclaimer in a U.S. Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals opinion, near “**” markers and a statement about the panel’s unanimous conclusion.

patterns.name: Double-asterisk footnote/panel formatting in legal decisions
patterns.context: In the layout of a decision’s first or final page, double asterisks serve as footnote markers; their meaning depends on position and legal document formatting.

patterns.name: Medical table headings and separator lines
patterns.context: In tables or formatted paper content, double asterisks surround column headings, while horizontal lines separate table areas.

patterns.name: Decorative separators or borders
patterns.context: Asterisks are repeated as table borders, visual separator lines, or decoration for note blocks; vertical bars, slashes, newlines, and whitespace often appear nearby.

patterns.name: Double asterisks in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Double asterisks occur immediately after variables and numbers in mathematical expressions, possibly as operators or formatting markers; there is only one example, so the exact function is unclear.

patterns.name: C/C++ double-asterisk pointers
patterns.context: Double asterisks occur between a type name and a variable name as part of a pointer declaration; ordinary code structures also occur, but without the same clearly identifiable double-asterisk trigger.

11_2670.description: 最稳定线索是字面双星号及星号分隔符，横跨法律脚注、医学表格、数学式和代码；另有第九巡回判决的非先例声明模板，与星号在该语料中常相邻，但不足以解释非法律例子。

patterns.name: 法律意见末尾的双星脚注标记
patterns.trigger: “**”被标为强激活（[1]中 ** 为10，[3]–[5]、[7]中 ** 为10；[6]中表格标题附近 ** 为9；[8]中横线后的 ** 为10；[9]中注释分隔线附近 ** 为9；[2]中数学式末尾 ** 为10；[10]中 char 指针声明里的 ** 为9）
patterns.context: 双星号出现在各类结构化文本中：法律意见标题/脚注处、表格或分隔线旁、数学表达式末尾、C/C++ 注释或指针声明中。周围排版、语义和领域差异很大；似乎主要由字面双星号触发，而非特定语义。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学表格、数学文本、论坛表格及代码

patterns.name: 法律文书的 Ninth Circuit 非先例声明
patterns.trigger: “This disposition is not appropriate for publication and is not precedent”及“9th Cir. R. 36-3.”
patterns.context: 出现在美国第九巡回上诉法院意见的脚注式声明中，邻近“**”标记及对合议庭一致结论的说明。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的双星脚注/合议庭格式
patterns.trigger: “**”后接“ The panel unanimously concludes this case”，或“Submitted June 25, 2014 **”
patterns.context: 判决首页或结尾的排版结构中，双星号用作脚注标记；其意义受位置与法律文书格式约束。

patterns.name: 医学表格标题与分隔线
patterns.trigger: “**Number of cases**”“**Nail plate dermoscopy**”“**Pathology**”及长串横线
patterns.context: 表格或版式化论文内容中，双星号包围栏目标题，横线用于分隔表格区域。

patterns.name: 装饰性分隔符或边框
patterns.context: 星号被重复用作表格边框、视觉分隔线或注释块装饰；旁边常见竖线、斜杠、换行和空白。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 表格、Github 代码注释

patterns.name: 数学式中的双星号
patterns.context: 双星号紧接数学表达式中的变量和数字，可能充当运算符或格式标记；仅有一个样例，不能确定具体功能。

patterns.name: C/C++ 双星号指针
patterns.context: 双星号出现在类型名与变量名之间，作为指针声明的一部分；另有普通代码结构但未见同样明确的双星触发。
