en.concept: Numerical values and function definitions in algebra problems
en.description: This neuron responds strongly to algebraic numerical expressions in DM Mathematics problems, especially extremum/magnitude comparison questions, candidate sequences, and function definitions of the form “Let …(…) = …”; it also responds to fractions, decimals, polynomial powers, and a few incomplete formulas.

patterns.name: Extremum comparison/ranking prompts
patterns.context: Asks for the largest, smallest, rank, or value closest to zero from a set of given numbers or expressions; candidate options commonly follow the prompt.

patterns.name: Function definitions and evaluation instructions
patterns.context: A problem first defines a polynomial or other expression, then asks for an evaluation based on the definition or to use the function; common in a new problem after a newline.

patterns.name: Fraction and decimal problems
patterns.context: Values appear as comparison targets, candidate options, or parts of a definition; often co-occur with minus signs, operators, and extremum questions.

patterns.name: Greatest common factor problems
patterns.context: Asks for the greatest common factor of two integers, with numbers and variables in a short prompt.

patterns.name: Variables and polynomial expressions with powers
patterns.context: Function definitions contain variables, powers, and addition, subtraction, or multiplication; degrees, coefficients, and signs vary considerably.

patterns.name: Incomplete or truncated formula fragments
patterns.context: The fragment begins with a formula or expression and lacks a complete visible prompt; activation still occurs in a mathematical text context.

11_2670.concept: 代数题中的数值与函数定义
11_2670.description: 该神经元在 DM Mathematics 题目中强烈响应代数数值表达式，尤其是极值/大小比较问句、候选数列，以及“Let …(…) = …”形式的函数定义；也响应分数、小数、幂次多项式和少量残缺公式。

patterns.name: 极值比较/排序题干
patterns.trigger: “Which is the … value …?”, “What is the … value …?”, “Which is bigger …?”；如 “third smallest value”“biggest value”“nearest to 0”
patterns.context: 要求从一组给定数或表达式中找最大、最小、次序位置、最近于零者；常见候选项列在题干后。

patterns.name: 函数定义与求值指令
patterns.trigger: “Let [字母]([变量]) = …”及“Let [字母] be …”；如 “Let s(i) = …”“Determine n(d).”
patterns.context: 题目先定义多项式或其他表达式，随后要求据定义求值或使用该函数；常见于换行后的新题。

patterns.name: 分数与小数数值题
patterns.context: 数值作为比较对象、候选项或定义式的一部分；常与负号、运算符和极值问句共现。

patterns.name: 最高公因数问题
patterns.context: 要求求两个整数的最大公因数，数值及变量出现在短题干中。

patterns.name: 变量与幂次多项式表达式
patterns.context: 函数定义中出现变量、幂次及加减乘运算；具体次数、系数和符号变化较大。

patterns.name: 不完整或残缺的公式片段
patterns.context: 片段以公式或表达式起始，缺少可见的完整题干；激活仍出现在数学文本环境。

en.description: Activations appear in mathematical problem options, numbers, operators, and function definitions, as well as biotechnology terms in patents and code loops; no single word sense unifies these heterogeneous texts.

patterns.name: Options and function-definition markers in math problems
patterns.context: A multiple-choice problem asks about the magnitude or order of values, then gives a function definition with a variable as its argument after a newline; activation is concentrated in the prompt, option markers, and start of the new function definition.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical text
patterns.context: Math problems contain dense numbers, variables, multiplication, and equality signs; examples include prime factorization problems and function expressions, but do not necessarily include a magnitude-comparison prompt.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic or algebra problems

patterns.name: Biological terms and term introductions in patents
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs discuss natural oils, vitamin E, or gene-function defects; the text introduces a term with “The term,” followed by an abnormality or encoding string.

patterns.name: Nested loops and indexing in code
patterns.context: A code block iterates over a two-dimensional map, accessing its elements with nested for loops and indices; activation spans loop structure, variables, and property access.

11_2670.description: 激活遍及数学题的选项、数值、运算符和函数定义，也出现在专利生物技术术语及代码循环中；没有单一词义能统一这些异质文本。

patterns.name: 数学题中的选项与函数定义标记
patterns.context: 多项选择题询问数值大小或次序，随后换行并给出以变量为自变量的函数定义；激活集中在题干、选项标记和新函数定义的开头。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学题中密集出现数字、变量、乘法和等式；包括质因数问题及函数表达式，但不一定有大小比较的题干。

patterns.name: 专利中的生物术语及术语引出
patterns.context: 专利背景段落讨论天然油、维生素E或基因功能缺陷；文本以“The term”引出术语，后接异常或编码串。

patterns.name: 代码中的嵌套循环与索引
patterns.context: 代码块中遍历二维 map，以嵌套 for 循环和索引访问其元素；激活覆盖循环结构、变量与属性访问。

en.concept: Medical paper results and figure references (with a code exception)
en.description: Most examples come from medical paper results or figure-caption contexts. Activation often falls on figure cross-references, numbers, and medical word fragments, but the trigger location is not fixed. Another example is program specification code, where activation is distributed across identifiers and control-flow text.

patterns.name: Figure and table reference markers
patterns.context: The main text of a medical paper cites a figure or table at the end of a sentence; activation is distributed across markers such as parentheses, numbers, links, and `ref-type` tokens, rather than falling only on one fixed figure number
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical papers and their XML/HTML-converted text

patterns.name: Medical statistics and percentages
patterns.context: A medical results section reports sample sizes, measurements, follow-up times, percentages, or statistical test values; some numbers activate strongly, but the numerical types vary

patterns.name: Anatomical and medical term fragments
patterns.context: Medical descriptions contain terms for anatomical structures, diseases, imaging, or study subjects; activation falls on different subword fragments within words, with no single specific term category evident
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, radiology, dentistry, and biomedicine

patterns.name: Group and study-subject labels
patterns.context: Study results use letters to identify patient groups or individuals; activation occurs at the letter markers, but this appears in only a few examples

patterns.name: Surgical procedures and complications
patterns.context: Describes surgical procedures, postoperative complications, or clinical interventions; there is no common specific procedure term, and these usually co-occur with figure references

patterns.name: Code identifiers and control flow
patterns.context: In specification or code text, activation falls on identifier fragments, punctuation, and step numbers; this example does not fit the medical-paper pattern
patterns.domain: Programming language specifications/technical code on Github

11_2670.concept: 医学论文结果与图引用（兼有代码例外）
11_2670.description: 多数段来自医学论文结果或图注附近，激活常落在图号交叉引用、数字及医学词语片段，但触发位置并不固定；另有一段程序规范代码，激活分布于标识符和控制流文本。

patterns.name: 图表引用标记
patterns.context: 医学论文正文在句末引用图或图表；激活分散在标记中的括号、数字、链接及 `ref-type` 等 token，并非只落在某个固定图号
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文及其 XML/HTML 转换文本

patterns.name: 医学统计数字与百分比
patterns.context: 医学结果段中报告样本数、测量值、随访时间、百分比或统计检验值；部分数字激活很强，但数值类型并不统一

patterns.name: 解剖及医学术语碎片
patterns.context: 医学描述中出现解剖结构、疾病、影像或研究对象术语；激活落在词内不同子词片段，未显示统一的具体术语类别
patterns.domain: 临床医学、影像学、牙科及生物医学

patterns.name: 分组与研究对象标签
patterns.context: 研究结果中用字母标识患者组别或个体；字母标记处有激活，但仅出现于少数段

patterns.name: 手术操作与并发症叙述
patterns.trigger: `active surgical removal`、`craniotomy procedure`、`late tracheostomy`、`port sites were closed`
patterns.context: 描述手术过程、术后并发症或临床操作；没有共同的特定操作词，且多与图引用同时出现

patterns.name: 代码标识符与控制流
patterns.context: 规范或代码文本中，激活落在标识符片段、标点和步骤编号；此段不属于医学论文模式
patterns.domain: Github 上的程序语言规范/技术代码

en.concept: Numbers and symbols in structured text
en.description: Activations occur around numbers and their formatting boundaries: decimals, fractions, minus signs, and newlines in math problems; values, units, and percentages in medical abstracts; and punctuation, identifiers, and hexadecimal constants in code. A possible cross-domain commonality is combinations of numbers and symbols in structured text.

patterns.name: Punctuation and numerical boundaries in math ranking problems
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, decimal points, or fractions occur nearby, often in math problems separated by newlines; activation falls on punctuation and numerical-format boundaries, rather than only on problem instructions.

patterns.name: Number and unit formats in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Percentages, exponents, ages, measurements, doses, or time expressions in clinical research abstracts; e.g., “30%” “0.98%” “10-cm” “0.94 mg/kg/hour”.

patterns.name: Identifiers and numeric literals in code comments
patterns.context: C-style code mixes macro definitions, underscored identifiers, hexadecimal constants, and comments.

11_2670.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与符号
11_2670.description: 激活分布在数字及其格式边界：数学题中的小数、分数、负号和换行，医学摘要中的数值、单位与百分比，以及代码中的标点、标识符和十六进制常量。跨领域共同点可能是结构化文本中的数字与符号组合。

patterns.name: 数学排序题中的标点与数值边界
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «.»、«↵»、«-»，以及 «/»；如 “Sort … in increasing order” 和 “Sort … in descending order”
patterns.context: 数字、负号、小数点或分数周围出现，常位于由换行分隔的数学题目中；激活落在标点和数字格式的边界上，而非仅限于题目指令。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的数字和单位格式
patterns.trigger: «%»、«.»、«-»、«cm»、«kg»，以及数值与单位或标点相邻的片段
patterns.context: 临床研究摘要中的百分比、指数、年龄、测量值、剂量或时间表达；如 “30%”“0.98%”“10-cm”“0.94 mg/kg/hour”。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标识符与数字字面量
patterns.trigger: «/*»、«#define»、«_»、«x»，以及注释里的 “High bits transf count” 和 “0x38”
patterns.context: C 风格代码中宏定义、带下划线的标识符、十六进制常量及注释混排。

en.description: Activations span multiple kinds of code and text, with no unified semantic theme. Code examples involve string identifiers, x86 addition instructions, Servlet filters, 128-bit addition, and Rust structs; other examples include Indian constituencies, transliterated Arabic verses, and fantasy football running back discussions.

patterns.name: String types or variables in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code, especially in local variable declarations or identifiers containing string; nearby text may include value, assignment, or type annotations.

patterns.name: x86 instruction identifiers
patterns.context: Appears as part of assembly instruction enumerations or identifiers, near architecture or instruction-set markers such as X64, X86, SSE2.

patterns.name: Servlet filters dependencies and asynchronous filter names
patterns.context: Appears in Java Servlet filter dependency configuration and module names.

patterns.name: 128-bit addition and low/high word variables
patterns.context: Implements 128-bit integer addition using 64-bit addition and a carry variable.

patterns.name: Indian constituencies and member-of-parliament entities
patterns.context: Describes Indian elections, members of parliament, and constituencies; constituency names and political office-related terms occur densely.

patterns.name: Transliterated Arabic verses and religious expressions
patterns.context: English transliterations of Arabic verses or quotations, accompanied by imagery of drinking to quench thirst and the expression “insha Allah”.

patterns.name: Rust struct fields and serialization derives
patterns.context: Rust struct definitions with integer-typed fields and derived traits for comparison, copying, and serialization.

patterns.name: RB in fantasy football drafts
patterns.context: Discusses whether to draft a running back in fantasy football, with nearby mentions of PPR, player choices, and returns.

11_2670.description: 激活跨多类代码与文本，未见统一语义主题。代码段涉及 string 标识符、x86 加法指令、Servlet 过滤器、128 位加法及 Rust 结构体；另有印度选区、阿拉伯语转写诗句和 fantasy football 跑卫讨论。

patterns.name: 代码中的 string 类型或变量
patterns.trigger: `string`（[1] 中完整单词；[2]、[9] 中作为变量名或标识符的一部分）
patterns.context: 出现在代码中，尤以局部变量声明或名称含 string 的标识符为明显；附近可能有 value、赋值或类型标注。

patterns.name: x86 指令标识符
patterns.context: 作为汇编指令枚举或标识符的一部分，周围有 X64、X86、SSE2 等架构或指令集标记。

patterns.name: Servlet filters 依赖及异步过滤器名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Java Servlet 过滤器依赖配置和模块名称中。
patterns.domain: 构建配置／JVM 项目代码

patterns.name: 128 位加法及低、高位变量
patterns.context: 实现 128 位整数加法，使用 64 位加法和进位变量。

patterns.name: 印度选区与议员实体名称
patterns.context: 描述印度大选、议员及选区；选区名称和政治职务相关词汇密集出现。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式政治／地理文本

patterns.name: 阿拉伯语转写诗句及宗教表达
patterns.context: 英文转写的阿拉伯语诗句或引文，伴有饮水解渴的意象及“insha Allah”表达。

patterns.name: Rust 结构体字段及序列化派生
patterns.context: Rust 结构体定义，字段带整数类型，且为比较、复制和序列化派生 trait。

patterns.name: 足球 fantasy 选秀中的 RB
patterns.context: 讨论 fantasy football 选秀中是否选择跑卫，周围提及 PPR、球员选择和收益。

en.description: Responds to statistical numbers, especially decimals, percentages, values in parentheses, and nearby results reporting. Common contexts include medical abstracts and population-category statistics; it also covers sports data and encyclopedic numerical facts about population.

patterns.name: Percentages, ratios, and decimal values
patterns.context: In statistical or results statements, numbers often have decimal points, percent signs, parentheses, or appear alongside grouped data; some numbers are split into multiple tokens by tokenization.
patterns.domain: Census, medical research, descriptive statistics; portions containing statistical values in examples 1–10

patterns.name: Statistical results and sample composition
patterns.context: Reports research samples, category distributions, frequencies, or group results, often organized by totals, categories, or rankings.

patterns.name: Medical and health research terms
patterns.context: Clinical studies or medical abstracts report patients, diseases, outcomes, sample characteristics, or treatment groups, often accompanied by numerical statistics.

patterns.name: Category lists and category shares
patterns.context: Divides a population or study subjects into several categories, listing each category and its corresponding share.

patterns.name: Numbers or calculated values in parentheses
patterns.context: Parentheses provide percentages, measurements, means/errors, or unit conversions; number formats may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Sports statistics, medical research, statistical text

patterns.name: Other numerical facts in English encyclopedic prose
patterns.context: Specific numbers appear when describing athletes’ performance or a community’s population or number of households; not all are percentage-based or medical in context.

11_2670.description: 对统计数字尤其是小数、百分比、括号内数值及其附近的结果报告有反应，常见于医学摘要和人口分类统计；也覆盖体育数据及人口数量等百科数字事实。

patterns.name: 百分比、比率及小数数字
patterns.context: 在统计或结果陈述中，数字常带小数点、百分号、括号，或与分组数据并列；部分数字因分词而拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 人口普查、医疗研究、描述性统计；覆盖段1–10中出现统计数值的部分

patterns.name: 统计结果与样本构成
patterns.trigger: 「included」「There were」「of these」「most frequent」「majority」「followed by」及其附近的数量、比例
patterns.context: 陈述研究样本、类别分布、频率或组间结果，常按总数、类别或排名报告。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、人口统计、研究结果

patterns.name: 医疗及健康研究术语
patterns.context: 临床研究或医学摘要中报告患者、疾病、结局、样本特征或治疗组，并常伴随数值统计。

patterns.name: 分类列表及类别占比
patterns.context: 把人口或研究对象分成若干类别，逐项列出类别名称及相应占比。
patterns.domain: 人口普查、地区与宗教统计

patterns.name: 括号内补充的数字或计算值
patterns.context: 括号中补充百分比、测量值、均值/误差或单位换算；数字格式可能被切成若干 token。
patterns.domain: 体育统计、医学研究、统计文本

patterns.name: 英文百科叙述中的其他数字事实
patterns.context: 叙述人物运动表现或社区人口、家庭数量时出现具体数字；并非都具有百分比或医学语境。

en.description: Responds to numbers and their decimal points, punctuation, units, and statistical symbols in dense numerical reports, found in census and biomedical text; content includes population counts, measurements, scores, concentrations, risks, and association statistics.

patterns.name: Census statistics
patterns.context: Population size, religious population, number of households, or population density presented as numbers and units.

patterns.name: Medical numerical values and measurements
patterns.context: Medical or biological papers report measurements, means, medians, ranges, concentrations, or clinical scores; values often contain decimals, plus/minus signs, ranges, and units.

patterns.name: Statistical associations and risk results
patterns.context: Results sections provide ratios, risks, incidence rates, confidence intervals, or statistical significance values.

patterns.name: Mixed formats of numbers, punctuation, and units
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across numerical expressions and adjacent punctuation, measurement units, and formatting symbols; the values refer to different things depending on the text.

11_2670.description: 对密集数值报告中的数字及其小数点、标点、单位和统计符号有反应，见于人口普查和生物医学文本；内容涉及人口计数、测量、评分、浓度、风险及关联统计。

patterns.name: 人口普查统计
patterns.trigger: census」「numbered」「population」「households」「families」「people per square mile」及其周围的数字、百分比
patterns.context: 人口规模、宗教人口、家庭数或人口密度等人口统计数据以数字和单位呈现。

patterns.name: 医学数值与测量结果
patterns.context: 医学或生物学论文报告测量值、均值、中位数、范围、浓度或临床评分；数值常含小数、正负号、区间和单位。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 统计关联与风险结果
patterns.context: 研究结果部分给出比值、风险、发生率、置信区间或显著性检验数值。

patterns.name: 数字、标点及单位的混合格式
patterns.trigger: 小数点「.」、逗号、括号、±、%、斜线，以及拆分的数字 token
patterns.context: 激活分布在数值表达及其紧邻标点、计量单位和格式符号上；具体数值所指内容随文本而变。
patterns.domain: 人口统计和科学/医学报告

en.description: Responds especially strongly to dense expressions of statistical results in medical research abstracts: numbers, percentages, intervals, sample sizes, units, and clinical outcomes often co-occur; topics include dentistry, material release, hospitalization, demographics, disease associations, immune assays, and postoperative prognosis.

patterns.name: Statistics and numeric formats in medical papers
patterns.context: Reports sample sizes, measurements, proportions, intervals, time, or outcomes in scientific abstracts; common combinations of numbers, punctuation, and units
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts and NIH research reports

patterns.name: Clinical research findings and association statements
patterns.context: States observational findings, variable associations, between-group comparisons, and prognoses in clinical or biomedical research; typically uses a formal, compressed abstract style
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine and biomedical research abstracts

patterns.name: Dental and water fluoridation indicators
patterns.context: Reports childhood caries indicators, with comparisons stratified by age, sex, and region
patterns.domain: Dental public health, NIH ExPorter text

patterns.name: Drug/material release concentrations and units
patterns.context: Reports material release into a specific fluid over time in micromolar concentrations, along with experimental sample counts

patterns.name: Comparisons of hospitalization duration and costs
patterns.context: Compares length of stay, costs, and their changes across healthcare processes or treatment groups
patterns.domain: Healthcare services and clinical outcome abstracts

patterns.name: Demographic sample characteristics
patterns.context: Describes study participants' age, sex, ethnicity/caste, and sample size
patterns.domain: Aging health and social medicine abstracts

patterns.name: Lists of diseases or clinical conditions
patterns.context: Describes disease prevalence or clinical conditions, possibly followed by risk-factor analysis
patterns.domain: Clinical epidemiology and patient study abstracts

patterns.name: Experimental immune/cell function results
patterns.context: Reports functional assays and statistical results for cells such as neutrophils against bacteria

patterns.name: Postoperative mortality and prognosis
patterns.context: Retrospectively analyzes pathological factors, recurrence, and survival/prognosis outcomes in surgical patients

11_2670.concept: 医学摘要中的定量结果
11_2670.description: 对医学研究摘要中统计结果的密集表达反应尤强：数字、百分比、区间、样本量、单位与临床结局常并现；主题涵盖牙科、材料释放、住院、人口学、疾病关联、免疫实验及术后预后。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的统计量与数字格式
patterns.trigger: 如“mean levels”“28% reduction”“1-4 year rates”“4.932 %”“n = 3”“95% CI”
patterns.context: 科学摘要中报告样本量、测量值、比例、区间、时间或结局；常见数字、标点和单位组合
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要及 NIH 研究报告

patterns.name: 临床研究结果与关联表述
patterns.trigger: “were associated”“independently associated”“was impaired”“rates of mortality”“charges were compared”“recurrence and prognosis”
patterns.context: 陈述临床或生物医学研究的观察结果、变量关联、组间比较及预后；通常采用正式、压缩的摘要文体
patterns.domain: 临床医学与生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 牙科与氟化水指标
patterns.context: 报告儿童龋齿指标，并按年龄、性别和地区分层比较
patterns.domain: 牙科公共卫生，NIH ExPorter 文本

patterns.name: 药物/材料释放浓度及单位
patterns.context: 以微摩尔浓度报告材料在特定时间、体液中的释放量，伴随实验样本数

patterns.name: 住院时长与费用比较
patterns.trigger: “length of stay”“stay duration”“overall charges”“compared between the two groups”
patterns.context: 比较医疗流程或治疗组的住院时间、费用及其变化
patterns.domain: 医疗服务与临床结局摘要

patterns.name: 人口学样本特征
patterns.trigger: “older adults”“aged 60 years and above”“mean(+/- SD)”“52% male”
patterns.context: 介绍研究对象的年龄、性别、族群/种姓及样本量
patterns.domain: 老年健康与社会医学摘要

patterns.name: 疾病或临床状态的列举
patterns.context: 描述患病比例或临床状态，并可能接续危险因素分析
patterns.domain: 临床流行病学与患者研究摘要

patterns.name: 实验性免疫/细胞功能结果
patterns.trigger: “phagocytosis was significantly impaired”“adhesion and ingestion”“opsonized Staphylococcus aureus”
patterns.context: 报告中性粒细胞等细胞对细菌的功能测定及统计结果
patterns.domain: 免疫学与微生物学摘要

patterns.name: 手术后死亡率与预后
patterns.context: 回顾性分析手术患者的病理因素、复发及生存/预后结局

en.description: All passages contain number-dense text, with activation concentrated on segmented numbers, decimal points, and numeric punctuation; values involve unit conversions, medical measurements and statistics, population proportions, and research results, while math problems often contain consecutive question-and-answer pairs.

patterns.name: Decimal points and digit strings
patterns.context: Numbers are split into multiple tokens; common items include decimals, measurements, statistics, and unit-conversion results. Shows strong responses to long digit strings and nearby punctuation.
patterns.domain: Applied math problems and biomedical numeric reporting

patterns.name: Numbers in unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: In consecutive unit conversions or quantity questions, problem values, units, and the numeric answer on the next line appear adjacent; activation falls especially on numbers, decimal points, and answer digits.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, English arithmetic word problems

patterns.name: Medical measurements and laboratory values
patterns.context: Statistical or experimental results appear as values, units, percentages, confidence intervals, or P values, usually between medical terms.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, PubMed Central medical papers

patterns.name: Numbers in population proportions
patterns.context: In demographic descriptions, religious group counts and their population shares are reported as decimal percentages.

patterns.name: Decimal values in non-mathematical papers
patterns.context: When papers report test-result ranges, factor loadings, and eigenvalues, activation falls on split digits and decimal punctuation.

11_2670.description: 各段均含数字密集文本，激活主要落在被拆分的数字、小数点及数值标点上；数值涉及单位换算、医学测量与统计、人口比例及研究结果，数学题还常有连续问答。

patterns.name: 小数点及数字串
patterns.context: 数字被拆成多个 token，常见小数、测量值、统计量和单位换算结果；对长数字串及数字附近的标点有明显响应。
patterns.domain: 数学应用题与生物医学数值报告

patterns.name: 单位换算题中的数字
patterns.trigger: «Convert»、«How many»、« in»，以及紧邻的数字和单位，如 «217»、«milliseconds»、«nanometers»
patterns.context: 连续的单位换算或数量问答中，问题数值、单位及下一行的数值答案相邻出现；激活尤其落在数字、小数点和答案数字上。

patterns.name: 医学测量与检验数值
patterns.context: 统计或实验结果以数值、单位、百分比、置信区间或 P 值呈现，通常夹在医学术语之间。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、PubMed Central 医学论文

patterns.name: 人口比例中的数字
patterns.context: 人口统计叙述中，宗教群体人数及其人口占比以小数百分比报告。
patterns.domain: 百科全书人口统计文本

patterns.name: 带小数点的非数学论文数值
patterns.context: 论文报告检验结果范围、因子载荷和特征值时，激活落在拆分的数字与小数标点上。

en.description: Primarily activates on number-dense scientific text containing decimal points and statistical punctuation, especially measurements, errors, proportions, and result values; also covers specific contexts such as crystal parameters, medical statistics, data tables, and population proportions.

patterns.name: Scientific values and statistical symbols
patterns.context: In tables, measurements, or statistical results, especially decimals, error ranges, values in parentheses, and nearby units; the specific numeric domain varies across passages
patterns.domain: Scientific and academic text, including crystallography, statistical analysis, medical research, and data tables

patterns.name: Crystallographic unit-cell parameters
patterns.context: Crystal descriptions list unit-cell lengths, angles, and uncertainties after the crystal-system name

patterns.name: Comparative statistics in color-naming tasks
patterns.context: Compares means between two groups or conditions and gives numbers in parentheses
patterns.domain: Experimental psychology or cognitive science papers

patterns.name: Tabular numeric matrices
patterns.context: Numbers and abbreviations are column-aligned and arranged across lines, with little or no coherent sentence structure
patterns.domain: Tables or data formatting in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Drug concentrations and administration times
patterns.context: Reports drug or compound concentrations, error ranges, and time points after administration

patterns.name: Nasal symptoms and regression coefficients
patterns.context: Describes associations between clinical variables and provides regression coefficients, confidence intervals, and P values

patterns.name: Veteran discharge and diagnostic outcomes
patterns.context: Compares diagnostic risks or odds ratios associated with different reasons for veteran discharge

patterns.name: Survival rates by treatment group
patterns.context: Lists survival proportions and follow-up durations for different treatment groups

patterns.name: Population proportions and religious affiliation
patterns.context: Describes the counts or proportions of different religious groups in a population

11_2670.description: 主要对数字密集、含小数点和统计标点的科学文本激活，尤其是测量值、误差、比例及结果数值；另覆盖晶体参数、医学统计、数据表和人口比例等具体语境。

patterns.name: 科学数值与统计符号
patterns.context: 在表格、测量值或统计结果中，尤其是小数、误差范围、括号内数值及单位附近；但各段具体数值领域不同
patterns.domain: 科学与学术文本，包括晶体学、统计分析、医学研究和数据表

patterns.name: 晶体学晶胞参数
patterns.context: 晶体结构描述中，晶系名称后列出晶胞边长、角度及不确定度

patterns.name: 颜色命名任务的比较统计
patterns.context: 比较两个组或条件的均值，并在括号中给出数字
patterns.domain: 实验心理学或认知科学论文

patterns.name: 表格状数字矩阵
patterns.context: 数字与缩写按列对齐、换行排列，缺少连贯句子
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文中的表格或数据排版

patterns.name: 药物浓度与给药时间
patterns.context: 报告药物或化合物浓度、误差范围及给药后时间点

patterns.name: 鼻部症状与回归系数
patterns.context: 描述临床变量关联，并附回归系数、置信区间及P值

patterns.name: 退伍军人出院与诊断结局
patterns.context: 比较不同退伍军人出院原因对应的诊断风险或优势比
patterns.domain: 精神卫生或流行病学摘要

patterns.name: 治疗组生存率
patterns.context: 列出不同治疗组的生存比例及随访时长
patterns.domain: 临床试验或肿瘤学摘要

patterns.name: 人口比例与宗教归属
patterns.context: 叙述人口中不同宗教团体的人数或比例
patterns.domain: 百科全书人口统计文本

en.description: Primarily responds to number-dense strings containing decimal points and punctuation, especially statistical results, measurements, dates, and table fields; also covers scientific abbreviations, units, identifiers, and segmented numbers and proper names in email headers/signatures.

patterns.name: Decimal points and digit strings
patterns.context: Dense values, measurements, or statistical data; numbers and punctuation are split into tokens in many passages
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, tables, and financial/email text

patterns.name: Statistics and interval formats
patterns.context: Numeric results accompanied by errors, sample sizes, confidence intervals, or percentages
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and biomedical statistical reports

patterns.name: Dates and timestamps
patterns.context: Dates, times, and time-zone abbreviations appear consecutively, often as record or email-header fields

patterns.name: Numeric contact information
patterns.context: Phone numbers are divided into digit and hyphen segments and appear after contact information

patterns.name: Numeric fields and country names in lists
patterns.context: Line-aligned tables/lists, with each row containing numeric fields and place names
patterns.domain: Tables or data lists in emails

patterns.name: Numbered chemical/pharmacological data
patterns.context: Numeric measurements appear alongside compound names, structural formulas, or classification markers

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase proper names and file markers
patterns.context: Uppercase company names, filenames, or filing types are split into multiple fragments interspersed with numbers and punctuation
patterns.domain: Forwarded emails or securities filing indexes

patterns.name: Name and email-address fragments
patterns.context: Letters, periods, and domains in names and email addresses are split; phone numbers may also appear nearby

patterns.name: Dose and experimental-condition units
patterns.context: Values are followed by drug dose or concentration units, often alongside experimental groups, animal models, and condition descriptions

patterns.name: Medical proper nouns/abbreviations interspersed with values
patterns.context: Technical or compound abbreviations alternate with performance or concentration values

patterns.name: Percentages in reproductive medicine results
patterns.context: Results such as sperm motility are compared as percentages, alongside control groups and medical terminology

patterns.name: Non-numeric lexical residue
patterns.context: Sporadic body text appears at the beginning, followed by an email signature; there is no clear numeric trigger here

11_2670.description: 主要响应数字密集、带小数点和标点的字符串，尤其统计结果、测量值、日期及表格字段；也覆盖科学缩写、单位、编号和邮件头/签名中被切分的数字与专名。

patterns.name: 小数点与数字串
patterns.trigger: 数字串中的 «.»，常与整数、小数位、正负号、百分号或科学计数法相邻
patterns.context: 密集的数值、测量结果或统计数据；多段中数字和标点均被切分成 token
patterns.domain: 科学论文、表格及财务/邮件文本

patterns.name: 统计量及区间格式
patterns.context: 数值结果附带误差、样本量、置信区间或百分比
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要与生物医学统计报告

patterns.name: 日期与时间戳
patterns.context: 日期、时刻及其时区缩写连续出现，常作为记录或邮件头字段

patterns.name: 数字化联系信息
patterns.context: 电话号码按数字、连字符分段，出现在联系信息之后

patterns.name: 列表中的数字字段与国家名
patterns.context: 换行对齐的表格/清单，每行包含数值字段和地名
patterns.domain: 邮件中的表格或数据列表

patterns.name: 编号式化学/药理数据
patterns.context: 数字化测量值与化合物名称、结构式或分类标记并列

patterns.name: 分段的大写专名及文件标记
patterns.context: 大写公司名、文件名或申报类型被切成多个片段，夹杂数字与标点
patterns.domain: 邮件转发或证券文件索引

patterns.name: 姓名与电子邮件地址片段
patterns.context: 姓名和邮件地址中的字母、句点及域名被切分；附近也有电话号码

patterns.name: 剂量和实验条件单位
patterns.context: 数值后跟药物剂量或浓度单位，常伴实验组、动物模型和条件描述

patterns.name: 医学专名/缩写夹杂数值
patterns.context: 技术或化合物缩写与性能、浓度等数值交替出现
patterns.domain: 生物医学与脑机接口研究

patterns.name: 生殖医学结果中的百分比
patterns.context: 精子活动率等结果以百分比比较，伴控制组和医学术语

patterns.name: 非数值的词汇性残留
patterns.context: 段首出现零散正文，后续转为邮件签名；此处没有明显数字触发

en.description: Primarily responds to dense numeric results in medical papers, especially decimals, percentages, effect sizes, and confidence intervals; also appears in table values, experimental concentrations, random character sequences, and institutional phone numbers.

patterns.name: Decimals and effect sizes in medical statistics
patterns.context: Medical research abstracts or results sections report associations, risks, incidence, or between-group differences, often near effect sizes and confidence intervals

patterns.name: Numeric columns and statistics in tables
patterns.context: Table fragments arranged with line breaks and spaces, densely packed with numbers and column values, with weak or absent sentence structure

patterns.name: Experimental concentrations and measurements
patterns.context: Experimental results report concentrations, error ranges, sample sizes, or measurement time points

patterns.name: Random alphanumeric sequences
patterns.context: Continuous mixtures of upper- and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols without recognizable natural-language context

patterns.name: Institutional contact information and phone/fax numbers
patterns.context: Institutional addresses, contact details, or directory entries; phone numbers contain hyphens

11_2670.description: 主要响应医学论文中密集的数值结果，尤其是小数、百分比、效应量和置信区间；也出现在表格数字、实验浓度、随机字符序列及机构电话号码中。

patterns.name: 医学统计中的小数与效应量
patterns.trigger: 如“odds ratio”“95% confidence interval”“p=”以及带小数和百分号的数字；另有“incidence rate ratio”“OR(adj)”
patterns.context: 医学研究摘要或结果段落，报告关联、风险、发生率或组间差异，常在效应量和置信区间附近

patterns.name: 表格中的数值列与统计量
patterns.trigger: 连续出现的小数、括号内数值及列标题，如“Abduction”“Internal rotation”；另有“–3.750”“–24.721”等
patterns.context: 以换行和空格排布的表格片段，数字和列值密集，语句结构较弱或缺失
patterns.domain: 医学补充表格、论文表格

patterns.name: 实验浓度与测量数值
patterns.context: 实验结果中报告浓度、误差范围、样本量或测量时间点

patterns.name: 随机字母数字序列
patterns.trigger: “75rVfz6Q+x00q7xSH825v9RL…”等无明显词法结构的字符序列
patterns.context: 连续的混合大小写字母、数字及符号，没有可辨认的自然语言上下文

patterns.name: 机构联系信息及电话传真号码
patterns.context: 机构地址、联系方式或目录条目，电话号码中含连字符

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on segmented digit strings such as phone numbers, legal case numbers and citations, and medical table values; a few ordinary words and punctuation marks also activate, possibly as accompanying or independent patterns.

patterns.name: Phone numbers and segmented area codes
patterns.context: Digit strings follow phone-number formats; hyphens, digit groups, and nearby phone-related contact terms appear together.
patterns.domain: Email contact information, customer service instructions

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in legal case numbers and citations
patterns.context: In legal document titles, case numbers, statutes, or case citations, numbers and alphanumeric identifiers appear in segmented form; activation often falls within identifiers.

patterns.name: Table values and decimal digit fragments
patterns.context: In medical tables or statistical results, activation falls on parts of decimals, measurements, or statistical values.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, tables, and statistical results

patterns.name: Numeric styles within individual words
patterns.context: Values accompany table row labels or terms; it is uncertain whether they share a source with identifier, phone, or decimal formats in other passages.

patterns.name: Mixed email fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic word fragments in email bodies and signatures; no stable semantics or shared trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: Ordinary words and punctuation in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in legal argument sentences and interleaves with case-citation numbers in the same passage; it is unclear whether these words themselves trigger activation.

patterns.name: Legal parties and procedural wording
patterns.context: Appears near case facts or party labels, with numeric case numbers also present; the relationship between these ordinary words and the strongly activating numbers is unclear.

patterns.name: Medical statistical text and units
patterns.context: Numeric values and nearby statistical symbols are marked in medical results descriptions; it remains unclear whether activation is driven solely by the numeric portions.

patterns.name: Customer-service prompts
patterns.context: Customer-service instructions prompt readers to contact a department or call; the same passage also contains a prominent phone number, so word activation may be incidental.

patterns.name: Email contact details and thanks
patterns.context: Event notices, contact details, and closing phrases in emails; activation is concentrated on a few word fragments, with no stable shared pattern.

11_2670.description: 激活主要集中于电话、法律案号与引证、医学表格数值等被分段呈现的数字串；少数普通词和标点也激活，可能是伴随或独立模式。

patterns.name: 电话号码及区号数字分段
patterns.context: 数字串呈电话号码格式，连字符、数字分组及其邻近电话联系用语共同出现。
patterns.domain: 邮件联系信息、客服说明

patterns.name: 法律案件编号与引证中的数字片段
patterns.context: 法律文书标题、案号、法规或判例引证中，数字和字母数字编号被分段呈现；激活常落在编号内部。

patterns.name: 表格数值与小数数字片段
patterns.context: 医学表格或统计结果中，激活落在小数、测量值或统计数值的部分数字上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、表格和统计结果

patterns.name: 个别词内数字样式
patterns.context: 表格行标签或术语旁伴随数值；与其他段落的编号、电话或小数格式是否同源不确定。

patterns.name: 混杂的邮件片段
patterns.context: 邮件正文和署名中出现的零散词片段；未见这些词构成稳定语义或共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律正文中普通词语及标点
patterns.context: 法律论证句中出现，且与同段的判例引证数字交错；这些词本身是否触发尚不明确。

patterns.name: 法律当事人及程序措辞
patterns.context: 案情或当事人称谓附近，数字案号也同时出现；这些普通词语与强激活数字的关系不清楚。

patterns.name: 医学统计文字与单位
patterns.context: 医学结果叙述中，数值及其周边统计符号被标记；是否仅由数字部分驱动仍不明确。

patterns.name: 客服联系提示词
patterns.context: 客服说明中提示联系部门或拨打电话；同段也包含醒目的电话号码，词语触发可能是伴随效应。

patterns.name: 邮件联系方式与致谢
patterns.context: 邮件中的活动通知、联系方式和结束语；激活集中于少数词片段，缺乏稳定共同模式。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on punctuation and separators in number-dense text: legal citation abbreviations, medical statistical values, phone and address information, and table values; it also responds more weakly to ordinary periods.

patterns.name: Punctuation and abbreviations in legal citation formats
patterns.context: Appears in case citations, court names, or citation procedure statements; periods, abbreviations, and citation fields are adjacent, often alongside numbers and line breaks

patterns.name: Statistical values and units in medical papers
patterns.context: Embedded in numeric expressions of treatment effects or experimental results, including decimals, confidence intervals, units, and comparative data

patterns.name: Phone numbers and numeric separators in contact information
patterns.context: Phone numbers are grouped with hyphens or slashes, often alongside contact prompts, extensions, fax numbers, or office information

patterns.name: Tabular numbers and field separators
patterns.context: Numbers appear in column-aligned form, with spaces separating values and labels; they are not necessarily phone numbers or paper statistics

patterns.name: Decimal points and punctuation in ordinary text
patterns.context: Periods occur in non-citation and non-statistical contexts, such as web addresses or email closings; activation is weak and lacks a clear shared context

11_2670.concept: 数字密集文本的分隔标点
11_2670.description: 激活集中于数字密集文本里的标点和分隔结构：法律引证缩写、医学统计数值、电话及地址资料，以及表格数字；也对普通句点有较弱反应。

patterns.name: 法律引证格式中的标点与缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、法院名称或引证程序语句中；句点、缩写和引证字段紧邻，常伴随数字与换行

patterns.name: 医学论文中的统计数值与单位
patterns.context: 嵌在疗效或实验结果的数字表达中，包括小数、置信区间、单位及比较数据

patterns.name: 联络信息中的电话号码和数字分隔符
patterns.context: 电话号码以连字符或斜杠分组，常与联系提示、分机、传真或办公信息并列

patterns.name: 表格式数字和字段分隔
patterns.context: 数字以列对齐形式呈现，空格将数值与标签分开；不一定是电话号码或论文统计量

patterns.name: 普通文本中的小数点与标点
patterns.context: 句点出现在网页地址或邮件尾部等非引证、非统计语境；激活很弱且缺少明确共同上下文

en.concept: Punctuation and digit strings in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to case captions, party information, case numbers, and citation formats in U.S. opinions; also responds strongly to dense numeric and punctuation sequences in encoded character streams and crystallographic parameter tables, with sporadic activation within a few body-text words.

patterns.name: Word breaks and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In U.S. opinions or citations, activation falls near citation punctuation, citation formats, and case-number digits, often spanning digits or words split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Court headings and litigation-party formats
patterns.context: Court level, presiding judge, case number, or litigation-party heading/caption formats; activation also appears in court names, titles, and institution names.

patterns.name: Base64/encrypted encoded character sequences
patterns.context: Long, space-free encoded data strings with multiple letter, number, and symbol fragments marked individually; no natural-language syntax.

patterns.name: Crystallographic unit-cell parameter tables
patterns.context: After the crystal form name, lists lattice parameters a, b, c, volume, and Å units, with dense numeric precision and uncertainty values in parentheses.

patterns.name: Numbers or letter splits within ordinary words
patterns.context: A few activations occur within body-text words, proper names, or organization names in legal passages, without a consistent word meaning or fixed phrase explaining them; they may relate to nearby legal formatting or tokenization boundaries.

11_2670.concept: 结构化文本中的标点与数字串
11_2670.description: 主要响应美国判决书的案首、当事人信息、案号及引文格式；另对编码字符流和晶体学参数表中的密集数字、标点序列强烈响应，少数正文词内也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的断词与标点
patterns.context: 美国判决书正文或引文中，神经元激活落在引文标点、引证格式与案号数字附近，常跨越被分词拆开的数字或词。

patterns.name: 法院标题和诉讼当事人格式
patterns.context: 法院层级、审理法官、案号或诉讼双方的标题/案首格式；激活也出现在法院名称及职务、机构名称中。

patterns.name: Base64/加密编码字符序列
patterns.context: 长串无空格的编码数据中，多个字母、数字和符号片段被逐一标记；没有自然语言句法。

patterns.name: 晶体学晶胞参数表
patterns.context: 晶型名称后列出晶格参数 a、b、c、体积及 Å 单位，数字精度和括号内误差值密集出现。
patterns.domain: 晶体学/材料科学论文数据

patterns.name: 普通词内数字或字母切分
patterns.trigger: «Sevent»eenth、«waives»、«sovereign»、«immunity»及«SISTERS OF THE PRECIOUS BLOOD»中的零散片段
patterns.context: 法律段落中的正文词、专名或组织名内部出现少量激活，无法由统一的词义或固定短语解释；可能与邻近法律格式或分词边界有关。

en.description: Primarily responds to party identities, adversarial relations, case numbers, and court/appellate information in U.S. court-document headings; also covers a civil-rights claim in body text and a certificate-like encoded data segment.

patterns.name: Court case captions and party fields
patterns.context: On the first page or in an appellate caption, lists plaintiffs, defendants, appellants, or appellees; often accompanied by line breaks, indentation, and uppercase names
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court opinions and case captions

patterns.name: Case-number and court-number formats
patterns.context: In court-document headings or case descriptions, case numbers are adjacent to the cause of action, court information, or party fields

patterns.name: Court names and appellate information
patterns.context: Identifies the court of adjudication, source of appeal, or circuit court in an opinion or appellate document

patterns.name: Specific legal claim wording
patterns.context: Describes a legal claim in the body of an opinion rather than in the caption

patterns.name: PEM/certificate-style long encoded strings
patterns.context: Continuous high-entropy encoded data; activation is distributed across encoded characters and blocks

11_2670.description: 主要响应美国法院文书标题中的当事人身份、对阵关系、案号及法院/上诉信息；另覆盖一处民权主张正文和一段类似证书的编码数据。

patterns.name: 法院诉讼标题与当事人栏
patterns.context: 法律文书首页或上诉标题中，列出原被告、上诉方或被上诉方；常伴随换行、缩进和大写姓名
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决及案卷标题

patterns.name: 案号与法院编号格式
patterns.trigger: “No.”、“Civ.”、“D.C. No.”、“Civil Action No.”及类似“76 Civ. 1734 (MP)”的编号
patterns.context: 法院文书标题或案情段落中，案件编号紧邻案由、法院信息或当事人栏

patterns.name: 法院名称与上诉信息
patterns.trigger: “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS TENTH CIRCUIT”、“Appeal from the United States District Court”、“United States District Court”
patterns.context: 判决或上诉文书中标示审理法院、上诉来源或巡回法院

patterns.name: 特定法律主张措辞
patterns.trigger: “alleging a conspiracy to deprive … of their civil rights”
patterns.context: 判决正文叙述诉讼主张，而非标题栏

patterns.name: PEM/证书编码式长串
patterns.trigger: “ATANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQUFAAOCAQ”及其后由字母数字、斜线和加号组成的编码
patterns.context: 连续的高熵编码数据；激活分布在编码字符及分块上

en.concept: Numbers and formatting markers in structured passages
en.description: Activation occurs in formatting-dense passages with many symbols and numbers: most prominently court case names and case numbers, but also paper experimental data, country-value tables, unit conversions, chemical crystal parameters, and patent citations. Specific semantics vary substantially across passages.

patterns.name: Federal litigation case-name and case-number formats
patterns.context: At the beginning of a court document or in the caption, includes plaintiffs and defendants, v., Civil case numbers, and court names; words in the caption are marked in fragments, but activation spans multiple formatting components.

patterns.name: PubMed values and experimental results
patterns.context: Experimental paper abstracts compare treatment groups and report quantitative results, statistical significance, or sample sizes, including decimals and inequalities.

patterns.name: Country codes and values in tables
patterns.context: Country or region abbreviations, values, and names appear in aligned columns; the text resembles a table dump and includes decimals.

patterns.name: Mathematical unit-conversion questions and answers
patterns.context: Asks questions using “How many … are there” or “Convert … to …”, involving metric units, quantities, or decimals, and provides an answer.

patterns.name: Civil-rights litigation narrative and case citation
patterns.context: Body text or case citation in legal documents mentions conspiracy, deprivation of civil rights, parties, and civil case numbers; it is not the standard case-caption layout on an opinion's first page.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and crystallographic parameters
patterns.context: Structured chemistry/crystallography records contain formulas, molecular weights, crystal systems, and lattice constants, among other symbols and values.

patterns.name: Medical research and regeneration in patent citations
patterns.context: Patent background sections cite research papers or patents discussing bone marrow-derived cell-mediated myocardial regeneration and list patent numbers.

11_2670.concept: 结构化文段中的数字与格式标记
11_2670.description: 激活见于格式密集、符号与数字较多的文段：尤以法院案名和案号最突出，也涵盖论文实验数据、国家数值表、单位换算、化学晶体参数及专利引文。各段具体语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 联邦诉讼案名与案号格式
patterns.context: 法院文书开头或案名区，出现原被告、v.、Civil 案号及法院名称；案名中的词被切分标记，但激活跨越多个格式成分。

patterns.name: PubMed 数值与实验结果
patterns.context: 实验论文摘要中，比较处理组、报告定量结果、统计显著性或样本量，含小数和不等式。

patterns.name: 表格中的国家代码与数值
patterns.context: 以对齐列呈现国家或地区缩写、数值和名称；文本像表格转储，包含小数。

patterns.name: 数学单位换算问答
patterns.trigger: «↵»4How« many»3« nan»2ometers are there« in»2 1/«4»1 of a microm«eter»1«?»4；«Convert»4
patterns.context: 以“How many … are there”或“Convert … to …”提问，涉及公制单位、数量或小数，并给出答案。

patterns.name: 民权诉讼叙述与引案
patterns.trigger: « alleging»2« a»2« conspiracy« to»3 deprive … «civil»1« rights»1；«Civil»2« Action»3« No»4
patterns.context: 法律文本正文或引案信息中，提及阴谋、剥夺民权、当事人及民事案号；不是标准判决首页案名布局。

patterns.name: 化学式与晶体学参数
patterns.context: 结构化化学/晶体学记录，包含分子式、分子量、晶系及晶格常数等符号和数值。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文/补充数据

patterns.name: 专利引用中的医学研究与再生
patterns.trigger: « the»4« regeneration»3« of»3« cardiac»2« muscles»3« mediated»2« by»3« bone»4« marrow»4«-»5«derived»4« cells»2；«JP« Patent»1« Publication»3
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中引用研究文献或专利，讨论骨髓来源细胞介导的心肌再生，并列出专利号。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across medical abstracts, chemical names, personal names, historical texts, and interface code. Local triggers are often subword fragments of proper names or terms, such as drug, assay, place names, and deflated. No unified semantic or stable syntactic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Split Z string
patterns.context: “Zidovudine” appears at the beginning of a sentence or text fragment, split into multiple subwords, followed by a comparison or clinical description.

patterns.name: chromogenic assay
patterns.context: Describes a potency assay method for recombinant factor VIII, especially when the phrase appears after several assays are listed.
patterns.domain: NIH research funding abstracts; coagulation testing

patterns.name: rapamycin and arousal
patterns.context: A study title or abstract begins by discussing the effects of rapamycin on stress-induced hyperarousal and its consolidation.

patterns.name: Skańska in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Felicja Schabińska appears on its own line, immediately followed by a repeated opening.

patterns.name: Probe deflation and deflated
patterns.context: A balloon probe is deflated, followed by a description of inserting it into the body; earlier text concerns cables and electrical safety.

patterns.name: Repeated chemical name
patterns.context: The compound name Zinc ammonium chloride appears at the beginning of a paragraph, then repeats after a line break.

patterns.name: Name of the St. Bartholomew's Massacre
patterns.context: St. Bartholomew's Massacre appears in a historical narrative discussing Henry III and punishment.

patterns.name: lipemic specimens testing
patterns.context: Describes reagent formulations, sample blanks, and automated testing of serum or plasma.

patterns.name: Interface label Top Bar
patterns.context: Appears as a text attribute value in XML/interface configuration, describing a control for toggling the top bar.

patterns.name: Paper references and nonttranslated
patterns.context: After author names and journal citations, an abstract fragment mentions insertion into a non-translated region and gene expression.

11_2793.description: 强激活分散于医学摘要、化学名称、人名、历史文本和界面代码；局部触发多为专名或术语的特定子词片段，如 drug、assay、地名及 deflated，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 被切分的 Z 字符串
patterns.context: 句首或文本片段开头出现拆分成多个子词的 “Zidovudine”，随后接比较或临床描述。

patterns.name: chromogenic assay
patterns.context: 描述重组因子 VIII 的效价测定方法，尤其是列举多种 assay 后出现该词组。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助摘要；凝血检测

patterns.name: rapamycin 与 arousal
patterns.context: 句首研究标题或摘要中讨论 rapamycin 对压力诱发过度唤醒及其巩固过程的影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要；神经科学、药理学

patterns.name: 人名中的 Skańska
patterns.context: 人名 Felicja Schabińska 单独成行并紧接着重复开头。

patterns.name: 探头放气与 deflated
patterns.context: 气球探头被放气后，随后描述将探头导入体内；前文涉及电缆和电气安全。

patterns.name: 化学品名称重复
patterns.context: 化合物名称 Zinc ammonium chloride 出现在段落开头，换行后再次重复。

patterns.name: 圣巴托罗缪大屠杀名称
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现 St. Bartholomew's Massacre，周围讨论亨利三世及惩罚。

patterns.name: lipemic specimens 检测
patterns.context: 描述血清或血浆检测的试剂配方、样本空白及自动化检测。
patterns.domain: 临床检验、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 界面标签 Top Bar
patterns.context: XML/界面配置中作为 text 属性值，描述切换顶部栏的控件。

patterns.name: 论文参考文献与 nonttranslated
patterns.context: 作者姓名和期刊引文之后，摘要片段提及插入非翻译区及基因表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文引文或摘要

en.concept: Formatting markers and salient word fragments
en.description: The strongest common trigger is “FYI” in emails; other activations are scattered across line breaks and heading formats, as well as chemistry, research, finance, and web phrases, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Email opening FYI
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or forwarded content, often followed by a line break, hyphen, or explanatory text.

patterns.name: Sectioned or line-broken headings
patterns.context: One or more line breaks follow a heading or phrase, often with a repeated heading or a subsequent paragraph.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedias, and email-formatted text

patterns.name: Chemical name
patterns.context: Tokens are split within the chemical name “Zinc ammonium chloride.”

patterns.name: Experimental comparison heading
patterns.context: Forms part of a research comparison heading with terms such as potency and recombinant FVIII.

patterns.name: Financial institution name
patterns.context: The beginning of the institution name “Platinum Mortgage Funding.”

patterns.name: Website follow options
patterns.context: Prompts to follow via email or RSS; two similar phrases appear repeatedly.

patterns.name: Scientific term or research topic
patterns.context: Abstract text describing the disintegration of graphene nanoribbons in a strong electrostatic field.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry heading
patterns.context: The heading “Industrial espionage” appears repeatedly, with the words split across tokens.

11_2793.concept: 格式标记与高显著词片段
11_2793.description: 最强共同触发是邮件中的“FYI”；其余激活分散于换行/标题格式，以及化学、科研、金融和网页短语，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.context: 邮件正文或转发内容开头，常接换行、连字符或说明文字。

patterns.name: 分段或断行标题
patterns.context: 标题或短语后出现一个或多个换行，常伴随标题重复或后续段落。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科及邮件格式文本

patterns.name: 化学品名称
patterns.context: “Zinc ammonium chloride”这一化学名称中，相关词被拆分为 token。

patterns.name: 实验比较标题
patterns.context: 与 potency、recombinant FVIII 等词构成研究比较标题。

patterns.name: 金融机构名称
patterns.context: “Platinum Mortgage Funding”机构名称的开头。

patterns.name: 网页关注方式提示
patterns.context: 提示通过 email 或 RSS 关注，两个相似短语重复出现。

patterns.name: 科学术语或研究主题
patterns.context: 石墨烯纳米带在强静电场中解体的摘要表述。

patterns.name: 百科条目标题
patterns.context: “Industrial espionage”标题重复出现，词语跨 token 拆分。

en.description: Activations occur in medical word fragments, code and configuration identifiers, CSS colors, English contractions, project titles, and all-caps court headings. Trigger forms differ markedly across examples and cannot be grouped into a single semantic or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments in PubMed medical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall within medical vocabulary split across tokens, especially immunology/cytokine terms and terms related to myelodysplasia; there is insufficient evidence of a response to any single medical concept.

patterns.name: Specific strings in structured data
patterns.context: Game/interrogation data in a JSON-style object; activations cluster on difficulty field values and uppercase fear labels in arrays, alongside delimiters, numbers, and enum values.

patterns.name: CSS styles and color values
patterns.context: Character fragments in hexadecimal color codes activate in CSS declarations; the same block also contains properties such as height, background, color, and border.

patterns.name: English negative contraction
patterns.context: In colloquial English sentences, don't is followed by reassurance; the trigger is primarily the contraction itself.

patterns.name: Control syntax in template code
patterns.context: An ERB-style if/end block and conditional class name appear in templated HTML; activations are associated with template markers and the active class.

patterns.name: Slash in project summary heading
patterns.context: Activations occur near the Summary/Abstract slash notation in an NIH project record's title field; the following text summarizes an electronic adherence monitoring project.

patterns.name: Criminal appellate court heading
patterns.context: A formal court heading in all caps, with activations distributed across multiple words and subword fragments in the institution name.

patterns.name: Cloud resource configuration identifier
patterns.context: Activations occur near an AWS instance resource name and the web tag in a Terraform-style resource declaration.

11_2793.description: 激活分散在医学词片段、代码与配置标识符、CSS 颜色、英语缩写、项目标题及法院全大写标题中。各处触发形式差异明显，无法归为单一语义或稳定句法模式。

patterns.name: PubMed 医学术语中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的医学词汇内部，尤其是免疫/细胞因子术语与骨髓增生异常相关术语；没有足够证据表明语义上只响应某一种医学概念。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的特定字符串
patterns.context: JSON 风格对象中的游戏/审讯数据；激活集中在难度字段值和数组中的大写恐惧标签，周围还有分隔符、数字及枚举值。
patterns.domain: GitHub 结构化文本/游戏数据

patterns.name: CSS 样式与颜色值
patterns.context: CSS 声明中，十六进制颜色代码的字符片段激活；同段还有 height、background、color、border 等属性。

patterns.name: 英语否定缩写
patterns.context: 口语式英语句子中，don't 后接安慰/保证语气；触发主要落在缩写本身。

patterns.name: 模板代码中的控制语法
patterns.context: 模板化 HTML 中出现 ERB 风格的 if/end 块及条件类名；激活与模板标记、active 类附近相关。

patterns.name: 项目摘要标题中的斜线
patterns.context: NIH 项目记录的标题字段中，Summary/Abstract 斜线写法附近激活；后文是电子依从性监测项目摘要。

patterns.name: 刑事上诉法院标题
patterns.context: 全大写的正式法院标题，激活分布在机构名称多个词及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 云资源配置标识符
patterns.context: Terraform 风格的 resource 声明中，AWS 实例资源名及 web 标签附近激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 基础设施配置代码

en.description: Activations often occur on identifiers, variables, function names, and path-related words in code and formulas. Other sporadic triggers include Chinese algorithm comments, morphemes in cited names, and CSS style values. They span languages, syntax, and domains, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Variable identifiers in code
patterns.context: Identifiers consist of common word roots and naming structures such as camel case and underscores, often in code contexts involving assignment, declaration, loops, or function calls; some longer identifiers activate more strongly.

patterns.name: File- and directory-related identifiers
patterns.context: Code or technical explanations discuss files, folders, and paths; activations occur on path text and related identifiers.

patterns.name: Variables or function symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, function names, or index symbols are embedded in formulas or numerical algorithm expressions rather than natural-language prose.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas and numerical computing code

patterns.name: Direction and extremum terms in Chinese comments
patterns.context: A code comment describes searching leftward from the current position for a maximum; activations span consecutive Chinese word fragments.

patterns.name: Morphemes in a class name or proper name
patterns.context: A morpheme occurs in the literature author's name “Kirschenmacher,” near a citation note.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal color values
patterns.context: In a webpage CSS declaration, numbers and units occur after a height style value; the block also contains CSS selectors and properties.

patterns.name: Path and drive-letter strings
patterns.context: A Windows file path's drive letter and path separators appear in a Python-style file operation example.
patterns.domain: File path examples in programming Q&A

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: The command occurs in a mathematical formula containing fractions, derivatives, and parentheses; activations also involve variables and numbers in the formula.

11_2793.concept: 代码与公式中的标识符
11_2793.description: 激活多见于代码和公式中的标识符、变量、函数名与路径相关词；另有中文算法注释、文献姓名词素及CSS样式值等零散触发，跨语言、语法和领域，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 代码中的变量标识符
patterns.context: 标识符由普通词根和驼峰、下划线等命名结构组成，常出现在赋值、声明、循环或函数调用等代码语境中；有些较长标识符处激活更强。

patterns.name: 文件与目录相关标识符
patterns.context: 代码或技术说明中谈到文件、文件夹及路径；激活落在文件路径文本和相关标识符上。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量或函数符号
patterns.context: 变量、函数名或索引符号嵌在公式或数值算法表达式中，而非自然语言叙述。
patterns.domain: 数学公式及数值计算代码

patterns.name: 中文注释中的方向与极值词
patterns.context: 代码注释描述从当前位置向左搜索最大值；激活覆盖连续中文词片段。
patterns.domain: 带中文注释的算法代码

patterns.name: 类名或专名中的词素
patterns.context: 词素出现在文献作者姓名“Kirschenmacher”中，附近有引用说明。
patterns.domain: 代码注释中的文献引用

patterns.name: 十六进制颜色值
patterns.context: 网页 CSS 声明中，数字和单位出现在 height 样式值之后；该段同时含 CSS 选择器和属性。

patterns.name: 路径及盘符字符串
patterns.context: Windows 文件路径的盘符及路径分隔符，位于 Python 风格的文件操作示例中。
patterns.domain: 编程问答中的文件路径示例

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 命令处于含分数、导数及括号的数学公式中；激活也涉及公式里的变量和数字。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments in code identifiers and short variables, SQL fragments, chemical formulas and names, drug abbreviations, and mathematicians' names; no prominent unified semantic or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments within identifiers, class names, and code tokens
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments of program identifiers or type names, often camel-case or compound names; surrounding contexts include code declarations, calls, or assignments.

patterns.name: Short letter fragments in code
patterns.context: Short variable names, parameter names, or identifier components in code statements, appearing in conditions, indexing, function calls, assignments, and other contexts.

patterns.name: Token fragments in SQL queries
patterns.context: In SQL query strings, especially near query keywords, table names, or random-ordering expressions; activations also occur in subsequent PHP data-reading code.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in chemical names and formulas
patterns.context: Spans element symbols, parentheses, numbers, and organic chemistry name fragments in complex formulas or systematic chemical names.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment
patterns.context: The drug abbreviation BCNU appears in descriptions of patient dosage, infusion method, and pharmacokinetics.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in a mathematician's name
patterns.context: An author's name in a mathematics paper is tokenized or split around an unusual character, near discussion of exterior algebra and formulas.

11_2793.concept: 词内片段与复合标识符
11_2793.description: 激活分散在代码标识符及短变量、SQL 片段、化学式与化学名称、药物缩写和数学家姓名的词内片段；没有显著统一的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 标识符、类名与代码 token 内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在程序标识符或类型名的词内片段上，常为驼峰式名称或复合名称；周围是代码声明、调用或赋值。

patterns.name: 代码中的短小字母片段
patterns.context: 代码语句中的短变量名、参数名或标识符组成部分，出现在条件、索引、函数调用、赋值等上下文中。

patterns.name: SQL 查询中的分词片段
patterns.context: SQL 查询字符串中，特别是查询关键字、表名或随机排序表达式附近；激活也出现在后续 PHP 数据读取代码中。

patterns.name: 化学名称与化学式中的内部片段
patterns.context: 复杂化学式或系统化学名称中，跨越元素符号、括号、数字及有机化学名称片段。

patterns.name: 药物名称片段
patterns.context: 药物缩写 BCNU 出现在患者给药剂量、输注方式及药代动力学描述中。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 临床/药理文本

patterns.name: 数学家姓名的词内片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中人名的分词或非常规字符切分，位于外代数与公式相关论述附近。

en.description: Activations occur in several kinds of code, technical Q&A, legal names and addresses, and French parliamentary text. Recognizable local patterns include delimiter-related discussions, code identifiers and domain-specific terms, and French and Portuguese text; overall, these examples lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Delimiter-related code Q&A
patterns.context: Discusses search ranges, delimiters, CSV, or code execution; “delimiter” recurs in different positions and usages

patterns.name: Graphical line-style code
patterns.context: Code describes line cap and join styles, especially bevel

patterns.name: Floating-point special-value assertions
patterns.context: Checks floating-point numbers for infinity and NaN

patterns.name: IMAP connection test code
patterns.context: Test skip conditions, logging, and creation of a connection object

patterns.name: Names and addresses in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal text lists parties or addresses

patterns.name: Portuguese error-description string
patterns.context: Portuguese system error-description text near code

patterns.name: French parliamentary text
patterns.context: Consecutive French sentences in a context of parliamentary policy, anti-fraud measures, and food safety

11_2793.description: 激活出现在多类代码、技术问答、法律姓名地址及法语议会文本中。可辨认的局部模式包括 delimiter 相关讨论、代码标识符与特定领域词，以及法语和葡萄牙语文本；这些材料整体缺少统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: delimiter 相关代码问答
patterns.context: 讨论搜索范围、分隔符、CSV/代码执行；“delimiter”在不同位置和用法中反复出现

patterns.name: 图形线条样式代码
patterns.context: 代码中描述线条端帽与连接样式，尤其是 bevel

patterns.name: 浮点特殊值断言
patterns.context: 对浮点数检查无穷大和 NaN

patterns.name: IMAP 连接测试代码
patterns.context: 测试跳过条件、日志与创建连接对象

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名地址
patterns.context: 法律文本中列出当事人或地址

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语错误说明字符串
patterns.trigger: “string”“código de erro interno”“documentação”“descrever erros do sistema”
patterns.context: 代码附近的葡萄牙语系统错误说明文字
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术内容/葡萄牙语

patterns.name: 法语议会文本
patterns.context: 连续法语句子，含议会政策、反欺诈及食品安全语境

en.description: Activations are distributed across word-internal fragments and code identifier fragments in multiple languages, including Java, Swift, Python, JavaScript, and Italian, English, and Spanish text; no stable semantic or grammatical function is evident.

patterns.name: Splitting Java identifiers and method names
patterns.context: Camel-case method names, class names, or identifiers in Java print statements; activations fall on subwords within the names

patterns.name: Word-internal Italian subwords
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on fragments within split words in Italian text; examples include IRC conversations and formal parliamentary text

patterns.name: Word-internal English subwords
patterns.context: Activations occur within English words or code identifiers, with no common syntactic role
patterns.domain: Forum text, Swift code, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: authenticate in Python identifiers
patterns.context: Part of the name of an authenticate method related to connection and database options in Python code

patterns.name: JavaScript timestamp identifiers
patterns.context: Variable names and property expressions contain datetime/timestamp fragments in a JavaScript file-upload callback

patterns.name: Word-internal Spanish fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments of ordinary words in explanatory answers in Spanish

11_2793.description: 激活分布于多种语言的词内片段及代码标识符片段，涵盖 Java、Swift、Python、JavaScript 和意大利语、英语、西班牙语文本；未见稳定的语义或语法功能。

patterns.name: Java 标识符与方法名拆分
patterns.context: Java 输出语句中的驼峰式方法名、类名或标识符；激活落在名称内部的子词上

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词
patterns.context: 意大利语文本中，激活集中于被切分的词内部片段；含 IRC 对话和正式议会文本
patterns.domain: 意大利语口语及正式文本

patterns.name: 英语词内子词
patterns.context: 英语词或代码标识符内部出现激活，缺乏共同的句法角色
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、Swift 代码及生物医学摘要

patterns.name: Python 标识符中的 authenticate
patterns.context: Python 代码中，作为连接与数据库选项相关的 authenticate 方法名的一部分

patterns.name: JavaScript 时间戳标识符
patterns.context: JavaScript 文件上传回调中，变量名和属性表达式含 datetime／timestamp 片段

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语解释性回答中，激活落在普通词的片段上

en.concept: Multilingual short words and word fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on short function words in multilingual text, especially English the/a and Romance-language articles. Other isolated triggers include currency, give, medical word-internal fragments, an Italian reform term, a party name, makefile, and a Spanish evaluative word.

patterns.name: Articles or their morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on articles or short words functioning as articles in different languages, often near noun phrases; the language and syntactic environment vary.
patterns.domain: Natural-language text in English, Italian, Dutch, Spanish, and other languages

patterns.name: Currency-unit noun
patterns.context: In “sovereign currency,” activation falls on the noun naming the type of currency, preceded by sovereign and followed by punctuation.

patterns.name: Expressions of giving or donating
patterns.context: A conditional sentence supposes that someone copies a spreadsheet and gives it away for free; activation falls on give.

patterns.name: Medical word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a medical term describing acetylcholine hydrolysis levels; activation falls on an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Italian word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within the Italian word for “reform”; the same word appears in different passages discussing PAC reform and judicial reform.
patterns.domain: Italian speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Greek party name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a fragment of the Communist stem in a Dutch rendering of the name of the Greek Communist Party.

patterns.name: Filename-related fragment
patterns.context: Refers to the software build tool make and its file, alongside C.h, tester, and directories.

patterns.name: Spanish evaluative expression
patterns.context: An answer says it is fine to get a value from the display page, but not from the label; activation falls on the evaluative word meaning “good/okay.”

11_2793.description: 激活主要分布在多语种文本中的短功能词，尤其是英语 the/a 与罗曼语冠词；另有若干孤立触发：货币、give、医学词内片段、意大利语改革词、党名、makefile 及西班牙语评价词。

patterns.name: 冠词或其形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言中的冠词或带冠词功能的短词上，常出现在名词短语附近；具体语言和句法环境不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 英语、意大利语、荷兰语、西班牙语等自然语言文本

patterns.name: 货币单位名词
patterns.context: “sovereign currency”中激活在货币类别名词上，前有 sovereign，后接标点。

patterns.name: 让与、赠与表达
patterns.context: 条件句设想某人复制电子表格并免费给出去，激活落在 give。

patterns.name: 医学词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述乙酰胆碱水解水平的医学术语中，激活落在词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、生化指标

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“改革”一词内部；同一词在讨论 PAC 改革和司法改革的不同段落出现。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语发言

patterns.name: 希腊语党名词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语译写的希腊共产党名称中的 Communist 词干片段。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会记录、党派名称

patterns.name: 文件名相关片段
patterns.context: 与 C.h、tester、目录等并列，指软件构建工具 make 及其文件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语评价表达
patterns.context: 回答中说明展示页面取值可以，但不要从 label 取值；激活在表示“好／可以”的评价词上。

en.description: Activations cluster on several specific word fragments: multiple examples highlight pay, involving labor compensation, deferred compensation, or server fees. Others occur separately in brings, Assistant, VTE, DSL, aperf, and breakaway contexts, with no shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Bring/cause
patterns.context: The verb brings means that a good opportunity brings someone somewhere; the context is a letter or dramatic dialogue.

patterns.name: Occupation and job seeking
patterns.context: Job titles appear in discussions of job hunting, employment history, and résumé gaps.

patterns.name: Payment obligations and labor compensation
patterns.context: Discusses payment obligations in relation to benefits, retained interests, and reasonable value arising from labor or services.

patterns.name: Hourly pay
patterns.context: Describes how a repair shop might pay based on the time a mechanic works.

patterns.name: Payment of deferred compensation
patterns.context: Discusses a company agreeing to pay deferred compensation and the conditions for signing.

patterns.name: Medical term VTE
patterns.context: The abbreviation for venous thromboembolism is split in a discussion of complications associated with pancreatic cancer.

patterns.name: DSL and engineering practice
patterns.context: Discusses reverse engineering a DSL before understanding, using, or fixing it, and compares the time required.

patterns.name: Command and performance tool
patterns.context: A Shell script starts an aperf performance load for each CPU.

patterns.name: Income, costs, and payments
patterns.context: Discusses whether funds count as income and using part of the funds to pay for server space.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussion of finances and server costs

patterns.name: breakaway in program resumption
patterns.context: A code comment specifies that ProgramResumption can occur only after breakaway.

11_2793.description: 激活集中于若干具体词片：多段突出 pay，涉及劳动报酬、延期补偿或服务器费用；其余分别落在 brings、Assistant、VTE、DSL、aperf、breakaway 等不同语境，未见共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 带来／引出
patterns.context: 动词 brings 表示某种好机会把人带到某地；上下文是书信或戏剧对白。

patterns.name: 职业与求职
patterns.context: 职位名称出现在求职、就业经历及简历空档的讨论中。

patterns.name: 支付义务与劳动报酬
patterns.context: 围绕劳动或服务产生的受益、保留利益及合理价值，讨论支付义务。

patterns.name: 按工时付费

patterns.context: 描述修理店可能按维修技师工作的时间付钱。

patterns.name: 延期补偿的支付
