patterns.context: A Japanese single release description lists versions and media; overlaps with the quantity-expression pattern.

11_2805.description: 激活集中于数列数学题的数字、负号及题干邻近片段；另在two数量短语和若干专名、商品或型号描述中出现。跨模式缺乏足够证据支持单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的两位数片段
patterns.context: DM Mathematics 的数列补项或求第 n 项题，激活散布在题干和序列数字附近；触发可能与多位数、数字串或负号有关，但标注不足以确定精确边界

patterns.name: two 后的数量短语
patterns.trigger: “two varieties”“two styles”“two- and three-pickup models”“two Limited CD+DVD”中的“two”
patterns.context: two 表示数量，后接名词或复合名词；出现于产品介绍或版本描述

patterns.name: Chandler 中的内部片段
patterns.context: HTML 表格单元格内的人名，激活落在标签闭合符号及姓名开头附近

patterns.name: yEnc/yProxy 字符串中的片段
patterns.context: 讨论编码格式及代理软件，多个专名反复出现；标注还覆盖“Proxy”及其前后文本，难以判断激活是否特指词首

patterns.name: 商品评论中的外观描述
patterns.context: 描述万圣节主题纸制微缩模型；激活稀疏，可能只是与局部词形或分词有关

patterns.name: 吉他型号描述中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 吉他型号与拾音器配置的百科叙述；激活分散在词内或邻近词上

patterns.name: 音乐发行描述中的版本数量
patterns.context: 日本单曲发行说明，列举发行版本及介质；与数量表达模式重叠

en.description: Primarily responds to category or form lists introduced by “in two”, and also involves classification expressions such as “in three ways”; number activations in mathematical sequences also occur, and some word positions are difficult to explain through a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Enumeration following “in two …”
patterns.context: States that something is divided into two categories or has two forms, often followed by a colon or specific categories; similar enumeration structures also occur with “two …” followed by other quantity words.
patterns.domain: Expository texts such as encyclopedias, product introductions, and medical papers

patterns.name: Classification list using “one of three ways”
patterns.context: First states that an object has several configurations or modes, then introduces specific types with a colon; here, the phrase refers to holster carry positions.

patterns.name: Numbers in math sequence problems
patterns.context: Numbers appear in a math problem asking for the pth term of a sequence; activation falls on a value in the middle of the sequence.

patterns.name: Unexplained residual patterns
patterns.context: Although the passage as a whole contains classification expressions, activations are scattered across other words, and no consistent additional trigger can be identified.

11_2805.description: 主要响应“in two”引出的类别或形式列举，也涉及“三种方式”的分类表达；另有数学数列中的数字激活，部分词位难以由共同模式解释。

patterns.name: “in two …”后的列举
patterns.context: 说明某物被分成两类或有两种形式，常接冒号或具体分类；也有 “two …”后接其他数量词的相似列举结构。
patterns.domain: 百科、产品介绍、医学论文等说明性文本

patterns.name: “one of three ways”的分类列举
patterns.context: 先说明某对象有若干种配置或方式，再以冒号引出具体类型；此处是枪套的佩戴位置。

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在要求寻找数列第 p 项的数学题里；激活落在数列中间的数值。

patterns.name: 未解释的残余模式
patterns.trigger: “in two …”或数量分类列举不足以解释的具体触发位置
patterns.context: 段落整体虽含分类表达，但激活位置分散在其他词语上，无法确定统一的额外触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to quantity and classification expressions in noun phrases, especially numerals indicating the number of styles, versions, groups, modes, or components; sporadic activations also occur on in, time/model numbers, and some proper names, medical terms, and common function words.

patterns.name: Grouping, classification, or quantity expressions after numerals
patterns.context: A numeral in a noun phrase indicates the number of classifications, styles, versions, groups, modes, or components; nearby words often include in or into, or a noun directly follows the numeral.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, product and entertainment introductions, medical papers

patterns.name: Local activations on the preposition in
patterns.context: The preposition in is followed by a quantity, time, or other noun phrase; not every in is marked. The trigger appears biased toward uses adjacent to classification, release, time, or structural descriptions.

patterns.name: Division into two groups in medical statistics
patterns.context: A clinical study divides patients into two subgroups according to a particular status.

patterns.name: Measurement data analysis and listing of time points
patterns.context: A methods section lists follow-up times or the times, tools, and procedures for data analysis.

patterns.name: Numeric expressions in identifiers or model numbers
patterns.context: A number appears as part of a product model or as a publication year; these numbers may share a numeric/classification tendency with nearby quantity expressions, but evidence is weak.

patterns.name: Local activations in encoding names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Subwords within special encoding names or proper nouns are marked, without the clear syntactic conditions found in numeral-based grouping patterns.

patterns.name: Number of electric guitar pickups
patterns.context: In a product model description, a numeral is linked to the compound word pickup to indicate the pickup configuration.

patterns.name: Local activations in anatomical and histological terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms in medical surgery or anatomical descriptions are marked in fragments; no clear shared syntactic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Medical imaging classification components
patterns.context: An imaging system divides a plaque into multiple components, with a number indicating the number of categories.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common function words such as prepositions and articles
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions, with no stable, independent trigger condition.

11_2805.description: 主要响应名词短语中的数量与分类表达，尤其数词表示款式、版本、组别、方式或组成数量；也有 in、时间/型号数字及若干专名、医学术语和常见功能词的零散激活。

patterns.name: 数词后的分组、分类或数量表达
patterns.trigger: « two»、« three»、« four»，以及“in two varieties/styles/editions/models”“two subgroups”“three ways”“four major components”等
patterns.context: 数词出现在名词短语中，表示分类、款式、版本、组别、方式或组成部分的数量；附近常有 in、into，或名词直接跟在数词后
patterns.domain: 百科条目、产品与娱乐介绍、医学论文

patterns.name: 介词 in 的局部激活
patterns.trigger: « in»，如“comes in two varieties”“released in four editions”“in May 2015”“in two layers”“in 2016”
patterns.context: 介词 in 后接数量、时间或其他名词短语；并非所有 in 都有标记，触发似乎偏向与分类、发布、时间或结构描述相邻的用法

patterns.name: 医学统计中的两组划分
patterns.context: 临床研究中按某项状态将患者分为两个亚组

patterns.name: 测量数据分析与时间点列举
patterns.trigger: “Data were analyzed … in « 2016»”及“6 months”等时间点
patterns.context: 研究方法段落列出随访时间或数据分析的时间、工具和流程

patterns.name: 编号或型号中的数值表达
patterns.context: 数值作为产品型号的一部分或出版年份出现；这些数值可能与周边的数量表达共享数字/分类倾向，但证据较弱

patterns.name: 编码名称与专名的局部激活
patterns.context: 特殊编码或专名内部的子词被标记，缺乏与数词分组模式相同的明显句法条件

patterns.name: 电吉他拾音器数量表达
patterns.context: 产品型号描述中，数词与复合词 pickup 相连，表示拾音器配置

patterns.name: 解剖与组织学术语中的局部激活
patterns.context: 医学手术或解剖描述中的专业词被拆分标记，未见明确共同句法触发条件
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 病例/手术描述

patterns.name: 医学影像分类组件
patterns.context: 影像系统将斑块划分为多个成分，数字表示分类数目
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学影像研究

patterns.name: 介词或冠词等常见功能词的零散激活
patterns.context: 分布于不同句法位置，未体现稳定、独立的触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to classification, style, version, configuration, or layer expressions introduced by quantity words, especially “in two …” and “two + category noun”; it also covers research groupings, format enumerations, and sporadic within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Quantity or type enumeration following “come in”
patterns.context: When describing products, versions, games, or publications, a quantity or category word follows “in”, often introducing subsequent classifications, configurations, or lists.

patterns.name: “two” and its classification collocations
patterns.context: The quantity word two occurs before nouns for categories, groups, styles, configurations, or layers, and may also occur in hyphenated configuration descriptions.

patterns.name: Classification or enumeration introduced by other quantity words
patterns.context: Introduces multiple options such as versions or formats; triggers are not limited to two and also include quantity expressions such as four and number of.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and grouping expressions
patterns.context: Study subjects are divided into two groups or categories according to a status or characteristic; the phrase need not contain “in”, but retains a quantity-and-category enumeration structure.

patterns.name: Layered structures in medical procedures
patterns.context: Describes the number of layers in surgical suturing or tissue repair; unlike general product classification, it likewise features a quantity word two plus a structural category noun.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or surgical papers

patterns.name: Quantity descriptions of sources, time, and format
patterns.context: A quantity or range specifies research institutions, a time interval, or formats provided by a website; the first two are only weakly connected to the dominant “quantity + style/category” pattern.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragments within or at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented words, proper nouns, or morpheme fragments; they occur in technical names, brands, specialized terms, and other texts, making it difficult to infer an independent, consistent semantic trigger from these fragments.

11_2805.description: 主要响应数量词引出的分类、款式、版本、配置或层数表达，尤以“in two …”及“two + 类别名词”为强；亦覆盖研究分组、格式枚举和若干零散词内片段。

patterns.name: “come in”后列举数量或类型
patterns.trigger: « comes»3« in»6« two»10 varieties»；« come»1« in»6« two»9 styles»；« released»1« in»6« four»9 editions»；« released»« in»6« multiple»8 chapters»
patterns.context: 描述产品、版本、游戏或出版物时，数量词或类别词紧跟“in”，常引出后续分类、配置或清单。
patterns.domain: 百科、商品介绍、用户评论

patterns.name: “two”及其分类搭配
patterns.trigger: « two»10 varieties»；« two»9 styles»；« two»9-«；« two»8 subgroups»；« two»8 categories»；« two»8« layers»
patterns.context: 数量词 two 出现在类别、分组、款式、配置或层数等名词前，也可出现在连字符构成的配置描述中。

patterns.name: 其他数量词引出的分类或枚举
patterns.trigger: « in»6« four»9« editions»；« a»« number»2« of»5« formats»
patterns.context: 介绍不同版本、格式等多个选项；触发不限于 two，也包括 four、number of 等数量表达。

patterns.name: 统计分析与分组表达
patterns.trigger: « divided»« into»5« two»8 subgroups»；« classified»« into»3« two»8« categories»
patterns.context: 研究对象按状态或特征划分为两组或两类；未必含“in”，但保留数量与类别的列举结构。

patterns.name: 医疗操作中的分层结构
patterns.context: 描述手术缝合或组织修复的层数；与一般产品分类不同，但同样出现数量词 two 加结构类别名词。

patterns.name: 资料来源、时间及格式的数量描述
patterns.trigger: « from»1« 34»1 hospitals»；« in»4 the United States« from»2 November to December 2016»；« in»3« a»1« number»2« of»5« formats»
patterns.context: 数量或范围用于交代研究机构、时间区间，或网站提供的格式；前两类与主导的“数量+款式/类别”模式联系较弱。

patterns.name: 英文词内部或边界的切分片段
patterns.trigger: « y»1«Enc»1；«Proxy»；« M»2eter«Plus»；« Ev»2«enson»2；« Ar»1«ion»2« mini»2atures；« T»2-ara；« ph»2aryngeal；« muc»2o-«per»1ioste«al»1
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词、专名或词素片段上；出现于技术名称、品牌、专业术语等文本中，难以从这些片段归纳出独立一致的语义触发条件。

en.concept: Parameters and numbers in scientific texts
en.description: Diverse activation patterns: a clear preference for “pH” and its numerical conditions; also responds to digit strings containing “1920,” list formatting, experimental parameters, and technical terms. A few passages can only be described by their specific domain content and are difficult to assign to a unified mechanism.

patterns.name: Occurrence of pH
patterns.context: In scientific or patent texts, as a measurement metric, experimental condition, or adjustment target; followed by a value, range, or other parameter
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, patents

patterns.name: 1920 and adjacent digits
patterns.context: Appears in years, dates, or similar digit sequences; sometimes the digits are split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Historical figure lineages, academic entries, mathematical citations, film classifications; also digit strings in emails

patterns.name: Enumerated items and category formatting
patterns.context: Proper names or category labels arranged compactly in entries, references, or classification lists

patterns.name: Scientific experimental parameters and materials
patterns.context: Materials, values, and measurement parameters occur together in experimental methods or results
patterns.domain: PubMed biochemistry and food science abstracts

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and anatomical terms
patterns.context: Technical entities or terms in biomedical texts; triggering substrings are scattered, with no clear shared word form

patterns.name: Preparation/formulation context in patents
patterns.context: Describes latex product manufacturing, formulation, or pH adjustment

patterns.name: Numbers and transaction judgments in emails
patterns.context: Digit strings occur alongside judgments about whether a transaction is good or bad, with names or codes

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and citations
patterns.context: An author-and-year citation follows a formula

patterns.name: Medical disease names
patterns.context: Title-like phrases describing eye diseases and related blood vessels

11_2834.concept: 科学文本中的参数与数字
11_2834.description: 激活模式多样：明显偏好“pH”及其数值条件；另对含“1920”的数字串、列表排版、实验参数和专业术语有响应。少数段落仅能由其具体领域内容描述，难归入统一机制。

patterns.name: pH 的出现
patterns.trigger: “pH”，紧邻数字或实验条件时尤为明显
patterns.context: 在科学或专利文本中，作为测量指标、实验条件或调节目标；后接数值、范围或其他参数
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述、专利

patterns.name: 1920 年及相邻数字
patterns.context: 出现在年份、日期或类似数字序列中；有时数字被切分成多个 token
patterns.domain: 历史人物谱系、学术条目、数学引文、电影分类；另有邮件中的数字串

patterns.name: 列举式条目与分类排版
patterns.context: 条目、参考资料或分类列表中，专名或类别标签以紧凑格式排列

patterns.name: 科学实验参数与材料
patterns.trigger: “Sephadex A-50”“Sephadex G-100”“50 kD”“8.0”“50”；以及“11 W/cm2”“40, 60, and 80 min”“10, 7 and 14 d”
patterns.context: 实验方法或结果中，材料、数值和测量参数相邻出现
patterns.domain: PubMed 生化与食品科学摘要

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及解剖名词
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的专业实体或术语；触发子串分散，并无明显统一词形
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 专利中的制备/配方语境
patterns.context: 描述乳胶制品生产、配方或 pH 调节

patterns.name: 邮件中的数字与交易判断
patterns.context: 数字串与对某项交易好坏的判断并列，含人名或代号

patterns.name: 数学公式及引文
patterns.context: 公式之后接作者与年份引文

patterns.name: 医学疾病名称
patterns.context: 标题式短语中描述眼科疾病及相关血管

en.description: Activations are scattered across sentence-initial subword fragments (Wire, Tim), digit strings, fragments within medical and biological terms, and could in email requests; these examples show no unified semantics or stable contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial Wire
patterns.context: Wire appears at the beginning of a sentence in uppercase; later continued as wire bonding or wireless.

patterns.name: Time or timeline word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Tim appears at the beginning of a sentence, continued as Timeline or Tim:.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in digit strings
patterns.context: Transaction records or numeric strings in emails; another activation falls on «85» in mathematical text.

patterns.name: In-word stem fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-initial or stem fragments within longer words, respectively in texts about pregnancy weight and phylogeny.

patterns.name: could in requests
patterns.context: Informal email requests beginning with “Hey could you...”.

11_2834.concept: none
11_2834.description: 激活分散在句首词片段（Wire、Tim）、数字串，以及医学、生物学词内片段和邮件请求中的 could；这些样例未显示统一语义或稳定上下文模式。

patterns.name: Wire 词首
patterns.context: Wire 位于句首并以大写形式出现；后文将其接成 wire bonding 或 wireless。

patterns.name: 时间或时间线词首
patterns.context: Tim 位于句首，分别续成 Timeline 或 Tim:。

patterns.name: 数字串中的特定片段
patterns.context: 邮件中的交易记录或数值串；另一次激活落在数学文本中的 «85»。

patterns.name: 词内词干片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词内部的词首或词干片段，分别出现在孕期体重和系统发育相关文本中。

patterns.name: 请求语句中的 could
patterns.context: 邮件中以“Hey could you...”开头的非正式请求。

en.description: Activations occur at formatting boundaries across genres: spaces, indentation, line breaks, and the text that follows; they also cover email paragraphs, court headings, attachment lists, code comments, legal notices, and mathematical answer choices, with no unified semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Blank lines and sentence starts after line breaks in email body
patterns.context: In email bodies, two spaces and a line break appear after a sentence or paragraph, followed by a new sentence or paragraph; also seen in the space after a salutation.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, conversational or business email body

patterns.name: Court heading formatting
patterns.context: An uppercase court name is centered and indented across line breaks, forming a fixed legal-document heading.

patterns.name: Line breaks and filenames in attachment lists
patterns.context: After “See attached” in an email, attachment filenames are listed using line breaks and bullets.

patterns.name: Line-comment formatting in code license text
patterns.context: Source-code license notices appear as comment lines beginning with asterisks, line breaks, and indentation.

patterns.name: Contract-like data-use restriction clause
patterns.context: States that data may not be disclosed without written consent and emphasizes data ownership or proprietary rights.
patterns.domain: Legal notices about market data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Mathematics problem answer-choice formatting
patterns.context: Parenthesized letter choices and mathematical expressions are separated by spaces after the problem statement.

11_2834.concept: 排版边界与格式化文本
11_2834.description: 激活出现在多种文体的格式边界：空格、缩进、换行及其后的文本；同时覆盖邮件段落、法院抬头、附件列表、代码注释、法律声明和数学选项，缺少统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 邮件正文换行后的空行与句首
patterns.context: 邮件正文中句子或段落结束后出现两个空格、换行，随后接续新句或新段；也见于称呼后空格。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，口语或商务邮件正文

patterns.name: 法院抬头排版
patterns.trigger: «                        »4«UNITED»5« STATES»10 DISTRICT« COURT»3«↵»6«                        »5«FOR»2« THE»3« DISTRICT»1 OF
patterns.context: 大写法院名称以居中缩进和换行排版，出现固定法律文书抬头。

patterns.name: 附件清单中的换行与文件名
patterns.context: 邮件中“See attached”之后，以换行和项目符号列出附件文件名。

patterns.name: 代码许可文本中的行注释格式
patterns.context: 源码许可声明以星号开头的注释行、换行及缩进呈现。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释/许可证文本

patterns.name: 合同式数据使用限制条款
patterns.trigger: «valuable»9« property»3 rights；« the»6« express»2« written»3« consent
patterns.context: 声明不得未经书面同意披露数据，并强调数据所有权或专有权利。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的市场数据法律声明

patterns.name: 数学题选项排版
patterns.context: 题干后以空格分隔括号字母选项及数学表达式。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on the substring New: it appears in proper names such as New York, New Orleans, and Newar, often at the beginning of a place or name; line-break boundaries also often show weaker activations. Variables and exponents in mathematical formulas form a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Proper names or phrases beginning with New
patterns.context: New is followed by York, Orleans, ar, etc., in proper names, place names, ethnic group names, or titles; the strongest activation usually falls on New itself.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, papers, film reviews, and webpage titles

patterns.name: Newline character
patterns.context: Between titles and body text, at paragraph or entry boundaries; also appears near mathematical problem content.
patterns.domain: Formatting and structural markers across corpora

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and polynomial expressions
patterns.context: Formulas consisting of variables, coefficients, powers, and algebra problem instructions.

patterns.name: Title-style proper-name combinations
patterns.context: Phrases made up of multiple capitalized words in webpage titles or section names; this example does not fully match the New York place-name pattern.

patterns.name: Newar substring within a proper name
patterns.context: Within Newar (the name of a Nepali ethnic group), where New is not an independent New York/Orleans place-name word.

11_2834.concept: New 子串及结构边界
11_2834.description: 激活主要集中于 New 这一子串：它出现在 New York、New Orleans、Newar 等专名中，常处于地名或名称开头；此外换行边界也常有较弱激活。数学公式中的变量与幂次构成单独模式。

patterns.name: New 开头的专名或短语
patterns.context: New 后接 York、Orleans、ar 等，出现在专名、地名、族名或标题中；最强激活多落在 New 本身。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、论文、影评及网页标题

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 标题与正文之间、段落或条目边界处；也出现在数学题目内容附近。
patterns.domain: 多种语料的排版与结构标记

patterns.name: 数学变量与多项式表达式
patterns.context: 变量、系数、幂和代数题目指令构成的公式中。

patterns.name: 标题式专名组合
patterns.context: 网页标题或栏目名中，多个首字母大写词组成短语；此例与 New York 地名模式不完全相同。

patterns.name: 专名中间的 Newar 子串
patterns.context: Newar（尼泊尔族群名称）内部，New 并非独立的 New York/Orleans 地名词。

en.description: Activations occur in three text types: GNU software licenses and their disclaimers, all-uppercase U.S. court names in headings, and algebraic variables, numbers, and expressions in math problems; there is no evidence they share a more specific trigger word.

patterns.name: GNU license identifiers
patterns.context: GNU GPL/LGPL appears in software source-file copyright or license text, often alongside line-break comments, disclaimers, or license versions

patterns.name: U.S. court name headings
patterns.context: All-uppercase headings with official U.S. court names; institution names may include qualifiers such as a state or military branch

patterns.name: Variables and numerical expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions, integer operations, or digit problems appear alongside natural-language math problem statements

11_2834.concept: 法律/许可与数学文本标记
11_2834.description: 激活出现在三类文本：GNU 软件许可证及其免责声明，标题中的美国法院全大写名称，以及数学题里的代数变量、数字和运算式；没有证据表明它们共享更具体的触发词。

patterns.name: GNU 许可证标识
patterns.context: 软件源文件版权或许可证文本中出现 GNU GPL/LGPL，常伴随换行注释、免责声明或许可版本

patterns.name: 美国法院名称标题
patterns.context: 美国法院正式名称的全大写标题；机构名称可包含州或军种等限定词

patterns.name: 数学题中的变量与数值表达
patterns.context: 代数式、整数运算或数位问题与自然语言数学题干相邻

en.description: Activations often occur on fixed modifiers or fact-finding phrases in legal texts: special verdict/conditions, ultimate facts, prior sexual, final contention, consecutive sentences; also seen with colloquial special and neighbors.

patterns.name: special collocations with legal terms
patterns.context: In legal judgments, special modifies legal concepts such as verdicts, conditions, or rules; often appears in descriptions of disputed issues or remedies.

patterns.name: Legal collocation ultimate facts
patterns.context: Legal discussion of claims, evidence, or fact-finding; ultimate occurs with facts.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw: legal opinions and evidentiary discussion

patterns.name: Collocation prior sexual conduct
patterns.context: Discusses a victim’s prior sexual conduct and the admissibility of evidence.

patterns.name: Collocation final contention
patterns.context: When a court addresses appellate claims one by one, final modifies contention.

patterns.name: Collocation consecutive sentences
patterns.context: Discusses whether the court imposed consecutive sentences after making the required findings.

patterns.name: special in personal evaluations
patterns.context: A colloquial quotation evaluates someone’s character and importance; distinct from the legal usage.

patterns.name: Neighbor relationship context
patterns.context: Describes adjacent parties and the locations of their properties, with no clear semantic collocation shared with the other highlighted words.

11_2834.concept: 法律文本中的突出搭配词
11_2834.description: 激活多出现在法律文本中的固定修饰搭配或事实认定措辞：special verdict/conditions、ultimate facts、prior sexual、final contention、consecutive sentences；另见口语 special 和 neighbors。

patterns.name: special 与法律术语搭配
patterns.context: 法律判决中，special 修饰裁决、条件、规则等法律概念；常出现在对争点或救济措施的描述中。

patterns.name: ultimate facts 法律搭配
patterns.context: 法律论述中谈及主张、举证或事实认定；ultimate 与 facts 连用。

patterns.name: prior sexual conduct 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论被害人既往性行为及证据可采性。

patterns.name: final contention 搭配
patterns.context: 法院逐项处理上诉主张时，final 修饰 contention。

patterns.name: consecutive sentences 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论法院是否作出所需认定后判处连续刑期。

patterns.name: 人物评价中的 special
patterns.context: 口语引述中评价某人的品格及其重要性；与法律用法不同。

patterns.name: 邻居关系语境
patterns.context: 描写相邻当事人及其房产位置，缺少与其他高亮词明显一致的语义搭配。

en.description: Often marks the importance of a factor, stage, condition, or work to subsequent research, judgment, or argument in academic prose; also responds to research-plan stage/goal language, with outlier triggers in introductions to scientific works and URL subword fragments.

patterns.name: Importance or significance of a relationship/following content
patterns.context: When explaining that a concept, finding, condition, or step is important to subsequent understanding, research, judgment, or argument; importance terms often follow an explanatory statement
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research plans, and encyclopedia descriptions

patterns.name: Introduction of research goals, plans, or stages
patterns.context: Describes follow-up research or specific goals of a research project, or transitions from prior work to the current stage; not all these instances explicitly express importance

patterns.name: Scientific works and history of science topics
patterns.context: Introduces someone’s works, especially works about scientific progress; activation falls on a phrase related to the work

patterns.name: In-word fragments in webpage links
patterns.context: A Wikipedia URL embedded in a HackerNews post; the trigger is a subword fragment in the link, not a topic word in the body

patterns.name: Local conditions in formal mathematics
patterns.context: In discussing a proof or technical modification, notes that the main change concerns a particular condition; possibly related to research-importance statements only in the sense of “main/key”

11_2834.concept: 重要性与后续研究
11_2834.description: 多在学术叙述中标记某因素、阶段、条件或工作对后续研究、判断或论证的重要性；也响应研究计划的阶段/目标用语，并有科学著作介绍及URL词片段的离群触发。

patterns.name: 关系/后续内容的关键性或重要性
patterns.context: 在说明某个概念、发现、条件或步骤对后续理解、研究、判断或论证具有重要作用时；重要性词常出现在解释性陈述之后
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研计划与百科说明

patterns.name: 研究目标、计划或研究阶段的引入
patterns.context: 叙述研究项目的后续研究、具体目标，或从既有工作过渡到当前阶段；并非所有这些位置都明确表达重要性

patterns.name: 科学著作及科学史主题
patterns.context: 介绍某人的著作，尤其是关于科学进步的作品；激活落在作品相关短语中

patterns.name: 网页链接中的词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在HackerNews帖子里的维基百科URL，触发点是链接中的词片段，不是正文主题词

patterns.name: 形式化数学中的局部条件
patterns.context: 讨论证明或技术修改时，说明主要改动涉及某一条件部分；与科研重要性表述可能只在“主要/关键”意义上相近

en.description: Activations mainly fall on words emphasizing commonality (common, share) or importance (key, critical, pivotal); two other examples, atypical and unique, both convey distinction or specialness, though the wording is not consistent.

patterns.name: Commonality/shared features
patterns.context: Different genes, antigenic epitopes, or cells have common features, shared origins, or similarities; often appears in sentences presenting evidence or a hypothesis.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, scientific abstracts, and microbial ecology

patterns.name: Key importance or significance
patterns.context: Modifies a function, role, process, or feature to emphasize that it is important, core, or key; common in academic discussion.

patterns.name: Atypical classification
patterns.context: Describes viral genome combinations that differ from common categories.

patterns.name: Unique cultural impact
patterns.context: Describes the distinctive impact of a group’s experiences on culture.

11_2834.concept: 强调特征的显著性
11_2834.description: 激活主要落在强调共同性（common、share）或重要性（key、critical、pivotal）的词上；另有 atypical、unique 两例，均带有突出区别或特殊性的意味，但词面不统一。

patterns.name: 共同性／共性
patterns.context: 不同基因、抗原表位或细胞之间具有共同特征、共享来源或相似性；常出现于提出证据或假设的句子中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科研摘要及微生物生态学

patterns.name: 关键性或重要性
patterns.context: 修饰作用、角色、过程或特征，强调其重要、核心或关键；多见于学术论述。

patterns.name: 异常／非典型分类
patterns.context: 描述少数病毒基因组组合区别于常见类别。

patterns.name: 独特文化影响
patterns.context: 描述某群体经历对文化产生的特有影响。
patterns.domain: 维基百科传记／书籍介绍

en.concept: Biomedical genetic terminology and a few outliers
en.description: Most passages concern genes, cancer, genomic variation, transcription, or genetic selection, with activations often falling on related biological terms; neural circuit research is also present, as are the words “noble,” “worthy,” and “god” in a prayer narrative, which are difficult to fit into the same semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Gene/oncogene terminology
patterns.context: Cancer research, especially oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and their mutations or treatments; activations fall on cancer-related gene terms

patterns.name: Genome and genetic variation terminology
patterns.context: Describes genomic changes in cancer cells or gene conservation and specificity across genomes of different strains

patterns.name: Gene expression and transcriptional regulation
patterns.context: Discusses eukaryotic transcription, specific gene expression levels, or changes in expression patterns

patterns.name: Evolutionary selection and traits
patterns.context: Selection acts on RNA secondary structure and affects fitness, or selective breeding changes genetic traits

patterns.name: Nervous system development and connectivity
patterns.context: Uses Caenorhabditis elegans as a model to study neural connectivity and genes related to spinal circuit formation

patterns.name: Deities and prayer narrative
patterns.context: Narrative descriptions of a person expressing wishes to deities or praying for attention or blessings

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传术语及少数异类
11_2834.description: 多数段落涉及基因、癌症、基因组变异、转录或遗传选择，激活常落在相关生物学术语；另见神经回路研究，以及祈愿叙事中“noble”“worthy”“god”等词，难以归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 基因／癌基因术语
patterns.context: 癌症研究语境，尤其是癌基因、肿瘤抑制基因及其突变或治疗；激活落在癌症相关基因术语上

patterns.name: 基因组与遗传变异术语
patterns.trigger: « recurrent» « homozygous» « deletions»；« copy» « number» « alterations»；« conserved» « genes»；« strain» «-»«specific» « genes»
patterns.context: 描述癌细胞基因组改变或不同菌株基因组中的基因保守性、特异性

patterns.name: 基因表达与转录调控
patterns.trigger: « transcriptional» « repertoire»、« transcription»、« gene»；« minor» … « alterations»
patterns.context: 讨论真核细胞转录、特定基因表达水平或模式变化

patterns.name: 进化选择与性状
patterns.trigger: « selection»、« secondary» « structures»、« beneficial»；« selective» « breeding»
patterns.context: 选择作用于RNA二级结构并影响适应性，或通过选择育种改变遗传性状

patterns.name: 神经系统发育与连接
patterns.trigger: « crucial» … « roles»；« nervous» « system»、« spinal» « cord»
patterns.context: 以秀丽隐杆线虫为模型研究神经连接及脊髓回路形成相关基因

patterns.name: 神祇与祈愿叙事
patterns.context: 人物向神祇表达愿望、祈求关注或恩赐的叙事描写
patterns.domain: 维基百科／宗教或仪式性叙事

en.concept: Genes and molecular genetics research texts
en.description: Generally oriented toward genes, genetic variation, and expression regulation in biomedical research texts; also responds to topics in tumors, breeding, sequence evolution, and functional experiments. A passage on ascites syndrome in livestock and poultry shows no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Gene and molecular biology terminology
patterns.context: Genes and proteins are discussed as research subjects or mechanisms; no specific organism is required.

patterns.name: Genetic variation and chromosomal changes
patterns.context: Describes genetic variation, changes in genome structure, or their relationship to tumors and traits.

patterns.name: Expression regulation and cell differentiation
patterns.context: Involves cell fate, transcriptional regulation, or RNA regulatory mechanisms.

patterns.name: Genome sequencing and sequence homology
patterns.context: Analyzes gene or RNA sequences, homology, or evolutionary processes.

patterns.name: Tumor and cancer-related research
patterns.context: Cancer as a research context, discussing tumor suppression, cancer cells, or chromosomal changes.

patterns.name: Livestock and poultry traits and selective breeding
patterns.context: Relates disease susceptibility or production traits in poultry to genetics and breeding.

patterns.name: Transposon- or integrase-related sequences
patterns.context: Describes sequence elements that contain integrase genes and their homology.
patterns.domain: Microbial or mobile genetic element research

patterns.name: Gene function experiments and reporter systems
patterns.context: Uses experimental systems to test the functional effects of genetic variation or protein isoforms.
patterns.domain: Research plans and experimental molecular biology

patterns.name: snRNA multicopy and coevolution
patterns.context: Discusses the copy number and evolution of small nuclear RNA paralogs.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within terminology
patterns.context: Activations fall on in-word fragments split by tokenization; these fragments occur in different technical contexts and do not support a unified meaning.

11_2834.concept: 基因与分子遗传学科研文本
11_2834.description: 总体偏向生物医学科研文本中的基因、遗传变异与表达调控；也响应肿瘤、育种、序列进化及功能实验等主题。另有畜禽腹水综合征段落，未见明确共享触发词。

patterns.name: 基因与分子生物学术语
patterns.context: 基因、蛋白质及其表达作为研究对象或机制被讨论；不要求特定生物种类。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研计划

patterns.name: 遗传变异及染色体改变
patterns.context: 描述遗传变异、基因组结构变化，或其与肿瘤、性状的关系。
patterns.domain: 癌症遗传学、遗传学研究

patterns.name: 表达调控与细胞分化
patterns.context: 涉及细胞命运、转录调控或RNA调控机制。

patterns.name: 基因组测序与序列同源性
patterns.context: 分析基因或RNA序列、同源关系或进化过程。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学与进化生物学

patterns.name: 肿瘤与癌症相关研究
patterns.context: 癌症作为研究背景，讨论肿瘤抑制、癌症细胞或染色体改变。

patterns.name: 畜禽性状与选择育种
patterns.context: 家禽疾病倾向或生产性状与遗传、育种相关联。

patterns.name: 转座或整合酶相关序列
patterns.context: 描述序列元件中含有整合酶基因及其同源性。
patterns.domain: 微生物或移动遗传元件研究

patterns.name: 基因功能实验与报告系统
patterns.context: 通过实验系统检验遗传变异或蛋白异构体的功能影响。
patterns.domain: 科研计划与实验分子生物学

patterns.name: snRNA多拷贝与协同进化
patterns.context: 讨论小核RNA旁系同源基因的拷贝数及进化。

patterns.name: 术语内部子词碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的词内片段；这些片段出现在不同专业语境，无法据此归纳统一词义。
patterns.domain: 科研文本中的分词碎片

en.description: Primarily responds to discussions of genes, mutations, genetic diseases, and cancer in biomedical texts; also covers specific topics such as gene expression regulation, molecular function, integrase sequences, and ABC transporters.

patterns.name: Genetic variation and disease association
patterns.context: Genetic variation, genotype, or gene defects are linked to disease risk or functional consequences; sometimes involving monoallelic or biallelic inheritance.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics and disease research abstracts

patterns.name: Cancer- and tumor suppressor-related genes
patterns.context: Discusses genes in cancer, tumor-suppressive effects, or chromosomal rearrangements and fusion genes.

patterns.name: Gene expression, regulation, and cell differentiation
patterns.context: Describes changes in gene expression, lineage regulation, or the potential regulation of gene expression by small RNAs.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology and cell differentiation research

patterns.name: Molecular mechanisms and functional characterization
patterns.context: Explains molecular function, gene or protein defects, sequence features, and their biological consequences.

patterns.name: Genetic causes of specific diseases
patterns.context: Focuses on a hereditary syndrome, describing its severity and associated gene mutations.

patterns.name: ABC transporter family
patterns.context: Names the ATP-binding cassette transporter family and discusses its links to aging or age-related diseases.

patterns.name: Bacterial integrases and sequence homology
patterns.context: Analyzes sequence elements, noting that they contain an integrase gene and show within-group homology.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传与基因研究
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中基因、突变、遗传病与癌症的讨论，也涉及基因表达调控、分子功能、整合酶序列及 ABC 转运蛋白等具体主题。

patterns.name: 遗传变异与疾病关联
patterns.context: 遗传变异、基因型或基因缺陷与疾病风险、功能后果相联系；有时涉及单等位或双等位遗传。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学与疾病研究摘要

patterns.name: 癌症及肿瘤抑制相关基因
patterns.context: 讨论癌症中的基因、肿瘤抑制作用或染色体重排与融合基因。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学与癌症研究

patterns.name: 基因表达、调控与细胞分化
patterns.context: 描述基因表达变化、谱系调控，或小 RNA 对基因表达的潜在调节。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与细胞分化研究

patterns.name: 分子机制与功能表征
patterns.context: 阐述分子功能、基因或蛋白缺陷、序列特征及其生物学后果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 特定疾病的遗传病因
patterns.context: 以遗传性综合征为主题，说明其严重程度及相关基因突变。

patterns.name: ABC 转运蛋白家族
patterns.context: 点名 ATP 结合盒转运蛋白家族，并讨论其与衰老或年龄相关疾病的联系。
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述标题及摘要

patterns.name: 细菌整合酶与序列同源性
patterns.context: 分析序列元件，指出其中含有整合酶基因及组内同源性。
patterns.domain: 微生物遗传学研究摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to terms related to genes, their sequences, allelic variants, mutations, and genome structure, commonly in biomedical and genetics texts; cancer is prominent, with additional coverage of plant resistance genes and cardiac developmental genetics.

patterns.name: Genes and genetic variation
patterns.context: Discusses gene identity, function, variation, or disease association; paragraph 1 also mentions promoters and integrase genes, while paragraph 7 concerns viral genome fragments
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular genetics, and cancer research

patterns.name: Sequences, elements, and genome structure
patterns.context: Describes genetic sequences, repetitive elements, genome rearrangements, or evolutionary relationships

patterns.name: Cancer and tumor-related contexts
patterns.context: Genes or mutations are discussed in the context of cancer development, treatment, or tumor suppression

patterns.name: Cardiac development and congenital defects
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between Nkx2.5 mutations and congenital heart defects in families

patterns.name: Plant resistance genes and truncated proteins
patterns.context: Describes resistance gene allelic variants and their protein truncation in cotton resistant lines

11_2834.concept: 基因与遗传变异
11_2834.description: 主要对基因及其序列、等位变异、突变和基因组结构相关词汇反应，常见于生物医学与遗传学文本；癌症语境突出，另覆盖植物抗性基因和心脏发育遗传学。

patterns.name: 基因与遗传变异
patterns.context: 讨论基因的身份、功能、变异或疾病关联；第1段另有启动子与整合酶基因，第7段涉及病毒基因组片段
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子遗传学及癌症研究

patterns.name: 序列、元件与基因组结构
patterns.context: 描述遗传序列、重复元件、基因组重排或演化关系

patterns.name: 癌症与肿瘤相关语境
patterns.context: 基因或突变被置于癌症发生、治疗或肿瘤抑制的语境中

patterns.name: 心脏发育与先天性缺陷
patterns.context: 讨论 Nkx2.5 的突变与家系中先天性心脏缺陷的关系

patterns.name: 植物抗性基因与截短蛋白
patterns.context: 描述棉花抗性品系中抗性基因等位变异及其蛋白截短

en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical contexts involving genes, genetic elements, and their sequence relationships, especially mutations, variants, truncations, rearrangements, and homology; also covers cancer-related genes and clinical descriptions and gene introductions for cystic fibrosis.

patterns.name: Types of genetic variation and mutation
patterns.context: Discusses the types, consequences, or pathogenicity of gene or chromosomal variants, including splice sites, truncations, allelic variants, and fusion genes.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics, cancer genetics, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Sequence homology and gene families
patterns.context: Compares homology among genes, DNA sequences, and family members from different organisms or genetic elements.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, microbiology, and genomics papers

patterns.name: Cancer-related genes and tumor suppression
patterns.context: Introduces cancer-related genes, gene expression, or receptor-mediated antitumor effects.

patterns.name: Clinical manifestations and gene discovery in disease
patterns.context: Describes the clinical manifestations of cystic fibrosis and mentions related gene cloning or function.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学
11_2834.description: 主要响应基因、遗传元件及其序列关系的生物医学语境，尤其是突变、变异、截短、重排和同源性；也覆盖癌症相关基因及囊性纤维化临床与基因介绍。

patterns.name: 遗传变异与突变类型
patterns.context: 讨论基因或染色体变异的类型、后果或致病性；包括剪接位点、截短、等位变体及融合基因。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、癌症遗传学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 序列同源与基因家族
patterns.trigger: “Ty3/Gypsy family”“related element”“sequence homology”“share extensive homologies”“structural genes”
patterns.context: 比较不同生物或遗传元件的基因、DNA序列及家族成员之间的同源性。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、微生物学及基因组学论文

patterns.name: 癌症相关基因及肿瘤抑制
patterns.context: 介绍癌症相关基因、基因表达或受体介导的抗肿瘤作用。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学与医学摘要

patterns.name: 疾病临床表现与基因发现
patterns.trigger: “pulmonary infection”“pulmonary failure”“pancreatic dysfunction”“male infertility”“CF gene had been cloned”
patterns.context: 描述囊性纤维化的临床表现，并提及相关基因克隆或功能。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的遗传病医学介绍

en.description: Primarily responds to genomes, genes, and nucleic acid sequences and their analysis in biomedical genetics texts; also covers variation, homology, expression regulation, transposition, and chromosomal rearrangements, as well as viral, genetic disease, and cancer contexts.

patterns.name: Genome and nucleic acid sequence descriptions
patterns.context: Describes genome composition, gene sequences, cloning, or sequencing in life science papers, especially when terms for genes, nucleic acids, and experimental procedures appear.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, genetics, biomedical abstracts, and research background

patterns.name: Gene variation and polymorphism
patterns.context: Involves gene variants, alleles, or identification of disease-causing genes, often linked to disease risk or genetic markers.

patterns.name: Genome rearrangements and transposable elements
patterns.context: Discusses transposon copies, chromosomal rearrangements or translocations, and their effects on the genome.

patterns.name: Homology and evolutionary relationships
patterns.context: Compares similarities and relationships among genes or genetic elements across members, species, or evolutionary timescales.

patterns.name: Virus and vaccine research
patterns.context: Describes viral genomes or virulence, or genetic modification for vaccine development.

patterns.name: Promoters and gene expression regulation
patterns.context: Focuses on the effects of promoter or LTR sequences on gene function, expression, or transfection assay readouts.

patterns.name: Disease phenotypes and clinical manifestations
patterns.context: Lists clinical manifestations of genetic diseases or cancer-related genomic abnormalities; not always accompanied by specific sequence experiments.

patterns.name: RNA gene families
patterns.context: Describes similarities among members of small nuclear RNA gene families and their species distribution.

11_2834.concept: 生物医学遗传学与基因组研究
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中的基因组、基因与核酸序列及其分析；也覆盖变异、同源性、表达调控、转座和染色体重排，以及病毒、遗传病和癌症语境。

patterns.name: 基因组与核酸序列描述
patterns.trigger: « genome»、« RNA»、« gene»、« sequence»、« sequenced»、« cloned»
patterns.context: 生命科学论文中描述基因组组成、基因序列、克隆或测序；尤其出现基因、核酸与实验过程词汇时。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学、生物医学摘要及研究背景

patterns.name: 基因变异与多态性
patterns.context: 涉及基因变异、等位基因或致病基因识别，常与疾病风险或遗传标记相连。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、药物基因组学及疾病研究

patterns.name: 基因组重排与转座元件
patterns.context: 讨论转座子拷贝、染色体重排或易位，以及这些事件对基因组的影响。

patterns.name: 同源性与进化关系
patterns.context: 比较基因或遗传元件在不同成员、物种或进化时间中的相似性与关系。
patterns.domain: 比较基因组学、进化生物学

patterns.name: 病毒与疫苗研究
patterns.trigger: « rot»«avir»uses、« virulence»、« vaccine» candidates、« RV» genome
patterns.context: 描述病毒基因组、毒力或遗传改造以开发疫苗。

patterns.name: 启动子与基因表达调控
patterns.trigger: « promoter»、« 5»'» sequences、« LTR» enhancement、« reporter» gene
patterns.context: 关注启动子或LTR序列对基因功能、表达或转染实验读出的影响。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因表达实验

patterns.name: 疾病表型与临床表现
patterns.trigger: « pulmonary» infection、« pancreatic» dysfunction、« male» infertility、« cancer»
patterns.context: 列举遗传病临床表现或癌症相关基因组异常；并不总是伴随具体序列实验。
patterns.domain: 临床遗传学、医学研究背景

patterns.name: RNA基因家族
patterns.context: 描述小核RNA基因家族成员的相似性及其物种分布。

en.description: Primarily responds to genome, sequence, and variation terminology in scientific texts, and also covers genetic element annotation and dense numeric/unit information; one passage of religious text involving numerical names is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Genomics and viral sequence terminology
patterns.context: Biomedical descriptions centered on genome structure, sequences, fragments, or genetic variation; nearby text often includes numbers, abbreviations, and technical modifiers.

patterns.name: Gene mutations and pathogenicity annotation
patterns.context: Discusses predicted effects of mutations, disease associations, conservation, or whether a disease-causing gene has been identified.

patterns.name: Genetic elements and sequence function
patterns.context: Describes functional regions or genetic elements in the genome, often accompanied by abbreviations, classification labels, and accounts of functional restoration or sequence homology.
patterns.domain: Molecular genetics papers, genome annotation tables

patterns.name: Text involving numbers and precision
patterns.context: Numbers, percentages, base lengths, or decimal precision requirements are embedded in text; this pattern may be unrelated to biology.
patterns.domain: Math problems and biomedical data descriptions

patterns.name: Numerical names in Hebrew scripture
patterns.context: Recounts Moses, Mount Sinai, and divine revelation, with numbers forming part of religious names; stylistically distinct from the scientific passages.

11_2834.concept: 基因组科学术语与数字
11_2834.description: 主要响应科学文本中的基因组、序列与变异术语，也覆盖遗传元件注释及密集数字/单位；另有一段宗教文本中的数字称谓，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 基因组学与病毒序列术语
patterns.context: 围绕基因组结构、序列、片段或遗传变异展开的生物医学描述；术语附近常出现数字、缩写及技术性修饰语。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、分子生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 基因突变及致病性注释
patterns.context: 讨论突变的预测影响、疾病关联、保守性或致病基因是否已确定。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与临床生物医学论文

patterns.name: 遗传元件与序列功能
patterns.context: 描述基因组中的功能区域或遗传元件，常伴随缩写、分类标签及功能恢复或序列同源性叙述。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学论文、基因组注释表

patterns.name: 数字与精度相关文本
patterns.context: 数字、百分比、碱基长度或小数精度要求嵌在文本中；此模式可能与生物学主题无关。
patterns.domain: 数学题及生物医学数据描述

patterns.name: 希伯来经文中的数字化称谓
patterns.context: 叙述摩西、西奈山及上帝启示，数字用作宗教称谓的一部分；与科学段落风格不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to identification and definition of genes, mutations, or miRNAs in biomedical genetics texts; also covers molecular function, disease phenotypes, and sequence analysis and homology discourse. These patterns overlap but do not form a single narrow concept.

patterns.name: Identified or unidentified genes/variants
patterns.context: Genetic or molecular biology discourse introduces the discovery, identification, cloning, or number of disease-associated genes, pathogenic mutations, or allelic variants.

patterns.name: miRNA definitions and properties
patterns.context: Defines microRNA, describing its noncoding nature, molecular size, or regulatory function; the same definition may recur in different research contexts.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, patent background, paper background

patterns.name: Pathological or functional mechanism discourse
patterns.context: Explains the physiological mechanism, functional effects, or potential treatment strategies for a disease or molecule; may not focus on identifying genetic variants.

patterns.name: Recombinant sequences, integrase genes, and homology
patterns.context: Analyzes recombinant sequences or genetic elements, describing sequence composition, genes, and their homology relationships.

patterns.name: Clinical disease phenotypes
patterns.context: Describes clinical pathology, expression features, or organ-system manifestations of disease rather than directly reporting molecular discoveries.
patterns.domain: Medical paper background or main text

11_2834.concept: 生物医学分子遗传学叙述
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传学文本中基因、突变或 miRNA 的鉴定与定义，也覆盖分子功能、疾病表型，以及序列分析和同源性叙述；这些模式有交叠，但并非单一窄概念。

patterns.name: 被识别或尚未识别的基因/变异
patterns.trigger: “have been identified”“have not been identified”“had been cloned”，以及“mutations”“genes”“variant alleles”
patterns.context: 遗传或分子生物学叙述中，介绍疾病相关基因、致病突变或等位变异的发现、鉴定、克隆或数量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、论文背景

patterns.name: miRNA定义与性质
patterns.trigger: “Micro RNAs (miRNAs) are non-coding”“microRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs”
patterns.context: 以定义句介绍 microRNA，说明其非编码属性、分子大小或调控功能；相同定义可在不同研究背景中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、专利背景、论文背景

patterns.name: 病理或功能机制叙述
patterns.trigger: “correct BMP signaling defects”“metabolism of clopidogrel”“pulmonary failure”“regulate”
patterns.context: 说明疾病或分子的生理机制、功能影响或潜在治疗策略；未必围绕基因变异鉴定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与专利背景

patterns.name: 重组序列、整合酶基因与同源性
patterns.context: 分析重组序列或遗传元件，描述序列组成、基因及其同源关系。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、生物技术研究摘要

patterns.name: 临床疾病表型
patterns.trigger: “clinical pathology and expression profile”“pulmonary infection”“pancreatic dysfunction and male infertility”
patterns.context: 描述疾病的临床病理、表达特征或器官系统表现，而不是直接陈述分子发现。

en.description: Responds to molecular genetics descriptions of genes, RNA, and genomes in biomedical literature, especially definitions of noncoding RNA, gene mutations and disease associations, and sequence analysis and homology comparisons; also covers expression, transcription, and replication.

patterns.name: Noncoding RNA descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces miRNA in a definitional sentence; activation is concentrated on “non-coding/noncoding” and adjacent RNA descriptors.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, patent background, or paper introduction

patterns.name: Gene mutations and disease associations
patterns.context: Discusses disease-related genes, gene mutations, or identification of disease-causing genes; [1] also concerns the number of mutations and their potential effects.

patterns.name: Genomics and sequence comparisons
patterns.context: Describes genomes, sequence analysis, or similarities, homology, and identity between sequences from different organisms.

patterns.name: Gene expression and transcription/replication
patterns.context: Describes genome transcription and replication, or gene/protein expression in an organism; this pattern occurs only sparsely.

11_2834.concept: 分子遗传学描述
11_2834.description: 响应生物医学文献中基因、RNA及基因组的分子遗传学描述，尤其是非编码RNA定义、基因突变与疾病关联，以及序列分析和同源性比较；也涵盖表达、转录和复制。

patterns.name: 非编码 RNA 描述
patterns.trigger: [3]“Micro RNAs (miRNAs) are noncoding, single-stranded RNA molecules”；[10]“MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs”
patterns.context: 以定义性句式介绍 miRNA 的性质；激活集中在“non-coding/noncoding”及相邻 RNA 描述词。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、专利背景或论文引言

patterns.name: 基因突变与疾病关联
patterns.trigger: [1]“BMP type 2 receptor gene… mutations”；[7]“Mutations in the human MITF gene are responsible for… disorder”；[6]“causative genes have not been identified”
patterns.context: 谈论疾病相关基因、基因突变或致病基因鉴定；[1]还涉及突变数量及潜在效应。

patterns.name: 基因组学与序列比较
patterns.trigger: [2]“Sequence analysis… integrase genes… extensive homologies”；[8]“rice genome contains three PPT candidates… significant similarity”；[9]“genome sequences… 97%-99% nucleotide sequence identity”
patterns.context: 描述基因组、序列分析或不同生物序列之间的相似性、同源性与一致性。
patterns.domain: 分子遗传学、微生物学论文摘要

patterns.name: 基因表达及转录/复制
patterns.trigger: [5]“genome transcription and replication strategies”；[4]“Akt… expressed in mammals”
patterns.context: 说明基因组的转录和复制过程，或基因/蛋白在生物体中的表达；该模式仅少量出现。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、细胞生物学论文

en.description: All passages concern genes and their biological study: gene discovery, sequencing, mutations, polymorphisms, transcription, coding functions, or associations with disease, phenotypes, and immune susceptibility.

patterns.name: Gene syntax and annotation
patterns.context: A gene serves as the subject or object of study, followed by descriptions such as identified, sequenced, transcribed, or encoding, or linked to mutations, function, or phenotype.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts, patent background, and genetics research

11_2834.concept: 基因研究
11_2834.description: 所有片段都涉及基因及其生物学研究：基因的发现、测序、突变、多态性、转录、编码功能，或与疾病、表型和免疫易感性的关联。

patterns.name: 基因句法与注释
patterns.trigger: gene；genes；gene»6« is»9« highly；the unique envelope gene
patterns.context: 基因作为句子主语或研究对象，后接 identified、sequenced、transcribed、encoding 等描述，或与突变、功能、表型相连。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、专利背景与遗传学研究

en.concept: Gene discovery and genetic variation discourse
en.description: Primarily responds to gene and gene symbols in biomedical contexts, favoring descriptions of genes being identified, cloned, sequenced, detected, or mutated; also occurs with fusion genes and gene knockouts. God in paragraph 8 is an incidental exception.

patterns.name: Genes identified or cloned
patterns.context: Biomedical texts describe the discovery, cloning, or sequencing of disease-related genes; often adjacent to mutations, coding, or functional studies
patterns.domain: Medical genetics, molecular biology abstracts, and patent background

patterns.name: Genes and nearby names
patterns.context: Gene names or symbols are introduced, repeated, or listed alongside chromosomes, genetic loci, or encoded products

patterns.name: Present-perfect passive voice
patterns.context: Reports that a research subject has been discovered, detected, isolated, or cloned; gene often appears in the same or nearby sentence

patterns.name: Gene mutations and pathogenicity
patterns.context: Describes associations between gene variation and disease, phenotype, or gene dosage effects

patterns.name: Gene fusions and chromosomal rearrangements
patterns.context: Chromosomal translocations produce fusion genes, followed by reports of the fusion types detected

patterns.name: Capitalization or tokenization variants in gene symbols
patterns.context: Gene symbols are split, or variant names occur next to gene or locus; activation may fall on a symbol fragment rather than the generic word gene

patterns.name: God in song titles
patterns.context: A proper name in a concert program title, unrelated to genes or biomedical meaning

patterns.name: Suppressing placental hormone synthesis during pregnancy
patterns.context: Describes a proposed gene knockout to prevent placental hormone synthesis in mice; activation words occur in gene/protein discourse

patterns.name: BMP receptor gene mutations
patterns.context: Links receptor gene mutations to BMP signaling defects and potential therapeutic approaches

11_2834.concept: 基因发现与遗传变异叙述
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学语境中gene及基因符号，并偏好基因被鉴定、克隆、测序、检测或突变的叙述；也见于融合基因和基因敲除。第8段的God属偶然异例。

patterns.name: 基因被鉴定或克隆
patterns.trigger: «gene»、«identified»、«cloned»、«sequenced»，以及“gene had been cloned”“gene has been identified”
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中描述疾病相关基因的发现、克隆或测序；常与突变、编码或功能研究相邻
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、分子生物学摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 基因及其名称附近
patterns.trigger: «gene»及基因符号，如“Glycop​horin E”“CF gene”“CCHCR1 gene”“MITF gene”“SS18 gene”“Gsc locus”
patterns.context: 基因名称或符号被引入、复述，或与染色体、遗传位点、编码产物并列
patterns.domain: 遗传学与疾病机制研究

patterns.name: 完成时被动语态
patterns.context: 报道研究对象已被发现、检测、分离或克隆；gene 常在同句或邻近文本中

patterns.name: 基因突变与致病关系
patterns.trigger: “«Mut»ations in the human «MITF» «gene»”“«mutations» have been identified”“causative genes”
patterns.context: 说明基因变异与疾病、表型或基因剂量效应相关

patterns.name: 基因融合与染色体重排
patterns.trigger: “«fusion» between the SS18 gene … and … SSX genes”“translocation”及“fusion genes”
patterns.context: 染色体易位产生融合基因，随后报告检测到的融合类型

patterns.name: 基因符号中的大小写或分词变化
patterns.context: 基因符号被拆分、变体名称紧邻gene或locus；激活可能落在符号片段而非gene通用词
patterns.domain: 发育遗传学及基因命名

patterns.name: 歌词标题中的 God
patterns.context: 音乐会曲目标题中的专名，不涉及基因或生物医学含义

patterns.name: 妊娠期间抑制胎盘激素合成
patterns.trigger: “gene encoding this protein has been disrupted”
patterns.context: 描述拟通过基因敲除阻止小鼠胎盘激素合成；激活词位于gene/protein叙述中

patterns.name: BMP受体基因突变
patterns.context: 将受体基因突变与BMP信号缺陷及治疗思路联系起来

en.description: Primarily responds to genes and molecular terminology in biomedical texts, especially genes being identified, sequenced, cloned, or mapped, as well as gene polymorphisms, allelic variants, and disease-related mutations; may also activate on common words in music titles.

patterns.name: Genes and their discovery, sequencing, or mapping
patterns.context: Introduces the discovery, acquisition, sequencing, or chromosomal mapping of a specific gene or its nucleic acid sequence, often phrased as “gene has been…” or “cDNA has been…”

patterns.name: Gene variation and mutations
patterns.context: Describes polymorphisms, allelic variants, or mutations in disease-related genes, often with details on their number and functional effects
patterns.domain: Genetics, disease mechanisms, and medical research

patterns.name: Gene terminology in biomedicine
patterns.context: Technical descriptions related to genes, molecular mechanisms, or genetic diseases; does not necessarily describe discovery or mutation

patterns.name: Common words in album track titles
patterns.context: A common English word in a live music recording or track description is marked; lacks a gene or biomedical context

11_2834.concept: 基因与遗传变异
11_2834.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的基因及分子术语，尤其是基因被识别、测序、克隆或定位，以及基因多态性、等位变异和疾病相关突变；也可在音乐曲名的普通词中激活。

patterns.name: 基因及其发现、测序或定位
patterns.trigger: “gene”“has been identified and sequenced”“cDNA has been obtained”“gene has been isolated and mapped”
patterns.context: 介绍特定基因或其核酸序列的发现、获取、测序或染色体定位，常见表达为“gene has been…”或“cDNA has been…”
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 基因变异与突变
patterns.trigger: “gene is highly polymorphic”“variant alleles”“mutations”“mutations have been identified”
patterns.context: 说明疾病相关基因存在多态性、等位变异或突变，常伴随数量和功能影响的描述
patterns.domain: 遗传学、疾病机制及医学研究

patterns.name: 生物医学中的基因术语
patterns.trigger: “gene”“cDNA”“non-homologous end joining”及专业基因或分子名称
patterns.context: 基因、分子机制或遗传疾病相关的专业说明；不一定描述发现或突变
patterns.domain: 免疫学及生物医学研究

patterns.name: 专辑曲目标题中的普通词
patterns.trigger: “More than You Know”“All God's Chillun Got Rhythm”
patterns.context: 音乐现场录音或曲目介绍中，标题里的普通英语词被标记；缺少基因或生物医学语境

en.description: The most salient shared cue is available, especially when describing the availability of resources, products, formats, or information. Other local triggers include hunting, drugs, YAML, chemistry, research, typefaces, holsters, product prices, and regulatory emails; the semantic domains are dispersed.

patterns.name: available followed by resources or information
patterns.context: “available” is followed by a specific obtainable object, or describes content that can be provided; objects include preparation, YAML, solvent, services, typefaces, products, and summary.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, technical documentation, encyclopedias, product copy, business emails

patterns.name: available access
patterns.context: “available” modifies access, expressing the convenience of obtaining a method or capability.

patterns.name: Conditional use of available
patterns.context: “available” appears in a conditional clause, indicating that a format will be used if it is available.

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of people or groups hunting; one instance is paired with gathering food, and another describes a holster used for hunting.

patterns.name: Drug names and clinical comparisons
patterns.context: Drug names appear in research descriptions comparing newer sleeping pills with existing formulations.

patterns.name: YAML format name
patterns.context: Appears in a description of formats that are alternatives to or supersets of JSON, within the conditional phrase “if available”.

patterns.name: Chemical catalysis terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a chemistry abstract on preparing cyclic products, as a method for generating radical species.

patterns.name: High-loading support materials
patterns.context: Describes support materials used to synthesize compound libraries, alongside solvent-delivery robots.

patterns.name: Cancer centers and pharmacogenomics
patterns.context: Describes laboratory services for cancer research and their areas of analysis.

patterns.name: Typefaces and scripts
patterns.context: Describes Baroque style, Gothic calligraphic roots, and digital versions of related typefaces.

patterns.name: Holster categories and uses
patterns.context: Lists holster types used by military and police, plainclothes personnel, private users, and shooting-sports participants.

patterns.name: Product names and prices
patterns.context: Product sets and individual items are available for purchase, with prices listed.

patterns.name: Regulatory documents and meeting abstracts
patterns.context: Concerns rules and strategic plans issued by regulatory agencies, and says meeting abstracts will be available later.

11_2993.concept: 可获得性及若干词项触发
11_2993.description: 最显著共同线索是 available，尤其用于说明资源、商品、格式或信息可获得；另有 hunting、药物、YAML、化学、科研、字体、枪套、商品价格和监管邮件等局部触发，语义领域分散。

patterns.name: available 后接资源或信息
patterns.context: “available”后面跟具体可获取的对象，或以“available”描述可提供的内容；对象包括 preparation、YAML、solvent、services、typefaces、products 和 summary。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、技术文档、百科、商品文案、商务邮件

patterns.name: available access
patterns.context: “available”修饰 access，表达获得某种方法或能力的便利性。

patterns.name: available 的条件性用法
patterns.context: “available”出现在条件从句中，表示某格式若可用则采用。

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: 出现在人物或群体从事狩猎的叙述中；一处与 gathering food 并列，一处说明枪套用于 hunting。

patterns.name: 药物名称及临床比较
patterns.context: 药物名称嵌在比较新型安眠药与现有制剂的研究描述中。

patterns.name: YAML 格式名称
patterns.context: 在 JSON 格式的替代或超集格式说明中出现，且处于“if available”条件短语内。

patterns.name: 化学催化术语
patterns.context: 作为生成自由基物种的方法，出现在环状产物制备的化学摘要中。

patterns.name: 高负载支持材料
patterns.context: 描述用于合成化合物库的支持材料，并与溶剂输送机器人并列。

patterns.name: 癌症中心与药物基因组学
patterns.context: 描述面向癌症研究的实验室服务及其分析领域。

patterns.name: 字体与字样
patterns.context: 描述巴洛克风格、哥特书法根源及相关字体的数字版本。

patterns.name: 枪套类别与用途
patterns.context: 枚举军警、便衣人员、私人用户及射击运动者使用的枪套类型。

patterns.name: 商品名称与价格
patterns.context: 商品套装及单品均可购买，并列出价格。

patterns.name: 监管文件与会议摘要
patterns.context: 涉及监管机构发布的规则与战略计划，并称会议摘要稍后可提供。

en.description: Activation triggers are dispersed: several clusters involve initial P/pl and following fragments, alongside isolated triggers such as hunting, dietary, and Monte Carlo, spanning different topics and styles.

patterns.name: Words beginning with P and their following subword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers occur at initial or internal P/pl fragments, which form different words; in segments 9 and 10, “pls” begins a request.
patterns.domain: Different styles, including medical abstracts, grant texts, encyclopedias, and emails

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: Appears in contexts describing a family’s hunting-and-gathering history, or holster uses and hunting activities.

patterns.name: dietary fat-related wording
patterns.context: Appears in a title-like statement about the effects of dietary fat levels and types on performance.

patterns.name: Monte Carlo technique
patterns.context: Appears in research text introducing the development of quantitative analysis methods.

11_2993.description: 激活触发形式分散：多段集中于词首 P/pl 及其后续片段，另有 hunting、dietary 和 Monte Carlo 等孤立触发，分属不同主题与文体。

patterns.name: P 开头词及其后续词片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于词首或词内的 P/pl 片段，后续分别组成不同词；第 9、10 段中“pls”是请求语句的开头。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、资助项目文本、百科与邮件等不同文体

patterns.name: hunting
patterns.context: 出现于描述家庭狩猎采集经历，或枪套用途及狩猎活动的语境。

patterns.name: dietary fat 相关措辞
patterns.context: 出现在研究饮食中脂肪水平与类型对表现影响的标题式表述中。

patterns.name: Monte Carlo 技术
patterns.context: 出现在介绍定量分析方法开发的研究文本中。

en.description: Activation concentrates on specialized terms in medical and life-science abstract titles: pulmonary/respiratory words, Micro- terms, pregnancy and prenatal words, and various diseases and health topics. No more specific shared semantics are apparent across topics.

patterns.name: Pulmonary and respiratory terminology
patterns.context: Medical titles or abstracts contain terms for lung diseases, respiratory tracts, or pulmonary function tests; one instance is a title about a pediatric airway disease.

patterns.name: Terms beginning with micro-
patterns.context: Biomedical or environmental science nouns beginning with Micro- appear at the start of titles or abstracts; they refer to microRNA, microbial quality, and microplastics.

patterns.name: Prenatal and pregnancy-related terms
patterns.context: Concerns vitamin D metabolism during pregnancy or fetal/prenatal diagnosis.

patterns.name: Other medical diseases or health research
patterns.context: Activation falls on disease names, health problems, or related research topics in medical titles or abstracts; these topics are distinct from one another.

11_2993.description: 激活集中于医学及生命科学摘要标题中的专业术语：肺部/呼吸词、Micro-术语、妊娠与产前词，以及多种疾病和健康主题。不同主题间未见更具体的共同语义。

patterns.name: 肺部与呼吸相关术语
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中出现肺部疾病、呼吸道或肺功能检测词汇；另有一例儿科气道疾病标题。

patterns.name: micro- 开头的术语
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头出现以 Micro- 开始的生物医学或环境科学名词；具体所指分别为微 RNA、微生物质量和微塑料。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、食品质量、环境科学

patterns.name: 产前与妊娠相关
patterns.context: 涉及妊娠中的维生素 D 代谢，或胎儿/产前诊断。

patterns.name: 其他医学疾病或健康研究
patterns.context: 激活落在医学标题或摘要中的疾病名、健康问题或相关研究主题；这些主题彼此不同。

en.description: The most prominent shared feature across segments is tokenization activation around apostrophes and following content, especially possessive ’s. Text topics span neuroscience, medicine, law, obituaries, and webpages, without a unified domain semantics.

patterns.name: Possessive marker
patterns.context: High activation occurs after apostrophes in English possessive contractions, especially word-final “’s”; it also appears on digits or gene names after “’”.

patterns.name: English possessive ’s
patterns.context: An apostrophe is followed by s, commonly in possessives of personal names, disease names, institution names, or technical terms.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal texts, obituaries, and webpage copy

patterns.name: Digits or proper-name fragments after apostrophes
patterns.context: Content after an apostrophe is tokenized as digits or single-letter fragments; beyond possessives, this also occurs in abbreviations, names, or transcription boundaries.
patterns.domain: Papers, webpage copy, obituaries, legal texts

patterns.name: Medical research contexts
patterns.context: Biomedical content includes domain terminology and research descriptions, but activation remains concentrated around apostrophe tokenization.

patterns.name: Non-research webpages and legal texts
patterns.context: Webpage event descriptions, prices and obituary lists, or judicial opinions; no unified domain semantics.

11_2993.description: 各段最突出的共同点是撇号及其后接内容的分词激活，尤其是所有格 ’s；文本主题跨神经科学、医学、法律、讣告和网页，领域语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 所有格标记
patterns.context: 高激活集中出现在英文所有格缩写中的撇号后，尤其是词尾 “’s”，也见于 “’” 后的数字或基因名称

patterns.name: 英语所有格 ’s
patterns.context: 撇号后接 s，常见于人名、疾病名、机构名或术语的所有格形式
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文本、讣告与网页文案

patterns.name: 撇号后数字或专名片段
patterns.context: 撇号后的内容被分词成数字或单字母片段；除所有格外，也出现在缩写、名称或转录边界
patterns.domain: 论文、网页文案、讣告、法律文本

patterns.name: 医学科研语境
patterns.context: 生物医学内容中出现领域术语与研究描述；但激活仍集中在撇号分词附近

patterns.name: 非科研的网页及法律文本
patterns.trigger: “Initiation to Shamanistic Ayahuasca”；“the crux of McDonald’s complaint”
patterns.context: 网页活动介绍、价格与讣告列表，或司法意见；缺少统一领域语义
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本、FreeLaw 判决

en.concept: Sentence-initial proper names and terminology fragments
en.description: The most prominent repeated pattern is Joe followed by a surname at the beginning of a sentence (5 segments). Other activations are dispersed across Slovak parliamentary text, medical titles, chemical names and formulas, nucleic acid sequences, and Nascom entry titles; these triggers differ in form.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial name Joe
patterns.context: Joe appears at the start of the context, followed by a surname; only the name or a small amount of following text is captured.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, emails, and webpage text

patterns.name: Slovak Q&A/parliamentary text
patterns.context: Slovak words are segmented into subword fragments, appearing near questions and agenda headings in parliamentary documents.

patterns.name: Nitric oxide topic phrase
patterns.context: The chemical name appears at the start of an abstract title or topic phrase, paired with pain.

patterns.name: Lists of silicon compound names
patterns.context: Multiple silicon compound names and molecular formulas are listed line by line, including chemical symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence fragments
patterns.context: Sequences of uppercase letters appear next to spaces, line breaks, and text resembling primers or markers.

patterns.name: Nascom entry title
patterns.context: Nascom appears at the beginning of an entry title, followed by the parenthetical description “computer kit”.

11_2993.description: 最突出的可重复模式是句首 Joe 后接姓氏（5段）。其余激活分散于斯洛伐克语议会文本、医学标题、化学名与分子式、核酸序列及 Nascom 条目标题；这些触发形式各异。

patterns.name: 句首姓名 Joe
patterns.context: Joe 位于上下文开头，后续是人名中的姓氏；只截取到姓名或其后少量文本。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件及网页文本

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语问答/议会文本
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语词被拆为子词片段；出现在议会文件的提问、议题标题附近。

patterns.name: 一氧化氮主题短语
patterns.context: 化学物质名称位于摘要标题或主题短语开头，并与 pain 并列。

patterns.name: 硅化合物名称列表
patterns.context: 多个硅化合物名称及分子式按行列出，包含化学符号和数字。

patterns.name: 核酸序列片段
patterns.context: 大写字母组成的序列与空格、换行及类似引物/标记的文本相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学文本

patterns.name: Nascom 条目标题
patterns.context: Nascom 出现在条目标题开头，后接括号说明“computer kit”。

en.concept: Structural and technical fragments across diverse text
en.description: Activations are dispersed across several text forms: terminology, formulas, and units in academic prose; references and citations; and parliamentary text, patent chemical formulas, author affiliations, and alphanumeric lists. No stable word meaning or theme spans all segments.

patterns.name: Scientific terminology and academic prose
patterns.context: Appears in coherent academic sentences spanning medicine, harmonic analysis, astrophysics, geology, and other topics; no stable single term or semantic category is apparent.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Bibliographic formatting and citations
patterns.context: Reference entries or in-text citations; activation falls on formatting elements such as abbreviations, punctuation, numbering, and author names.

patterns.name: Slovenian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Slovenian words appear as subword fragments, alongside parliamentary meeting headings, line breaks, and document numbers.

patterns.name: Patent chemical formulas and variable definitions
patterns.context: A patent background section explains substituent definitions in a general formula and the chemical groups that can be formed.

patterns.name: Author affiliations and addresses
patterns.context: Title-page-like paper metadata lists institutions, locations, and author names; names and places are segmented into subwords.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric sequences and lists
patterns.context: Repeated combinations of numbers and letters are comma-separated and line-broken, resembling a list or data sequence without a definite semantic context.

11_2993.concept: 多样文本中的结构与专业片段
11_2993.description: 激活分散于多种文本形态：学术正文的术语、公式和单位，参考文献与引文，以及议会文本、专利化学式、作者地址和数字字母列表；没有贯穿所有片段的稳定词义或主题。

patterns.name: 科学术语与学术正文
patterns.trigger: 高亮分布在专业术语、数学表达、数值单位及普通学术词语中，如 «laser»、«bounded»、«subset»、«dispersion»、«sub»-«mm»、«ppm»、«precursor»
patterns.context: 出现在连贯的学术句子中；覆盖医学、调和分析、天体物理、地质学等不同主题，未见稳定的单一术语或语义类别
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文摘要及正文

patterns.name: 书目格式与引文
patterns.context: 参考文献条目或正文中的文献引用；激活落在缩写、标点、编号及作者名等格式成分上

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语词语以子词片段呈现，伴随议会会议题头、换行和文件编号

patterns.name: 专利化学式与变量定义
patterns.context: 专利背景段落说明通式中取代基的定义及可形成的化学基团

patterns.name: 作者单位与地址
patterns.context: 论文首页式元数据，列出机构、地点及作者姓名；姓名和地名被切分为子词

patterns.name: 数字字母序列及列表
patterns.context: 重复的数字与字母组合以逗号分隔并换行，近似列表或数据序列，缺少可确定的语义背景
patterns.domain: StackExchange 内容或格式化序列

en.concept: Proper names and numeric fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activation mainly falls on scientific terms containing Fe and paper metadata, and also appears on 30 in legal text, sports season years, and X11/Fe65 in research abstracts; these patterns have no obvious shared trigger semantics.

patterns.name: Scientific terms with Fe
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of iron spectral lines, ionization, chelation, metallic abundance, or iron-containing superconductors.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, chemistry, biomedicine, condensed matter physics

patterns.name: PACS classification numbers
patterns.context: Lists physics subject classification codes at the end of papers or in metadata.

patterns.name: Numerical legal records
patterns.context: Appears in a legal account of a sentence of “30 months”.

patterns.name: Sports season records
patterns.context: Lists team honors and match results by year.

patterns.name: Protein names in research plans
patterns.context: Discusses how their binding to Beta-APP affects processing and secretion.

11_2993.concept: 异质文本中的专名与数字片段
11_2993.description: 激活主要落在含 Fe 的科学术语及论文元数据，也见于法律中的 30、体育赛季年份，以及科研摘要里的 X11/Fe65；这些模式缺少明显共同触发语义。

patterns.name: Fe 的学科术语
patterns.trigger: “Fe”及其化学、天体物理或材料学上下文，如 “Fe K”, “Fe … chelator”, “[Fe/H]”, “KFe$_2$Se$_2$”
patterns.context: 出现在铁的谱线、电离、螯合、金属丰度或含铁超导体等讨论中
patterns.domain: 天体物理、化学、生物医学、凝聚态物理

patterns.name: PACS 分类编号
patterns.trigger: “PACS numbers:” 后的数字、标点和字母代码
patterns.context: 论文末尾或元数据中列出物理学科分类号
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文格式与元数据

patterns.name: 数字化法律记录
patterns.context: 出现在刑期“30 months”的法律叙述中

patterns.name: 体育赛季记录
patterns.context: 按年份列出球队荣誉与比赛成绩

patterns.name: 科研计划中的蛋白质名称
patterns.context: 讨论它们结合 Beta-APP 对加工和分泌的影响

en.concept: Expressions of results/findings and local stylistic cues
en.description: Activations are dispersed: in academic contexts, difficult outcomes introduced by become, citation years, and reports of findings with found stand out; other instances include religious belief narratives, hyphens in disease names, and historical travel stories.

patterns.name: “become” introducing a contrastive result in academic English
patterns.context: Describes a method or computation becoming extremely difficult due to a particular challenge; become introduces an outcome or state change.

patterns.name: Years in bibliographic citations
patterns.context: A colon and year follow an author name; digit fragments within the year also activate strongly.

patterns.name: Reporting research findings after a citation
patterns.context: States that a person or study found, concluded, or observed a result in a reference or narrative.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and Wikipedia narratives

patterns.name: Volunteering for an assignment in a historical narrative
patterns.context: People want to avoid lengthy official travel, others make excuses, while Zhao volunteers to go.

patterns.name: Belief and practice in religious or spiritual contexts
patterns.context: Mentions Bonpo symbolic beliefs and spiritual practices, or worship, devotion, and righteous resolve in the Bhagavad Gita.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia religious and cultural entries; religious texts and StackExchange citations

patterns.name: Recurring abnormalities in MeCP2 disease research
patterns.context: In a neurogenetic disease context, discusses MeCP2 and cell types or syndromes.

patterns.name: Relaxing the compact Lie algebra condition
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion relaxes a compactness condition to the noncompact case and states the resulting conclusion.

patterns.name: Functional relation result following a mathematical theorem
patterns.context: Cites work by author and theorem number, then states that a functional relation was found.

11_2993.concept: 结果/发现表达及局部文体线索
11_2993.description: 激活分散：学术语境中突出 become 引出的困难结果、引文年份及 found 报告发现；另见宗教信仰叙述、疾病名中的连字符和历史差旅故事。

patterns.name: 学术英语中的“become”转折结果
patterns.context: 描述某项方法或计算因特定困难而变得极难；become 引出结果或状态变化

patterns.name: 文献引文中的年份
patterns.context: 作者姓名后的冒号及年份；年份内部的数字片段也显著激活

patterns.name: 引用后报告研究结果
patterns.context: 文献或叙述中说明某人/某研究发现、得出或观察到某结果
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及 Wikipedia 叙述

patterns.name: 历史叙事中主动承担差事
patterns.context: 众人想躲避漫长公务差旅，其他人找借口，而 Zhao 主动自愿前往

patterns.name: 宗教或灵性语境中的信仰与实践
patterns.context: 提到 Bonpo 象征信仰、灵性实践，或《薄伽梵歌》中崇拜、虔诚信仰与正当决心
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 宗教文化条目；宗教文本及 StackExchange 引文

patterns.name: MeCP2疾病研究中的重复异常
patterns.context: 神经遗传疾病语境，讨论 MeCP2 与细胞类型或综合征

patterns.name: 紧凑李代数条件的放宽
patterns.context: 数学论述从紧致性条件放宽转向非紧情形，并陈述由此得到的结论

patterns.name: 数学定理后的函数关系结果
patterns.context: 按作者和定理编号引用工作，说明其随后发现函数关系

en.concept: ArXiv scientific paper formatting and terminology
en.description: Activations often occur in specialized formats and terminology in ArXiv scientific papers: PACS classification codes, section headings, citations, formulas, and numerical values, as well as physics and mathematics topics. Coverage includes nuclear physics, field theory, astronomy, semiconductors, and theorem discussions.

patterns.name: PACS/subject classification numbers
patterns.context: Classification information near the beginning or abstract of a paper; codes consist of digits, decimal points, and letters, often adjacent to commas and line breaks.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata, especially physics classifications

patterns.name: Paper titles and section heading formats
patterns.context: Paper titles or section boundaries, often with line breaks, Markdown/LaTeX markers, or rows of equals signs.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and symbols
patterns.context: Specialized terminology and formulas are interwoven in discussions of particles, nuclear structure, field theory, or gravity-related physics.

patterns.name: Mathematical/statistical methods and theorem terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical objects, error bounds, inequalities, or theorem names appear in method descriptions or theoretical statements.

patterns.name: Scientific citation format
patterns.context: In-text citations use square brackets and @ markers, linking author names to years, journal information, or numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical results, units, and formula fragments
patterns.context: The context reports quantitative results, physical units, or mathematical expressions embedded in prose.

patterns.name: Astronomical observables and data relationships
patterns.context: Discusses astronomical observables, time units, and data scatter or empirical relationships.

patterns.name: Semiconductor and nanostructure classifications
patterns.context: Lists condensed matter physics topics in a classification-style format with corresponding subject codes.

11_2993.concept: ArXiv 科学论文格式与术语
11_2993.description: 激活多见于 ArXiv 科学论文的专门格式与术语：PACS 分类码、章节标题、引文、公式和数值，以及物理、数学主题词；覆盖核物理、场论、天文、半导体及定理论述。

patterns.name: PACS/学科分类编号
patterns.context: 论文开头或摘要附近的分类信息；编号由数字、小数点及字母组成，常与逗号、换行相邻
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据，尤其物理学分类

patterns.name: 论文标题与章节标题格式
patterns.trigger: “[**Introduction**]”“Introduction”“====================”及“BESIII, charmonium decay, proton form factor”等标题文字
patterns.context: 论文标题或章节分隔处，常出现换行、Markdown/LaTeX 标记或等号线

patterns.name: 物理学专业术语与符号
patterns.trigger: “nucleons”“nuclear surface”“shell model”“fermion spinor”“quartic interactions”“renormalize”“spin-0”“higher spin”“Teukolsky system”等
patterns.context: 讨论粒子、核结构、场论或引力相关物理问题时，专业术语与公式交织出现

patterns.name: 数学/统计方法与定理术语
patterns.trigger: “non-asymptotic theorems”“L^p-mean error bounds”“concentration inequalities”“tensor algebra”“MacMahon’s Master theorem”“Molien’s theorem”
patterns.context: 方法或理论陈述中出现数学对象、误差界、不等式或定理名称

patterns.name: 科学文献引用格式
patterns.context: 正文中以方括号和 @ 标记引用，作者名与年份、期刊信息或编号相连
patterns.domain: 学术论文引用与参考文献

patterns.name: 数值结果、单位与公式片段
patterns.context: 上下文报告定量结果、物理单位或嵌入正文的数学表达式

patterns.name: 天文学观测量与数据关系
patterns.context: 讨论天体观测量、时间单位及数据散布或经验关系

patterns.name: 半导体与纳米结构分类
patterns.context: 以分类式条目列出凝聚态物理主题和对应学科代码

en.description: Activations span multiple text domains and involve English function words, proper-name subwords, formulas, and formatting markers; local patterns also include classification numbers, hyphenated descriptions, personal titles, and nuclear physics result words. No stable unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent across instances.

patterns.name: English word-initial fragments and common function words
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial subword fragments of ordinary English words or phrases across narratives, paper text, and titles; there is no consistent syntactic position or semantic role.

patterns.name: Proper names and internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of people, places, institutions, physics terminology, and other names or words; trigger words vary by text, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, historical narratives, physics papers

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and markers
patterns.context: Local activations occur near paper formulas, citation labels, and mathematical formatting; the papers are all ArXiv papers, but marker forms are not identical.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in classification codes
patterns.context: In a list of PACS numbers following the paper title and author information, digits, periods, and commas occur in sequence and activate.

patterns.name: Hyphenated coordinated adjectives
patterns.context: Repeated well- structures and fragments after hyphens activate in a sentence describing soldiers’ equipment and condition.

patterns.name: Section heading separators
patterns.context: Activations occur near paper-style section titles and their Markdown/text-format boundaries.

patterns.name: Occupational title after a personal name
