patterns.context: In a biographical sentence, the occupational title teacher receives the strongest local activation after the name, ethnicity, and description of scholarly identity.

patterns.name: Expressions of action outcomes
patterns.context: In a nuclear physics explanation, result nouns and adjectives activate in a sentence describing nucleons forming isolated clusters or protrusions.

11_2993.description: 激活跨多领域文本，涉及英文功能词、专名子词、公式与排版标记；另有分类号、连字符描写、人物称谓及核物理结果词等局部模式。各处缺少稳定统一的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 英文词首及常见功能词
patterns.trigger: « the»、« in»、« of»、« to»、« and»、« a»
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文单词或词组的起始子词片段，分布在叙述、论文正文与标题中；并无一致的句法位置或语义角色。

patterns.name: 专名与词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人物、地名、机构、物理术语及其他专名或词语的内部子词片段；触发词随文本而变，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、历史叙述、物理学论文

patterns.name: 数学公式与标记
patterns.context: 论文公式、引用标签及数学排版附近出现局部激活；同为 ArXiv 论文，但标记形式不完全相同。

patterns.name: 分类号中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 紧跟论文标题作者信息后的 PACS numbers 列表中，数字、句点和逗号依次出现并被激活。

patterns.name: 带连字符的并列形容词
patterns.context: 同一段中重复的 well- 结构以及连字符后的词片段被激活，处于描写士兵装备与状态的句子里。

patterns.name: 章节标题分隔符
patterns.context: 论文标题式章节名及其 Markdown/文本格式边界附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 人名后的身份称谓
patterns.context: 人物传记句中，在姓名、族群和学者身份描述之后，职业称谓 teacher 获得该段最强局部激活。

patterns.name: 动作结果表达
patterns.context: 核物理解释中，描述核子形成孤立团簇或凸起的句子里，结果性名词和形容词被激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across paper structure and citations, astrophysics, biophysics, particle physics, molecular physics, mathematical physics, and historical prose; local token strings are clear in each passage, but no common semantic trigger pattern can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Line breaks and section headings
patterns.context: A paper introduction heading appears after a line break, followed by an underlined-style heading format.

patterns.name: Reference citations and numbering
patterns.context: Author–year citations, bibliography keys, and reference lists appear in the paper body, often alongside numbers, abbreviations, or equations.

patterns.name: Orbital parameters and comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between increasing distance or changing slope and orbital distributions or inclinations.

patterns.name: X-ray emission and observation
patterns.context: Describes celestial objects emitting intense X-rays due to shock heating, and the detection and measurement of spectral lines.

patterns.name: Phospholipid vesicles and nuclear magnetic resonance
patterns.context: Describes vesicle structure, phase-transition properties, and proton NMR spectra.

patterns.name: Praise of the Red Cross
patterns.context: Describes the reputation and work of the Red Cross and its supporters in a laudatory tone.

patterns.name: Hidden-sector Higgs and theoretical limits
patterns.context: Discusses the origin of dark matter mass and theoretical limits on additional Higgs bosons.

patterns.name: Raman spectra and molecular cluster growth
patterns.context: Identifies pure gas molecules in a low-temperature free jet and tracks their cluster growth.

patterns.name: Spin fields and symmetry operators
patterns.context: Discusses symmetry operators for different spin fields and cites mathematical physics literature.

11_2993.description: 激活分散在论文结构与引文、天体物理、生物物理、粒子物理、分子物理、数学物理及历史散文中；各段局部词串明显，但没有可确认的共同语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 行首换行与章节标题
patterns.context: 行首换行后出现论文引言标题及其下划线式标题格式。

patterns.name: 参考文献引用与编号
patterns.context: 论文正文中出现作者—年份引用、文献键及引文列表；常伴随数字、缩写或公式。

patterns.name: 轨道参数与比较描述
patterns.context: 讨论距离增大或斜率变化与轨道分布、倾角之间的关系。

patterns.name: X射线辐射与观测
patterns.context: 描述天体因激波加热而强烈发射X射线，以及谱线的探测和测量。

patterns.name: 磷脂囊泡与核磁共振
patterns.trigger: 「phospholipid bilayer vesicles」「Proton nuclear magnetic resonance spectra」「360 MHz」
patterns.context: 描述囊泡结构、相变性质及其质子核磁共振谱。

patterns.name: 红十字会的赞誉叙述
patterns.context: 以赞扬口吻叙述红十字会及其支持者的声誉与工作。

patterns.name: 隐藏部门希格斯与理论界限
patterns.context: 讨论暗物质质量来源及额外希格斯玻色子的理论界限。

patterns.name: 拉曼谱与分子团簇生长
patterns.context: 在低温自由射流中识别纯气体分子，并追踪其团簇生长。

patterns.name: 自旋场与对称算符
patterns.context: 讨论不同自旋场的对称算符，并给出数学物理文献引用。

en.concept: Technical text markers in academic papers
en.description: Activations are concentrated in ArXiv academic text: citations and author–year markers, split technical terms and proper nouns, numerical formulas, and disciplinary terminology. Topics include physical theory, astronomical observations, and paper title formatting. Some common linking words also activate, but there is no stable semantic collocation.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citations and metadata
patterns.context: A research statement, term, or result is followed by an author–year citation; activations involve author names, years, and tokens near punctuation in the citation.

patterns.name: Technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Technical terms are split across multiple tokens or formed from hyphens and abbreviations; they occur in dense academic and technical prose.

patterns.name: Quantitative expressions and symbolic notation
patterns.context: Papers contain orders of magnitude, values, units, mathematical expressions, or physical quantities, often alongside technical explanations.

patterns.name: Physical models, theories, and interactions
patterns.context: Discusses theoretical frameworks, particles or fields, symmetries, cosmological conditions, or effective theories, often alongside citations and formulas.
patterns.domain: High-energy physics, field theory, string theory, and cosmology

patterns.name: Astronomical observations and astrophysical phenomena
patterns.context: Describes spectra, velocities, observational exposure conditions, and evolutionary features of stars or supernovae.

patterns.name: Highly activated words at local syntactic connections
patterns.context: These words appear in technical prose across different topics, often linking conditions, causes, modifiers, or purposes; no single fixed collocation is evident.

patterns.name: Section headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near opening paper headings and Markdown or text separators.

patterns.name: Author names and proper nouns split after citations
patterns.context: Names or proper nouns are split by the tokenizer, usually adjacent to citations; they may also be part of the citation marker itself.

11_2993.concept: 学术论文技术文本标记
11_2993.description: 激活集中在 ArXiv 学术文本：引用及作者年份标记、被拆分的专业术语和专名、数值公式与学科术语；具体涵盖物理理论、天体观测及论文标题排版。部分普通连接词也激活，但无稳定语义搭配。

patterns.name: 文献引用与元数据
patterns.context: 出现研究陈述、术语或结果后，接有作者—年份式参考文献；激活涉及引用中的作者名、年份及标点附近 token。

patterns.name: 技术术语及其复合词
patterns.context: 专业术语被拆分成多个 token，或由连字符、缩写组成；出现在密集的学术技术叙述中。
patterns.domain: 物理、天文学及理论研究

patterns.name: 量化表达与符号化记法
patterns.context: 论文中出现阶数、数值、单位、数学表达式或物理量；附近常有技术性解释。

patterns.name: 物理学模型、理论与相互作用
patterns.context: 讨论理论框架、粒子或场、对称性、宇宙学条件或有效理论；常与引文和公式并存。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、场论、弦论、宇宙学

patterns.name: 天体观测与天体物理现象
patterns.context: 描述恒星或超新星的光谱、速度、观测曝光条件及演化特征。

patterns.name: 高激活词位于局部句法连接处
patterns.context: 这些词在不同主题的科技叙述中出现，常连接条件、因果、修饰或目的结构；未见单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 章节标题与排版标记
patterns.context: 论文开篇标题及 Markdown/文本分隔符附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 引用后作者名及专名切分
patterns.context: 姓名或专名被分词器拆分，通常紧邻文献引用；也可能是引用标记本身的一部分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the digit 9 in citation years, the T in Tamil Nadu, commas after astrophysical parameters, and the words excessive and changing in an observation sentence about pulsating stars; a discussion of complex shell properties has no clear counterpart. Overall, these appear to be multiple local triggers.

patterns.name: Tokenization of digit 9 in citation years
patterns.context: Appears in the year portion of a bracketed citation key; activation falls on a year digit token rather than a term from a single discipline.

patterns.name: Tokenization of Madras/Tamil Nadu place names
patterns.context: In an account of local Indian political history, a place name is expanded with a slash after a mention of the 1967 election in Madras and party alliances.

patterns.name: Comma in variable mass notation
patterns.context: In an introduction to black hole X-ray transients, a comma separates the mass function from parameters such as the companion and distance.

patterns.name: Time variation causing spectral line broadening
patterns.context: An observation description of RR Lyrae pulsating stars explains that short exposures avoid spectral line broadening caused by time variation.

patterns.name: T/U ordinal marker
patterns.context: Here it is associated with local subword segmentation at the same token position and a place-name string; it appears only here, so any relation to general letters or markers is uncertain.

11_2993.description: 激活分散于学术引用年份中的数字 9、Tamil Nadu 的 T、天体物理参数后的逗号，以及脉动星观测句中的 excessive、changing；另有复形壳性论述无明确对应。整体更像多个局部触发。

patterns.name: 数字 9 的引文年份分词
patterns.context: 出现在方括号引用键的年份部分；激活落在年份数字的分词上，而非单一学科术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及其引用

patterns.name: Madras/Tamil Nadu 地名分词
patterns.context: 印度地方政治史叙述中，提到 1967 年 Madras 的选举与政党结盟后，地名以斜杠连接展开。

patterns.name: 变量质量记号中的逗号
patterns.context: 黑洞 X 射线暂现源介绍中，逗号分隔质量函数与伴星、距离等参数。

patterns.name: 时间变化导致光谱线展宽
patterns.context: RR Lyrae 脉动星的观测说明中，短曝光用于避免随时间变化造成的光谱线展宽。

patterns.name: T/U 序号标记
patterns.trigger: “T”10，出现在 “T” 与后续 “amil Nadu” 的分词边界
patterns.context: 这里与同一 token 位置的局部子词分割及地名字符串有关；仅此处出现，是否与一般字母或标记有关无法确认。

en.description: Activations span Indian place names and personal names, academic technical terms and formulas, historical religious and moral statements, and local police reporting; no single word form or semantic trigger unifies all passages.

patterns.name: Indian people and place names
patterns.context: Indian historical figures, administrative places, transport stops, or political place names appear; proper nouns are often split across multiple tokens, and some passages contain lists of places.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on Indian history, geography, railways, and politics

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbols in academic text
patterns.context: Academic discussion includes specialized mathematical or physical terms, abbreviations, and formula symbols; activations fall on term fragments, symbols, and nearby words.

patterns.name: Quaker religious testimony and moral statements
patterns.context: A historical account introduces a religious group's public position on an issue and quotes a moral statement about ease, affluence, and the labor of others.
patterns.domain: Historical religious documents; old-style Gutenberg prose

patterns.name: Police deployment and local security reporting
patterns.context: Reports that checkpoints are guarded by police and soldiers, gives the number of personnel deployed, and quotes a local police official.

11_2993.description: 激活分布于印度地名与人物专名、学术技术术语和公式、历史宗教道德陈述及地方警务报道；未见单一词形或语义触发点能统一所有段落。

patterns.name: 印度人物与地名
patterns.context: 出现印度历史人物、行政地名、交通站点或政治地名；专名常被拆成多个 token，部分段落中有地名列表。
patterns.domain: 印度历史、地理、铁路与政治的百科条目

patterns.name: 学术文本中的技术术语与符号
patterns.trigger: “simplicial complex”“field”“shellable”“RR Lyrae stars”“spectral lines”“coupled-cluster”“CCSD”“binding energies”“Λ=2.0 fm”
patterns.context: 学术论述中出现数学或物理专门术语、缩写及公式符号，激活落在术语片段、符号和邻近词上。

patterns.name: Quaker 宗教见证与道德陈述
patterns.trigger: “religious society”“Quakers”“publicly testified”“their sentiments”“live in ease and plenty by the toil”
patterns.context: 历史叙述引出宗教团体对某议题的公开表态，并引用有关安逸、富足与他人劳动的道德陈述。
patterns.domain: 历史宗教文献、Gutenberg 旧式散文

patterns.name: 警务部署与地方治安报道
patterns.trigger: “checkpoints manned by police officers and soldiers”“commune police chief”“district police had ordered”
patterns.context: 报道检查站由警察和士兵把守、部署人员数量，并引述地方警务负责人的说法。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on split fragments of South Asian and Australian proper nouns; there are also local words related to nuclear physics, non-minimal coupling, equation subscripts, and historical quotations, with no consistent semantic trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Indian place names Bang(a)lore / Junagadh
patterns.context: Place names are split into subword tokens, with activations on their initial or internal fragments; [1] mentions a campus location, [8] a tuberculosis research site, and [4] the princely state associated with a historical figure.
patterns.domain: Indian geography, biography, and public health

patterns.name: Australian surname fragment Hawthorn
patterns.context: The club name Hawthorn is split in an Australian football player's biography; peak activation is on the initial fragment of the surname/place name.

patterns.name: Fragments of Indian names and biographical proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns for Indian or Pakistani people and places activate on split token fragments; contexts are usually biographies, family or education histories, or sports information.
patterns.domain: South Asian biographies and sports encyclopedias

patterns.name: Spatial localization in nuclear physics
patterns.context: A theoretical statement says that nucleon correlations in a nucleus spatially localize particles in the nuclear surface region; strong activation is on spatially.

patterns.name: Non-minimal coupling and quantum corrections
patterns.context: Discusses non-minimal coupling, the ξ parameter, quantum corrections, and renormalization; activations are scattered across term abbreviations and citation-year fragments.

patterns.name: Equation symbol with velocity subscript Fe
patterns.context: The velocity variable has subscript Fe in mathematical equations, appearing in electric-field evolution equations and differential-operator expressions.

patterns.name: Wording emphasizing an affluent life in historical accounts
patterns.context: Describes Quakers publicly stating their position in 1754 and quotes a passage about living in ease and affluence through others' labor; activations concentrate on ease, and, toil, and those.

11_2993.description: 激活主要落在拆分的南亚及澳洲专名片段；另有核物理、非最小耦合、方程下标和历史引文中的局部词语，各段上下文并无一致语义触发。

patterns.name: 印度地名 Bang(a)lore / Junagadh
patterns.context: 地名被拆分成子词 token，激活落在地名开头或内部片段；[1] 提到分校所在地，[8] 是结核病研究地点，[4] 是历史人物所属土邦。
patterns.domain: 印度地理、传记与公共卫生

patterns.name: 澳大利亚姓氏片段 Hawthorn
patterns.context: 澳式足球球员简介中俱乐部名 Hawthorn 被拆分；最高激活集中在姓氏/地名开头片段。

patterns.name: 印度姓名及传记专名片段
patterns.context: 印度、巴基斯坦人物或地点专名在被拆分的 token 片段上激活；上下文多为人物条目、亲属/教育履历或赛事信息。
patterns.domain: 南亚人物传记与体育百科

patterns.name: 核物理中空间局域化表述
patterns.context: 原子核中核子相关性使粒子在原子核表面区域空间局域化的理论陈述；强激活在 spatially。

patterns.name: 非最小耦合术语与量子修正
patterns.context: 讨论 non-minimal coupling、ξ 参数、量子修正及重整化；激活分散在术语缩写和引文年份片段。

patterns.name: 速度下标 Fe 的方程符号
patterns.context: 数学方程中的速度变量下标 Fe，出现在电场演化方程与微分算子表达中。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中强调生活富足的措辞
patterns.trigger: «ease»4« and»9« plenty»5« by»5 the «to»1«il»6 of»6 those»6
patterns.context: 叙述 1754 年贵格会公开表达立场，引用关于靠他人劳动而安逸富足生活的句子；激活集中在 ease、and、toil、those 等词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across cricket and Indian encyclopedic text, legal proceedings, quark physics and formulas, historical moral discussion, and an announcement from a Greek association in New York; there is no common stable semantic or stylistic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Cricket figures and event terminology
patterns.context: Often appears near player biographies, teams, and match reports, alongside names, teams, formats, or event dates.

patterns.name: Indian place or institution names
patterns.context: Place names, country names, or city names appear in accounts of Indian people, sports, or institutions; this overlaps with the cricket pattern but also appears in a music school profile.

patterns.name: Litigation context for “Petitioner”
patterns.context: Describes a party filing a petition or seeking relief in a court decision or account of legal proceedings.

patterns.name: Quark and antiquark physics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses an effective Hamiltonian at the quark level or quark–antiquark bound states, often accompanied by formulas and particle symbols.

patterns.name: Summation and indices in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Summations, indices, inner products, or Greek letters appear in formula environments; fragments are mostly formulas and lack sufficient semantic context.

patterns.name: Affluent living and the fruits of labor
patterns.context: Historical text discusses the moral or social evaluation of an easy and affluent life made possible by the labor of others.

patterns.name: Greek-American New York association parade
patterns.context: A street closure notice mentions a parade by the Federation of Hellenic Societies of Greater New York.

11_2993.description: 激活分散于板球与印度百科、法律诉讼、夸克物理及公式、历史道德论述和纽约希腊社团公告；没有共同的稳定语义或文体触发模式。

patterns.name: 板球人物与赛事名词
patterns.context: 板球运动员简介、队伍和比赛报道中，常与人名、球队、赛制或赛事日期相邻。

patterns.name: 印度地点或机构名称
patterns.context: 印度人物、体育或机构介绍中出现地名、国家名或城市名；与板球模式有交叉，但也出现在音乐学校介绍中。

patterns.name: “Petitioner”诉讼程序语境
patterns.context: 法院裁判或诉讼过程叙述中，描述当事人提交申请、救济请求等程序。

patterns.name: 夸克与反夸克物理术语
patterns.context: 讨论夸克层级的有效哈密顿量或夸克—反夸克束缚态，常伴随公式和粒子符号。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的求和与指标
patterns.context: 公式排版环境中出现求和、指标、内积或希腊字母；片段以公式为主，缺少足够语义上下文。

patterns.name: 宽裕生活及劳动所得
patterns.context: 历史文本中谈到凭借他人劳动而安逸富足生活的道德或社会评价。

patterns.name: 希腊裔纽约社团游行
patterns.context: 街道封闭通知中提及纽约大希腊社团联合会游行。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially paired \left/\right delimiters and formula structure; there are also physical symbols, descriptions of paper decay, and local wording in historical, copyright, and judicial texts, with the latter categories differing considerably from one another.

patterns.name: left in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, often paired with parentheses, square brackets, or braces, near fractions, variables, or formula structure.

patterns.name: Right delimiter in physical formulas
patterns.context: Closes parentheses or square brackets in mathematical formulas, often adjacent to variables, parameters, or operators.

patterns.name: Long-form LaTeX formula syntax
patterns.context: Dense mathematical formula fragments; activations are scattered near structural commands, variables, and operators.

patterns.name: Functions, parentheses, and quantitative relations
patterns.context: Formulas express quantitative relationships between functions or variables.

patterns.name: Physical symbols and particle notation
patterns.context: Particles, energy, cosmological parameters, or neutrino symbols in physics text; formula notation interleaves with prose.

patterns.name: Religious groups and descriptions of lifestyle
patterns.context: A historical account describes a religious group's position on a social issue.

patterns.name: Copyright legal language
patterns.context: Discusses copyright protection, legal clauses or bills, and an author's views on them.

patterns.name: Conclusion of a judicial decision
patterns.context: The decision is marked in uppercase; the preceding text concerns a circuit court, case, deadline, or statutory claim.

patterns.name: Research plans and decay processes in papers
patterns.context: A paper introduction states which particle decays and related configurations will be studied.

11_2993.description: 激活主要集中于LaTeX数学表达式，尤其成对的\left/\right及公式结构；另见物理符号、论文衰变描述，以及历史、版权和判决文本中的局部措辞，后几类彼此差异较大。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 left
patterns.context: 出现在LaTeX数学表达式中，常与括号、方括号或大括号配对，附近有分数、变量或公式结构。

patterns.name: 物理公式中的右括号
patterns.context: 作为数学公式中括号或方括号的闭合部分，常邻接变量、参数或运算符。

patterns.name: 长篇LaTeX公式语法
patterns.context: 密集排版的数学公式片段，激活散落于结构命令、变量及运算符附近。

patterns.name: 函数、括号与定量关系
patterns.context: 以公式表达函数或变量之间的数量关系。

patterns.name: 物理符号与粒子记号
patterns.context: 物理学文本中的粒子、能量、宇宙学参数或中微子符号；公式符号与叙述文字交错。

patterns.name: 宗教团体及生活方式叙述
patterns.trigger: “Quakers”“testified”“live in ease and plenty by the toil”
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述宗教团体对社会议题的表态。

patterns.name: 版权法律措辞
patterns.context: 讨论版权保护、法律条款或法案及作者对此的看法。

patterns.name: 司法判决结语
patterns.context: 判决结果以大写格式标示，前文涉及巡回法院、案件及时限或法条主张。

patterns.name: 论文研究计划及衰变过程
patterns.context: 论文引言说明将考察的粒子衰变及相关构型。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal, scientific, sports, and literary-historical texts. Local cues respectively involve evaluative judgments, records, nuclides or experimental results, legal relief, aesthetic change, and labor and living conditions; there is no clear shared word form or topic.

patterns.name: Incomplete judgment/opinion expression
patterns.context: An evaluation or opinion follows “leave me with,” and the sentence is unfinished; activation is concentrated around me and with exactly the opinion.

patterns.name: Nuclides and neutron abundance
patterns.context: Describes neutron excess, nuclides, and their reactions in astrophysics or nuclear physics.

patterns.name: Sports records and performance
patterns.context: Compares the pace of scoring a cricket century, balls faced, or historical records.

patterns.name: Particle physics states and thresholds
patterns.context: Discusses resonance or non-resonance production cross-sections and the position of charmonium states relative to thresholds.

patterns.name: Legal injunctions and relief
patterns.context: A court considers an injunction to prevent harm to a party and describes the consequences of inadequate relief.

patterns.name: Supernova decay rates and nuclides
patterns.context: Compares an observed decay rate or magnitude with cobalt-56 decay; activations involve formulas, symbols, and nuclide notation.

patterns.name: Evaluative judgment about something
patterns.context: Uses would be to introduce a positive evaluation of a proposed activity, with evaluative words such as interesting and fitting nearby.

patterns.name: Experimental results confirm neutrino oscillations
patterns.context: Reports experimental results and corroborates them with neutrino observations from another experiment.

patterns.name: Aesthetic change and contrast
patterns.context: Contrasts a formerly admired beauty with a later shift toward unadorned natural beauty; includes evaluative and change-related language.

patterns.name: Lifestyle and labor
patterns.context: Discusses a luxurious, affluent life dependent on the labor of others, quoting a religious group's position on the issue.

11_2993.description: 激活分散于法律、科学、体育与文学历史文本，局部线索分别涉及判断评价、纪录、核素/实验结果、法律救济、审美变化及劳作生活；没有明显共享的具体词形或主题。

patterns.name: 未完成判断/观点表达
patterns.trigger: “will leave me with exactly the opinion”
patterns.context: “leave me with”后接评价或观点，句子尚未结束；激活集中在 me 和 with exactly the opinion 一带。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、版权法律议题（Gutenberg）

patterns.name: 核素与中子丰度
patterns.context: 天体物理或核物理中描述中子过剩、核素及其反应。

patterns.name: 体育纪录与成绩
patterns.context: 比较板球百球得分速度、用球数或历史纪录。

patterns.name: 粒子物理态及阈值
patterns.context: 讨论共振或非共振产生截面，以及粲偶素态相对于阈值的位置。

patterns.name: 法律禁令与救济
patterns.context: 法院为避免一方受损而考虑禁令，描述未获充分救济的后果。

patterns.name: 超新星衰变率及核素
patterns.context: 用观测衰变率或星等与钴-56衰变作比较；激活涉及公式、符号与核素标记。

patterns.name: 对某事物的评价判断
patterns.trigger: “It would be an interesting and fitting thing”
patterns.context: 以 would be 引出对拟议活动的正面评价，interesting、fitting 等评价词相邻。

patterns.name: 实验结果确认中微子振荡
patterns.context: 报告实验结果并将其与另一实验的中微子观测相印证。

patterns.name: 美感变化与对照
patterns.context: 对比过去受欣赏的美与后来转移到未经修饰的自然美；含有评价与转变叙述。

patterns.name: 生活方式与劳作
patterns.trigger: “to live in ease and plenty by the toil of those”
patterns.context: 讨论奢逸富足的生活依赖他人劳作，引用宗教团体关于相关议题的表态。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of local fragments: tokenized names, LaTeX formula symbols and commands, first-person me in copyright discussion, astrophysical terminology, legal citation abbreviations, and wording about enslavement; no unified semantic trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: F and Hab in a person's name
patterns.context: A person's name appears in an email header, with name tokenization especially salient.

patterns.name: Specific symbols and structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical expressions, integrals, or formula environments; activations are scattered across formula symbols, commands, and adjacent structure.

patterns.name: me in statements about bills and copyright
patterns.context: First-person narration about the possible personal impact of a copyright bill.

patterns.name: Elemental abundances in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between red giant color and overall metallicity or iron abundance.

patterns.name: Case citation abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Abbreviated format for court citations and appellate dispositions.

patterns.name: Wording about enslavement
patterns.context: Describes the condition of people involuntarily enslaved in a sentence discussing a religious denomination and opposition to slavery.

11_2993.description: 激活分布于多类局部片段：姓名分词、LaTeX公式符号与命令、版权叙述中的第一人称me、天体物理术语、法律引证缩写及奴役状态措辞；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 人名中的 F 与 Hab
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现个人姓名，尤其姓名分词被标记

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号与结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式、积分或公式环境；激活分散在公式符号、命令和相邻结构上

patterns.name: 法案与版权表述中的 me
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述版权法案可能带来的个人影响

patterns.name: 天体物理学中的元素丰度
patterns.context: 讨论红巨星颜色与总体金属丰度或铁丰度的关系

patterns.name: 法律引证中的判例缩写
patterns.context: 法院判决引证及上诉处理情况的缩写格式

patterns.name: 奴役状态的措辞
patterns.context: 描述被非自愿奴役者的状态，且句子谈及宗教派别及反对奴役

en.concept: Formulas and structural markers in scientific text
en.description: Most activations occur in LaTeX mathematical formulas in scientific text, favoring right-hand delimiters, Greek letters, integrals and differentials, and formula-environment markers; there are also sporadic activations on condensed matter physics terminology, email header fields, and copyright wording.

patterns.name: Right parentheses in LaTeX math environments
patterns.context: Occurs especially at closing parentheses or delimiters in mathematical formulas; often adjacent to equations, subscripts or superscripts, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv/scientific paper mathematical typesetting; also medical paper formulas

patterns.name: Integral expressions and differential variables
patterns.context: Near integrands and differential symbols in integral formulas; often at the end of a formula line or in an alignment environment.

patterns.name: Formula markers and environment endings
patterns.context: Near equation numbers, reference labels, or the end of an alignment environment for displayed equations.

patterns.name: Greek letters and parameter formulas
patterns.context: Symbolic expressions for parameters, functions, or variables in mathematical formulas; usually co-occurs with delimiters and subscripts or superscripts.

patterns.name: Physics term Fermi liquid
patterns.context: A physics prose passage discussing high density of states, Fermi energy, and spin susceptibility.

patterns.name: Email subject and sender fields
patterns.context: Email reply headers followed by a subject, email address, name, and date.

patterns.name: Copyright language and insertions or deletions
patterns.context: Discusses whether copyright text covers insertions, deletions, or language reserving rights.

11_2993.concept: 科学文本中的公式与结构标记
11_2993.description: 多数激活出现在科学文本的 LaTeX 数学公式中，偏向右侧定界符、希腊字母、积分微分及公式环境标记；另对凝聚态物理术语、邮件头字段和版权措辞有零星激活。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学环境中的右括号
patterns.context: 数学公式中，尤其是括号或定界符闭合处；常邻接公式、上下标或标点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv/科学论文数学排版；另见医学论文公式

patterns.name: 积分表达式及微分变量
patterns.context: 积分公式中，被积函数和积分微分符号附近；常处于公式行尾或对齐环境。

patterns.name: 公式标记与环境收尾
patterns.context: 显示公式的编号、引用标签或对齐环境收尾附近。

patterns.name: 希腊字母与参数公式
patterns.context: 数学公式中参数、函数或变量的符号表达；通常与定界符、上下标同现。

patterns.name: 物理术语 Fermi liquid
patterns.context: 讨论高态密度、费米能级和自旋磁化率的物理叙述段落。

patterns.name: 邮件标题与发件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件回复头部，后接主题、邮箱地址、姓名与日期。

patterns.name: 版权措辞及插入删节
patterns.context: 讨论版权文本是否涵盖插入、删节或保留权利措辞。
